{"headword":"accurate","explanation":"「accurate」在學測中極為高頻，特別是在描述科學實驗、數據分析、歷史紀錄或新聞報導時。它強調的是「精確且無誤」的狀態，與 precision 相關。","senses":[{"sense":"精確的；準確的","entries":[{"pattern":"accurate information / data","pos":"adjective","translation":"精確的資訊／數據","explanation":"常用於描述研究結果或事實陳述，強調內容完全符合事實。","sentences":[{"sentence":"To get an <target>accurate</target> result from the chemistry experiment, the students must measure the liquids very carefully with a glass tube.","translation":"為了從化學實驗中獲得精確的結果，學生們必須使用玻璃管非常小心地測量液體。"},{"sentence":"The journalist spent three months interviewing witnesses to ensure that the news report provided <target>accurate</target> information about the accident.","translation":"記者花三個月時間訪問證人，以確保新聞報導提供了關於該事故的準確資訊。"}]},{"pattern":"be accurate in sth.","pos":"adjective","translation":"在…方面很準確","explanation":"用來描述某人在特定技能或行為上的精確度。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The experienced archer was incredibly <target>accurate</target> <pattern>in</pattern> his shots, hitting the center of the target every single time.","translation":"那位經驗豐富的弓箭手在射擊方面非常準確，每次都能擊中目標的中心。"},{"sentence":"Despite her young age, the accountant was very <target>accurate</target> <pattern>in</pattern> her calculations, making no mistakes in the financial report.","translation":"儘管她年紀輕，但那位會計師在計算方面非常準確，在財務報告中沒有犯任何錯誤。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"precise","pos":"adjective","translation":"精確的","explanation":"強調極高的準確度，通常與量化數據相關。"},{"word":"exact","pos":"adjective","translation":"準確的；確切的","explanation":"強調與原件完全一致，沒有偏差。"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"inaccurate","pos":"adjective","translation":"不準確的","explanation":null},{"word":"incorrect","pos":"adjective","translation":"錯誤的","explanation":null}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 accur (正確) + 形容詞字尾 -ate","related":[{"word":"accuracy","pos":"noun","translation":"準確度","explanation":"由 accurate 延伸而來的名詞。"}]}}

{"headword":"adviser","explanation":"「adviser」在學測閱讀中常出現在政治、教育或企業管理類型的文章中，指代那些提供專業知識或建議的人。其拼寫方式可以是 adviser 或 advisor，兩者皆通用。","senses":[{"sense":"顧問；建議者（提供專業指引的人）","entries":[{"pattern":"an adviser on/to sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"關於某事的顧問／對某人的顧問","explanation":"介系詞 on 用於標註建議的專業領域，to 用於標註建議的對象（如政府或領導者）。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The prime minister hired a special <target>adviser</target> <pattern>on</pattern> environmental policy to help the country fight climate change.","translation":"總理聘請了一名環境政策方面的特別顧問，以幫助國家對抗氣候變遷。"},{"sentence":"Every college student is assigned an academic <target>advisor</target> <pattern>to</pattern> guide them through their course selection and graduation requirements.","translation":"每位大學生都被分配了一名學術顧問，以引導他們完成課程選擇和畢業要求。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"consultant","pos":"noun","translation":"顧問；諮詢專家","explanation":"通常指受聘的外部專業人員"},{"word":"mentor","pos":"noun","translation":"導師；良師益友","explanation":"強調提供長期、深層次的人生指引"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"動詞 advise + 行為者字尾 -er/-or","related":[{"word":"advice","pos":"noun","translation":"建議","explanation":"核心基礎名詞。"},{"word":"advisable","pos":"adjective","translation":"明智的","explanation":"形容詞型態。"}]}}

{"headword":"afford","explanation":"「afford」在學測中主要考查其「經濟能力」與「時間/機會」的語義。最關鍵的考點是它常與助動詞 can, could, be able to 搭配使用，且後接不定式 (to V)。","senses":[{"sense":"負擔得起（指金錢、時間或機會）","entries":[{"pattern":"can afford to do sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"能負擔得起做某事","explanation":"最高頻的用法，指金錢上能支付，或情況允許做某事。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After saving money for three years, the young couple could finally <target>afford</target> <pattern>to</pattern> buy a small apartment in the city.","translation":"儲蓄三年後，這對年輕夫婦終於能負擔得起在市區買一間小公寓。"},{"sentence":"I am so busy with my final exams that I cannot <target>afford</target> <pattern>to</pattern> waste any more time on video games.","translation":"我期末考壓力這麼大，以至於我不能承受浪費更多時間在電子遊戲上。"}]},{"pattern":"can afford sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"能買得起某物","explanation":"及物動詞，直接接名詞受詞，通常指金錢上的能力。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Even though he earns a high salary, he still cannot <target>afford</target> the expensive luxury car he saw in the showroom.","translation":"儘管他賺高薪，他仍然買不起他在展示間看到的那輛昂貴的豪華車。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"manage","pos":"verb","translation":"設法；勉強地","explanation":"強調在困難情況下成功完成某事"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"提供（較為正式，指提供機會或便利）","entries":[{"pattern":"afford sb. sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"給予某人某物","explanation":"常用於正式文本中，指提供抽象名詞如機會、保護或便利。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The new laws <target>afford</target> the citizens more protection <pattern>against</pattern> unfair treatment by the government.","translation":"新法律賦予了公民更多對抗政府不公平對待的保護。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"provide","pos":"verb","translation":"提供","explanation":"泛指提供所需之物"},{"word":"grant","pos":"verb","translation":"授予；給予","explanation":"正式地提供權利或機會"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"afforded","past_participle":"afforded"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 afford (提供、負擔)","related":[{"word":"affordable","pos":"adjective","translation":"可負擔得起的","explanation":"由動詞 afford 加上形容詞字尾 -able 延伸而來，常用於 affordable housing (可負擔住房)。"}]}}

{"headword":"afterward","explanation":"「afterward」與「afterwards」在語義上完全相同，後者在英式英語中更為普遍。在學測中，它主要作為連接副詞，用來標記時間順序，是寫作中增加文章連貫性的重要工具。","senses":[{"sense":"之後；隨後（在某件事發生之後）","entries":[{"pattern":"afterward","pos":"adverb","translation":"之後；隨後","explanation":"用來修飾整個句子或標記時間順序，通常位於句首或句末。","sentences":[{"sentence":"We spent the whole afternoon visiting the museum, and <target>afterward</target> we went to a quiet cafe to talk about it.","translation":"我們花了一整個下午參觀博物館，隨後我們去了一間安靜的咖啡廳討論這件事。"},{"sentence":"The scientist performed the experiment carefully, but <target>afterwards</target> he realized that he had made a small mistake in the data.","translation":"科學家仔細地進行了實驗，但隨後他意識到他在數據中犯了一個小錯誤。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"later","pos":"adverb","translation":"之後；較晚","explanation":"最普遍常用的時間副詞"},{"word":"subsequently","pos":"adverb","translation":"隨後；接著","explanation":"較正式的用法，強調事情發生的順序"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"beforehand","pos":"adverb","translation":"事先；提前","explanation":"指在事情發生之前就做好準備"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"介系詞 after + 副詞字尾 -ward","related":[{"word":"after","pos":"preposition","translation":"在...之後","explanation":"核心基礎詞彙。"},{"word":"forward","pos":"adverb","translation":"向前","explanation":"具有相似的 -ward 方向/時間副詞結構。"}]}}

{"headword":"agriculture","explanation":"「agriculture」在學測中常出現在環境保護、糧食安全與科技發展的閱讀文章中。理解這個字時，應關注其與 sustainable (永續的) 或 organic (有機的) 等形容詞的搭配，以及其作為產業 (industry) 的相關討論。","senses":[{"sense":"農業（種植作物與飼養牲畜的科學或實踐）","entries":[{"pattern":"agriculture","pos":"noun","translation":"農業","explanation":"指種植作物或飼養牲畜的整體實踐或科學。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Modern <target>agriculture</target> relies heavily on advanced machinery and chemical fertilizers to increase the amount of food produced for the growing population.","translation":"現代農業高度依賴先進的機械和化學肥料，以增加為日益增長的人口所生產的食物量。"},{"sentence":"The government is encouraging farmers to switch to organic <target>agriculture</target> to protect the soil and keep the environment clean.","translation":"政府正鼓勵農民轉向有機農業，以保護土壤並保持環境潔淨。"}]},{"pattern":"sustainable agriculture","pos":"noun","translation":"永續農業","explanation":"一種旨在長期維持生產力且不破壞生態的農業方式，是環境類文章的高頻詞組。","sentences":[{"sentence":"By using natural compost instead of chemicals, these farmers practice <pattern>sustainable</pattern> <target>agriculture</target> to ensure the land remains healthy for future generations.","translation":"透過使用天然堆肥而非化學藥劑，這些農民實踐永續農業，以確保土地在未來世代中依然健康。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"farming","pos":"noun","translation":"耕種；務農","explanation":"較為口語，指實際的農事工作"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 agri- (田地) + -culture (耕作/培養)","related":[{"word":"agricultural","pos":"adjective","translation":"農業的","explanation":"由 agriculture 加上形容詞字尾 -al 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"airline","explanation":"「airline」在旅遊、交通與全球化討論的文本中非常常見。通常與經營 (operate)、航線 (route) 或服務 (service) 等動詞搭配使用。","senses":[{"sense":"航空公司","entries":[{"pattern":"airline","pos":"noun","translation":"航空公司","explanation":"指經營飛機運輸服務的公司。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Due to the sudden heavy snowstorm in the city, the <target>airline</target> decided to cancel all flights for the safety of the passengers.","translation":"由於城市中突然發生的強烈雪暴，航空公司為了乘客的安全決定取消所有航班。"},{"sentence":"Many people prefer this <target>airline</target> because they provide more legroom and better food than other companies.","translation":"許多人偏好這家航空公司，因為他們提供的腿部空間比其他公司更多，食物也更好。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"alley","explanation":"「alley」通常出現在描述城市環境、社區生活或故事背景的描寫中。注意它與 street 或 road 的區別：alley 指的是較窄的巷弄。","senses":[{"sense":"小巷；巷弄","entries":[{"pattern":"alley","pos":"noun","translation":"小巷","explanation":"指兩側有建築物的狹窄道路。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The small coffee shop is hidden in a narrow <target>alley</target> and is only known to a few local residents.","translation":"那間小咖啡店隱藏在一個狹窄的小巷中，只有少數當地居民才知道。"},{"sentence":"A stray cat was sleeping quietly in the dark <target>alley</target> behind the old school building.","translation":"一隻流浪貓正安靜地睡在舊校舍後方陰暗的小巷裡。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"lane","pos":"noun","translation":"小巷；車道","explanation":"指較窄的道路，可用於鄉間小路或城市巷弄"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"almond","explanation":"「almond」在健康飲食或生物類文章中作為基礎名詞出現，通常與其顏色 (almond-colored) 或營養價值搭配。","senses":[{"sense":"杏仁","entries":[{"pattern":"almond","pos":"noun","translation":"杏仁","explanation":"指一種可食用堅果。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many people who cannot drink milk choose to use <target>almond</target> milk as a healthy and tasty alternative.","translation":"許多不能喝牛奶的人選擇使用杏仁奶作為一種健康且美味的替代品。"},{"sentence":"The baker added some crushed <target>almonds</target> to the top of the cake to give it a crunchy texture.","translation":"烘焙師在蛋糕頂端加入了一些碎杏仁，以賦予其酥脆的口感。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"alphabet","explanation":"「alphabet」在語言學、教育或文化討論中是基礎詞彙。注意它指的是「一整套字母表」，而非單個字母 (letter)。","senses":[{"sense":"字母表","entries":[{"pattern":"alphabet","pos":"noun","translation":"字母表","explanation":"指一種語言所使用的完整字母系統。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The teacher used a colorful poster to help the young children learn the English <target>alphabet</target> in a fun way.","translation":"老師使用一張色彩鮮豔的海報來幫助幼童以有趣的方式學習英文字母表。"},{"sentence":"Each language has its own <target>alphabet</target> and set of rules for how the letters should be pronounced.","translation":"每種語言都有自己的字母表以及關於字母應如何發音的一套規則。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"源自希臘文 alpha (第一個字母) + beta (第二個字母)","related":[]}}

{"headword":"amaze","explanation":"「amaze」在學測中常用於描述驚訝的程度，其強度高於 surprise。重點在於區分動詞形式與名詞 amazement 的用法，以及其被動語態（be amazed at/by）在描述情感反應時的極高頻率。","senses":[{"sense":"使驚訝；使驚嘆（程度極深，通常伴隨不可置信之感）","entries":[{"pattern":"amaze sb.","pos":"verb","translation":"使某人驚訝","explanation":"及物動詞直接接受詞，描述某事或某人給予對方強烈的視覺或情感衝擊。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The magician's ability to make a giant elephant disappear in a second <target>amazed</target> everyone in the crowded theater.","translation":"魔術師在短短一秒內讓一頭大象消失的能力，讓劇院裡的所有人都感到驚訝。"}]},{"pattern":"be amazed at/by sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"對某事感到驚訝","explanation":"被動結構，用來表達主詞對某個現象或能力感到驚嘆。at 或 by 均可使用。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Visitors to the Great Wall of China are often <target>amazed</target> <pattern>at</pattern> the sheer scale and beauty of the ancient structure.","translation":"來到中國長城的遊客經常對這座古代建築的巨大規模與美感感到驚嘆。"},{"sentence":"The teachers were <target>amazed</target> <pattern>by</pattern> the student's creative ideas for solving the local environmental pollution problem.","translation":"老師們對該學生解決當地環境污染問題的創意想法感到驚訝。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"astonish","pos":"verb","translation":"使大吃一驚","explanation":"語氣比 amaze 更強，強調完全不可置信"},{"word":"surprise","pos":"verb","translation":"使驚訝","explanation":"最通用且程度最輕的驚訝"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"bore","pos":"verb","translation":"使厭煩","explanation":null}]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"amazed","past_participle":"amazed"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 amaze (驚訝) + 名詞字尾 -ment","related":[{"word":"amazement","pos":"noun","translation":"驚訝；驚嘆","explanation":"由動詞 amaze 延伸而來，常用於 to one's amazement (令某人驚訝的是)。"},{"word":"amazing","pos":"adjective","translation":"令人驚訝的；太棒的","explanation":"描述事物本身具有令人驚訝的特徵。"}]}}

{"headword":"ambassador","explanation":"「ambassador」在學測閱讀中常出現在外交、國際關係或品牌推廣的語境中。除了指政府派出的「大使」，在現代商業語境中常指「品牌大使」，用來代表特定組織或產品進行宣傳。","senses":[{"sense":"大使；代表（官方代表或品牌代言人）","entries":[{"pattern":"an ambassador to [country]","pos":"noun","translation":"派駐於某國的大使","explanation":"使用介系詞 to 表示派遣的目的地。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The newly appointed <target>ambassador</target> <pattern>to</pattern> France worked hard to improve the trade relationship between the two nations.","translation":"新任命的法國大使努力改善兩國之間的貿易關係。"}]},{"pattern":"a brand ambassador","pos":"noun","translation":"品牌大使；代言人","explanation":"指被公司聘請來增加產品知名度或提升品牌形象的名人或專業人士。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The famous basketball player was chosen as a <target>brand ambassador</target> because his healthy lifestyle matches the company's image.","translation":"這名著名的籃球員被選為品牌大使，因為他健康的生活方式符合公司的形象。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"representative","pos":"noun","translation":"代表","explanation":"較為泛用的代表稱呼"},{"word":"envoy","pos":"noun","translation":"使節；特使","explanation":"較正式且通常指臨時性的外交代表"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"ambition","explanation":"「ambition」在描述人物特質、職業規劃或社會成功時是高頻詞彙。注意它在句中可作主詞或受詞，且常與 achieve, pursue 或 lack 搭配。","senses":[{"sense":"雄心；抱負；野心（強烈想要成功的渴望）","entries":[{"pattern":"have the ambition to do sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"有志於做某事","explanation":"後接不定詞，描述一個人內心強烈的目標或渴望。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Despite growing up in a poor village, the young girl had the <target>ambition</target> <pattern>to</pattern> become a world-class doctor.","translation":"儘管在一個貧困的村莊長大，這個年輕女孩有志於成為一名世界級的醫生。"}]},{"pattern":"pursue one's ambition","pos":"noun","translation":"追求某人的抱負","explanation":"常用動詞 pursue 表示對目標的持續追求。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many students leave their hometowns after graduation to <target>pursue</target> their <pattern>ambitions</pattern> in the big city.","translation":"許多學生畢業後離開家鄉，前往大城市追求他們的抱負。"}]},{"pattern":"lack ambition","pos":"noun","translation":"缺乏抱負","explanation":"常用於描述一個人缺乏動力或對未來沒有明確目標。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The manager complained that his new employee seemed to <target>lack</target> <pattern>ambition</pattern>, as he never tried to improve his skills.","translation":"經理抱怨他的新員工似乎缺乏抱負，因為他從未嘗試提升自己的技能。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"aspiration","pos":"noun","translation":"志向；抱負","explanation":"較為正面且較高的目標"},{"word":"drive","pos":"noun","translation":"動力；積極性","explanation":"強調達成目標的內在推動力"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"apathy","pos":"noun","translation":"冷漠；缺乏興趣","explanation":null}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 ambition (抱負) + 形容詞字尾 -ious","related":[{"word":"ambitious","pos":"adjective","translation":"有野心的；雄心勃勃的","explanation":"描述一個人渴望權力、金錢或成功的特質。"}]}}

{"headword":"ambulance","explanation":"「ambulance」是基礎生活詞彙，常出現在醫療急救或意外事故的閱讀情境中。重點在於其搭配的動詞（如 call 或 arrive）。","senses":[{"sense":"救護車","entries":[{"pattern":"call an ambulance","pos":"noun","translation":"叫救護車","explanation":"最常用的動詞搭配。","sentences":[{"sentence":"When the old man suddenly collapsed on the street, a kind stranger quickly <target>called</target> <pattern>an ambulance</pattern> for him.","translation":"當那位老人突然在街上昏倒時，一位好心的陌生人迅速地為他叫了救護車。"}]},{"pattern":"an ambulance arrives","pos":"noun","translation":"救護車到達","explanation":"描述急救過程中的時間順序。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The crowd stood back to make a clear path so that the <target>ambulance</target> could <pattern>arrive</pattern> at the scene more quickly.","translation":"人群向後退，以便救護車能更快速地到達現場。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"angel","explanation":"「angel」在文學、藝術或隱喻語境中較為常見。除了指宗教上的「天使」，在日常描述中常用來指代那些善良、溫柔且樂於助人的好人。","senses":[{"sense":"天使；極其善良的人","entries":[{"pattern":"be an angel","pos":"noun","translation":"像天使一樣（極其善良）","explanation":"用來形容一個人非常溫柔或在關鍵時刻提供了巨大的幫助。","sentences":[{"sentence":"My sister has been a total <target>angel</target> while I was sick, taking care of all my meals and cleaning the room.","translation":"在我生病期間，我姐姐完全像個天使，幫我準備所有的餐點並清理房間。"},{"sentence":"The nurse was an absolute <target>angel</target> during my hospital stay, always speaking softly and making me feel safe.","translation":"那名護士在我住院期間完全是一個天使，總是溫柔地說話並讓我感到安心。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"saint","pos":"noun","translation":"聖人","explanation":"強調道德水準極高且忍耐力強"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"devil","pos":"noun","translation":"惡魔","explanation":"指性格惡劣或造成傷害的人"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

for）會決定其具體含義，這是克漏字中極為關鍵的考點。","senses":[{"sense":"吸引力；呼籲/請求（對某人產生興趣或請求幫助）","entries":[{"pattern":"appeal to <pattern>to</pattern> young buyers who care about the environment.","translation":"這款新電動車的現代設計吸引了那些在意環境的年輕買家。"}]},{"pattern":"make an appeal for sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"呼籲/請求某事","explanation":"將 appeal 用作名詞，搭配 make an appeal for，用來正式地請求幫助、金錢或資訊。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After the terrible earthquake, the local government made an urgent <target>appeal</target> <pattern>for</pattern> food and medical supplies.","translation":"在可怕的地震之後，當地政府緊急呼籲提供食物和醫療用品。"}]},{"pattern":"have {"headword":"athlete","explanation":"「athlete」在學測中常用於描述個人紀律、身體健康以及運動精神等主題。注意其與 sports player 的區別：athlete 更強調身體素質的訓練與競賽，而 player 則常用於球類運動。","senses":[{"sense":"運動員（經過訓練且擅長體育競賽的人）","entries":[{"pattern":"athlete","pos":"noun","translation":"運動員","explanation":"指在體育競賽中表現卓越的人，可用於各種運動類別。","sentences":[{"sentence":"To maintain a top level of performance, professional <target>athletes</target> must follow a strict diet and exercise every single day.","translation":"為了維持頂尖的表現，職業運動員必須遵循嚴格的飲食並每天進行運動。"},{"sentence":"The young <target>athlete</target> felt incredibly proud when she finally won the gold medal after years of hard training.","translation":"那名年輕的運動員在經過多年的刻苦訓練後，終於贏得金牌，感到無比自豪。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"sportsman","pos":"noun","translation":"運動員","explanation":"較傳統的稱呼，指參與體育活動的人"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 athl- (競賽) + 字尾 -ete (人)","related":[{"word":"athletic","pos":"adjective","translation":"運動的；體格強健的","explanation":"由名詞 athlete 轉化而來，描述人的身體素質或運動相關事物。"},{"word":"athletics","pos":"noun","translation":"田徑運動","explanation":"指特定的跑、跳、投擲類運動。"}]}}

{"headword":"attitude","explanation":"「attitude」在學測閱讀中頻繁出現，通常用於探討心理狀態、對待事物的看法或社會態度。理解這個字時，應關注其後方常接的介系詞 to 或 toward(s)，用以標記對象。","senses":[{"sense":"態度；看法（對人或事的心理反應或觀點）","entries":[{"pattern":"attitude toward(s) sth./sb.","pos":"noun","translation":"對…的態度／看法","explanation":"最常見的搭配，用來描述一個人對特定議題或對象的心理傾向。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many older people have a negative <target>attitude</target> <pattern>toward</pattern> using new digital tools, such as smartphones and tablets.","translation":"許多年長者對使用新的數位工具（如智慧型手機和平板電腦）持有負面態度。"},{"sentence":"The teacher praised the student for having a positive <target>attitude</target> <pattern>toward</pattern> learning, which helped her improve her grades quickly.","translation":"老師稱讚這名學生對學習持有積極的態度，這幫助她快速提升了成績。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"mindset","pos":"noun","translation":"心態；思維模式","explanation":"強調長期形成的思考方式"},{"word":"perspective","pos":"noun","translation":"觀點；視角","explanation":"看事情的角度"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 att- (朝向) + 字尾 -itude (狀態)","related":[{"word":"attitudinal","pos":"adjective","translation":"態度的","explanation":"由名詞 attitude 轉化而來的形容詞形態。"}]}}

{"headword":"attract","explanation":"「attract」的核心概念是「吸引」。在學測中，它不僅指物理上的吸引（如磁鐵或昆蟲），也常用於描述吸引注意力、吸引投資或吸引遊客等抽象情境。","senses":[{"sense":"吸引（引起注意力、興趣或使人靠近）","entries":[{"pattern":"attract sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"吸引某事","explanation":"及物動詞，受詞通常是 attention (注意力) 或 interest (興趣)。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The colorful flowers in the garden <target>attract</target> many bees and butterflies during the warm spring months.","translation":"花園裡色彩鮮豔的花朵在溫暖的春季吸引了許多蜜蜂和蝴蝶。"},{"sentence":"The new shopping mall tried to <target>attract</target> more visitors by offering big discounts and free gift bags.","translation":"這座新購物中心試圖透過提供大幅折扣和免費禮品袋來吸引更多訪客。"}]},{"pattern":"attract attention","pos":"verb","translation":"吸引注意力","explanation":"極高頻的固定搭配，用於描述某物因其特徵而被人注意到。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The loud noise coming from the old house <target>attracted</target> the <pattern>attention</pattern> of everyone walking down the street.","translation":"從舊房子裡傳出的巨大噪音吸引了街道上每個行人的注意力。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"draw","pos":"verb","translation":"吸引","explanation":"常用於 draw attention 或 draw interest"},{"word":"allure","pos":"verb","translation":"誘惑；吸引","explanation":"語氣較強，強調吸引力來自於魅力或誘惑"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"repel","pos":"verb","translation":"排斥；驅除","explanation":"與 attract 相對，指物理上的排斥或心理上的反感"}]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"attracted","past_participle":"attracted"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字首 ad- (朝向) + 字根 tract (拉)","related":[{"word":"attraction","pos":"noun","translation":"吸引力；景點","explanation":"由動詞 attract 加上名詞字尾 -tion 延伸而來。"},{"word":"attractive","pos":"adjective","translation":"有吸引力的","explanation":"由動詞 attract 加上形容詞字尾 -ive 延伸而來。"},{"word":"distract","pos":"verb","translation":"分心；分散注意力","explanation":"字首 dis- (分開) + 字根 tract (拉)，意為將注意力拉開。"}]}}

{"headword":"attractive","explanation":"「attractive」常用於描述外貌、方案或機會。在學測中，學生應注意其與 appealing 的 近義關係，以及它在描述非人物體（如工作機會或價格）時的意義。","senses":[{"sense":"有吸引力的（外貌出眾或條件優越）","entries":[{"pattern":"attractive","pos":"adjective","translation":"有吸引力的；迷人的","explanation":"可用於描述人、物或抽象的提案/價格。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The company offered him an <target>attractive</target> salary and a private office, so he decided to join their team.","translation":"公司為他提供了有吸引力的薪水和私人辦公室，因此他決定加入他們的團隊。"},{"sentence":"The small village in the mountains is very <target>attractive</target> because of its clean air and beautiful green forests.","translation":"山中的那個小村莊因為其清新空氣和美麗的綠色森林而非常有吸引力。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"appealing","pos":"adjective","translation":"吸引人的；有魅力的","explanation":"強調讓人感到愉悅或感興趣"},{"word":"charming","pos":"adjective","translation":"迷人的","explanation":"通常指外貌或性格上的魅力"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"unattractive","pos":"adjective","translation":"無吸引力的；醜陋的","explanation":null},{"word":"repulsive","pos":"adjective","translation":"令人厭惡的","explanation":"語氣強烈，指極其醜陋或令人反感"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"動詞 attract 加上形容詞字尾 -ive","related":[{"word":"attractiveness","pos":"noun","translation":"吸引力","explanation":"由形容詞 attractive 加上名詞字尾 -ness 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"audience","explanation":"「audience」在學測中主要出現在演出、演講或數位媒體的語境中。注意其單複數用法：它可以被視為一個整體（單數）或指個體（複數），但在大多數基礎學測題目中，視為單數集合名詞。","senses":[{"sense":"觀眾；聽眾（在演出、演講或作品前的人群）","entries":[{"pattern":"audience","pos":"noun","translation":"觀眾；聽眾","explanation":"指在現場觀看演出或聆聽演講的人，也可用於指閱讀某本書或目標受眾。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The speaker told a funny joke at the start of his talk, which immediately <target>audience</target> gained the attention of the audience.","translation":"演講者在演講開始時講了一個有趣的笑話，立即吸引了聽眾的注意力。"},{"sentence":"The movie was so boring that half of the <target>audience</target> left the theater before the story ended.","translation":"這部電影太無聊了，以至於一半的觀眾在故事結束前就離開了電影院。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"spectators","pos":"noun","translation":"觀眾","explanation":"特別指在體育場館觀看運動賽事的人"},{"word":"listeners","pos":"noun","translation":"聽眾","explanation":"強調聆聽的人"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 aud- (聽) + 字尾 -ience (狀態/集體)","related":[{"word":"audio","pos":"noun","translation":"音訊；聲音","explanation":"與聽覺相關的基礎詞彙。"},{"word":"audible","pos":"adjective","translation":"可聽見的","explanation":"由字根 aud- 延伸而來。"},{"word":"audit","pos":"verb","translation":"審核；查帳","explanation":"字面意為透過聽取報告來核對帳目。"}]}}

{"headword":"automatic","explanation":"「automatic」在學測中常用於描述科技產品、人為反應或生物本能。要注意它不僅指「自動的」機器，還常用於描述一種無需意識思考的「下意識」反應，這在心理學或生物學類文章中極為常見。","senses":[{"sense":"自動的；無需人為操作的（由機器或系統自動執行）","entries":[{"pattern":"automatic transmission","pos":"adjective","translation":"自動排檔","explanation":"汽車工業的專用術語，指無需手動換檔的系統。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Most modern cars come with an <target>automatic</target> <pattern>transmission</pattern>, making them much easier for new drivers to operate in heavy city traffic.","translation":"大多數現代汽車都配有自動排檔，使新駕駛在繁忙的城市交通中操作起來容易得多。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 auto (自動/自我) + 字尾 -matic (形容詞字尾)","related":[{"word":"automatically","pos":"adverb","translation":"自動地；下意識地","explanation":"由 automatic 加上副詞字尾 -ly 延伸而來。"},{"word":"automation","pos":"noun","translation":"自動化","explanation":"由 automatic 延伸而來的名詞，指將生產過程自動化的狀態。"}]}}

{"headword":"automobile","explanation":"「automobile」是「car」的正式書面用語，在學測的閱讀測驗中，尤其是探討交通運輸或工業發展的文章中，會比 car 更常出現。其縮寫形式「auto」在美式英語中亦十分普遍。","senses":[{"sense":"汽車","entries":[{"pattern":"automobile","pos":"noun","translation":"汽車","explanation":"指四輪的機動車輛，書面語體。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The invention of the <target>automobile</target> completely changed how people travel, allowing them to move between cities faster than ever before.","translation":"汽車的發明完全改變了人們旅行的方式，讓他們能比以往更快地在城市之間移動。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 auto (自我) + mobile (移動)","related":[{"word":"mobile","pos":"adjective","translation":"可移動的；行動的","explanation":"指可以輕鬆移動的物體或狀態。"}]}}

{"headword":"avenue","explanation":"「avenue」在城市地理描述中常指「大道」。在抽象用法中，它可以用來比喻「途徑」或「方法」，這是學測高階閱讀中經常出現的隱喻用法，學生應將其與 path 或 way 同義。","senses":[{"sense":"大道；林蔭大道（通常指寬闊且兩側有樹木的街道）","entries":[{"pattern":"avenue","pos":"noun","translation":"大道","explanation":"指城市中較寬的街道，常作為路名的一部分。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The tourists walked slowly down the wide <target>avenue</target>, admiring the beautiful rows of green trees lining both sides of the street.","translation":"遊客們緩慢地走在寬闊的大道上，欣賞著街道兩側成排的美麗綠樹。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"awake","explanation":"「awake」既可作為形容詞也可作為動詞。作為形容詞時，它描述一種「清醒」的狀態；作為動詞時，它指「從睡眠中醒來」。在學測中，要注意其形容詞用法常置於系動詞之後（如 stay awake），而動詞用法則常與 awaken 混淆。","senses":[{"sense":"清醒的；未睡眠的（形容詞狀態）","entries":[{"pattern":"stay awake","pos":"adjective","translation":"保持清醒","explanation":"常用於描述熬夜學習或在疲憊時強迫自己不睡覺的情況。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After drinking three cups of strong coffee, the exhausted student tried to <pattern>stay</pattern> <target>awake</target> to finish his final project before dawn.","translation":"在喝了三杯濃咖啡後，疲憊的學生試圖保持清醒，以便在黎明前完成他的期末專案。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"awoke","past_participle":"awoken"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"awaken","pos":"verb","translation":"喚醒；覺醒","explanation":"比 awake 更正式的動詞形式。"}]}}

{"headword":"awaken","explanation":"「awaken」是一個正式的動詞，除了指生理上的「喚醒」，在學測中更常出現於描述心理上的「覺醒」或「喚起」某種情感（如興趣、好奇心）。這種抽象用法是閱讀測驗中高頻的考點。","senses":[{"sense":"喚醒；使覺醒（生理或心理上的喚醒）","entries":[{"pattern":"awaken to sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"意識到…；覺醒於…","explanation":"指突然意識到某個現實或問題，常用於社會議題或個人成長類文章。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many people have finally <target>awoken</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the dangers of climate change and have started to reduce their plastic waste.","translation":"許多人終於意識到了氣候變遷的危險，並開始減少他們使用塑料垃圾。"}]},{"pattern":"awaken sb.'s curiosity/interest","pos":"verb","translation":"喚起某人的好奇心／興趣","explanation":"指激發出某種潛在的情感或興趣。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The mysterious old book in the library <target>awakened</target> the young boy's <pattern>curiosity</pattern> about ancient Egyptian history.","translation":"圖書館裡那本神秘的舊書喚起了那個小男孩對古埃及歷史的好奇心。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"awakened","past_participle":"awakened"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"awake","pos":"verb","translation":"醒來","explanation":"較口語且直接的生理醒來。"}]}}

{"headword":"award","explanation":"「award」在學測中常作為名詞（獎項）與動詞（頒獎、授予）。其核心概念是「正式地給予某物（通常是榮譽或金錢）」。要注意區分它與 prize 的不同：award 通常強調正式的評審過程或法律上的裁定。","senses":[{"sense":"獎項；獎勵（正式授予的榮譽或金錢）","entries":[{"pattern":"win an award","pos":"noun","translation":"贏得獎項","explanation":"最常見的搭配，指透過競爭或成就獲得正式的認可。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After months of hard work on her science project, the student was thrilled to <pattern>win</pattern> an <target>award</target> for her innovative research.","translation":"在科學專案上努力數月後，這名學生對能贏得其創新研究的獎項感到欣喜若狂。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"awarded","past_participle":"awarded"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 award (授予)","related":[{"word":"awardee","pos":"noun","translation":"獲獎者","explanation":"由 award 加上受詞字尾 -ee 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"aware","explanation":"「aware」是一個極高頻的形容詞，核心意義為「意識到」或「察覺到」。在學測中，最關鍵的考點在於其固定搭配介系詞 of，以及它在否定句中表示「不自覺」的用法。","senses":[{"sense":"意識到；察覺到（對某事有認知或知情）","entries":[{"pattern":"be aware of sth.","pos":"adjective","translation":"意識到某事","explanation":"最核心的用法，of 後方接名詞或動名詞。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many people are not <target>aware</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the long-term damage that plastic waste causes to the deep ocean environment.","translation":"許多人並未意識到塑料廢物對深海環境所造成的長期損害。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 aware (覺醒、意識)","related":[{"word":"awareness","pos":"noun","translation":"意識；覺悟","explanation":"由形容詞 aware 加上名詞字尾 -ness 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"awful","explanation":"「awful」在口語與閱讀中常用於表達「極其糟糕」的負面感受。雖然在古英語中曾有「令人敬畏」之意，但在現代學測語境中，幾乎全部是指「可怕的」或「糟糕的」。","senses":[{"sense":"可怕的；糟糕的（令人不快或品質低劣）","entries":[{"pattern":"awful","pos":"adjective","translation":"糟糕的；可怕的","explanation":"直接修飾名詞或作補語，描述心情、天氣、氣味或品質。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The weather during our school camping trip was <target>awful</target>, with heavy rain and strong winds that lasted for three whole days.","translation":"我們學校露營旅行期間的天氣非常糟糕，連續三整天都有大雨和強風。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 awe (敬畏) + 字尾 -ful (充滿)","related":[{"word":"awfully","pos":"adverb","translation":"非常；糟糕地","explanation":"可用作程度副詞，類似於 very。"}]}}

{"headword":"awkward","explanation":"「awkward」在學測中常用於描述「社交上的尷尬」或「物理上的笨拙」。理解這個字的關鍵在於區分這兩種情境：一種是心理上的不自在，一種是身體上的不協調。","senses":[{"sense":"尷尬的；不自在的（社交情境中的不適感）","entries":[{"pattern":"awkward","pos":"adjective","translation":"尷尬的","explanation":"描述人在社交場合中感到不自然或不知如何反應。","sentences":[{"sentence":"There was an <target>awkward</target> silence in the room after the student accidentally called his teacher by a nickname instead of her official name.","translation":"在那名學生不小心用綽號而不是正式名稱稱呼老師後，房間裡陷入了一陣尷尬的沉默。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"background","explanation":"「background」在學測中具有具體與抽象兩種核心義項。具體義項是指視覺上的「背景」，抽象義項是指一個人的「家庭背景」或「教育背景」。","senses":[{"sense":"背景；底色（視覺上的後方區域）","entries":[{"pattern":"in the background","pos":"noun","translation":"在背景中","explanation":"指在照片或畫作中位於後方的部分。","sentences":[{"sentence":"If you look closely at the old photograph, you can see a small, blurry mountain <target>background</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the distance.","translation":"如果你仔細看那張舊照片，你可以在遠處看到一個模糊的小山背景。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 back (後) + ground (地)","related":[{"word":"backgrounder","pos":"noun","translation":"背景資料","explanation":"指提供給記者或大眾的詳細背景說明。"}]}}

{"headword":"bacon","explanation":"「bacon」在學測中通常出現在生活化、日常飲食的閱讀或聽力測驗中。雖然它是基礎單字，但要注意它在口語中常與 a slice of 或 crispy 作為形容詞修飾，用以增加場景的具體感。","senses":[{"sense":"培根；煙燻豬背肉","entries":[{"pattern":"bacon","pos":"noun","translation":"培根","explanation":"指經過煙燻或鹽漬的豬肉，通常作為早餐或配料。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The smell of crispy <target>bacon</target> frying in the pan woke me up early on Sunday morning, making me feel hungry.","translation":"鍋中煎培根的香氣在週日早晨將我喚醒，讓我感到飢餓。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"besides","explanation":"「besides」在學測中常被考查其作為介系詞（除了…之外還）與副詞（此外）的區分，學生容易與 beside (在…旁邊) 混淆。核心在於 besides 具有「附加」或「更重要的是」的語義，而 beside 僅指空間位置。","senses":[{"sense":"除此之外；此外（作為副詞，用來增加資訊）","entries":[{"pattern":"besides","pos":"adverb","translation":"此外；而且","explanation":"通常位於句首或句中，用來補充說明理由或增加論點。","sentences":[{"sentence":"I don't think we should go hiking this weekend because the weather is terrible; <target>besides</target>, I have too much homework to finish.","translation":"我不認為我們這個週末應該去登山，因為天氣很糟糕；此外，我還有太多作業要完成。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"除了…之外（還） (作為介系詞，表示附加)","entries":[{"pattern":"besides sth./sb.","pos":"preposition","translation":"除了…之外（還）","explanation":"指在原有之上再增加。等同於 in addition to。注意與 beside (在…旁邊) 的區別。","sentences":[{"sentence":"<target>Besides</target> <pattern>learning</pattern> English, the school encourages students to participate in sports to develop their physical health.","translation":"除了學習英語之外，學校還鼓勵學生參加體育活動以增進身體健康。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"除了…之外（不） (較少見，但用於特定否定句中)","entries":[{"pattern":"besides sth./sb.","pos":"noun","translation":"除了…之外（不）","explanation":"指除了某人之外，沒有其他人。","sentences":[{"sentence":"There was no one in the room <target>besides</target> <pattern>me</pattern>, so I had to spend the entire afternoon in complete silence.","translation":"房間裡除了我之外沒有其他人，所以我不得不花整個下午在完全的寂靜中度過。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"由 beside (在…旁邊) 加上字尾 -s 演變而來，語義從空間上的「在旁邊」延伸到邏輯上的「附加」。","related":[{"word":"beside","pos":"preposition","translation":"在…旁邊","explanation":"除了 besides 之外，最常用的基礎介系詞。"}]}}

{"headword":"bleed","explanation":"「bleed」在學測中除了基本的「流血」外，還常出現在描述色彩滲透或財務損失的隱喻語境中。注意其不規則動詞變化，以及在不同情境下（如醫療、藝術或經濟）的翻譯差異。","senses":[{"sense":"流血；滲出（液體從傷口或容器中流出）","entries":[{"pattern":"bleed","pos":"verb","translation":"流血；滲出","explanation":"及物或不及物動詞，指血液或液體從身體或物體中流出。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After accidentally cutting his finger with a sharp kitchen knife, the young cook saw his finger <target>bleed</target> for several minutes.","translation":"在不小心用鋒利的廚房刀切到手指後，年輕的廚師看到他的手指流血了好幾分鐘。"},{"sentence":"The old pipe in the basement had a small leak, causing water to <target>bleed</target> slowly through the cracks in the concrete wall.","translation":"地下室的舊水管有個小漏洞，導致水分緩慢地從混凝土牆的裂縫中滲出。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"hemorrhage","pos":"verb","translation":"大出血","explanation":"醫療術語，指血液大量流出"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"（顏色）滲透；（資金）流失","entries":[{"pattern":"bleed into sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"滲透到…；融合到…","explanation":"描述顏色、聲音或概念逐漸地與另一部分融合在一起。","sentences":[{"sentence":"In the beautiful sunset, the deep orange colors <target>bleed</target> <pattern>into</pattern> the soft purple of the evening sky.","translation":"在美麗的日落中，深橙色滲透（融合）到了傍晚天空的柔紫色中。"}]},{"pattern":"bleed sth. dry","pos":"verb","translation":"榨乾…；使…資金枯竭","explanation":"隱喻用法，指透過高額費用或貪婪地將某人的錢財榨乾。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The corrupt government used high taxes to <target>bleed</target> the poor citizens <pattern>dry</pattern>, leaving them with almost no money for food.","translation":"腐敗的政府利用高稅金將貧困公民榨乾，使他們幾乎沒有錢買食物。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"drain","pos":"verb","translation":"排乾；耗盡","explanation":"指將液體或資源（如錢財、精力）完全排空"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"bled","past_participle":"bled"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"bleeding","pos":"adjective","translation":"流血的","explanation":"bleed 的現在分詞形式，作形容詞使用。"}]}}

{"headword":"bless","explanation":"「bless」的核心概念是「神聖化」或「賦予好運」。在學測中，它常出現在宗教背景、文學作品或日常社交禮儀（如祝福語）中。","senses":[{"sense":"祝福；祈求好運","entries":[{"pattern":"bless sb.","pos":"verb","translation":"祝福某人","explanation":"及物動詞，指祈求神靈或上天給予某人平安、幸福或成功。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Before the students left for their final exams, the teacher <target>blessed</target> them with a warm smile and a wish for success.","translation":"在學生們離開去參加期末考之前，老師帶著溫暖的笑容祝福他們成功。"}]},{"pattern":"be blessed with sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"天賦於…；幸運擁有…","explanation":"常用被動態，指天生就擁有某種才華、資源或良好特徵。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The coastal city is <target>blessed</target> <pattern>with</pattern> a warm climate and beautiful beaches, attracting millions of tourists every year.","translation":"這座沿海城市幸運地擁有溫暖的氣候和美麗的海灘，每年吸引數百萬名遊客。"},{"sentence":"She was <target>blessed</target> <pattern>with</pattern> a natural talent for painting, allowing her to create amazing art without much formal training.","translation":"她天賦於繪畫，使她不必經過太多正式訓練就能創作出令人驚嘆的藝術品。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"sanctify","pos":"verb","translation":"使神聖","explanation":"強調宗教上的神聖化"},{"word":"consecrate","pos":"verb","translation":"祝聖","explanation":"指將某物奉獻給神"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"curse","pos":"verb","translation":"詛咒","explanation":"與 bless 相反，指祈求不幸"}]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"blessed","past_participle":"blessed"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"blessing","pos":"noun","translation":"祝福；幸運的事","explanation":"由 bless 加上名詞字尾 -ing 延伸而來。"},{"word":"bliss","pos":"noun","translation":"極樂；極大的幸福","explanation":"與 bless 同源，指達到最高境界的幸福。"}]}}
