{"headword":"bomb","explanation":"「bomb」在學測中既可作為名詞表示「炸彈」，也可作為動詞表示「轟炸」。此外，在非正式語境中，它還可以用來描述某事「徹底失敗」。理解其物理破壞與抽象失敗的對比是掌握此字的關鍵。","senses":[{"sense":"炸彈（物理上的爆炸裝置）","entries":[{"pattern":"bomb","pos":"noun","translation":"炸彈","explanation":"指引起爆炸的裝置，常出現在歷史、戰爭或新聞類文章中。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The soldiers carefully removed the old <target>bomb</target> from the battlefield to prevent any further danger to the local civilians.","translation":"士兵們小心地從戰場上移除了舊炸彈，以防止對當地平民造成進一步的危險。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"轟炸；炸毀（使用炸彈攻擊）","entries":[{"pattern":"bomb sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"轟炸某處","explanation":"及物動詞，指利用航空或遠程手段對特定目標進行大規模破壞。","sentences":[{"sentence":"During the war, the enemy aircraft began to <target>bomb</target> the city's main harbor to destroy the ships and stop the supply of food.","translation":"戰爭期間，敵軍飛機開始轟炸城市的Глав港口，以摧毀船隻並停止食物供應。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"徹底失敗（非正式用法，常用於表演或企劃）","entries":[{"pattern":"bomb","pos":"verb","translation":"慘敗；徹底失敗","explanation":"指某項表演、考試或企劃完全沒有得到預期的成功，是口語中常見的用法。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The comedian tried his best to tell a funny story, but the joke <target>bombed</target> completely because the audience did not understand it.","translation":"那位喜劇演員盡力地講一個有趣的故事，但那個笑話徹底失敗了，因為觀眾完全不明白。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"bombed","past_participle":"bombed"},"relatives":{"morphology":"單一形態，但在現代英語中作為爆炸裝置的代稱","related":[{"word":"bombard","pos":"verb","translation":"轟炸；連續攻擊","explanation":"指持續不斷地發射砲彈或大量投擲問題/資訊。"}]}}

{"headword":"bookcase","explanation":"「bookcase」是一個基礎生活類名詞，指用來存放書籍的家具。在描述房間佈局或家庭環境時常出現。","senses":[{"sense":"書櫃","entries":[{"pattern":"bookcase","pos":"noun","translation":"書櫃","explanation":"由 book (書) 與 case (箱/櫃) 組成的複合詞。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The professor has a massive wooden <target>bookcase</target> in his study, which is filled with thousands of old history books from around the world.","translation":"教授在他的書房裡有一個巨大的木製書櫃，裡面裝滿了來自世界各地數千本古老的歷史書。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"book (書) + case (櫃/殼)","related":[{"word":"bookshelf","pos":"noun","translation":"書架","explanation":"指單層或較簡單的書架，而 bookcase 通常指帶有框架的完整櫃體。"}]}}

{"headword":"boot","explanation":"「boot」在學測中具有多重含義。名詞方面，除了最常見的「靴子」外，在英式英語中還指汽車的「後車廂」。動詞方面，則常用於「踢出」或電腦術語中的「啟動」。","senses":[{"sense":"靴子（足部保護裝備）","entries":[{"pattern":"boot","pos":"noun","translation":"靴子","explanation":"指覆蓋腳踝以上的鞋類。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Because it was raining heavily and the ground was muddy, the hiker decided to wear waterproof <target>boots</target> to keep his feet dry.","translation":"因為雨下得很大且地面泥濘，登山客決定穿防水靴子以保持雙腳乾爽。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"後車廂（英式英語用法）","entries":[{"pattern":"the boot of a car","pos":"noun","translation":"汽車後車廂","explanation":"在英式英語中，boot 等同於美式英語的 trunk。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After we finished shopping for the party, my father helped me put all the heavy grocery bags into the <target>boot</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the car.","translation":"我們為派對採購完畢後，我父親幫我將所有沉重的雜貨袋放入汽車後車廂中。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"踢出；啟動（動作）","entries":[{"pattern":"boot sb. out of sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"將某人踢出（某處/某組織）","explanation":"非正式用法，指強迫某人離開或將其除名。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The lazy employee was <target>booted</target> <pattern>out of</pattern> the company after he was caught stealing money from the office safe.","translation":"這名懶散的員工在被發現從辦公室保險箱偷錢後，被公司開除（踢出）了。"}]},{"pattern":"boot up","pos":"verb","translation":"啟動（電腦）","explanation":"指電腦從電源開啟到進入操作系統的過程。","sentences":[{"sentence":"It takes several minutes for the old laptop to <target>boot</target> <pattern>up</pattern> because it has too many programs running at the same time.","translation":"這台舊筆記型電腦需要好幾分鐘才能啟動，因為它同時運行了太多程序。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"booted","past_participle":"booted"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"bore","explanation":"「bore」是一個極具挑戰性的字，因為它既是 bear (忍受/生育) 的過去式，也是一個獨立的動詞（使厭煩）和名詞（乏味的人）。學生必須根據上下文判定其身分。","senses":[{"sense":"使厭煩（讓某人感到無聊）","entries":[{"pattern":"bore sb.","pos":"verb","translation":"使某人感到厭煩","explanation":"及物動詞，指說話太長或內容太乏味而讓人失去興趣。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The history teacher spoke in such a flat, monotone voice that he <target>bored</target> almost every student in the classroom within ten minutes.","translation":"這位歷史老師的聲音如此平淡且單調，以至於他在十分鐘內就讓課堂上的幾乎每個學生感到厭煩。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"bored","past_participle":"bored"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"boring","pos":"adjective","translation":"乏味的；令人厭煩的","explanation":"指事物本身令人無聊。"},{"word":"bored","pos":"adjective","translation":"感到厭煩的","explanation":"指人的主觀感受。"}]}}

{"headword":"bowling","explanation":"「bowling」在學測中通常作為名詞，出現在描述休閒活動、社交生活或運動類文章中。","senses":[{"sense":"保齡球","entries":[{"pattern":"bowling","pos":"noun","translation":"保齡球","explanation":"指保齡球這項運動或保齡球館。","sentences":[{"sentence":"To celebrate the end of the school term, the students decided to go <target>bowling</target> together at the local sports center this weekend.","translation":"為了慶祝學期結束，學生們決定這個週末一起去當地的體育中心打保齡球。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"brake","explanation":"「brake」在學測中常作為名詞表示「煞車」或動詞表示「減速」。需區分其與同音字 break (打破/休息) 的差異，尤其在交通安全或機械描述的閱讀測驗中極為關鍵。","senses":[{"sense":"煞車；減速（使車輛或機器停止或慢下來）","entries":[{"pattern":"hit the brakes","pos":"noun","translation":"踩煞車","explanation":"固定搭配，指在緊急情況下迅速按下煞車踏板以停止車輛。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The driver had to <pattern>hit</pattern> the <target>brakes</target> suddenly when a small cat ran across the road in front of his car.","translation":"當一隻小貓突然跑到車前時，駕駛不得不突然踩煞車。"}]},{"pattern":"put on the brakes","pos":"noun","translation":"煞車；減速","explanation":"指將煞車裝置啟動，使物體停止移動。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The cyclist <target>braked</target> hard before the red light, but he almost crashed into the fence because the road was slippery.","translation":"單車騎士在紅燈前強力煞車，但因為路面濕滑，他幾乎撞上了圍欄。"}]},{"pattern":"brake","pos":"verb","translation":"煞車；減速","explanation":"作為及物動詞，指控制速度下降或完全停止。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The train driver had to <target>brake</target> sharply to avoid hitting a fallen tree that had blocked the railroad tracks.","translation":"火車司機必須猛烈煞車，以避免撞上擋在鐵路軌道上的一棵倒下的樹。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"slow down","pos":"verb","translation":"減速","explanation":"泛指任何使速度降低的動作"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"accelerate","pos":"verb","translation":"加速","explanation":"增加移動速度"}]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"braked","past_participle":"braked"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"brass","explanation":"「brass」在學測中主要作為名詞指「黃銅」，或作為形容詞修飾樂器或裝飾品。在藝術或歷史類文章中較為常見。","senses":[{"sense":"黃銅（一種合金）","entries":[{"pattern":"brass","pos":"noun","translation":"黃銅","explanation":"指一種金黃色、耐腐蝕的合金材料。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The old hotel lobby was decorated with shiny <target>brass</target> lamps and handles, giving the place a very classic and expensive look.","translation":"這家舊飯店的大廳裝飾著閃亮的黃銅燈和把手，讓這個地方看起來非常古典且昂貴。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"黃銅色的；由黃銅製成的","entries":[{"pattern":"brass","pos":"adjective","translation":"黃銅色的；由黃銅製成的","explanation":"用來修飾名詞，表示材質或顏色。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The musician carefully cleaned his <target>brass</target> trumpet before the concert to make sure it sparkled under the bright stage lights.","translation":"那位音樂家在音樂會前小心地清潔他的黃銅小號，以確保它在明亮的舞台燈光下閃閃發光。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"bravery","explanation":"「bravery」是一個核心名詞，描述人的勇氣。在閱讀理解中常與 bravery, courage 等同義詞互換，常用於描述英雄行為或克服恐懼的情境。","senses":[{"sense":"勇氣；勇敢","entries":[{"pattern":"show bravery","pos":"noun","translation":"展現勇氣","explanation":"指在危險或痛苦的情況下表現出勇敢。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The young firefighter showed great <target>bravery</target> when he ran into the burning building to save a small child and a puppy.","translation":"那位年輕的消防員在衝進著火的建築救出一個小孩和一隻小狗時，展現了極大的勇氣。"}]},{"pattern":"act of bravery","pos":"noun","translation":"勇敢的行為","explanation":"指單一的一次勇敢行動。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Saving a stranger from the rushing river was an act of <target>bravery</target> that earned the teenager a medal from the city mayor.","translation":"從湍急的河流中救出陌生人是一個勇敢的行為，讓這位青少年贏得了市長頒發的勳章。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"courage","pos":"noun","translation":"勇氣","explanation":"最通用的勇氣同義詞"},{"word":"valor","pos":"noun","translation":"英勇","explanation":"較正式，常用於軍事或戰爭背景"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"cowardice","pos":"noun","translation":"膽怯","explanation":"指缺乏勇氣"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"由形容詞 brave (勇敢的) 加上名詞字尾 -ry 延伸而來","related":[{"word":"brave","pos":"adjective","translation":"勇敢的","explanation":"基礎形容詞"}]}}

{"headword":"breast","explanation":"「breast」在學測中主要指胸部。在文學描述或比喻用法中，常出現於描述情感或動物（如鳥類）的胸部）。","senses":[{"sense":"胸部；胸腔","entries":[{"pattern":"breast","pos":"noun","translation":"胸部","explanation":"指身體的前胸部分。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The bird puffed out its <target>breast</target> to look bigger and more powerful when it tried to attract a mate during the spring.","translation":"這隻鳥在春天試圖吸引配偶時，會鼓起胸部以顯得更大且更有力。"}]},{"pattern":"chicken breast","pos":"noun","translation":"雞胸肉","explanation":"常用於飲食、健康或營養類的文章中。","sentences":[{"sentence":"To build more muscle, the athlete eats grilled chicken <target>breast</target> and fresh vegetables every day for lunch to stay healthy.","translation":"為了增加肌肉，這位運動員每天午餐吃烤雞胸肉和新鮮蔬菜以保持健康。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"breath","explanation":"「breath」是名詞，指「呼吸」或「一口氣」。需注意區分其與動詞 breathe (呼吸) 的發音與拼寫差異，這是學測文法與拼寫考點。","senses":[{"sense":"呼吸；氣息 (名詞)","entries":[{"pattern":"take a breath","pos":"noun","translation":"吸一口氣","explanation":"指吸入空氣的動作。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Before starting the difficult piano competition, the young girl took a deep <target>breath</target> to calm her nervous heart.","translation":"在開始困難的鋼琴比賽前，這名年輕女孩深吸一口氣以平復她緊張的心情。"}]},{"pattern":"hold one's breath","pos":"noun","translation":"屏息；屏住呼吸","explanation":"常用於描述緊張、期待或在水中游泳時的情況。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The crowd held their <target>breath</target> as the magician slowly pulled a white rabbit out of his empty black hat.","translation":"當魔術師緩慢地從他空空的黑色帽子裡拉出一隻白兔時，群眾屏住了呼吸。"}]},{"pattern":"out of breath","pos":"adjective","translation":"喘不過氣來","explanation":"常用於描述劇烈運動後的狀態。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After running up five flights of stairs to catch the bus, the student was completely <pattern>out</pattern> <pattern>of</pattern> <target>breath</target>.","translation":"在跑了五層樓梯去趕公車後，這名學生完全喘不過氣來。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"breathe","pos":"verb","translation":"呼吸","explanation":"對應的動詞形式"}]}}

{"headword":"breathe","explanation":"「breathe」在學測中除了基礎的生理呼吸外，常在文學描寫或壓力情境中用來表達「放鬆」或「喘息」之意。注意其拼法與名詞 breath (呼吸) 的區分，breathe 是動詞，結尾有 e，發音為 /briːð/。","senses":[{"sense":"呼吸（將空氣吸入並呼出）","entries":[{"pattern":"breathe in / out","pos":"verb","translation":"吸氣／呼氣","explanation":"最基礎的生理動作，常用於描述運動後或冥想時的過程。","sentences":[{"sentence":"To reduce stress and calm your mind, you should slowly <target>breathe</target> <pattern>in</pattern> through your nose and exhale through your mouth.","translation":"為了減輕壓力並平定心神，你應該用鼻子緩慢地吸氣，並用嘴巴呼氣。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"breathed","past_participle":"breathed"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"breath","pos":"noun","translation":"呼吸；氣息","explanation":"名詞形式，指一次呼吸或呼吸的動作。"},{"word":"breathless","pos":"adjective","translation":"喘不過氣的；屏息的","explanation":"指因劇烈運動或興奮而無法正常呼吸。"}]}}

{"headword":"breeze","explanation":"「breeze」作為名詞時指輕風，常營造舒適的氛圍；作為動詞時較少見。在口語或非正式寫作中，它也常被用作比喻，指「極其簡單的事」。","senses":[{"sense":"微風；輕風（輕柔且舒適的風）","entries":[{"pattern":"a gentle breeze","pos":"noun","translation":"一陣微風","explanation":"常用於描寫自然環境，營造寧靜或愜意的情緒。","sentences":[{"sentence":"As they walked along the sandy beach, a <pattern>gentle</pattern> <target>breeze</target> blew through the trees, making the hot summer afternoon feel cool.","translation":"當他們沿著沙灘散步時，一陣微風吹過樹林，讓炎熱的夏日午後感覺很涼爽。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"breezed","past_participle":"breezed"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"brick","explanation":"「brick」在學測中多作為具體名詞，出現在城市建築、歷史遺址或比喻「堅固」的語境中。","senses":[{"sense":"磚塊（建築用的矩形塊）","entries":[{"pattern":"brick","pos":"noun","translation":"磚塊","explanation":"指建築材料，常用於描述房屋的外觀或建築過程。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The old library was built with heavy red <target>bricks</target>, giving the building a classic and solid feeling that lasts for centuries.","translation":"這座舊圖書館是用沉重的紅磚建造的，使這棟建築具有持續數世紀的經典且堅固的感覺。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"bricklayer","pos":"noun","translation":"砌磚工","explanation":"指負責將磚塊砌成牆壁的專業工人。"}]}}

{"headword":"bride","explanation":"「bride」指新娘，常出現在描述婚禮或社會習俗的文章中，與 groom (新郎) 成對出現。","senses":[{"sense":"新娘","entries":[{"pattern":"bride","pos":"noun","translation":"新娘","explanation":"指在婚禮當天或剛結婚的女性。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The beautiful <target>bride</target> wore a long white dress and walked slowly down the aisle with a happy smile on her face.","translation":"美麗的新娘穿著一件長白裙，帶著幸福的微笑緩慢地走在走道上。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"bridal","pos":"adjective","translation":"新娘的；婚禮的","explanation":"形容詞形式，常用於 bridal shop (婚紗店) 或 bridal veil (新娘面紗)。"}]}}

{"headword":"broadcast","explanation":"「broadcast」在學測中極其高頻，涵蓋了傳統媒體（廣播、電視）與現代數位傳播。注意其動詞形式的過去式與過去分詞通常保持不變 (broadcast)，儘管 broadcasted 在某些地區被接受。","senses":[{"sense":"廣播；播送（透過電波或網路將資訊傳遞給大眾）","entries":[{"pattern":"broadcast sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"播送某事","explanation":"及物動詞，受詞通常是新聞、節目或警告訊息。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The national news station will <target>broadcast</target> the live game tonight, so millions of fans can watch the match from home.","translation":"國家新聞台今晚將直播這場比賽，因此數百萬名球迷可以在家中觀看比賽。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"broadcast","past_participle":"broadcast"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"broadcaster","pos":"noun","translation":"廣播者；播音員","explanation":"指從事廣播或電視播送工作的人。"},{"word":"broadcast","pos":"noun","translation":"廣播節目；播送","explanation":"名詞形式，指一次播送的行為或具體節目。"}]}}

{"headword":"brunch","explanation":"「brunch」是 breakfast 和 lunch 的合成詞，在描述現代生活方式、休閒文化或旅遊行程時常出現。在學測中，它通常作為名詞使用，代表一種輕鬆的社交活動或飲食習慣。","senses":[{"sense":"早午餐","entries":[{"pattern":"brunch","pos":"noun","translation":"早午餐","explanation":"指在早晨晚些時候或中午前吃的一餐，通常取代了早餐和午餐。","sentences":[{"sentence":"On lazy Sunday mornings, my family often gathers at a cozy cafe to enjoy a delicious <target>brunch</target> together.","translation":"在慵懶的週日早晨，我的家人經常聚集在一家舒適的咖啡館一起享受美味的早午餐。"},{"sentence":"Since I woke up late after a long week of studying for exams, I decided to have a late <target>brunch</target> at eleven o'clock.","translation":"由於在準備考試的一週後醒來較晚，我決定在十一點吃一頓遲來的早午餐。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"breakfast + lunch","related":[]}}

{"headword":"bubble","explanation":"「bubble」在學測中既可作名詞（指物理上的氣泡或經濟學中的泡沫）也可作動詞（指氣泡上升或興奮地說話）。理解其「圓形且易碎」的核心隱喻是掌握此字關鍵。","senses":[{"sense":"氣泡；泡沫（物理實體）","entries":[{"pattern":"bubble","pos":"noun","translation":"氣泡；泡沫","explanation":"指液體中產生的圓形氣體團。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The young child laughed with delight when he saw many tiny <target>bubbles</target> floating in the soapy water of the bathtub.","translation":"當小孩子看到浴缸肥皂水中漂浮著許多微小氣泡時，他開心地笑了。"},{"sentence":"If you blow into a straw in a glass of juice, you can create small <target>bubbles</target> that rise quickly to the surface.","translation":"如果你用吸管向一杯果汁中吹氣，你可以創造出快速升至表面的小氣泡。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"foam","pos":"noun","translation":"泡沫","explanation":"指較多且較小的氣泡聚集而成的泡沫"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"泡沫（比喻：不穩定且易碎的狀態）","entries":[{"pattern":"economic bubble","pos":"noun","translation":"經濟泡沫","explanation":"指價格遠高於其實際價值，隨時可能崩潰的狀態，常見於財經類閱讀。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Experts warn that the sudden rise in housing prices is an <pattern>economic</pattern> <target>bubble</target> that could burst at any moment.","translation":"專家警告說，房價的突然上漲是一個隨時可能破裂的經濟泡沫。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"speculation","pos":"noun","translation":"投機","explanation":"強調價格上漲是基於投機而非實際價值"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"冒泡；沸騰（動詞用法）","entries":[{"pattern":"bubble up","pos":"verb","translation":"冒泡；湧現","explanation":"指液體中氣泡上升，或比喻指情感湧現。","sentences":[{"sentence":"As the water started to <target>bubble</target> <pattern>up</pattern> in the pot, the chef added the vegetables to the soup.","translation":"當鍋中的水開始冒泡時，主廚將蔬菜加入湯中。"},{"sentence":"The excitement <target>bubbled</target> <pattern>up</pattern> inside her as she waited for the teacher to announce the winner of the art competition.","translation":"當她等待老師宣布美術比賽獲獎者時，內心的興奮之情湧現而生。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"boil","pos":"verb","translation":"沸騰","explanation":"強調高溫導致液體沸騰"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"bubbled","past_participle":"bubbled"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"bucket","explanation":"「bucket」在學測中主要是基礎名詞，指容器。但在口語或比喻用法中，常與特定動詞搭配形成片語，如 kick the bucket（去世），但對於 GSAT 學生，重點應放在其基本義與實用搭配上。","senses":[{"sense":"水桶；桶子","entries":[{"pattern":"bucket","pos":"noun","translation":"水桶；桶子","explanation":"指一個圓形且有把手的容器，通常用於裝水或沙子。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The farmer used a large plastic <target>bucket</target> to carry water from the well to the dry vegetable garden.","translation":"農夫使用一個大型塑料水桶將水從井中運到乾燥的菜園。"},{"sentence":"After the heavy rain, the children played with a <target>bucket</target> and spade to build a tall sandcastle on the beach.","translation":"大雨後，孩子們用桶子和鏟子在海邊建造一座高大的沙堡。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"pail","pos":"noun","translation":"桶","explanation":"較為正式或古老的稱呼"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"bud","explanation":"「bud」在生物類閱讀中常出現，指植物的芽。其動詞用法較少見，但理解其「開始生長」的核心概念對於理解衍生字彙至關重要。","senses":[{"sense":"花蕾；芽","entries":[{"pattern":"bud","pos":"noun","translation":"花蕾；芽","explanation":"指植物上準備開花或長葉子的部分。","sentences":[{"sentence":"In early spring, the apple trees in the garden began to show small, green <target>buds</target> on their branches.","translation":"早春時分，花園裡的蘋果樹枝頭開始長出細小的綠色芽苞。"},{"sentence":"The gardener carefully pruned the <target>buds</target> of the roses to ensure the flowers would bloom more beautifully.","translation":"園丁小心地修剪玫瑰的花蕾，以確保花朵能開得更漂亮。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"萌芽；開始發展（動詞用法）","entries":[{"pattern":"bud","pos":"verb","translation":"發芽；萌芽","explanation":"指植物發芽，或比喻指某種關係或想法開始發展。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After several weeks of warm weather, the rare tropical plants in the greenhouse finally <target>budded</target>.","translation":"在經過數週的溫暖天氣後，溫室裡的稀有熱帶植物終於發芽了。"},{"sentence":"A strong friendship <target>budded</target> between the two students after they worked together on a difficult science project.","translation":"在兩名學生共同完成一個困難的科學專案後，他們之間萌芽了深厚的友誼。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"sprout","pos":"verb","translation":"發芽","explanation":"指植物從種子或芽苞中長出新芽"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"budded","past_participle":"budded"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"budget","explanation":"「budget」是學測高頻詞彙，在描述經濟、政府政策或個人理財時必備。它既可作名詞（預算）也可作動詞（編制預算/調整支出）。","senses":[{"sense":"預算（金額）","entries":[{"pattern":"on a budget","pos":"noun","translation":"在預算內；省錢地","explanation":"指在有限的金額內進行消費，是極為常見的固定搭配。","sentences":[{"sentence":"As a college student living <pattern>on</pattern> a <target>budget</target>, Sarah decided to cook her own meals instead of eating out.","translation":"作為一名預算有限的大學生，莎拉決定自己煮飯而不是在外就餐。"},{"sentence":"Traveling <pattern>on</pattern> a <target>budget</target> allows you to experience the local culture more deeply without spending too much money.","translation":"在有限的預算內旅行，能讓你深入體驗當地文化而不會花太多錢。"}]},{"pattern":"budget","pos":"noun","translation":"預算","explanation":"指為特定目的而編制的一定金額。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The school board decided to increase the <target>budget</target> for the library to buy more updated digital resources.","translation":"學校委員會決定增加圖書館的預算，以購買更多更新的數位資源。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"funds","pos":"noun","translation":"資金","explanation":"指可用的金錢"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"編制預算；調整支出（動詞用法）","entries":[{"pattern":"budget for sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"為…編制預算","explanation":"指預先為某件事預留出金錢。","sentences":[{"sentence":"It is important to <target>budget</target> <pattern>for</pattern> unexpected expenses, such as medical bills or car repairs, every month.","translation":"每個月為不預期的支出（如醫療帳單或汽車維修）預留預算是非常重要的。"},{"sentence":"The city government must <target>budget</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the construction of a new bridge to reduce traffic jams in the city center.","translation":"市政府必須為建設一座新橋樑編制預算，以減少市中心的交通堵延。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"allocate","pos":"verb","translation":"分配","explanation":"s-allocation: 指將金錢或資源分配到特定項目"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"budgeted","past_participle":"budgeted"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"buffalo","explanation":"「buffalo」在學測中主要作為名詞出現，指一種大型哺乳動物。在自然生態或地理類文章中，常與「棲息地」或「滅絕」等議題討論。注意其複數型態可為 buffaloes 或 buffaloes，兩者皆通用。","senses":[{"sense":"水牛；野牛（一種大型、有角的哺乳動物）","entries":[{"pattern":"buffalo","pos":"noun","translation":"水牛；野牛","explanation":"指生活在亞洲或北美洲的大型有角動物。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Farmers in some Asian countries still rely on the strong <target>buffalo</target> to plow the fields before the rainy season begins.","translation":"在某些亞洲國家，農民在雨季開始前仍然依賴強壯的水牛來耕田。"},{"sentence":"The American <target>buffaloes</target> almost became extinct in the nineteenth century because hunters killed too many of them for their skin.","translation":"由於獵人為了皮毛殺死了太多動物，美國野牛在十九世紀幾乎滅絕。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"buffet","explanation":"「buffet」在學測中主要出現在生活類文章中，指一種自助餐形式。注意其發音與拼寫與「打擊」的動詞 buffet (/bəˈfɛt/) 不同，但在基礎詞彙表中，名詞的「自助餐」意義最為高頻。","senses":[{"sense":"自助餐；自助餐檯","entries":[{"pattern":"buffet","pos":"noun","translation":"自助餐","explanation":"指一種提供多種食物讓顧客自行選擇並取餐的餐飲方式。","sentences":[{"sentence":"To celebrate her graduation from college, the family decided to have a lavish <target>buffet</target> dinner at a famous five-star hotel.","translation":"為了慶祝她大學畢業，這家人決定在一家著名的五星級酒店享用豪華的自助晚餐。"},{"sentence":"Because the seafood <target>buffet</target> offered so many delicious dishes, I accidentally ate too much and felt very full for hours.","translation":"因為那家海鮮自助餐提供了如此多美味的菜餚，我不小心吃太多了，好幾個小時都覺得很飽。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"bulb","explanation":"「bulb」在學測中具有兩種完全不同的核心意義：一是電學中的「燈泡」，二是植物學中的「球莖」。在閱讀測驗中，學生必須根據上下文（如 electric 或 plant）來快速判定其義項。","senses":[{"sense":"燈泡（發光設備）","entries":[{"pattern":"light bulb","pos":"noun","translation":"燈泡","explanation":"指發光設備的玻璃球體部分。","sentences":[{"sentence":"When the light <target>bulb</target> in the classroom suddenly flickered and went out, the teacher had to stop the lesson to replace it.","translation":"當教室裡的燈泡突然閃爍並熄滅時，老師不得不停止授課來更換它。"},{"sentence":"Energy-saving LED <target>bulbs</target> are much more efficient than old traditional lamps because they use less electricity to produce the same brightness.","translation":"節能 LED 燈泡比舊的傳統燈具效率高得多，因為它們使用較少的電量來產生相同的亮度。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"球莖（植物的儲藏器官）","entries":[{"pattern":"bulb","pos":"noun","translation":"球莖","explanation":"如鬱金香或百合花等植物的地下儲藏器官。","sentences":[{"sentence":"To grow beautiful tulips in the spring, the gardener planted several flower <target>bulbs</target> deep in the soil during the late autumn.","translation":"為了在春天種出美麗的鬱金香，由於園丁在深秋時將數個花球莖種在土壤深處。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"bull","explanation":"「bull」是指成年雄性牛。在學測中，除了指動物本身，有時也會出現在比喻義中（如 bull market 意為牛市/看漲市場），但基礎名詞義為主。","senses":[{"sense":"公牛；雄牛","entries":[{"pattern":"bull","pos":"noun","translation":"公牛","explanation":"指成年雄性牛。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The angry <target>bull</target> charged at the red cloth, showing how powerful and dangerous these animals can be when they are upset.","translation":"那頭憤怒的公牛衝向紅布，展示了這些動物在不開心時會有多麼強大且危險。"},{"sentence":"The farmer kept a large, strong <target>bull</target> on his farm to produce more healthy calves for the next year.","translation":"農夫在農場裡養了一頭強壯的大公牛，以便明年能產出更多健康的牛犢。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"bullet","explanation":"「bullet」在學測中主要指子彈。但在現代數位時代，其衍生義「bullet point」在描述報告、簡報或寫作格式時非常高頻，學生應將其視為一組搭配。","senses":[{"sense":"子彈","entries":[{"pattern":"bullet","pos":"noun","translation":"子彈","explanation":"指射出武器中使用的金屬小塊。","sentences":[{"sentence":"In the old war movie, the soldier bravely ran across the open field while <target>bullets</target> flew through the air around him.","translation":"在一部舊的戰爭電影中，士兵勇敢地穿過開闊地，而子彈在他周圍的空氣中飛舞。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"項目符號","entries":[{"pattern":"bullet point","pos":"noun","translation":"項目符號；要點","explanation":"指在清單中用來標記每一項的小圓點或符號。","sentences":[{"sentence":"To make the presentation more clear, the student used <target>bullet</target> <pattern>points</pattern> to list the main ideas of his research.","translation":"為了讓簡報更清晰，學生使用項目符號來列出他研究的主要想法。"},{"sentence":"Instead of writing long paragraphs, you should use <target>bullet</target> <pattern>points</pattern> to summarize the key facts in your report.","translation":"與其寫長段落，你應該使用項目符號來總結報告中的關鍵事實。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"bump","explanation":"「bump」在學測中既可作為名詞（碰撞、腫塊）也可作為動詞（碰撞、意外遇到）。要注意其在不同詞性間的語義切換，特別是作為動詞時，常與介系詞 to 或 into 搭配，用以描述意外的身體接觸或社交上的不期而遇。","senses":[{"sense":"碰撞；腫塊（物理上的撞擊或撞擊後留下的紅腫）","entries":[{"pattern":"bump","pos":"noun","translation":"碰撞；腫塊","explanation":"指身體撞到物體後的瞬間撞擊，或撞擊後在皮膚上產生的紅腫凸起。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After running into the wooden table in the dark, the little boy had a large, red <target>bump</target> on his forehead.","translation":"在黑暗中撞到木桌後，那個小男孩的額頭上留下了一個巨大的紅腫塊。"},{"sentence":"The car drove over a small <target>bump</target> in the road, causing the passengers to jump slightly in their seats.","translation":"汽車開過路面上的一個小凸起，導致乘客在座位上輕輕跳了一下。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"lump","pos":"noun","translation":"腫塊；塊狀物","explanation":"泛指任何不規則的凸起物"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"碰撞；意外遇到（物理上的撞擊或社交上的不期而遇）","entries":[{"pattern":"bump into sb./sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"撞到某人／某物；偶然遇見某人","explanation":"物理上是指身體直接撞擊物體；社交上是指在某處意外地見到熟人，等同於 run into。","sentences":[{"sentence":"While walking through the crowded airport terminal, I accidentally <target>bumped</target> <pattern>into</pattern> an old high school friend from ten years ago.","translation":"在擁擠的機場航廈行走時，我意外地遇到了十年前的一位高中舊友。"},{"sentence":"The clumsy waiter <target>bumped</target> <pattern>into</pattern> a tray of glasses, sending them crashing to the floor in a loud noise.","translation":"那個笨拙的服務生撞到了一盤玻璃杯，使它們大聲地摔在地上，碎成碎片。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"encounter","pos":"verb","translation":"遭遇；遇到","explanation":"較為正式的詞彙，可用於描述遇到困難或人"},{"word":"collide","pos":"verb","translation":"碰撞","explanation":"強調強烈的物理撞擊"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"bumped","past_participle":"bumped"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"bunch","explanation":"「bunch」主要用於描述一群人或一簇花卉、水果。在口語中，常被用來泛指「一堆」或「一群」，在學測閱讀中需注意其對象的具體性。","senses":[{"sense":"簇；串；一群（聚集在一起的一組事物或人）","entries":[{"pattern":"a bunch of sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"一串／一束／一堆某物","explanation":"常用於描述水果（如香蕉）、花卉（如玫瑰）或隨機聚集在一起的物品。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The young man bought a beautiful <target>bunch</target> <pattern>of</pattern> fresh red roses to surprise his girlfriend on their anniversary.","translation":"這個年輕男子買了一束美麗的鮮紅玫瑰，想在週年紀念日給他的女朋友一個驚喜。"},{"sentence":"I forgot my house keys at home, so I had to borrow a <target>bunch</target> <pattern>of</pattern> spare keys from the janitor.","translation":"我把家門鑰匙忘在家裡，所以我不得不向管理員借一串備用鑰匙。"}]},{"pattern":"a bunch of sb.","pos":"noun","translation":"一群人","explanation":"口語用法，指一群特質相似的人。","sentences":[{"sentence":"My classmates are a great <target>bunch</target> <pattern>of</pattern> funny students who always make the whole class laugh during break time.","translation":"我的同學是一群非常有趣的學生，他們總是能在下課時間讓全班大笑。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"cluster","pos":"noun","translation":"簇；群","explanation":"強調事物緊密地聚集在一起"},{"word":"group","pos":"noun","translation":"群；組","explanation":"最普遍的通用詞"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"bundle","explanation":"「bundle」強調的是「綑綁」在一起的狀態。與 bunch 不同，bundle 通常指被繩子或繩索綑綁在一起的物品，具有更強的物理約束力。","senses":[{"sense":"捆；束（被綑綁在一起的一組物品）","entries":[{"pattern":"a bundle of sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"一捆／一束某物","explanation":"常用於描述木材、報紙、衣服等被綑綁在一起的物品。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The old man spent the whole morning gathering a large <target>bundle</target> <pattern>of</pattern> dry sticks to start a fire for cooking.","translation":"這位老人花了一整個早晨收集一大捆乾樹枝，以便生火煮食。"},{"sentence":"The delivery driver left a heavy <target>bundle</target> <pattern>of</pattern> old newspapers on the porch, waiting for the recycling truck to pick them up.","translation":"快遞員將一大捆舊報紙留在門廊上，等待回收車將其載走。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"package","pos":"noun","translation":"包裹","explanation":"泛指被包裝好的物品"},{"word":"stack","pos":"noun","translation":"堆","explanation":"強調將物品疊在一起"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"bury","explanation":"「bury」在學測中除了基本的「埋葬」外，還常出現在描述心理狀態或物理掩蓋的語境中。注意其不規則動詞變化（bury - buried - buried），雖然結尾是 d，但發音需注意。","senses":[{"sense":"埋葬；掩蓋（將物體放入地下或用某物覆蓋）","entries":[{"pattern":"bury sth. (in/under sth.)","pos":"verb","translation":"將某物埋在（…之中／之下）","explanation":"可指物理上的埋葬，也可指將物品隱藏在某處以便他人不發現。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many animals, such as squirrels, <target>bury</target> their nuts <pattern>in</pattern> the cold ground during autumn to prepare for the long winter.","translation":"許多動物，例如松鼠，會在秋天將堅果埋在冰冷的地下，為漫長的冬天做準備。"},{"sentence":"The pirate hid his gold coins and <target>buried</target> them <pattern>under</pattern> a giant palm tree on a secret island.","translation":"海盜將他的金幣藏起來，並將它們埋在一座秘密島嶼上的大棕櫚樹下。"}]},{"pattern":"bury one's face in sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"將臉埋在…之中","explanation":"常見的固定搭配，用來描述極度悲傷或害羞地將臉掩蓋住。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After losing the final basketball game, the young athlete <target>buried</target> his face <pattern>in</pattern> his hands and cried silently.","translation":"在輸掉最後一場籃球賽後，這名年輕運動員將臉埋在雙手中，沉默地哭泣。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"inter","pos":"verb","translation":"埋葬","explanation":"正式的埋葬詞彙"},{"word":"hide","pos":"verb","translation":"隱藏","explanation":"explanation: "}],"antonyms":[{"word":"dig up","pos":"verb","translation":"挖掘出","explanation":null},{"word":"uncover","pos":"verb","translation":"揭露；揭開","explanation":null}]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"buried","past_participle":"buried"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"bush","explanation":"「bush」在生物或地理類閱讀中較為基礎，指較矮的灌木叢。需區分其與 tree 的不同點：bush 通常指沒有單一主幹的，且從基部起就分枝的植物。","senses":[{"sense":"灌木；灌木叢（矮小且分枝多的植物）","entries":[{"pattern":"bush","pos":"noun","translation":"灌木；灌木叢","explanation":"常用於描述自然環境或動物隱藏處。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The small, brown rabbit quickly <target>bush</target> into the thick green <target>bush</target> to hide from the hungry fox.","translation":"這隻小棕兔快速地鑽進茂密的綠色灌木叢中，以躲避飢餓的狐狸。"},{"sentence":"My grandmother loves gardening and has planted many colorful flowering <target>bushes</target> around her small backyard.","translation":"我的祖母熱愛園藝，在她的後院周圍種了許多五彩繽紛的開花灌木。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"shrub","pos":"noun","translation":"灌木","explanation":"與 bush 近義，但 shrub 更具生物學上的專業感"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"buzz","explanation":"「buzz」在學測中既可用於描述聲音（如蜜蜂或電器的嗡嗡聲），也可用於描述一種社會氛圍（如對某事的熱烈討論）。在動詞用法中，除了發聲，還常用於比喻人們對某事感到興奮或好奇地議論紛紛。","senses":[{"sense":"嗡嗡聲；喧鬧聲（昆蟲或電器的聲音）","entries":[{"pattern":"buzz","pos":"noun","translation":"嗡嗡聲","explanation":"指昆蟲翅膀快速振動或電子設備發出的持續低頻聲音。","sentences":[{"sentence":"I could not sleep because there was a constant <target>buzz</target> coming from the old refrigerator in my bedroom.","translation":"我無法入睡，因為我臥室裡的那台舊冰箱一直發出嗡嗡聲。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"熱烈討論；興奮的氛圍","entries":[{"pattern":"create a buzz","pos":"noun","translation":"引起熱烈討論","explanation":"常用於描述新產品、電影或事件在社交媒體上引起的大規模關注。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The new smartphone model created a huge <target>buzz</target> among teenagers before it was officially released to the public.","translation":"這款新手機在正式對外發行前，就在青少年之間引起了巨大的熱烈討論。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"嗡嗡地響；熱烈討論（動詞用法）","entries":[{"pattern":"buzz with sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"因…而喧鬧／充滿…的氛圍","explanation":"常用於描述一個地方因為充滿了興奮的人們或討論而顯得熱鬧。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The school hallway was <target>buzzing</target> <pattern>with</pattern> excitement as the students waited for the final exam results to be posted.","translation":"學生們在等待期末考成績公布時，學校走廊裡充滿了興奮的喧鬧聲。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"（酒精或藥物引起的）興奮感","entries":[{"pattern":"get a buzz","pos":"noun","translation":"感到興奮／陶醉","explanation":"非正式用法，指在嘗試某事或服用某物後感受到的快感或興奮感。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Some people enjoy the adrenaline <target>buzz</target> they get from jumping out of a plane during a skydive.","translation":"有些人享受從飛機上跳下進行傘跳時所獲得的腎上腺素激發的興奮感。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"buzzed","past_participle":"buzzed"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"cabin","explanation":"「cabin」在閱讀測驗中常出現在兩種完全不同的場景：一是自然環境中的「原木小屋」，二是交通工具（飛機、船）中的「客艙」。學生需根據上下文判斷其具體含義。","senses":[{"sense":"原木小屋；山莊（通常位於偏遠地區）","entries":[{"pattern":"cabin","pos":"noun","translation":"原木小屋","explanation":"指在森林或山上建造的簡單小型房屋。","sentences":[{"sentence":"During the winter break, my family rented a cozy <target>cabin</target> in the mountains to enjoy the fresh air and snow.","translation":"寒假期間，我的家人在山區租了一間溫馨的原木小屋，以享受新鮮空氣與白雪。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"客艙；船艙（飛機或船上的封閉空間）","entries":[{"pattern":"cabin","pos":"noun","translation":"客艙","explanation":"指交通工具內部乘客乘坐的區域。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The flight attendants asked all passengers to remain in their <target>cabins</target> and fasten their seatbelts during the heavy turbulence.","translation":"空服員要求所有乘客在強烈亂流期間留在客艙內並繫好安全帶。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"cable","explanation":"「cable」除了指物理上的「電纜」或「鋼纜」外，在現代英語中也常與「有線電視」 (cable TV) 連接。在動詞用法中，雖然較少見，但指透過電纜傳輸數據或連接設備。","senses":[{"sense":"電纜；鋼纜（粗的線纜）","entries":[{"pattern":"cable","pos":"noun","translation":"電纜；鋼纜","explanation":"指傳輸電力、數據或用於支撐重物的粗線。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The engineers had to replace the thick steel <target>cables</target> of the bridge to ensure the safety of thousands of drivers.","translation":"工程師必須更換橋樑的厚鋼纜，以確保數千名駕駛者的安全。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"有線電視","entries":[{"pattern":"cable TV","pos":"noun","translation":"有線電視","explanation":"固定搭配，指透過電纜傳輸的電視節目。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many families are canceling their <target>cable</target> TV subscriptions because they prefer watching movies on streaming platforms.","translation":"許多家庭正在取消他們的有線電視訂閱，因為他們更喜歡在串流平台觀看電影。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"用電纜連接；傳送電報（動詞用法）","entries":[{"pattern":"cable sb. sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"用電報／電纜通知某人某事","explanation":"較舊的用法，指透過電纜發送訊息。現代英語中較少見，但在閱讀中可能出現。","sentences":[{"sentence":"In the early twentieth century, businessmen would <target>cable</target> their partners in other countries to discuss urgent trade deals.","translation":"在二十世紀初，商人會透過電報通知他們在其他國家的合作夥伴，以討論緊急的貿易協議。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"cabled","past_participle":"cabled"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"cafeteria","explanation":"「cafeteria」是校園生活類文章中極高頻的單字。它與 restaurant 不同，強調的是「自助式」的服務方式，乘客或學生自取食物後才付款。","senses":[{"sense":"自助餐廳；食堂","entries":[{"pattern":"cafeteria","pos":"noun","translation":"自助餐廳","explanation":"指學校、醫院或公司內部提供簡單餐點的自助式餐廳。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The students usually gather in the school <target>cafeteria</target> during the lunch break to talk about their homework and hobbies.","translation":"學生們通常在午休時間聚集在學校食堂，討論他們的家庭作業和愛好。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"campus","explanation":"「campus」在學測中常出現在描述大學生活、教育制度或校園環境的文章中。其核心概念是「大學或學院的整個場地」，包含教室、宿舍和運動場。","senses":[{"sense":"校園；大學園區","entries":[{"pattern":"on campus","pos":"noun","translation":"在校園內","explanation":"固定搭配，指在大學校區內部（如住在校內宿舍）。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Living <pattern>on</pattern> <target>campus</target> is very convenient for freshmen because they do not have to spend time commuting to class.","translation":"住在校園內對新生來說非常方便，因為他們不需要花時間通勤去上課。"}]},{"pattern":"off campus","pos":"noun","translation":"在校園外","explanation":"固定搭配，指在大學校區外部（如租房子住）。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Some senior students prefer to live <pattern>off</pattern> <target>campus</target> because they want more privacy and freedom in their daily lives.","translation":"一些高年級學生更喜歡住在校園外，因為他們想要在日常生活中擁有更多隱私和自由。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"canyon","explanation":"「canyon」常用於描述地理景觀，特別是在自然科學類閱讀中出現。學生應注意其與 valley 的區別：canyon 通常指由河流長期侵蝕而形成的深谷，且兩側牆壁較陡峭。","senses":[{"sense":"峽谷（由河流侵蝕形成的深谷）","entries":[{"pattern":"canyon","pos":"noun","translation":"峽谷","explanation":"指地理上深且陡峭的谷地。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After hiking for several hours, the travelers finally reached the edge of the <target>canyon</target> and looked down at the blue river below.","translation":"徒步旅行數小時後，旅人們終於到達了峽谷邊緣，並俯視著下方湛藍的河流。"},{"sentence":"The Grand <target>Canyon</target> in the United States is famous for its colorful rock layers and breathtaking views of the natural landscape.","translation":"美國的大峽谷以其色彩斑斕的岩層和令人驚嘆的自然景觀而聞名。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"gorge","pos":"noun","translation":"深谷；峽谷","explanation":"通常指較窄且更陡峭的峽谷"},{"word":"valley","pos":"noun","translation":"山谷","explanation":"泛指山與山之間的低地，不一定陡峭"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"capable","explanation":"「capable」在描述個人能力或機器功能時極為高頻。最關鍵的考點在於其固定搭配介系詞 be capable of，後接名詞或動名詞 (V-ing)，這在文法填空題中是核心考點。","senses":[{"sense":"有能力的；能做到的（具備某項技能或潛力）","entries":[{"pattern":"be capable of sth./doing sth.","pos":"adjective","translation":"有能力做某事","explanation":"後接名詞或動名詞，強調具備達成某事所需的條件或潛力。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Although he is still a young student, he is <target>capable</target> <pattern>of</pattern> solving complex math problems that even some adults find difficult.","translation":"雖然他還是一個年輕的學生，但他有能力解決甚至某些成年人都覺得困難的複雜數學問題。"},{"sentence":"Modern smartphones are <target>capable</target> <pattern>of</pattern> taking professional photos, which allows many people to start their own photography hobby.","translation":"現代智慧型手機有能力拍出專業的照片，這讓許多人能開始他們的攝影愛好。"}]},{"pattern":"capable","pos":"adjective","translation":"能幹的；有能力的","explanation":"用作形容詞修飾人，表示其工作效率高且可靠。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The company decided to hire her as the new manager because she had proven herself to be a highly <target>capable</target> leader.","translation":"公司決定聘請她擔任新經理，因為她已證明自己是一位非常有能力的領導者。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"able","pos":"adjective","translation":"能夠的","explanation":"最基礎的同義詞，但 be able to 後接原形動詞"},{"word":"competent","pos":"adjective","translation":"勝任的；合格的","explanation":"強調具備足夠的專業技能來完成工作"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"incapable","pos":"adjective","translation":"不能夠的；無能力的","explanation":"capable 的反義詞，同樣搭配 be incapable of"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 cap (拿、握) + 形容詞字尾 -able (可...的)","related":[{"word":"capability","pos":"noun","translation":"能力；才能","explanation":"由形容詞 capable 轉化而來的名詞形式。"}]}}

{"headword":"captain","explanation":"「captain」在學測中除指船長或機長外，也常出現在運動隊伍的領導者（隊長）情境中。要注意其在不同場景下的具體職稱翻譯。","senses":[{"sense":"船長；機長；隊長（領導者的職位）","entries":[{"pattern":"captain","pos":"noun","translation":"船長；機長；隊長","explanation":"指在船隻、飛機或運動團隊中負責最高指揮權的人。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The <target>captain</target> of the ship stayed on the deck until every single passenger was safely evacuated from the burning vessel.","translation":"船長在甲板上停留直到每一位乘客都從著火的船隻中安全地撤離。"},{"sentence":"After scoring the winning goal in the final game, the <target>captain</target> of the basketball team led his teammates to celebrate.","translation":"在決賽中射入致勝球後，籃球隊的隊長帶領著他的隊友們一起慶祝。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"leader","pos":"noun","translation":"領導者","explanation":"泛指任何類型的領導角色"},{"word":"commander","pos":"noun","translation":"指揮官","explanation":"強調軍事或高度組織化的指揮權"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"capture","explanation":"「capture」在學測中具有「捕捉實體」與「捕捉抽象概念」兩種重要語意。前者常用於動物捕捉或戰爭中，後者則常用於描述攝影、藝術或紀錄某種情感、時刻的狀態。","senses":[{"sense":"捕捉；捉住（物理上的捕獲）","entries":[{"pattern":"capture sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"捕捉某物","explanation":"指使用工具或力量將某物捉住或控制住。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The brave hunters used large nets to <target>capture</target> the wild animals that were attacking the local farmers' crops.","translation":"勇敢的獵人們使用大網來捕捉那些攻擊當地農民作物的野生動物。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"catch","pos":"verb","translation":"捕捉；抓住","explanation":"最普遍且基礎的捕捉動詞"},{"word":"seize","pos":"verb","translation":"強行奪取；抓住","explanation":"強調快速、強而有力地抓住"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"release","pos":"verb","translation":"釋放","explanation":"將捕獲的對象釋放回自然"}]},{"sense":"捕捉；記錄（抽象的捕捉，如情感、光線、瞬間）","entries":[{"pattern":"capture sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"捕捉（情感、時刻、特徵）","explanation":"常用於攝影、電影或文學，指將某種瞬間或感覺記錄下來。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The young photographer tried to <target>capture</target> the beauty of the sunset by taking a perfect photo of the ocean.","translation":"年輕的攝影師試圖透過拍下一張完美的海洋照片，來捕捉落日的美景。"},{"sentence":"The novel successfully <target>captures</target> the feeling of loneliness that many students experience when they move to a new city.","translation":"這本小說成功地捕捉到了許多學生搬到新城市時所經歷的孤獨感。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"record","pos":"verb","translation":"記錄","explanation":"指將資訊或影像記錄下來"},{"word":"depict","pos":"verb","translation":"描繪","explanation":"強調透過藝術方式呈現"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"捕獲物；紀錄物（捕捉後的結果）","entries":[{"pattern":"capture","pos":"noun","translation":"捕捉；捕獲","explanation":"指捕捉這個動作本身或捕捉到的對象。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The <target>capture</target> of the dangerous criminal was a huge relief for the police and the citizens of the city.","translation":"捕捉到這名危險的罪犯對警察和城市居民來說是一個巨大的寬慰。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"captured","past_participle":"captured"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"career","explanation":"「career」在學測中主要用於討論職業規劃、人生目標與職場發展。學生應區分 career 與 job 的不同：job 傾向於指單一的具體工作項目或職位，而 career 則是指一個人一生中在特定專業領域的長期發展路徑。","senses":[{"sense":"職業；生涯（長期專業發展路徑）","entries":[{"pattern":"career","pos":"noun","translation":"職業；生涯","explanation":"指在某個特定領域中長期從事的工作路徑。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After finishing her degree in biology, she decided to pursue a <target>career</target> in medicine to help sick people.","translation":"在完成生物學學位後，她決定在醫學領域追求職業發展，以幫助病人。"},{"sentence":"The famous singer had a long and successful <target>career</target> spanning over forty years in the music industry.","translation":"這位著名的歌手在音樂產業中擁有長達四十多年且成功的職業生涯。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"profession","pos":"noun","translation":"專業職業","explanation":"強調需要高度專業知識或教育的職業"},{"word":"occupation","pos":"noun","translation":"職業；工作","explanation":"較為正式的說法，指從事的工作"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"casual","explanation":"「casual」在學測中常出現在社交、職場或衣著描述中。其核心概念是「不正式」或「不經意的」。學生應區分其在描述衣服（休閒）與描述態度（隨意/漫不經心）時的微妙差異。","senses":[{"sense":"休閒的；非正式的（指衣著或場合）","entries":[{"pattern":"casual clothes","pos":"adjective","translation":"休閒服裝","explanation":"指日常穿著，與正式西裝或禮服相對。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Since the company allows a <target>casual</target> dress code on Fridays, many employees choose to wear jeans and T-shirts to the office.","translation":"由於公司允許在週五採取休閒著裝規範，許多員工選擇穿著牛仔褲和 T 恤到辦公室。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"源自拉丁語 casus (偶然)，意為落下、發生。","related":[{"word":"casually","pos":"adverb","translation":"隨意地；不經意地","explanation":"由形容詞 casual 加上副詞字尾 -ly 延伸而來。"},{"word":"casualty","pos":"noun","translation":"傷亡人數","explanation":"原意為偶然發生的不幸事件，現常用於描述災害或戰爭中的傷亡。"}]}}

{"headword":"comma","explanation":"「comma」在學測英文中主要出現在寫作規範或閱讀理解中，用來描述標點符號的運用。學生應注意其在句子結構中作為「短暫停頓」的功能，以及在列舉項目時的正確位置。","senses":[{"sense":"逗號（標點符號）","entries":[{"pattern":"comma","pos":"noun","translation":"逗號","explanation":"指書寫時用來標示短暫停頓或分隔項目的標點符號。","sentences":[{"sentence":"If you forget to put a <target>comma</target> after the introductory phrase, the entire sentence may become confusing for the reader.","translation":"如果你忘了在引導句之後加上逗號，整句話對讀者來說可能會變得令人困惑。"},{"sentence":"When listing three or more items, a <target>comma</target> is usually placed before the word and to separate each piece of information.","translation":"當列舉三個或更多項目時，通常會在 and 之前放置一個逗號以分隔每一項資訊。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"committee","explanation":"「committee」在學測中常出現在校園生活或社會議題討論的語境中。這是一個集合名詞，在美式英語中通常視為單數，但在英式英語中可視為單數或複數，視乎其強調的是整體還是個體成員。","senses":[{"sense":"委員會；委員會成員","entries":[{"pattern":"committee","pos":"noun","translation":"委員會","explanation":"指一群被選出或被指定來處理特定任務或做出決定的組織。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The school <target>committee</target> met last Friday to discuss how to reduce the amount of plastic waste in the cafeteria.","translation":"學校委員會在上週五開會討論如何減少食堂中的塑膠垃圾量。"},{"sentence":"After long debates, the organizing <target>committee</target> finally decided to hold the graduation ceremony in the city park.","translation":"籌備委員會在經過長時間的爭論後，終於決定將畢業典禮在城市公園舉行。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"board","pos":"noun","translation":"董事會；委員會","explanation":"通常指更高層級的管理組織"},{"word":"panel","pos":"noun","translation":"專家小組","explanation":"指由專家組成的一組人"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"communicate","explanation":"「communicate」的核心在於「資訊的傳遞」。在學測中，這個字常出現在討論科技通訊、跨文化交流或人際關係的篇章中。重點在於分辨其後接的介系詞搭配以及其在不同語境下的具體含義。","senses":[{"sense":"交流；溝通（交換資訊、想法或情感）","entries":[{"pattern":"communicate with sb.","pos":"verb","translation":"與某人溝通","explanation":"強調與他人建立聯繫並交換資訊或情感。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Because she had never been abroad, she found it difficult to <target>communicate</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the local people during her trip.","translation":"因為她從未出國，她在旅途中發現很難與當地人溝通。"},{"sentence":"Parents are encouraged to <target>communicate</target> <pattern>with</pattern> their children more often to build a stronger emotional bond.","translation":"家長被鼓勵更經常地與孩子溝通，以建立更強的情感紐帶。"}]},{"pattern":"communicate sth. to sb.","pos":"verb","translation":"將某事傳達給某人","explanation":"強調資訊的單向傳遞，受詞通常是想法、訊息或感覺。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The manager used simple charts and clear graphs to <target>communicate</target> the complex data <pattern>to</pattern> the entire team.","translation":"經理使用簡單的圖表和清晰的圖形，將複雜的數據傳達給整個團隊。"},{"sentence":"The artist tried to <target>communicate</target> her deep sadness <pattern>to</pattern> the audience through the use of dark colors and slow music.","translation":"將其深沉的悲傷傳達給觀眾。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"interact","pos":"verb","translation":"互動","explanation":"強調雙向的行為互動"},{"word":"convey","pos":"verb","translation":"傳達","explanation":"常用於傳達抽象的想法或情感"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"communicated","past_participle":"communicated"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 communic (共同、分享) + 字尾 -ate (動詞字尾)","related":[{"word":"communication","pos":"noun","translation":"溝通；通訊","explanation":"由動詞 communicate 加上名詞字尾 -tion 延伸而來。"},{"word":"communicative","pos":"adjective","translation":"樂於溝通的","explanation":"由動詞 communicate 加上形容詞字尾 -ive 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"comparison","explanation":"「comparison」在學測中常出現在閱讀測驗中，用來描述兩者或多者之間的差異與相似之處。學生應掌握其常見的固定搭配（如 make a comparison 或 in comparison with），以利於快速準確地分析文章結構。","senses":[{"sense":"比較；對比（分析相似與差異之處）","entries":[{"pattern":"make a comparison between A and B","pos":"noun","translation":"將 A 與 B 進行比較","explanation":"常用於學術論文或分析類文章中，用來明確指出比較對象。","sentences":[{"sentence":"In the biology class, the teacher asked the students to <pattern>make a</pattern> <target>comparison</target> <pattern>between</pattern> the heart of a fish and a mammal.","translation":"在生物課上，老師要求學生將魚類與哺乳類動物的心臟進行比較。"},{"sentence":"The author makes a detailed <target>comparison</target> <pattern>between</pattern> traditional books and digital e-books in her latest essay.","translation":"作者在她最新的文章中，將傳統書籍與數位電子書進行了詳細的比較。"}]},{"pattern":"in comparison with sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"與…相比","explanation":"常用於作為修飾語，用以對比兩個對象的特徵特徵。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The cost of living in a small town is very low <pattern>in</pattern> <target>comparison</target> <pattern>with</pattern> that of a big city.","translation":"小鎮的生活成本與大城市相比是非常低的。"},{"sentence":"The new electric car is much quieter <pattern>in</pattern> <target>comparison</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the older gasoline models.","translation":"新款電動車與舊款汽油車相比，運行起來要安靜得多。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"contrast","pos":"noun","translation":"對比；對照","explanation":"強調差異之處"},{"word":"analogy","pos":"noun","translation":"類比","explanation":"強調相似之處"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 compar (比較) + 字尾 -ison (名詞字尾)","related":[{"word":"compare","pos":"verb","translation":"比較","explanation":"核心基礎動詞型態。"},{"word":"comparable","pos":"adjective","translation":"可比較的；相當的","explanation":"由動詞 compare 加上形容詞字尾 -able 延伸而來。"},{"word":"incomparable","pos":"adjective","translation":"無與倫比的","explanation":"字首 in- (否定) + comparable。"}]}}

{"headword":"compete","explanation":"「compete」在學測中常出現在討論競爭激烈的環境（如校園、職場、或是自然界）的語境中。重點在於掌握其後接的介系詞（with, against, for），因為這決定了其具體語義及考點。","senses":[{"sense":"競爭；競賽（為了贏得某物或達到某個目標而努力）","entries":[{"pattern":"compete with/against sb.","pos":"verb","translation":"與某人競爭","explanation":"強調與對手之間直接的對抗或比拼。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many talented students <target>compete</target> <pattern>with</pattern> each other to win a place in the most famous university.","translation":"許多才華橫溢的學生彼此競爭，以贏得進入最著名大學的一個名額。"},{"sentence":"Small local shops often find it difficult to <target>compete</target> <pattern>against</pattern> huge global companies that sell products at lower prices.","translation":"小型當地商店經常發現很難與那些以低價銷售產品的全球大公司競爭。"}]},{"pattern":"compete for sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"爭奪某物","explanation":"強調競爭的目標或獎項。","sentences":[{"sentence":"In the forest, different species of colorful birds <target>compete</target> <pattern>for</pattern> food and nesting sites to survive the winter.","translation":"在森林中，不同種類的彩色鳥類爭奪食物和築巢地點，以度過寒冬。"},{"sentence":"The two athletes <target>compete</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the gold medal in the 100-meter sprint, hoping to achieve their lifelong dream.","translation":"這兩位運動員在一百公尺衝刺賽中爭奪金牌，希望能實現他們終身夢想。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"vie","pos":"verb","translation":"競爭；爭奪","explanation":"較正式，常用於爭奪某種地位或權力"},{"word":"rival","pos":"verb","translation":"與…競爭；比肩","explanation":"強調對手實力相當"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"cooperate","pos":"verb","translation":"合作","explanation":"指共同努力達成目標"}]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"competed","past_participle":"competed"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 compet (追求、一起跑) + 字尾 -ete (動詞字尾)","related":[{"word":"competition","pos":"noun","translation":"競爭；競賽","explanation":"由動詞 compete 加上名詞字尾 -tion 延伸而來。"},{"word":"competitive","pos":"adjective","translation":"有競爭力的；好競爭的","explanation":"由動詞 compete 加上形容詞字尾 -ive 延伸而來。"},{"word":"competitor","pos":"noun","translation":"競爭者","explanation":"由動詞 compete 加上名詞字尾 -itor 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"complain","explanation":"「complain」在學測中常用於描述人對不滿之處的表達。注意其後方接續的介系詞（about, of, to）決定了不滿的對象、內容或對象，是文法考點重點。","senses":[{"sense":"抱怨；投訴（對某事表示不滿）","entries":[{"pattern":"complain about sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"抱怨某事","explanation":"最普遍的用法，指對某個狀況、環境或品質表示不滿。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many students <target>complain</target> <pattern>about</pattern> the heavy workload of high school, claiming that they have no time for sleep.","translation":"許多高中生抱怨高中沉重的課業負荷，聲稱他們沒有時間睡覺。"},{"sentence":"The tourists <target>complained</target> <pattern>about</pattern> the poor service at the hotel and asked for a full refund of their money.","translation":"遊客們抱怨飯店的服務很差，並要求全額退款。"}]},{"pattern":"complain to sb. about sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"向某人抱怨某事","explanation":"明確指出抱怨的對象（人）與內容（事）。","sentences":[{"sentence":"If you are unhappy with your room, you should <target>complain</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the manager <pattern>about</pattern> the loud noise next door.","translation":"如果你對房間不滿意，你應該向經理抱怨隔壁的噪音。"}]},{"pattern":"complain that...","pos":"verb","translation":"抱怨說…","explanation":"後接名詞子句，詳細描述不滿的內容。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The employees <target>complained</target> <pattern>that</pattern> the office was too cold, so the boss decided to fix the air conditioner.","translation":"員工們抱怨說辦公室太冷，因此老闆決定修理冷氣機。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"grumble","pos":"verb","translation":"抱怨；嘟囔","explanation":"指用低聲、不滿地說話"},{"word":"whine","pos":"verb","translation":"哀鳴；抱怨","explanation":"指用一種像小孩一樣的高頻率、煩人的聲音抱怨"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"complained","past_participle":"complained"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 complain (抱怨)","related":[{"word":"complaint","pos":"noun","translation":"抱怨；投訴","explanation":"complain 的名詞形式。"}]}}

{"headword":"complaint","explanation":"「complaint」是「complain」的名詞形式。在學測中，常出現在消費者權益、法律投訴或醫療診斷（主訴症狀）的語境中。","senses":[{"sense":"抱怨；投訴（表達不滿的行為或文字）","entries":[{"pattern":"make a complaint","pos":"noun","translation":"提出投訴","explanation":"固定搭配，指正式地表達不滿。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After receiving a broken toy, the customer decided to <pattern>make</pattern> a <target>complaint</target> to the store manager about the quality.","translation":"在收到損壞的玩具後，顧客決定向店經理提出投訴，質疑其品質。"}]},{"pattern":"a complaint about sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"關於某事的投訴","explanation":"用來修飾投訴的具體內容。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The school received a formal <target>complaint</target> <pattern>about</pattern> the new dress code, which many students found too strict.","translation":"學校收到了一份關於新校服規定（服裝規範）的正式投訴，許多學生認為這太嚴格了。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"grievance","pos":"noun","translation":"不滿；委屈","explanation":"通常指長期以來感覺不公平而產生的不滿"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"由動詞 complain 加上名詞字尾 -t","related":[{"word":"complain","pos":"verb","translation":"抱怨；投訴","explanation":"對應的動詞形式。"}]}}

{"headword":"concert","explanation":"「concert」在學測中多出現在描述音樂會、藝術展演或校園活動的語境中。注意其名詞用法，通常搭配特定的動詞如 attend 或 put on。","senses":[{"sense":"音樂會；演奏會","entries":[{"pattern":"attend a concert","pos":"noun","translation":"參加音樂會","explanation":"最常見的搭配，指親臨現場觀賞。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The students were very excited to <pattern>attend</pattern> a <target>concert</target> by their favorite pop star after the final exams.","translation":"期末考後，學生們非常興奮能去參加他們最喜歡的流行歌手的音樂會。"}]},{"pattern":"put on a concert","pos":"noun","translation":"舉辦音樂會","explanation":"指主辦方組織並執行演出。","sentences":[{"sentence":"To raise money for the poor children, the local high school decided to <pattern>put</pattern> <pattern>on</pattern> a charity <target>concert</target> in the gym.","translation":"為了替貧困兒童籌款，當地高中決定在體育館舉辦一場慈善音樂會。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"performance","pos":"noun","translation":"表演；演出","explanation":"較廣泛的詞彙，涵蓋所有類型的表演"},{"word":"gig","pos":"noun","translation":"小型演出","explanation":"非正式用法，常用於搖滾或流行音樂演出"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"conclusion","explanation":"「conclusion」在學測中是核心必考字彙。除了指物理上的「結尾」，更常用於學術論文、實驗報告或邏輯推理中的「結論」。","senses":[{"sense":"結論；推論（經過思考或證據後得出的結果）","entries":[{"pattern":"come to a conclusion","pos":"noun","translation":"得出結論","explanation":"固定搭配，指經過分析後決定或認同某個想法。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After reviewing all the evidence in the case, the judge <pattern>came</pattern> <pattern>to</pattern> a <target>conclusion</target> that the man was innocent.","translation":"在審查了案件中所有的證據後，法官得出了該男子無罪的結論。"}]},{"pattern":"draw a conclusion","pos":"noun","translation":"得出結論；推論","explanation":"指從特定事實中提取出一個概括性的結論。","sentences":[{"sentence":"It is dangerous to <pattern>draw</pattern> a <target>conclusion</target> based on only one example, because the truth can be very different.","translation":"僅根據一個例子就得出結論是非常危險的，因為事實真相可能完全不同。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"deduction","pos":"noun","translation":"推論；演繹","explanation":"強調從一般原則到具體事例的邏輯推演"},{"word":"inference","pos":"noun","translation":"s","explanation":"指從已知事實中推斷出未知之事"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"結尾；結束","entries":[{"pattern":"bring sth. to a conclusion","pos":"noun","translation":"使某事結束","explanation":"較正式的用法，指將一件事物（如會議、演講）圓滿結束。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The chairman <pattern>brought</pattern> the long meeting <pattern>to</pattern> a <target>conclusion</target> by asking everyone to vote on the final plan.","translation":"主席透過要求每個人對最終計劃投票，將這場漫長的會議圓滿結束。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"end","pos":"noun","translation":"結束；末端","explanation":null},{"word":"word","pos":"noun","translation":"終結","explanation":null}],"antonyms":[{"word":"beginning","pos":"noun","translation":"開始","explanation":null},{"word":"introduction","pos":"noun","translation":"前言；引言","explanation":null}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 conclude (結束/推論) + 名詞字尾 -sion","related":[{"word":"conclude","pos":"verb","translation":"得出結論；結束","explanation":"對應的動詞形式。"},{"word":"conclusive","pos":"adjective","translation":"決定性的；確鑿的","explanation":"指證據足以讓人在心中得出結論。"}]}}

{"headword":"cone","explanation":"「cone」在學測中主要出現在生物學（如松果或眼睛的錐狀細胞）以及基礎幾何學中。其核心語意是「錐形物」。","senses":[{"sense":"圓錐體；錐形物","entries":[{"pattern":"cone","pos":"noun","translation":"圓錐體；錐形物","explanation":"指任何形狀如圓錐的物體。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The children made a perfect <target>cone</target> of sand at the beach, which looked like a small mountain of gold.","translation":"孩子們在海邊用沙子堆了一個完美的圓錐體，看起來像一座金色的小山。"},{"sentence":"Traffic police often place bright orange <target>cones</target> on the road to warn drivers to slow down and change lanes.","translation":"交通警察經常在道路上放置亮橘色的錐形桶，以警告駕駛者減速並變換車道。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"confirm","explanation":"「confirm」在學測中常用於正式的溝通、法律證據或科學驗證。要注意它與 verify 或 prove 的細微差別：confirm 通常是指「確認」已經存在的訊息或傾向是否正確。","senses":[{"sense":"確認；證實（使某事被證明為真實或正確）","entries":[{"pattern":"confirm sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"確認某事","explanation":"及物動詞，受詞通常是約定、消息、事實或假設。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The airline sent a short email to <target>confirm</target> the flight date and time, so I know exactly when to leave.","translation":"航空公司發了一封簡短的電子郵件來確認航班日期和時間，所以我確切知道何時該出發。"}]},{"pattern":"confirm that...","pos":"verb","translation":"確認…（後接子句）","explanation":"後接名詞子句，用來詳細說明被確認的具體內容，在正式報告中極為常見。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The laboratory results <target>confirm</target> <pattern>that</pattern> the water in the local river is safe for drinking and contains no dangerous chemicals.","translation":"實驗室結果證實，當地河流中的水適合飲用且不含危險化學物質。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"confirmed","past_participle":"confirmed"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字首 con- (一起) 與字根 firm (堅固)","related":[{"word":"confirmation","pos":"noun","translation":"確認；證實","explanation":"由動詞 confirm 加上名詞字尾 -tion 延伸而來。"},{"word":"firm","pos":"adjective","translation":"堅固的；堅定的","explanation":"核心字根，指狀態穩定且不輕易改變。"}]}}

{"headword":"confuse","explanation":"「confuse」在學測中不僅指心理上的「混淆」，也常出現在描述實驗數據或複雜指令時的誤解。要注意其被動態用法 confuse a with b 或 be confused by sth.，這是考題中的陷阱點。","senses":[{"sense":"使混淆；弄錯（使某人無法分辨兩者或感到困惑）","entries":[{"pattern":"confuse A with B","pos":"verb","translation":"將 A 與 B 混淆","explanation":"最核心的搭配句型，指將兩個相似的東西誤認為是同一個。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Because the two twins look almost identical, many new students often <target>confuse</target> Sarah <pattern>with</pattern> her sister Emily.","translation":"因為這對雙胞胎長得幾乎一模一樣，許多新學生經常將莎拉與她的妹妹艾蜜莉混淆。"}]},{"pattern":"be confused by sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"被某事搞混／感到困惑","explanation":"常用被動態，表示主詞對於某項複雜的資訊或指令感到不解。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The visitors were completely <target>confused</target> <pattern>by</pattern> the complicated signs in the airport, and they walked in circles for an hour.","translation":"遊客們被機場裡複雜的標誌搞得完全困惑，他們在那裡繞圈子走了一個小時。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"confused","past_participle":"confused"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字首 con- (一起) 與字根 fuse (傾倒、融合)","related":[{"word":"confusion","pos":"noun","translation":"混亂；困惑","explanation":"由動詞 confuse 加上名詞字尾 -ion 延伸而來。"},{"word":"confusing","pos":"adjective","translation":"令人困惑的","explanation":"描述事物的性質，指該事物會使人感到困惑。"}]}}

{"headword":"connect","explanation":"「connect」在學測中涵蓋了物理上的「連接」與邏輯上的「關聯」。在科技類文章中常用於描述網路連接，而在人文類文章中則用於描述概念之間的聯繫。","senses":[{"sense":"連接；聯繫（物理上或邏輯上的結合）","entries":[{"pattern":"connect A to B","pos":"verb","translation":"將 A 連接到 B","explanation":"強調物理上的連接，如電線或道路。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The technician helped me <target>connect</target> my new laptop <pattern>to</pattern> the office Wi-Fi so I could start working immediately.","translation":"技術員幫我將新筆記型電腦連接到辦公室的 Wi-Fi，這樣我才能立即開始工作。"}]},{"pattern":"be connected with sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"與…有關聯","explanation":"常用於描述抽象的概念、原因或事件之間的邏輯關係。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many scientists believe that high sugar intake is closely <target>connected</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the rising rate of childhood obesity.","translation":"許多科學家認為，攝取過多糖分與兒童肥胖率上升密切相關。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"connected","past_participle":"connected"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字首 con- (一起) 與字根 nect (綁、連結)","related":[{"word":"connection","pos":"noun","translation":"連接；關聯","explanation":"由動詞 connect 加上名詞字尾 -ion 延伸而來。"},{"word":"disconnect","pos":"verb","translation":"中斷連接；切斷","explanation":"字首 dis- (相反) + connect，意為取消連接。"}]}}

{"headword":"conscious","explanation":"「conscious」在學測中主要分為「意識到」與「清醒」兩個層面。要注意它與 subconscious (潛意識) 的對比，以及它常搭配的介系詞 of，這是文意選填的關鍵考點。","senses":[{"sense":"意識到的；覺察的（對周圍環境或特定事實的認知）","entries":[{"pattern":"be conscious of sth.","pos":"adjective","translation":"意識到某事","explanation":"指主詞察覺到某種情況、事實或情感的存在。","sentences":[{"sentence":"As the storm approached, the hikers became <target>conscious</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the sudden drop in temperature and decided to head back.","translation":"隨著風暴接近，登山客們意識到溫度突然下降，於是決定往回走。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"清醒的（未昏迷或失去意識）","entries":[{"pattern":"conscious","pos":"adjective","translation":"清醒的","explanation":"常用於醫療或事故描述，指主詞處於意識清醒狀態。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The patient was still <target>conscious</target> when the paramedics arrived, though he could barely speak due to the pain.","translation":"當救護人員到達時，病人仍然清醒，儘管他因為疼痛而幾乎無法說話。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 sci (知道) + 形容詞字尾 -ous","related":[{"word":"consciousness","pos":"noun","translation":"意識；清醒","explanation":"由形容詞 conscious 加上名詞字尾 -ness 延伸而來。"},{"word":"unconscious","pos":"adjective","translation":"失去意識的；無意識的","explanation":"反義詞，指主詞處於昏迷或未察覺狀態。"}]}}

{"headword":"considerable","explanation":"「considerable」在學測中是一個高頻的程度副詞，用來修飾名詞，表示「相當大的」或「相當多的」。學生容易將其與 considerate (體貼的) 混淆，必須在記憶時將其區分為程度量化與人格特質。","senses":[{"sense":"相當大的；相當多的（在數量、程度或規模上值得注意）","entries":[{"pattern":"considerable + noun","pos":"adjective","translation":"相當大的…","explanation":"常用於修飾數量、金額、時間或影響力等名詞。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After months of hard work, the team spent a <target>considerable</target> <pattern>amount</pattern> of time researching the effects of climate change.","translation":"經過數月的努力，之後團隊花費了相當多的時間研究氣候變遷的影響。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"動詞 consider (考慮) + 形容詞字尾 -able (可…的)","related":[{"word":"considerate","pos":"adjective","translation":"體貼的；周到的","explanation":"指對他人的需求考慮周到，與 considerable 語意完全不同。"},{"word":"considerably","pos":"adverb","translation":"相當地；大幅地","explanation":"由形容詞 considerable 加上副詞字尾 -ly 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"continent","explanation":"「continent」在地理、環境類文章中是基礎名詞。學生應注意其與 continental (形容詞) 的區分，以及在描述大洲時的用法。","senses":[{"sense":"大陸；大洲","entries":[{"pattern":"continent","pos":"noun","translation":"大陸；大洲","explanation":"指地球上最大的陸地塊。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Africa is a vast <target>continent</target> with diverse climates, ranging from hot deserts to lush tropical rainforests.","translation":"非洲是一個巨大的大洲，擁有多樣的氣候，從炎熱的沙漠到茂密的熱帶雨林。"},{"sentence":"Many ancient animals traveled across the <target>continent</target> long before the modern borders of countries were created.","translation":"許多古代動物在現代國界創建之前，就早早跨越了這片大陸。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"continental","pos":"adjective","translation":"大陸的","explanation":"由 continent 加上形容詞字尾 -al 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"controller","explanation":"「controller」在科技、電玩以及管理類文章中常見。其核心概念是「控制者」或「控制裝置」，學生需分辨其具體物體與抽象管理者的區分。","senses":[{"sense":"控制器；遙控器（電子設備的控制裝置）","entries":[{"pattern":"controller","pos":"noun","translation":"控制器；遙控器","explanation":"指用來操作電子設備（如遊戲機）的硬體裝置。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The gamer complained that his wireless <target>controller</target> stopped working because the batteries had completely run out.","translation":"這名玩家抱怨他的無線控制器停止運作，因為電池已經完全用完了。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"remote","pos":"noun","translation":"遙控器","explanation":"更常用於電視或空調遙控器"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"掌控者；管理員（負責控制或監督的人）","entries":[{"pattern":"controller","pos":"noun","translation":"掌控者；管理員","explanation":"指負責監督、管理某項運作的人。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The air traffic <target>controller</target> must stay focused for hours to ensure that planes land safely at the airport.","translation":"空中交通管制員必須專注數小時，以確保飛機在機場安全著陸。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"manager","pos":"noun","translation":"經理；管理者","explanation":"指負責管理人員或調度的人"},{"word":"supervisor","pos":"noun","translation":"監督者","explanation":"指負責監督工作品質的人"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"動詞 control + 名詞字尾 -ler (指人或物)","related":[{"word":"control","pos":"verb","translation":"控制；掌控","explanation":"核心動詞型態。"},{"word":"controllable","pos":"adjective","translation":"可控制的","explanation":"由 control 加上形容詞字尾 -able 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"cooker","explanation":"「cooker」常被學生誤用為「廚師 (cook)」。在學測中，應明確區分 cooker (烹飪器具) 與 cook (廚師) 的用法。","senses":[{"sense":"烹飪器具（用來煮東西的設備）","entries":[{"pattern":"cooker","pos":"noun","translation":"烹飪器具","explanation":"指物理上的設備，如電鍋、壓力鍋等。","sentences":[{"sentence":"My mother bought a new electric rice <target>cooker</target> that can cook perfect rice in less than twenty minutes.","translation":"我母親買了一個新的電鍋，可以在不到二十分鐘內煮出完美的米飯。"},{"sentence":"The slow <target>cooker</target> is perfect for making tender meat because it heats the food slowly over many hours.","translation":"慢燉鍋非常適合製作嫩肉，因為它在許多小時內緩慢地加熱食物。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"動詞 cook + 名詞字尾 -er (指物)","related":[{"word":"cook","pos":"noun","translation":"廚師","explanation":"注意：cook 作為名詞時，指的人是廚師，而非烹飪器具。"},{"word":"cook","pos":"verb","translation":"烹飪","explanation":"核心動詞型態。"}]}}

{"headword":"costly","explanation":"「costly」雖然以 -ly 結尾，但它是形容詞而非副詞。在學測文法題中，這是極其高頻的考點（形容詞 vs 副詞辨析）。","senses":[{"sense":"昂貴的（價格高昂）","entries":[{"pattern":"costly + noun","pos":"adjective","translation":"昂貴的…","explanation":"修飾名詞，指物品價格高。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The royal family owns many <target>costly</target> paintings and gold statues that are kept in a private museum.","translation":"王室擁有許多昂貴的畫作和金像，被保存在私人博物館中。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"expensive","pos":"adjective","translation":"昂貴的","explanation":"最普遍常用的形容詞"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"cheap","pos":"adjective","translation":"便宜的","explanation":null},{"word":"affordable","pos":"adjective","translation":"可負擔的","explanation":"指價格在可接受範圍內"}]},{"sense":"代價沉重的（指錯誤或失誤導致的嚴重後果）","entries":[{"pattern":"a costly mistake / error","pos":"adjective","translation":"代價沉重的錯誤","explanation":"指非金錢上的損失，而是導致嚴重結果的錯誤。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The company made a <target>costly</target> <pattern>mistake</pattern> by ignoring the warning signs of the economic crisis.","translation":"公司因為忽略經濟危機的警告跡象而犯了一個代價沉重的錯誤。"},{"sentence":"One <target>costly</target> <pattern>error</pattern> in the computer code caused the entire system to crash during the final test.","translation":"電腦程式碼中的一個沉重錯誤導致整個系統在最終測試期間崩潰。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"dear","pos":"adjective","translation":"昂貴的；代價高的","explanation":"較為文學或舊式的用法"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"名詞 cost (成本/費用) + 字尾 -ly (形容詞)","related":[{"word":"cost","pos":"noun","translation":"成本；費用","explanation":"核心名詞型態。"},{"word":"word","pos":"noun","translation":"單字","explanation":"此處為範例填充，應以 cost 相關詞彙為主"}]}}

{"headword":"cotton","explanation":"「cotton」在閱讀測驗中常出現在關於天然纖維、紡織工業或環境議題（如快時尚對環境的影響）的文本中。它既可作為物質名詞，也可作為形容詞修飾後方衣物材質。","senses":[{"sense":"棉花；棉織品（天然纖維材質）","entries":[{"pattern":"cotton","pos":"noun","translation":"棉花；棉織品","explanation":"指天然的植物纖維或由其製成的布料。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Because <target>cotton</target> is soft and breathable, many people prefer wearing light shirts made of this material during the hot summer.","translation":"因為棉花材質柔軟且透氣，許多人在炎熱的夏天更喜歡穿著由這種材質製成的輕便襯衫。"},{"sentence":"The factory produces high-quality <target>cotton</target> for clothing brands, but the process requires a huge amount of water for irrigation.","translation":"這家工廠為服裝品牌生產高品質的棉花，但這個過程需要大量的灌溉用水。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"cottony","pos":"adjective","translation":"像棉花般的","explanation":"指外觀或觸感像棉花一樣柔軟。"}]}}

{"headword":"cough","explanation":"「cough」在日常健康與醫療情境中非常高頻。注意其名詞與動詞用法，且在描述症狀時，常搭配特定的形容詞（如 dry, productive）來具體化病情。","senses":[{"sense":"咳嗽（生理反應或症狀）","entries":[{"pattern":"cough","pos":"verb","translation":"咳嗽","explanation":"指從肺部排出空氣而發出的聲音。作為動詞時，可直接接名詞受詞表示「咳出」某物。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The student began to <target>cough</target> loudly during the silent exam, which distracted many other students who were trying to concentrate.","translation":"學生在寂靜的考試期間開始大聲咳嗽，這分散了許多正試圖專注的其他學生的注意力。"},{"sentence":"If you <target>cough</target> <pattern>up</pattern> some dust, you will feel much better because your lungs are cleaning themselves.","translation":"如果你能咳出一些灰塵，你會感覺好得多，因為你的肺正在進行自我清理。"}]},{"pattern":"a cough","pos":"noun","translation":"咳嗽；咳嗽聲","explanation":"指一次咳嗽的動作或一段時間的咳嗽症狀。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After walking through the smoggy city air for an hour, the tourist developed a persistent <target>cough</target> that lasted for weeks.","translation":"在煙霧繚繞的城市空氣中走了一小時後，這位遊客產生了持續數週的咳嗽症狀。"},{"sentence":"The teacher gave a small <target>cough</target> to get the students' attention before she started her lecture on world history.","translation":"老師在開始世界歷史講座之前，輕輕咳了一聲以吸引學生的注意力。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"透露；交出（非正式用法，常用於錢財或資訊）","entries":[{"pattern":"cough up sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"勉強交出；透露","explanation":"口語用法，指在壓力下不情願地交出金錢或資訊。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The company was forced to <target>cough</target> <pattern>up</pattern> thousands of dollars in fines after they were caught polluting the local river.","translation":"這家公司在被發現污染當地河流後，被迫交出數千美元的罰金。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"hack","pos":"verb","translation":"劇烈咳嗽","explanation":"指發出乾咳或不舒服的聲音。"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"coughed","past_participle":"coughed"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"countable","explanation":"「countable」在語言學或數學討論中出現。對於學測學生而言，理解其與「uncountable」的對比是掌握名詞可數性（countable vs. uncountable nouns）的關鍵。","senses":[{"sense":"可數的（可以被計算的）","entries":[{"pattern":"countable","pos":"adjective","translation":"可數的","explanation":"指數量可以用數字直接計算出的事物。","sentences":[{"sentence":"In English grammar, a <target>countable</target> noun refers to things that we can count using numbers, such as books, chairs, or apples.","translation":"在英文文法中，可數名詞是指我們可以用數字計算的事物，例如書本、椅子或蘋果。"},{"sentence":"The teacher explained that while water is an uncountable noun, a glass of water is <target>countable</target> because we can count the glasses.","translation":"老師解釋說，雖然水是不可數名詞，但一杯水是可數的，因為我們可以計算杯子的數量。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[{"word":"uncountable","pos":"adjective","translation":"不可數的","explanation":null}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 count (計算) + 形容詞字尾 -able (可...的)","related":[{"word":"count","pos":"verb","translation":"計算；重要","explanation":null},{"word":"counter","pos":"noun","translation":"計數器；櫃檯","explanation":null}]}}

{"headword":"county","explanation":"「county」在閱讀測驗中常出現在關於行政區劃或美國、英國等地的地理描述中。學生需區分其與 country (國家) 的拼寫與意義上的差異。","senses":[{"sense":"郡；縣（行政區劃）","entries":[{"pattern":"county","pos":"noun","translation":"郡；縣","explanation":"指一個國家內部的行政分區，通常比市或鎮小，但比村莊大。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The local government decided to build a new public library in our <target>county</target> to provide more learning resources for rural students.","translation":"地方政府決定在我們縣內建造一座新的公共圖書館，以向鄉村學生提供更多學習資源。"},{"sentence":"After moving to the countryside, my uncle found a quiet house in a small <target>county</target> where everyone knew each other's names.","translation":"搬到鄉下後， my uncle 在一個小郡中找到了一間安靜的房子，在那裡每個人都知道彼此的名字。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"country","pos":"noun","translation":"國家；鄉間","explanation":"容易與 county 混淆的單字。"}]}}

{"headword":"crab","explanation":"「crab」在自然生態或海洋生物類閱讀測驗中是基礎核心名詞。","senses":[{"sense":"螃蟹","entries":[{"pattern":"crab","pos":"noun","translation":"螃蟹","explanation":"常用於描述其身體特徵（如硬殼、橫著走）或出現在海洋生物學討論中。","sentences":[{"sentence":"While walking along the sandy beach, the children discovered a tiny <target>crab</target> hiding under a large, wet rock.","translation":"在沙灘上行走時，孩子們發現了一隻小螃蟹躲在一個巨大的、潮濕的岩石下方。"},{"sentence":"The biologist explained that the <target>crab</target> has a hard outer shell to protect its soft body from predators in the ocean.","translation":"生物學家解釋說，螃蟹擁有堅硬的外殼以保護其柔軟的身體免受海洋中捕食者的侵害。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}
