{"headword":"crane","explanation":"「crane」是一個典型的多義詞，在學測中考生必須區分其作為名詞時的「生物（起重機/鶴）」與作為動詞時的「伸長脖子」的動作。","senses":[{"sense":"起重機；鶴（大型機械或長頸鳥類）","entries":[{"pattern":"crane","pos":"noun","translation":"起重機","explanation":"指建築工地常見的大型起重設備。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The construction workers used a massive <target>crane</target> to lift heavy steel beams to the top of the new skyscraper.","translation":"建築工人使用一台巨大的起重機將沉重的鋼樑吊到新摩天大樓的頂端。"}]},{"pattern":"crane","pos":"noun","translation":"鶴","explanation":"指一種長腿、長頸的鳥類，常用於自然生態描述。","sentences":[{"sentence":"During the winter months, a group of elegant white <target>cranes</target> flew over the wetlands in search of a warmer place.","translation":"在冬季月份中，一群優雅的白鶴飛越濕地，尋找一個較溫暖的地方。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"伸長脖子（為了看清某物）","entries":[{"pattern":"crane one's neck","pos":"verb","translation":"伸長脖子","explanation":"模仿鶴的頸部動作，指為了看清前方的景象而努力伸長脖子。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The excited fans <target>craned</target> <pattern>their necks</pattern> to see the famous pop star as she walked through the crowded airport.","translation":"興奮的粉絲們伸長了脖子，想在那位著名的流行歌手走過擁擠的機場時看見她。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"craned","past_participle":"craned"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"crash","explanation":"「crash」在學測中常見於交通意外、電腦故障或金融崩潰的語境。要注意其作為名詞與動詞的用法均可直接接受詞或搭配介系詞 to 或 into。","senses":[{"sense":"碰撞；崩潰（劇烈撞擊或突然失效）","entries":[{"pattern":"crash into sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"撞上某物","explanation":"指物理上的劇烈碰撞，常用於車禍或意外事故。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Because the driver fell asleep at the wheel, the car <target>crashed</target> <pattern>into</pattern> a large brick wall by the roadside.","translation":"因為駕駛在方向盤前睡著了，汽車撞上了路邊的一堵大磚牆。"}]},{"pattern":"crash","pos":"verb","translation":"（電腦、系統）崩潰","explanation":"指電子設備或軟體突然停止運作。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The school's online registration system <target>crashed</target> because too many students tried to log in at the exact same time.","translation":"學校的線上註冊系統崩潰了，因為太多學生在同一時間嘗試登入。"}]},{"pattern":"a market crash","pos":"noun","translation":"股市崩潰；金融危機","explanation":"指金融市場價格突然大幅下跌。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The sudden stock market <target>crash</target> caused many wealthy investors to lose their entire life savings in just a few days.","translation":"突然的股市崩潰導致許多富有的投資者在短短幾天內失去了他們一生的積蓄。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"collide","pos":"verb","translation":"碰撞","explanation":"強調兩物體相撞"},{"word":"collapse","pos":"verb","translation":"崩潰；倒塌","explanation":"指系統或結構的突然失效"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"大聲地進入；不請自來（非正式用法）","entries":[{"pattern":"crash a party","pos":"verb","translation":"不請自來地參加派對","explanation":"非正式用法，指在沒有邀請的情況下強行參加活動。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Although he was not on the guest list, the bold teenager decided to <target>crash</target> the wedding party of his former classmate.","translation":"儘管他不在賓客名單上，這個大膽的青少年決定不請自來地參加他前任同學的婚禮派對。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"crashed","past_participle":"crashed"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"crawl","explanation":"「crawl」主要描述緩慢的移動方式。在學測中，除了指嬰兒或昆蟲的爬行，也常比喻指交通擁堵時車輛的「緩慢行進」。","senses":[{"sense":"爬行；緩慢移動","entries":[{"pattern":"crawl","pos":"verb","translation":"爬行","explanation":"指嬰兒、昆蟲或受傷的人在地面上緩慢移動。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The curious baby <target>crawled</target> across the living room floor to reach the colorful toy that his father had just bought.","translation":"好奇的寶寶在客廳地板上爬行，以拿到他父親剛剛買的彩色玩具。"}]},{"pattern":"crawl","pos":"verb","translation":"緩慢行進","explanation":"比喻用法，指車輛在交通堵塞時移動速度極慢。","sentences":[{"sentence":"During the heavy rush hour, the cars on the highway <target>crawled</target> forward so slowly that I felt like I would never arrive.","translation":"在繁忙的尖峰時段，高速公路上的車輛行進得如此緩慢，以至於我覺得自己永遠不會到達。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"creep","pos":"verb","translation":"悄悄爬行；潛行","explanation":"強調動作緩慢且試圖不被發現"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"sprint","pos":"verb","translation":"全速奔跑","explanation":null}]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"crawled","past_participle":"crawled"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"creative","explanation":"「creative」是描述能力、想法或作品的基礎形容詞。在寫作中，建議學生將其與 a creative approach 或 a creative solution 搭配，以提升文章的層次感。","senses":[{"sense":"有創造力的；創新的","entries":[{"pattern":"creative","pos":"adjective","translation":"有創造力的","explanation":"指一個人擁有產出新想法或原創作品的能力。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The art teacher praised the student for her <target>creative</target> use of recycled materials to build a model of a future city.","translation":"藝術老師稱讚這位學生有創造力地利用回收材料來建造一座未來城市的模型。"}]},{"pattern":"a creative solution","pos":"adjective","translation":"創新的解決方案","explanation":"指用不尋常但有效的方式解決問題。","sentences":[{"sentence":"When the team faced a difficult technical problem, they had to find a <target>creative</target> <pattern>solution</pattern> to fix it quickly.","translation":"當團隊面對一個困難的技術問題時，他們必須找到一個創新的解決方案來快速修復它。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"imaginative","pos":"adjective","translation":"富有想像力的","explanation":"強調腦海中構思能力強"},{"word":"innovative","pos":"adjective","translation":"創新地","explanation":"強調引入新方法或新技術"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"unimaginative","pos":"adjective","translation":"缺乏想像力的","explanation":null},{"word":"traditional","pos":"adjective","translation":"傳統的","explanation":"指遵循舊有方式"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 create (創造) + 形容詞字尾 -ive","related":[{"word":"creation","pos":"noun","translation":"創造物；創造","explanation":"由動詞 create 加上名詞字尾 -tion 延伸而來。"},{"word":"creativity","pos":"noun","translation":"創造力","explanation":"由形容詞 creative 加上名詞字尾 -ity 延伸而來。"},{"word":"creator","pos":"noun","translation":"創造者","explanation":"由動詞 create 加上人物名詞字尾 -or 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"creator","explanation":"「creator」在學測中常出現在探討藝術、科技、宗教或內容創作（如 YouTuber, Podcaster）的文章中。理解此字時應區分其作為「創造者」的通用義與在宗教語境中特指「造物主」的用法。","senses":[{"sense":"創造者；創作者（指將某物從無到有發明或設計出的人）","entries":[{"pattern":"creator of sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"…的創造者","explanation":"後接該作品、系統或發明之名稱，強調設計與產出的過程。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The <target>creator</target> <pattern>of</pattern> this innovative educational app designed it to help students learn languages more naturally.","translation":"這款創新教育應用程式的創造者設計它的目的是為了幫助學生更自然地學習語言。"},{"sentence":"Many people admire the original <target>creator</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the series for his ability to build such a complex and believable world.","translation":"許多人欽佩這系列作品的原創作者，因為他有能力建立一個如此複雜且令人信服的世界。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"inventor","pos":"noun","translation":"發明家","explanation":"強調從無到有發明新裝置或新方法的創造者"},{"word":"author","pos":"noun","translation":"作者；創作者","explanation":"泛指任何作品的創作者"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"造物主；上帝（宗教語境中的最高創造者）","entries":[{"pattern":"the Creator","pos":"noun","translation":"造物主","explanation":"通常首字母大寫，指宇宙與生命的創造者。","sentences":[{"sentence":"In many ancient cultures, people believed that the <target>Creator</target> designed every small detail of the natural world with a purpose.","translation":"在許多古代文化中，人們相信造物主是有目的地設計了自然世界的每一個小細節。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"God","pos":"noun","translation":"上帝；神","explanation":null}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"動詞 create (創造) + 名詞字尾 -or (…者)","related":[{"word":"create","pos":"verb","translation":"創造；建立","explanation":"核心基礎動詞。"},{"word":"creative","pos":"adjective","translation":"有創造力的","explanation":"由動詞 create 加上形容詞字尾 -ive 延伸而來。"},{"word":"creativity","pos":"noun","translation":"創造力","explanation":"由形容詞 creative 加上名詞字尾 -ity 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"dairy","explanation":"「dairy」在學測中主要出現在健康、營養、飲食或農業類型的閱讀測驗中。要注意其拼寫，不要與 diary (日記) 混淆，這是一個極為常見的考點。","senses":[{"sense":"乳製品；乳製品業","entries":[{"pattern":"dairy product","pos":"noun","translation":"乳製品","explanation":"指牛奶、起司、奶油等由牛奶製成的食品。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Doctors recommend that children eat enough <pattern>dairy</pattern> <target>products</target> like milk and yogurt to help their bones grow strong.","translation":"醫生建議孩子們攝取足夠的乳製品，如牛奶和優格，以幫助骨骼強壯成長。"},{"sentence":"Since he is allergic to milk, the young man must strictly avoid all <target>dairy</target> <pattern>products</pattern> in his daily diet.","translation":"由於他對牛奶過敏，這位年輕人必須在日常飲食中嚴格避免所有乳製品。"}]},{"pattern":"dairy farm","pos":"noun","translation":"奶牛場；乳製品農場","explanation":"指生產牛奶的農場。","sentences":[{"sentence":"My uncle owns a large <target>dairy</target> <pattern>farm</pattern> in the countryside, where hundreds of cows are milked every single morning.","translation":"我的叔叔在鄉下擁有一座大型奶牛場，每天早晨數百頭牛都被擠奶。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"dam","explanation":"「dam」在學測中常出現在環境、工程或自然地理類文章中。名詞指的是水壩，動詞則是指建造水壩以攔截水流。注意其拼寫，不要與 damn (該死) 混淆。","senses":[{"sense":"水壩（攔截水流的建築物）","entries":[{"pattern":"dam","pos":"noun","translation":"水壩","explanation":"指用來儲水或發電的水壩實體。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The government decided to build a massive concrete <target>dam</target> across the river to provide electricity for the growing city.","translation":"政府決定在河流上建造一座巨大的混凝土水壩，為日益增長的城市提供電力。"},{"sentence":"After the heavy rain, the local residents feared that the old <target>dam</target> might break and flood the entire valley.","translation":"大雨之後，當地居民擔心舊水壩可能會崩塌並淹沒整個山谷。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"barrier","pos":"noun","translation":"屏障；障礙物","explanation":"泛指攔截任何東西的屏障"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"築壩；攔截水流","entries":[{"pattern":"dam sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"築壩攔截某物","explanation":"指將水流攔截住，通常指建造水壩。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Beavers are famous for their ability to <target>dam</target> <pattern>up</pattern> small streams, creating deep ponds for their families to live in.","translation":"河狸以其築壩攔截小溪的能力而聞名，為其家人創造深池以居住。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"dammed","past_participle":"dammed"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"dare","explanation":"「dare」是一個特殊的動詞，既可用作主動詞（需助動詞 do/does/did），也可用作情態助動詞（不需助動詞）。在學測中，最常考的是 dare to do sth. 以及 dare not do sth. 的用法。","senses":[{"sense":"敢於；挑戰（具有勇氣去做某事）","entries":[{"pattern":"dare to do sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"敢於做某事","explanation":"最常見的用法，dare 作為一般動詞，後接 to-V。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Even though the dark forest was terrifying, the brave young explorer <target>dared</target> <pattern>to</pattern> enter the cave alone.","translation":"儘管黑暗的森林令人恐懼，這位勇敢的年輕探險家仍敢於獨自進入洞穴。"},{"sentence":"The shy student <target>dared</target> <pattern>not</pattern> <pattern>to</pattern> speak up in class, fearing that his classmates would laugh at his mistakes.","translation":"這位害羞的學生不敢在課堂上發言，擔心同學會嘲笑他的錯誤。"}]},{"pattern":"dare sb. to do sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"挑戰某人做某事","explanation":"指挑釁或激將法，要求對方做某事。","sentences":[{"sentence":"During the summer camp, the older boys <target>dared</target> <pattern>their</pattern> <pattern>friends</pattern> <pattern>to</pattern> jump into the cold lake at midnight.","translation":"在夏令營期間，大男孩們挑戰他們的朋友們在午夜跳入冰冷的湖中。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"venture","pos":"verb","translation":"冒險嘗試","explanation":"強調在危險或不確定情況下嘗試"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"fear","pos":"verb","translation":"恐懼","explanation":null}]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"dared","past_participle":"dared"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"darling","explanation":"「darling」在學測中主要作為名詞或形容詞使用，用來表達強烈的喜愛或親暱感。要注意它在文學作品或對話中常被用作稱呼語。","senses":[{"sense":"親愛的（名詞：稱呼對方）；（形容詞：可愛的）","entries":[{"pattern":"darling","pos":"noun","translation":"親愛的","explanation":"用來稱呼親近的人，如配偶、孩子或親密朋友。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The mother gently kissed her <target>darling</target> son on the forehead before he went to sleep in his own bed.","translation":"母親在兒子睡覺前，輕輕地在他額頭上親了一口，稱他為親愛的兒子。"}]},{"pattern":"darling","pos":"adjective","translation":"可愛的；討喜的","explanation":"用來描述人或物（如小動物、小衣服）非常可愛且令人喜愛。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The little girl was wearing a <target>darling</target> white dress with small pink flowers, making everyone in the room smile.","translation":"那個小女孩穿著一件可愛的白色洋裝，上面有小粉紅花，讓房間裡的所有人都微笑。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"beloved","pos":"noun","translation":"心愛的人","explanation":"較正式的詞彙，強調強烈的情感連結"},{"word":"adorable","pos":"adjective","translation":"可愛的","explanation":"指外觀或行為非常討喜"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"dash","explanation":"「dash」在學測中具有兩種完全不同的高頻用法：作為動詞時，強調「快速奔跑」的動態感；作為名詞時，則常出現在描述「短距離衝刺」或「少量添加」的語境中。區分這兩種語意對於理解文章的動作流程至關重要。","senses":[{"sense":"快速奔跑；衝刺（突然且迅速地移動）","entries":[{"pattern":"dash to sth./do sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"衝向某處／衝去執行某事","explanation":"強調在時間緊迫的情況下，突然快速移動。","sentences":[{"sentence":"As soon as the bell rang, the students <target>dashed</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the cafeteria to get their lunch before the line became too long.","translation":"當鈴聲一響，學生們便衝向食堂，以便在排隊人潮過長之前拿到午餐。"},{"sentence":"The young athlete <target>dashed</target> <pattern>to</pattern> grab his water bottle after finishing the race, gasping for air in the hot sun.","translation":"那名年輕運動員在跑完比賽後衝去拿他的水瓶，在烈日下大口喘氣。"}]},{"pattern":"make a dash for sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"向某處衝刺","explanation":"名詞用法，指一次快速的奔跑行動。","sentences":[{"sentence":"When the sudden rainstorm started, everyone <target>made a dash for</target> the nearest shelter to avoid getting soaked.","translation":"當突然的暴雨開始時，每個人都向最近的遮雨處衝刺，以避免被淋濕。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"sprint","pos":"verb","translation":"短跑；衝刺","explanation":"強調最高速度的短距離奔跑"},{"word":"rush","pos":"verb","translation":"衝；趕","explanation":"泛指匆忙地移動"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"少量添加（少量地加入某種物質）","entries":[{"pattern":"a dash of sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"少量的…","explanation":"常用於烹飪或調味語境，指極小量地加入某物。","sentences":[{"sentence":"To make the soup taste better, the chef added <pattern>a</pattern> <target>dash</target> <pattern>of</pattern> salt and a bit of black pepper.","translation":"為了讓湯的味道更好，主廚加入了少量的鹽和一點黑胡椒。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"dashed","past_participle":"dashed"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"database","explanation":"「database」是現代數位時代的基礎詞彙。在學測閱讀中，常出現在探討科技、數據分析、人工智慧以及資訊管理等主題的文章中，需注意其與 data (數據) 的區別。","senses":[{"sense":"資料庫（有組織地儲存資訊的系統）","entries":[{"pattern":"database","pos":"noun","translation":"資料庫","explanation":"指儲存在電腦中的有組織的資訊集合。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The university library provides students with access to a massive <target>database</target> of academic journals to help them with their research.","translation":"大學圖書館為學生提供了進入海量學術期刊資料庫的權限，以幫助他們進行研究。"},{"sentence":"The police used a national fingerprint <target>database</target> to quickly identify the suspect who had left a mark at the crime scene.","translation":"警方使用國家指紋資料庫，快速識別出在犯罪現場留下痕跡的嫌疑人。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"archive","pos":"noun","translation":"檔案館；數據存檔","explanation":"強調長期儲存的歷史記錄"},{"word":"repository","pos":"noun","translation":"儲藏庫","explanation":"儲存大量資訊或物品的地方"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"data (數據) + base (基礎/基地)","related":[{"word":"data","pos":"noun","translation":"數據；資料","explanation":"指單個的資訊片段"}]}}

{"headword":"dawn","explanation":"「dawn」既可作為名詞表示「黎明」或「開端」，也可作為動詞表示「意識到」。在學測中，特別是動詞用法（dawn on sb.）是極高頻的考點，學生常將其誤認為單純的物理時間點。","senses":[{"sense":"黎明；開端（時間上的開始）","entries":[{"pattern":"at dawn","pos":"noun","translation":"在黎明時分","explanation":"指太陽升起之前或剛升起之時。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The fishermen woke up <pattern>at</pattern> <target>dawn</target> and sailed their boats into the deep ocean to catch fresh fish.","translation":"漁民們在黎明時分起床，將船駛入深海捕捉新鮮的魚類。"}]},{"pattern":"the dawn of sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"…的開端／黎明","explanation":"比喻用法，指某個時代或重要事件的開始。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The invention of the steam engine marked the <target>dawn</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the Industrial Revolution, changing how people worked forever.","translation":"蒸汽機的發明標誌著工業革命的開端，永遠地改變了人們工作的方式。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"beginning","pos":"noun","translation":"開始","explanation":"最通用的開始"},{"word":"sunrise","pos":"noun","translation":"日出","explanation":"物理上的日出時刻"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"dusk","pos":"noun","translation":"黃昏","explanation":"日落之後的微光"}]},{"sense":"意識到；明白（突然意識到某事）","entries":[{"pattern":"dawn on sb.","pos":"verb","translation":"使某人意識到","explanation":"注意主詞通常是意識到的內容，而非意識到的人。句型為：[事情] dawn on [人]。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After staring at the math problem for an hour, it finally <target>dawned</target> <pattern>on</pattern> me that I had used the wrong formula.","translation":"盯著數學題目看了一個小時後，我終於意識到我使用了錯誤的公式。"},{"sentence":"It slowly <target>dawned</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the students that the teacher was not actually angry, but was just tired from working.","translation":"學生們慢慢意識到，老師實際上並沒有生氣，而只是因為工作而感到疲憊。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"realize","pos":"verb","translation":"意識到","explanation":"主動意識到某事"},{"word":"occur to","pos":"verb","translation":"突然想到","explanation":"與 dawn on 相似，主詞為事情"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"dawned","past_participle":"dawned"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"dealer","explanation":"「dealer」在商務、藝術品交易或法律語境中常用。在學測中，通常指經營特定商品的交易商，重點在於其商業角色而非單純的銷售員 (salesperson)。","senses":[{"sense":"交易商；經銷商（經營特定商品的商人）","entries":[{"pattern":"dealer","pos":"noun","translation":"交易商；經銷商","explanation":"指經營特定商品交易的商人，如汽車經銷商 (car dealer) 或藝術品交易商 (art dealer)。","sentences":[{"sentence":"If you want to buy a high-quality used car, it is better to visit a professional <target>dealer</target> who can guarantee the condition.","translation":"如果你想買一輛高品質的二手車，最好去拜訪一名專業的經銷商，他們能保證車況。"},{"sentence":"The famous <target>dealer</target> in old paintings spent years traveling to Europe to find rare pieces of art for his rich clients.","translation":"那位著名的古畫交易商花了好幾年時間在歐洲旅行，為他的富裕客戶尋找稀有藝術品。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"merchant","pos":"noun","translation":"商人","explanation":"較為正式且古老的稱呼"},{"word":"trader","pos":"noun","translation":"交易者","explanation":"強調買賣交易的過程"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"deal (交易/處理) + -er (人)","related":[{"word":"deal","pos":"verb","translation":"交易；處理","explanation":"核心動詞型態。"}]}}

{"headword":"decade","explanation":"「decade」是描述時間跨度、社會變遷或科學研究結果時極其高頻的單字。它是時間單位單字（century, millennium）系列中的核心成員，學生應將其與數字 10 緊密連結。","senses":[{"sense":"十年（時間跨度）","entries":[{"pattern":"for a decade","pos":"noun","translation":"持續十年","explanation":"常用於描述長期持續的狀態或習慣。","sentences":[{"sentence":"My grandfather has lived in this small coastal village <pattern>for</pattern> a <target>decade</target>, enjoying the quiet life by the sea.","translation":"我的祖父在這個沿海小村莊住了十年，享受著海邊寧靜的生活。"}]},{"pattern":"over the last decade","pos":"noun","translation":"在過去十年中","explanation":"在描述趨勢演變（如氣候變遷或科技進步）的寫作中極其高頻。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Over the last <target>decade</target>, the number of electric cars on the road has increased rapidly due to new technology.","translation":"在過去十年中，由於新技術的出現，路上的電動車數量快速增加。"},{"sentence":"Scientists have observed that global temperatures have risen slightly <pattern>over</pattern> the past <target>decade</target> because of heavy pollution.","translation":"科學家觀察到全球氣溫在過去十年中略有上升，這是因為嚴重的污染。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"dec- (十) + -ade (名詞字尾)","related":[{"word":"decimal","pos":"adjective","translation":"十進位的","explanation":"基於數字 10 的計算系統。"}]}}

{"headword":"deck","explanation":"「deck」在學測中常見於兩種完全不同的場景：一是描述船隻結構的「甲板」；二是描述家居裝飾、室內設計的「露台/平台」。在閱讀測驗中，若出現與海洋或航海相關的文字，應立即將其聯想至甲板。","senses":[{"sense":"甲板；平台（船隻或建築物上的平面區域）","entries":[{"pattern":"on deck","pos":"noun","translation":"在甲板上","explanation":"指在船隻的露天平面上，常用於航海或海邊場景的描寫。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The passengers stood <pattern>on</pattern> the <target>deck</target> of the cruise ship, watching the dolphins jump out of the blue water.","translation":"乘客們站在郵輪的甲板上，看著海豚從蔚藍的海水中跳出來。"}]},{"pattern":"deck","pos":"noun","translation":"露台；平台","explanation":"指房屋後方或側邊搭建的木製平台，常用於家庭聚會或休息。","sentences":[{"sentence":"During the warm summer evenings, my family often gathers <pattern>on</pattern> the back <target>deck</target> to enjoy a grilled dinner and chat.","translation":"在溫暖的夏日夜晚，我的家人經常聚集在後露台，享用烤肉晚餐並聊天。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"platform","pos":"noun","translation":"平台","explanation":"指一個平坦的表面"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"一副牌（撲克牌等成套的卡片）","entries":[{"pattern":"a deck of cards","pos":"noun","translation":"一副牌","explanation":"量詞用法，指一整套完整的撲克牌。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The magic trick was so impressive that the audience could not believe he had shuffled a whole <target>deck</target> <pattern>of</pattern> cards so quickly.","translation":"那個魔術非常令人印象深刻，以至於觀眾不敢相信他能如此快速地洗一副完整的撲克牌。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"decorate","explanation":"「decorate」除了基本的「裝飾」外，在學測中常出現在描述節日慶祝、室內設計或生物擬態（如動物用色彩裝飾身體）的語境中。注意其名詞形式 decoration 為極高頻考點。","senses":[{"sense":"裝飾；佈置（使外觀更美觀或具有節日氣氛）","entries":[{"pattern":"decorate sth. with sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"用…裝飾某事","explanation":"最常見的搭配，with 後方接具體的裝飾物。","sentences":[{"sentence":"To prepare for the upcoming Christmas party, the students <target>decorated</target> the classroom <pattern>with</pattern> colorful ribbons and shiny silver stars.","translation":"為了準備即將到來的聖誕派對，學生們用彩色緞帶和閃亮的銀星裝飾了教室。"},{"sentence":"The local artist decided to <target>decorate</target> the old city walls <pattern>with</pattern> beautiful murals to attract more tourists to the town.","translation":"當地藝術家決定用美麗的壁畫裝飾舊城牆，以吸引更多遊客來到這個小鎮。"}]},{"pattern":"decorate sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"裝飾某物","explanation":"及物動詞，直接接受詞，強調裝飾的行為。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Every year, the young girl loves to <target>decorate</target> her birthday cake with fresh strawberries and thick white cream.","translation":"每年，這個小女孩都喜歡用新鮮草莓和濃稠的白奶油來裝飾她的生日蛋糕。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"adorn","pos":"verb","translation":"裝飾；修飾","explanation":"較為正式的用詞，強調使之更美觀"},{"word":"embellish","pos":"verb","translation":"裝飾；潤飾","explanation":"指增加細節使之更華麗，也可指對故事進行誇大"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"decorated","past_participle":"decorated"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 decor (裝飾) + 字尾 -ate (動詞)","related":[{"word":"decoration","pos":"noun","translation":"裝飾；裝飾品","explanation":"由動詞 decorate 加上名詞字尾 -tion 延伸而來。"},{"word":"decorative","pos":"adjective","translation":"裝飾性的","explanation":"由動詞 decorate 加上形容詞字尾 -ive 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"decrease","explanation":"「decrease」是學測中描述數據、趨勢、人口或環境變化的核心動詞與名詞。學生應注意其與 increase 的對立關係，以及在圖表分析寫作中極其高頻。","senses":[{"sense":"減少；降低（數量、程度或強度的下降）","entries":[{"pattern":"decrease in sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"在…方面的減少","explanation":"名詞用法，常用於描述統計數據的下降。","sentences":[{"sentence":"There has been a significant <target>decrease</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the number of students who prefer traditional textbooks over digital tablets.","translation":"偏好傳統教科書而非數位平板的學生人數顯著減少。"},{"sentence":"The city government noticed a sharp <target>decrease</target> <pattern>in</pattern> air pollution levels after they banned old diesel trucks from the center.","translation":"在禁止舊型柴油卡車進入市中心後，市政府注意到空氣污染程度大幅下降。"}]},{"pattern":"decrease sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"減少某物","explanation":"及物動詞，直接接受詞，如數量、價格或速度。","sentences":[{"sentence":"To improve the health of the local community, the doctor suggested that residents <target>decrease</target> their daily sugar intake.","translation":"為了改善當地社區的健康，醫生建議居民減少每日的糖分攝取。"}]},{"pattern":"decrease","pos":"verb","translation":"減少；下降","explanation":"不及物動詞，描述數據或趨勢的自然下降。","sentences":[{"sentence":"As the sun began to set and the air grew colder, the temperature <target>decreased</target> rapidly throughout the valley.","translation":"隨著太陽開始下山且空氣變得寒冷，整個山谷的溫度迅速下降。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"decline","pos":"verb","translation":"下降；衰落","explanation":"常用於人口或品質的下降"},{"word":"reduce","pos":"verb","translation":"減少；降低","explanation":"強調主動地將數量或強度降低"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"increase","pos":"verb","translation":"增加","explanation":null}]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"decreased","past_participle":"decreased"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字首 de- (向下、去除) + 字根 crease (增加/褶皺)","related":[{"word":"increasingly","pos":"adverb","translation":"越來越…","explanation":"由 increase 衍生出的副詞，在寫作中極高頻。"}]}}

{"headword":"deed","explanation":"「deed」在學測中主要有兩種語意：一是描述人的「行為/事蹟」，二是法律上的「契據/房產證明」。在閱讀測驗中，由於其與 a good deed 的固定搭配，常出現在道德教育或寓言故事中。","senses":[{"sense":"行為；事蹟（通常指具體的行動，而非單純的想法）","entries":[{"pattern":"a good deed","pos":"noun","translation":"一件好事","explanation":"極高頻的固定搭配，指做一件對他人有益的事。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The young boy felt a sense of pride after he performed a <target>good</target> <pattern>deed</pattern> by helping an elderly woman cross the street.","translation":"這個小男孩在幫助一位老婦人過馬路這件好事之後，感到一種自豪感。"},{"sentence":"Many people believe that if you do a <target>good</target> <pattern>deed</pattern> for others, the universe will eventually reward you.","translation":"許多人相信，如果你為他人做一件好事，宇宙最終會獎賞你。"}]},{"pattern":"deed","pos":"noun","translation":"行為；舉動","explanation":"泛指任何一種具體行動，常用於對比想法與行動。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The brave soldier was honored for his noble <target>deeds</target> during the war, as he saved many innocent civilians from danger.","translation":"那名勇敢的士兵因其在戰爭期間的崇高事蹟而受到表彰，因為他救了許多無辜的平民。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"action","pos":"noun","translation":"行動","explanation":"最通用的詞彙"},{"word":"act","pos":"noun","translation":"行為；舉動","explanation":"指單一的次的行為"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"契據；房產證明（法律文件）","entries":[{"pattern":"the deed to sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"…的契據","explanation":"法律用語，指證明所有權的正式文件。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After paying the final installment of the mortgage, the couple finally received the <target>deed</target> <pattern>to</pattern> their new family home.","translation":"在支付完房貸的最後一期後，這對夫婦終於拿到了他們新家的房產契據。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"deepen","explanation":"「deepen」在學測中不僅指物理上的「加深」，更常用於描述抽象概念的例如「加深理解」、「加深感情」或「加深危機」。理解這種從物理到抽象的延伸是解題關鍵。","senses":[{"sense":"加深；使深化（物理上的深度增加或抽象情感、理解的增強）","entries":[{"pattern":"deepen one's understanding of sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"加深對…的理解","explanation":"學術情境高頻搭配，指透過學習或研究使對某事物的認知更全面。","sentences":[{"sentence":"By reading more historical books, the student hoped to <target>deepen</target> his <pattern>understanding</pattern> <pattern>of</pattern> the causes of the war.","translation":"藉由閱讀更多歷史書籍，這名學生希望加深他對戰爭起因的理解。"}]},{"pattern":"deepen the relationship / bond","pos":"verb","translation":"加深關係／紐帶","explanation":"描述人際關係變得更加親密或牢固。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Traveling together for a month allowed the two strangers to <target>deepen</target> their <pattern>bond</pattern> and become best friends.","translation":"一起旅行一個月讓這兩個陌生人加深了他們的紐帶，並成為最好的朋友。"}]},{"pattern":"deepen","pos":"verb","translation":"使加深；（顏色或聲音）變深／變低","explanation":"指物理上的深度增加，或聲音、顏色變得更濃郁、深沉。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The river <target>deepened</target> as it flowed toward the ocean, making it easier for large ships to enter the harbor.","translation":"這條河在流向大海時變得更深，使得大型船隻更容易進入港口。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"intensify","pos":"verb","translation":"強化；加劇","explanation":"常用於描述危機或衝突的加劇"},{"word":"expand","pos":"verb","translation":"擴展","explanation":"指在範圍上增加"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"shallow","pos":"adjective","translation":"淺的","explanation":"注意 deepen 是動詞，shallow 是其對立形容詞"}]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"deepened","past_participle":"deepened"},"relatives":{"morphology":"形容詞 deep 加上動詞字尾 -en (使…變得)","related":[{"word":"depth","pos":"noun","translation":"深度","explanation":"deep 的名詞形式。"}]}}

{"headword":"definition","explanation":"「definition」在學測中不僅指字典裡的「定義」，更常出現在學術討論中，用來界定某個概念的範圍。此外，在視覺或影像處理的語境下，它指「清晰度」或「解析度」，是科技類文章的高頻考點。","senses":[{"sense":"定義；界定（對詞彙或概念的明確說明）","entries":[{"pattern":"the definition of sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"…的定義","explanation":"最基礎的用法，用於明確指出某個術語或理論的具體含義。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The teacher asked the students to look up the <target>definition</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the word 'sustainable' in the dictionary.","translation":"老師要求學生在字典中查閱 'sustainable' 這個單字的定義。"},{"sentence":"Philosophers have spent centuries debating the precise <target>definition</target> <pattern>of</pattern> happiness, as it means different things to different people.","translation":"哲學家們花了好幾個世紀在爭論「幸福」的精確定義，因為對不同的人來說，幸福代表不同的意義。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"meaning","pos":"noun","translation":"意義；含義","explanation":"較泛指的詞彙"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"清晰度；解析度（影像或線條的明確程度）","entries":[{"pattern":"high-definition","pos":"adjective","translation":"高解析度的；清晰的","explanation":"常用於描述電視、螢幕或照片的畫質，縮寫為 HD。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The new television in the living room has such <target>high-definition</target> images that you can see every tiny detail of the nature documentary.","translation":"客廳裡的新電視影像解析度如此之高，以至於你能看見自然紀錄片中的每一個微小細節。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 defin (界定、明確) + 名詞字尾 -ition","related":[{"word":"define","pos":"verb","translation":"定義；界定","explanation":"核心動詞型態。"},{"word":"definite","pos":"adjective","translation":"明確的；肯定的","explanation":"指事物明確且不模糊。"},{"word":"definitely","pos":"adverb","translation":"肯定地；絕對地","explanation":"由形容詞 definite 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"dine","explanation":"「dine」是較為正式的動詞，意為「用餐」。在學測中，由於其名詞形式「dinner」更為高頻，學生應重點關注其動詞形式的用法及其正式程度。","senses":[{"sense":"正式用餐（通常指晚餐）","entries":[{"pattern":"dine","pos":"verb","translation":"用餐","explanation":"不及物動詞，指在正式場合或高級餐廳用餐。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The couple decided to <target>dine</target> at the most expensive restaurant in the city to celebrate their tenth wedding anniversary.","translation":"這對夫婦決定在市中心最昂貴的餐廳用餐，以慶祝他們的結婚十週年紀念日。"}]},{"pattern":"dine with sb.","pos":"verb","translation":"與某人一同用餐","explanation":"常用於描述正式的社交場合。","sentences":[{"sentence":"It was a great honor for the young student to <target>dine</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the famous professor from Oxford University.","translation":"對於這位年輕學生來說，能與來自牛津大學的著名教授一同用餐是極大的榮幸。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"dined","past_participle":"dined"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"dinner","pos":"noun","translation":"晚餐","explanation":"由動詞 dine 演變而來的名詞。"}]}}

{"headword":"dislike","explanation":"「dislike」既可用作動詞也可用作名詞。作為動詞時，它是及物動詞，直接接名詞或動名詞 (V-ing)；作為名詞時，常用於複數型態 「dislikes」 來描述個人的喜好。","senses":[{"sense":"不喜歡；厭惡（對某人或某事缺乏好感）","entries":[{"pattern":"dislike sth./sb.","pos":"verb","translation":"不喜歡某事／某人","explanation":"及物動詞，後接受詞，表達一種持續性的不喜好感。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many students <target>dislike</target> waking up early on Monday mornings because they spent their entire weekend sleeping in.","translation":"許多學生不喜歡在週一早晨起床，因為他們整個週末都賴在床上。"},{"sentence":"I strongly <target>dislike</target> the way he speaks to his classmates, as he often sounds rude and arrogant.","translation":"我非常不喜歡他對待同學的方式，因為他經常聽起來很粗魯且傲慢。"}]},{"pattern":"dislike doing sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"不喜歡做某事","explanation":"後接動名詞 (V-ing) 表達對特定行為的不喜好。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Most cats <target>dislike</target> <pattern>being</pattern> bathed, and they will often fight back with their claws when they see water.","translation":"大多數貓不喜歡洗澡，而且當它們看到水時，通常會用爪子反擊。"}]},{"pattern":"likes and dislikes","pos":"noun","translation":"喜好","explanation":"固定搭配，通常以複數形式出現，用來描述一個人的興趣和厭惡之處。","sentences":[{"sentence":"When you are trying to get to know a new friend, it is helpful to discuss your <target>dislikes</target> along with your likes.","translation":"當你試圖認識一個新朋友時，討論你的厭惡之處以及你的喜好會很有幫助。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"hate","pos":"verb","translation":"憎恨","explanation":"語氣比 dislike 更強烈"},{"word":"detest","pos":"verb","translation":"厭惡","explanation":"極其強烈的厭惡感"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"like","pos":"verb","translation":"喜歡","explanation":null},{"word":"adore","pos":"verb","translation":"愛慕；崇拜","explanation":null}]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"disliked","past_participle":"disliked"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字首 dis- (不、相反) + like (喜歡)","related":[{"word":"likable","pos":"adjective","translation":"可愛的；討人喜歡的","explanation":"由 like 加上形容詞字尾 -able 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"dumb","explanation":"「dumb」在現代英語中具有兩種截然不同的語意。一種是生理上的「無法說話」，另一種是口語中對智力或行為的貶稱（愚笨的）。在學測閱讀中，前者較少見，後者則常出現在對話或非正式敘事中。要注意此字在口語中具有強烈的主觀評價色彩。","senses":[{"sense":"無法說話的；失聲的（生理上的缺陷）","entries":[{"pattern":"be born dumb","pos":"adjective","translation":"天生失聲的","explanation":"指人天生缺乏說話能力，此用法在現代英語中較少見，多出現在較舊的文學作品中。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Although the young boy was <target>born</target> <target>dumb</target>, he learned to communicate with others using a complex system of hand signs.","translation":"儘管這個小男孩天生失聲，但他學會了使用一套複雜的手勢系統與他人溝通。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[{"word":"articulate","pos":"adjective","translation":"口才好的；能清晰表達的","explanation":null}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"dump","explanation":"「dump」的核心概念是「將東西快速、隨意地丟棄」。作為名詞時，它既可以指物理上的「垃圾場」，也可以指口語中對「糟糕環境」的貶稱。作為動詞時，除了丟棄垃圾，在現代社交語境中也常指「甩掉（伴侶）」。","senses":[{"sense":"丟棄；傾倒（快速地將東西扔掉或卸貨）","entries":[{"pattern":"dump sth. (in/at sth.)","pos":"verb","translation":"將某物丟棄（在某處）","explanation":"強調快速且不顧後果地傾倒，常用於環境污染或非法棄置垃圾的討論。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Some dishonest companies secretly <target>dump</target> toxic chemicals <pattern>into</pattern> the river at night to avoid paying for proper waste treatment.","translation":"一些不誠實的公司在深夜秘密地將有毒化學物質傾倒進河中，以避免支付正確的廢棄物處理費用。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"dumped","past_participle":"dumped"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"dumpling","explanation":"「dumpling」是文化類閱讀測驗中常見的食物名詞。它指代所有類型的「餃子」或「麵疙瘩」，具體種類視文化背景而定。對於學生來說，重點在於將其與特定文化美食（如中華文化圈的餃子）連結。","senses":[{"sense":"餃子；麵疙瘩","entries":[{"pattern":"dumpling","pos":"noun","translation":"餃子；麵疙瘩","explanation":"指用麵粉製作，包裹餡料後煮或蒸的食物。","sentences":[{"sentence":"During the Lunar New Year, my grandmother always prepares a huge plate of steamed <target>dumplings</target> filled with pork and cabbage.","translation":"在農曆新年期間，我的祖母總是準備一大盤填滿豬肉和高麗菜的蒸餃。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"（口語）愚蠢的人","entries":[{"pattern":"a dumpling","pos":"noun","translation":"笨蛋；呆子","explanation":"此用法極為罕見，主要出現在非常非正式的口語中，指代外觀圓潤且反應遲鈍的人。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Stop acting like a <target>dumpling</target> and focus on the math problem before the teacher notices your mistake.","translation":"別再像個笨蛋一樣表現，在老師注意到你的錯誤之前，專注於這道數學題。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"dust","explanation":"「dust」既是名詞也是動詞，其語意方向完全相反。名詞指「灰塵」，動詞則指「除塵」。在學測中，名詞用法最為常見，常用於描述環境、古蹟或廢棄空間；動詞用法則常出現在生活化場景中。","senses":[{"sense":"灰塵；塵埃（極小的顆粒）","entries":[{"pattern":"dust","pos":"noun","translation":"灰塵；塵埃","explanation":"不可數名詞，指空氣中或表面上的微小顆粒。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The old library had not been used for years, so every book on the shelf was covered in a thick layer of <target>dust</target>.","translation":"這間舊圖書館多年未被使用，因此書架上的每本書都被一層厚厚的灰塵覆蓋著。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"除塵；拍掉灰塵（從表面移除灰塵）","entries":[{"pattern":"dust sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"除塵；拍掉灰塵","explanation":"及物動詞，指使用抹布或刷子將灰塵從物體表面清除。","sentences":[{"sentence":"My mother asked me to <target>dust</target> the living room furniture every Saturday morning to keep the house clean and healthy.","translation":"我母親要求我每個星期六早晨為客廳家具除塵，以保持房屋乾淨健康。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"撒粉（在表面撒上粉末）","entries":[{"pattern":"dust sth. with sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"在…上撒粉","explanation":"常用於烹飪情境，指在食物表面撒上糖粉或可可粉。","sentences":[{"sentence":"To make the dessert look more professional, the chef <target>dusted</target> the chocolate cake <pattern>with</pattern> powdered sugar.","translation":"為了讓甜點看起來更專業，主廚在巧克力蛋糕上撒了糖粉。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"dusted","past_participle":"dusted"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"eager","explanation":"「eager」是一個表達強烈渴望的形容詞。在學測中，它常與 to-V 或 for sth. 搭配，用來描述學生學習的熱情、求知欲或對未來期待。理解其核心概念是「急切地想要做某事」，且語氣通常是正面的。","senses":[{"sense":"渴望的；急切的（強烈地想要做某事）","entries":[{"pattern":"be eager to do sth.","pos":"adjective","translation":"渴望做某事","explanation":"後接不定詞 (to-V)，強調主詞對該行動的強烈主觀意願。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After months of hard work and studying, the high school seniors were <target>eager</target> <pattern>to</pattern> start their college life in the city.","translation":"經過數月的努力學習，高中三年級的學生們渴望開始他們在城市的大學生活。"}]},{"pattern":"be eager for sth.","pos":"adjective","translation":"對某事感到渴望","explanation":"後接名詞，強調對特定目標或結果的渴望。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The young puppy was so <target>eager</target> <pattern>for</pattern> attention that it kept jumping up and barking at its owner.","translation":"這隻小狗如此渴望得到關注，以至於它不斷跳起來對著主人吠叫。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"keen","pos":"adjective","translation":"熱衷的；渴望的","explanation":"語氣較輕，常用於描述對某種興趣的熱衷。"},{"word":"enthusiastic","pos":"adjective","translation":"熱情的","explanation":"強調精神面貌上的興奮與熱忱。"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"reluctant","pos":"adjective","translation":"不情願的","explanation":"與 eager 相反，指對做某事感到遲疑或不想做。"},{"word":"indifferent","pos":"adjective","translation":"漠不關心的","explanation":"指對某事完全沒有興趣或情感投入。"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"形容詞 eager 加上名詞字尾 -ness","related":[{"word":"eagerness","pos":"noun","translation":"渴望；熱切","explanation":"由形容詞 eager 延伸而來的名詞型態。"}]}}

{"headword":"echo","explanation":"「echo」在學測中兼具名詞與動詞用法。名詞指物理上的「回聲」或思想上的「共鳴」；動詞則指「重複」或「呼應」。在閱讀測驗中，常出現於描述自然景觀、心理狀態或社會趨勢的文章中。","senses":[{"sense":"回聲；共鳴（物理上的聲音反射或思想上的呼應）","entries":[{"pattern":"echo","pos":"noun","translation":"回聲","explanation":"指聲音在封閉空間或山谷中反射而產生的重複聲音。","sentences":[{"sentence":"When the hiker shouted into the deep valley, a loud <target>echo</target> returned to him a few seconds later.","translation":"當登山客向深谷大喊時，幾秒鐘後一個巨大的回聲傳回給他。"}]},{"pattern":"echo of sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"…的共鳴；…的餘韻","explanation":"比喻指某種思想、風格或感覺在後來的時間或空間中被重複或呼應。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The modern building's design has a clear <target>echo</target> <pattern>of</pattern> classical Greek architecture, making it look both old and new.","translation":"這座現代建築的設計有著明顯的古希臘建築共鳴，使其看起來既古老又現代。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"resonance","pos":"noun","translation":"共鳴","explanation":"強調心理或情感上的深度共鳴"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"回聲；呼應（重複他人的話語或想法）","entries":[{"pattern":"echo sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"重複；呼應某事","explanation":"指重複他人的言論或想法，通常表示贊同或相似。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The prime minister's speech <target>echoed</target> the fears <pattern>of</pattern> many citizens who were worried about the rising cost of living.","translation":"首相的演講呼應了許多擔心生活成本上漲的公民的恐懼。"},{"sentence":"The children's laughter <target>echoed</target> throughout the empty school hallways during the summer vacation.","translation":"在暑假期間，孩子們的笑聲在空蕩蕩的學校走廊裡迴盪。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"repeat","pos":"verb","translation":"重複","explanation":"最普遍的重複動作"},{"word":"reiterate","pos":"verb","translation":"反覆地說","explanation":"為了強調而多次重複"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"echoed","past_participle":"echoed"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"edit","explanation":"「edit」在學測中主要出現在描述編輯、校對以及媒體創作的語境中。重點在於區分其「修改」與「校對」的細微差別，以及在現代數位環境（如影片編輯）中的應用。","senses":[{"sense":"編輯；修改（對文本、影片或音檔進行修正以使其更完善）","entries":[{"pattern":"edit sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"編輯某事","explanation":"及物動詞，受詞通常是文章、影片、照片或程式碼。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Before submitting the final essay to the teacher, Sarah spent two hours <target>editing</target> her grammar and spelling errors.","translation":"在將最終論文提交給老師之前，莎拉花了兩個小時修改她的語法和拼寫錯誤。"},{"sentence":"The professional film maker used special software to <target>edit</target> the long footage into a short, exciting three-minute trailer.","translation":"專業的電影製片人使用特殊軟體將長篇素材編輯成一段簡短且令人興奮的三分鐘預告片。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"revise","pos":"verb","translation":"修訂","explanation":"強調對內容或觀點的重大修改"},{"word":"modify","pos":"verb","translation":"修改","explanation":"指對部分特徵進行小幅調整"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"edited","past_participle":"edited"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"editor","pos":"noun","translation":"編輯者","explanation":"由動詞 edit 加上名詞字尾 -or 構成。"}]}}

{"headword":"editor","explanation":"「editor」是指負責內容審核、修改與定稿的專業人員。在學測閱讀中，常出現於描述出版業或媒體運作的語境中。","senses":[{"sense":"編輯（職業）","entries":[{"pattern":"editor","pos":"noun","translation":"編輯","explanation":"指在報紙、雜誌、書籍或網站上負責校對與修改內容的人員。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The senior <target>editor</target> of the school magazine decided to remove several pages to keep the total length under fifty.","translation":"學校雜誌的主編決定刪除幾個頁面，以將總長度控制在五十頁以內。"},{"sentence":"After writing the first draft of the novel, the author spent months working with an <target>editor</target> to polish the story.","translation":"在寫完小說的第一稿後，作者花了幾個月時間與一名編輯合作以潤色故事。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"動詞 edit + 名詞字尾 -or (表示人)","related":[{"word":"edit","pos":"verb","translation":"編輯","explanation":"核心基礎動詞。"},{"word":"editorial","pos":"adjective","translation":"編輯的；社論的","explanation":"由 editor 延伸而來的形容詞。"}]}}

{"headword":"educate","explanation":"「educate」在學測中是核心動詞。它不僅指單純的「教育」或「教導」，在某些語境中還指「使人意識到某事」或「培養」。要注意其常用的被動態用法以及與 educate sb. in sth. 等片語搭配。","senses":[{"sense":"教育；教導（透過學習、訓練或指導使其獲得知識或技能）","entries":[{"pattern":"educate sb.","pos":"verb","translation":"教育某人","explanation":"最基礎的用法，受詞為被教育者。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The government has launched a new program to <target>educate</target> the public about the dangers of plastic pollution in the ocean.","translation":"政府啟動了一項新計畫，旨在教育大眾關於海洋塑料污染的危險。"}]},{"pattern":"educate sb. in sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"在…方面教育某人","explanation":"介系詞 in 用來指定教育的具體領域（如藝術、科學、法律等）。","sentences":[{"sentence":"She was <target>educated</target> <pattern>in</pattern> classical music and painting, which helped her become a successful professional artist later in life.","translation":"她在古典音樂和繪畫方面受過教育，這幫助她在日後成為一名成功的專業藝術家。"}]},{"pattern":"be educated","pos":"verb","translation":"受過教育的","explanation":"常以被動態形式出現在形容詞化，表示某人受過良好的教育。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Even though he grew up in a remote village, he is highly <target>educated</target> because he studied hard and attended university.","translation":"儘管他在一個偏僻的村莊長大，但因為他努力學習並就讀大學，所以他受過高度教育。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"instruct","pos":"verb","translation":"指導；教導","explanation":"強調技術性的指導或具體指令"},{"word":"teach","pos":"verb","translation":"教","explanation":"最普遍且通用的教育動作"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"educated","past_participle":"educated"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 educ (引導出、教育) + 字尾 -ate (動詞字尾)","related":[{"word":"education","pos":"noun","translation":"教育","explanation":"由動詞 educate 加上名詞字尾 -tion 延伸而來。"},{"word":"educational","pos":"adjective","translation":"教育的","explanation":"由 educate 加上形容詞字尾 -ional 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"educational","explanation":"「educational」是一個高頻形容詞，常用於描述教育設備、計畫、目的或體驗。在學測中，常出現在關於學校生活、學習方法以及教育政策的討論中。","senses":[{"sense":"教育的；有教育意義的（與教育過程相關或旨在提供知識）","entries":[{"pattern":"educational sth.","pos":"adjective","translation":"教育的…","explanation":"用來修飾名詞，如 educational tools, educational goals, educational background。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The new <target>educational</target> tools, such as virtual reality headsets, allow students to experience ancient Rome without leaving the classroom.","translation":"新的教育工具，例如虛擬實境頭盔，讓學生不需要離開教室就能體驗古羅馬。"},{"sentence":"Visiting a local museum is a highly <target>educational</target> experience for children, as it teaches them about history and art.","translation":"參觀當地博物館對孩子們來說是一個非常有教育意義的體驗，因為它教會他們歷史和藝術。"}]},{"pattern":"educational background","pos":"adjective","translation":"教育背景","explanation":"固定搭配，指一個人的學習經歷和學位。","sentences":[{"sentence":"When applying for the scholarship, the student must provide a detailed description of his <target>educational</target> <pattern>background</pattern>.","translation":"在申請獎學金時，學生必須提供關於他教育背景的詳細描述。"}]},{"pattern":"educational system","pos":"adjective","translation":"教育體系","explanation":"固定搭配，指一個國家的教育制度。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many experts believe that the changing <target>educational</target> <pattern>system</pattern> will better prepare students for the future workforce.","translation":"許多專家認為，變革中的教育體系將能讓學生為未來的勞動力市場做好更好的準備。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"由 educate (動詞) 延伸而來的形容詞型態","related":[{"word":"educate","pos":"verb","translation":"教育","explanation":"核心基礎動詞。"},{"word":"education","pos":"noun","translation":"translation","explanation":"由 educate 加上名詞字尾 -tion 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"efficient","explanation":"「efficient」在學測中常用於討論科技、能源、時間管理或工作表現。其核心概念在於「用最少的資源（時間、金錢、精力）達到最大的效果」，與 effective（有效）不同，efficient 更強調「效率」。","senses":[{"sense":"有效率的；高效率的（資源利用最大化）","entries":[{"pattern":"efficient","pos":"adjective","translation":"有效率的","explanation":"用來修飾人或系統，強調其能迅速且準確地完成任務而不浪費資源。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The company decided to upgrade its old machines to more <target>efficient</target> models to reduce electricity costs and increase production.","translation":"公司決定將舊機器升級為更高效的型號，以降低電費並增加產量。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 effi- (做) + -cient (具有...能力的)","related":[{"word":"efficiency","pos":"noun","translation":"效率","explanation":"由形容詞 efficient 加上名詞字尾 -cy 延伸而來。"},{"word":"inefficient","pos":"adjective","translation":"低效率的","explanation":"由字首 in- (否定) + efficient 組成。"}]}}

{"headword":"elbow","explanation":"「elbow」作為名詞指身體部位，而作為動詞時則演變為一種比喻用法，指「用力擠開」或「強行取得」空間或地位，這是學測閱讀中較容易被忽略的考點。","senses":[{"sense":"手肘（身體部位）","entries":[{"pattern":"elbow","pos":"noun","translation":"手肘","explanation":"指上臂與前臂連接的關節部位。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The clumsy boy accidentally hit his <target>elbow</target> against the wooden table while he was rushing to finish his homework.","translation":"那個笨拙的男孩在急著寫完作業時，不小心讓手肘撞到了木桌上。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"elbowed","past_participle":"elbowed"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"elbow room","pos":"noun","translation":"活動空間；自由","explanation":"比喻用法，指有足夠的空間可以揮動手肘，即自由行動的空間。"}]}}

{"headword":"elderly","explanation":"「elderly」是 elderly 的委婉說法，在學測的文章中，為了表達禮貌，通常會使用 elderly 而非 old。注意它既可用作形容詞，也可用作名詞（the elderly）來指代一群人。","senses":[{"sense":"年長的；高齡的（禮貌用法）","entries":[{"pattern":"the elderly","pos":"adjective","translation":"年長者","explanation":"the + 形容詞 構成名詞片語，指代該類別的所有人。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The government is planning to build more community centers to provide healthcare and social activities for <pattern>the</pattern> <target>elderly</target>.","translation":"政府計劃建造更多社區中心，為年長者提供醫療保健和社交活動。"}]},{"pattern":"elderly people","pos":"adjective","translation":"年長的人們","explanation":"直接修飾名詞，用於描述高齡族群。","sentences":[{"sentence":"In many traditional cultures, <target>elderly</target> people are highly respected because they possess a wealth of wisdom and life experience.","translation":"在許多傳統文化中，年長的人們深受尊重，因為他們擁有豐富的智慧和人生經驗。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"比較級 elder + 副詞字尾 -ly","related":[{"word":"elder","pos":"adjective","translation":"較年長的","explanation":"通常用於家庭成員之間。"}]}}

{"headword":"elect","explanation":"「elect」在學測中主要出現在政治、社會治理類的文章中。它既可作為動詞表示「選出」，也可作為形容詞表示「當選但尚未就職的」。","senses":[{"sense":"選舉；選出（透過投票決定某人擔任某職務）","entries":[{"pattern":"elect sb. (as sth.)","pos":"verb","translation":"選某人（為…）","explanation":"及物動詞，後接被選出的人，以及用 as 引導的職位名稱。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The students of the high school <target>elected</target> Sarah <pattern>as</pattern> the new class president because of her strong leadership skills.","translation":"高中學生們選出莎拉作為新的班長，因為她具有強大的領導能力。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"elected","past_participle":"elected"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 elect (選擇)","related":[{"word":"election","pos":"noun","translation":"選舉","explanation":"由動詞 elect 加上名詞字尾 -ion 延伸而來。"},{"word":"selective","pos":"adjective","translation":"有選擇性的","explanation":"由字根 elect / select 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"election","explanation":"「election」是 elect 的名詞形式，在探討民主制度、校園選舉或社會議題時是核心詞彙。學生應注意其與 elect 的動詞用法之區分。","senses":[{"sense":"選舉（投票決定職位的過程）","entries":[{"pattern":"election","pos":"noun","translation":"選舉","explanation":"指投票選出領導者的正式過程。","sentences":[{"sentence":"During the presidential <target>election</target>, millions of citizens cast their votes to choose the leader who could best represent their values.","translation":"在總統大選期間，數百萬名公民投下選票，以選擇最能代表其價值觀的領導者。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"動詞 elect + 名詞字尾 -ion","related":[{"word":"elect","pos":"verb","translation":"選舉；選出","explanation":"核心動詞形式。"}]}}

{"headword":"electricity","explanation":"「electricity」在學測中常出現在環境、科技或歷史發展類文章中。重點在於區分其作為「電力」之能量形式與「電氣/電子設備」的區別，以及與電力供應、節能等概念的搭配。","senses":[{"sense":"電力；電能（能量的一種形式）","entries":[{"pattern":"electricity","pos":"noun","translation":"電力；電能","explanation":"指物理上的電能，常用於討論電力供應、電力短缺或電費。","sentences":[{"sentence":"During the heavy storm, the town lost its <target>electricity</target> for three whole days, leaving thousands of people in complete darkness.","translation":"在強烈風暴期間，小鎮失去了電力，整整三天，讓數千人處於完全的黑暗之中。"},{"sentence":"Many developing countries are now investing in solar panels to produce cheap and clean <target>electricity</target> for their rural villages.","translation":"許多開發中國家現在正投資於太陽能板，以為其農村地區生產廉價且乾淨的電力。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"power","pos":"noun","translation":"能源；動力","explanation":"在電力情境中，power 常與 electricity 通用。"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 electric (電的) + 名詞字尾 -ity","related":[{"word":"electric","pos":"adjective","translation":"用電的；電力的","explanation":"指由電驅動的設備。"},{"word":"electrical","pos":"adjective","translation":"電氣的；與電相關的","explanation":"泛指與電相關的事物，如 electrical engineering (電氣工程)。"},{"word":"electrician","pos":"noun","translation":"電工","explanation":"指專業安裝或維修電路的人。"}]}}

{"headword":"electronic","explanation":"「electronic」與「electric」的區別是學測常考考點。electric 指「用電的」或「產生電的」，而 electronic 則強調「電子設備」或「電子化」的數據處理與控制，常用於科技、數位化轉型等情境。","senses":[{"sense":"電子的；電子設備的（涉及電子管、晶片或數據處理）","entries":[{"pattern":"electronic device","pos":"adjective","translation":"電子設備","explanation":"指包含電子元件（如晶片）的設備，如手機、平板電腦等。","sentences":[{"sentence":"To protect the environment, the government encourages citizens to properly recycle their old <target>electronic</target> <pattern>devices</pattern> instead of throwing them away.","translation":"為了保護環境，政府鼓勵公民正確地回收舊的電子設備，而不是將其扔掉。"},{"sentence":"The high school library now offers <target>electronic</target> <pattern>books</pattern> that students can access from their home computers using a password.","translation":"高中圖書館現在提供電子書，學生可以使用密碼從家中的電腦訪問。"}]},{"pattern":"electronic payment","pos":"adjective","translation":"電子支付","explanation":"指透過電子手段（如信用卡、行動支付）完成的交易。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Most young people in the city prefer <target>electronic</target> <pattern>payment</pattern> methods because they are much faster than carrying a heavy wallet.","translation":"城市中的大多數年輕人喜歡電子支付方式，因為這比攜帶沉重的錢包快得多。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"digital","pos":"adjective","translation":"數位的","explanation":"強調數據以 0 和 1 的形式存在，與 electronic 經常互換使用。"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"analog","pos":"adjective","translation":"類比的","explanation":"與數位/電子化對立。"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 electric (電的) + 形容詞字尾 -onic","related":[{"word":"electronics","pos":"noun","translation":"電子學；電子產品","explanation":"指電子的科學或相關產品。"}]}}

{"headword":"element","explanation":"「element」在學測中具有物理、化學及抽象語意。物理上指「元素/元件」，抽象上指「組成部分/特質」。考生應重點關注其在描述分析文章中的「關鍵要素」用法。","senses":[{"sense":"元素；成分（化學元素或物質的組成部分）","entries":[{"pattern":"chemical element","pos":"noun","translation":"化學元素","explanation":"指週期表中的化學元素。","sentences":[{"sentence":"In the chemistry class, the teacher explained that gold is a precious <target>element</target> that cannot be broken down into simpler substances.","translation":"在化學課上，老師解釋說金是一種珍貴的元素，不能被分解成更簡單的物質。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"component","pos":"noun","translation":"成分；元件","explanation":"指組成一個整體的個體元件。"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"要素；成分（抽象的組成部分，如特質、氛圍或關鍵點）","entries":[{"pattern":"an element of sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"…的一種元素/要素","explanation":"指某事中包含的某種特質或部分。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The old movie contains an <target>element</target> <pattern>of</pattern> mystery, which makes the audience feel curious about the ending.","translation":"這部老電影包含了一種神秘元素，這使得觀眾對結局感到好奇。"},{"sentence":"Strong communication is a key <target>element</target> in any healthy relationship, as it helps people understand each other better.","translation":"強有力的溝通是任何健康關係中的關鍵要素，因為它能幫助人們更好地理解彼此。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"factor","pos":"noun","translation":"因素；要素","explanation":"指影響結果的關鍵點。"},{"word":"ingredient","pos":"noun","translation":"成分；原料","explanation":"常用於食物或抽象的「成功要素」。"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 elem- (基本、底層)","related":[{"word":"elementary","pos":"adjective","translation":"基礎的；初級的","explanation":"指最簡單、最基礎的層級。"}]}}

{"headword":"elevator","explanation":"「elevator」在日常描述或校園生活情境中是基礎名詞。在英美語法區分中，要注意其與 lift (英式英語) 的對應。","senses":[{"sense":"電梯","entries":[{"pattern":"elevator","pos":"noun","translation":"電梯","explanation":"指將人或物體在建築物內上下移動的機械裝置。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Because the <target>elevator</target> was broken, the students had to walk up six flights of stairs to reach their classroom on the top floor.","translation":"因為電梯壞了，學生們不得不走六層樓梯才能到達頂樓的教室。"},{"sentence":"In case of fire, you should never use the <target>elevator</target> because it might stop working and trap you inside the building.","translation":"在發生火災時，你絕對不應該使用電梯，因為它可能會停止工作並將你困在建築物內。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"lift","pos":"noun","translation":"電梯","explanation":"英式英語中對電梯的稱呼。"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"動詞 elevate (提升) + 名詞字尾 -or","related":[{"word":"elevate","pos":"verb","translation":"提升；提高","explanation":"指將某物提升到較高位置或提升地位。"}]}}

{"headword":"emergency","explanation":"「emergency」在學測中常出現在醫療、自然災害或安全指南類文章中。重點在於區分其作為「緊急情況」之名詞用法，以及與 emergency exit (緊急出口) 等固定搭配的強關聯。","senses":[{"sense":"緊急情況；緊急事件（需要立即採取行動的危險狀態）","entries":[{"pattern":"in an emergency","pos":"noun","translation":"在緊急情況下","explanation":"指在危險或非預期地發生突發事件時。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The school provides a first-aid kit <pattern>in</pattern> <pattern>an</pattern> <target>emergency</target>, allowing the nurse to treat injuries quickly.","translation":"學校提供急救箱以備在緊急情況下使用，讓護理師能快速治療傷口。"},{"sentence":"Please remember to keep the hallway clear <pattern>in</pattern> <pattern>an</pattern> <target>emergency</target> so that everyone can leave the building safely.","translation":" "}]},{"pattern":"emergency exit","pos":"noun","translation":"緊急出口","explanation":"指在危險時用於逃生之出口。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The flight attendant showed the passengers where the <target>emergency</target> <pattern>exit</pattern> was located, just in case the plane had a problem.","translation":"空服員向乘客展示了緊急出口的位置，以免飛機發生問題。"}]},{"pattern":"emergency room","pos":"noun","translation":"急診室","explanation":"指醫院中處理緊急醫療需求的房間。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After the car accident, the injured driver was rushed to the <target>emergency</target> <pattern>room</pattern> of the city hospital for immediate care.","translation":" "}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"crisis","pos":"noun","translation":"危機","explanation":"強調一種需要立即決定或行動的危險狀態。"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"形容詞 emergent (出現的) + 名詞字尾 -ency","related":[{"word":"urgent","pos":"adjective","translation":"緊急的；急迫的","explanation":"指需要立即處理的事務。"}]}}

{"headword":"enjoyable","explanation":"「enjoyable」是用來描述體驗或活動的形容詞。在學測中，常出現在描述旅行、課外活動或休閒時光的段落中。注意它與 enjoy 的主動關係：某件事是 enjoyable 的，而人則 enjoy 該件事。","senses":[{"sense":"令人愉快的；好玩的","entries":[{"pattern":"enjoyable experience","pos":"adjective","translation":"愉快的體驗","explanation":"常用於描述一次成功的旅行、活動或學習過程。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Spending a whole weekend hiking in the quiet mountains with my best friends was a truly <target>enjoyable</target> <pattern>experience</pattern> for me.","translation":"與我最好的朋友們在寧靜的山中度過整個週末徒步旅行，對我來說是一次真正愉快的體驗。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"動詞 enjoy + 形容詞字尾 -able (能夠...的)","related":[{"word":"enjoyment","pos":"noun","translation":"享受；樂趣","explanation":"指從某事中獲得的快樂感。"},{"word":"enjoyably","pos":"adverb","translation":"愉快地","explanation":"修飾動詞，描述活動進行的方式。"}]}}

{"headword":"entry","explanation":"「entry」在學測中具有多重含義。最常見的是指「進入」的動作或「進入的權利」，以及在資訊處理或競賽中指「參賽作品/條目」。建議將其視為三個不同的使用場景來記憶。","senses":[{"sense":"進入；入口","entries":[{"pattern":"entry to sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"進入...的入口/權利","explanation":"指進入某個物理空間或某個機構的權限。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The security guard checked everyone's identity card before allowing them <target>entry</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the high-security research laboratory.","translation":"保安在允許他們進入高安全性研究實驗室之前，檢查了每個人的身分證件。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"動詞 enter + 名詞字尾 -y","related":[{"word":"entrance","pos":"noun","translation":"入口；進入","explanation":"較常用於指物理上的大門或入口。"},{"word":"enter","pos":"verb","translation":"進入；輸入","explanation":"核心動詞型態。"}]}}

{"headword":"envy","explanation":"「envy」在學測中常出現在探討人際關係、心理狀態或社會競爭的文章中。它既可用作名詞表示「羨慕」，也可作為動詞表示「羨慕/嫉妒」。注意它與 jealousy 的細微差別：envy 通常指渴望擁有他人擁有的東西，而 jealousy 則帶有強烈的佔有欲或恐懼失去的感覺。","senses":[{"sense":"羨慕；嫉妒（渴望擁有他人擁有的東西）","entries":[{"pattern":"envy sb.","pos":"verb","translation":"羨慕某人","explanation":"及物動詞，直接接名人作為受詞，表示對其才華、財富或機會的羨慕。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many students <target>envy</target> her ability to speak four different languages fluently, which allows her to travel and study around the world.","translation":"許多學生羨慕她能流利地說四種不同語言的能力，這讓她能夠在世界各地旅行和學習。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"envied","past_participle":"envied"},"relatives":{"morphology":"單個字根，通常表示一種情感狀態","related":[]}}

{"headword":"erase","explanation":"「erase」在學測中常見於描述學習過程（如修改錯誤）或科技主題（如刪除數據）。其核心概念是「完全地去掉」，可用於物理上的橡皮擦除，也可用於抽象的記憶或紀錄的刪除。","senses":[{"sense":"擦除；刪除（使之不再見或不再存在）","entries":[{"pattern":"erase sth. from sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"從...中擦除/刪除某事","explanation":"常用於描述刪除電腦數據或從記憶中抹除某個印象。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The programmer had to <target>erase</target> all the old data <pattern>from</pattern> the hard drive to make room for the new system updates.","translation":"程式設計師必須從硬碟中刪除所有舊數據，以便為新的系統更新騰出空間。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"erased","past_participle":"erased"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 erase (擦除)","related":[{"word":"eraser","pos":"noun","translation":"橡皮擦","explanation":"由動詞 erase 加上名詞字尾 -er 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"excellence","explanation":"「excellence」是一個表示高品質或卓越表現的抽象名詞。在學測中，常出現在描述個人成就、教育目標或企業文化等正面評價的段落中，通常與形容詞 excellent 相關聯。","senses":[{"sense":"卓越；優秀","entries":[{"pattern":"pursue excellence","pos":"noun","translation":"追求卓越","explanation":"固定搭配，描述一個人或機構致力於達到最高標準。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The university encourages all its students to <pattern>pursue</pattern> <target>excellence</target> in both academic studies and creative arts through hard work.","translation":"這所大學鼓勵所有學生透過努力工作，在學業研究和創意藝術方面追求卓越。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"形容詞 excellent + 名詞字尾 -ence","related":[{"word":"excel","pos":"verb","translation":"擅長；勝過","explanation":"核心動詞型態，指在某方面表現極其優秀。"},{"word":"excellent","pos":"adjective","translation":"卓越的；優秀的","explanation":"核心形容詞型態。"}]}}
