{"headword":"exhibition","explanation":"「exhibition」主要作為名詞，指將物品公開展示以供大眾觀覽。在學測中常與 art, museum, 或 trade 搭配，出現在藝術、歷史或科技展覽類文章中。","senses":[{"sense":"展覽；展出（公開展示物品）","entries":[{"pattern":"hold an exhibition","pos":"noun","translation":"舉辦展覽","explanation":"動詞 hold 與 exhibition 搭配，指舉辦一個展覽活動。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The city museum decided to <target>hold</target> an <target>exhibition</target> <pattern>of</pattern> ancient Greek pottery to teach visitors about early Mediterranean history.","translation":"市博物館決定舉辦一場古希臘陶器展，以向訪客介紹早期的地中海歷史。"}]},{"pattern":"on exhibition / on display","pos":"noun","translation":"正在展出中","explanation":"固定搭配，指物品目前被放置在展覽空間中供人觀看。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The rare diamonds were placed <pattern>on</pattern> <target>exhibition</target> in the center of the room, protected by thick glass and security guards.","translation":"那些稀有的鑽石被放置在房間中央展出，由厚玻璃和保全人員保護。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"show","pos":"noun","translation":"表演；展示","explanation":"較通用的詞彙，可指表演或展覽"},{"word":"display","pos":"noun","translation":"陳列；展示","explanation":"強調物品被擺放出來的樣子"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"由動詞 exhibit (展示) 加上名詞字尾 -ion","related":[{"word":"exhibit","pos":"verb","translation":"展示；呈現","explanation":"核心動詞形式。"},{"word":"exhibit","pos":"noun","translation":"展品","explanation":"指展覽中的單個物品。"}]}}

{"headword":"expectation","explanation":"「expectation」是名詞，指對未來事情的預期或要求。在學測中常出現在討論教育、職場壓力或社會規範的語境中，且常與 meet, fulfill, 或 exceed 搭配。","senses":[{"sense":"期待；預期（認為某事將會發生）","entries":[{"pattern":"meet/fulfill expectations","pos":"noun","translation":"符合預期","explanation":"指達成對方所期待的標準或水平。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The new movie had a lot of hype, but the plot was too simple and failed to <target>meet</target> the audience's <target>expectations</target>.","translation":"這部新電影有很多宣傳，但劇情太簡單，未能符合觀眾的預期。"}]},{"pattern":"beyond expectation","pos":"noun","translation":"超出預期","explanation":"指結果比原本預想的還要好或更糟。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The local charity event raised five thousand dollars, which was far <pattern>beyond</pattern> <target>expectation</target>, helping many poor families in need.","translation":"這次當地慈善活動籌集了五千美元，遠遠超出預期，幫助了許多有需要的貧困家庭。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"anticipation","pos":"noun","translation":"期待；預期","explanation":"強調對未來事情的興奮地期待"},{"word":"prediction","pos":"noun","translation":"預測","explanation":"強調基於事實的推測"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"由動詞 expect (期待) 加上名詞字尾 -ation","related":[{"word":"expect","pos":"verb","translation":"期待；預期","explanation":"核心動詞形式。"},{"word":"expectant","pos":"adjective","translation":"期待的；懷孕的","explanation":"由動詞 expect 加上形容詞字尾 -ant 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"experiment","explanation":"「experiment」既可作為名詞（實驗）也可作為動詞（嘗試、做實驗）。在學測科學類閱讀文章中極為高頻，重點在於辨識其後接的 on 或 with 介系詞。","senses":[{"sense":"實驗（科學研究方法）","entries":[{"pattern":"conduct / carry out an experiment","pos":"noun","translation":"進行實驗","explanation":"動詞 conduct 或 carry out 與 experiment 搭配，指正式地執行一個科學程序。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The chemistry students had to <target>conduct</target> a careful <target>experiment</target> to see how different acids react with various metals.","translation":"化學學生必須進行一次仔細的實驗，以觀察不同酸類如何與各種金屬產生反應。"}]},{"pattern":"experiment on sth./sb.","pos":"noun","translation":"在…上做實驗","explanation":"指對特定對象（如動物或植物）進行測試以獲取數據。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many scientists <target>experiment</target> <pattern>on</pattern> mice because their biological systems are very similar to those of humans.","translation":"許多科學家在老鼠身上做實驗，因為它們的生物系統與人類非常相似。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"test","pos":"noun","translation":"測試","explanation":"較通用的詞彙，指驗證某事是否有效"},{"word":"trial","pos":"noun","translation":"試驗；審判","explanation":"強調在實際應用中測試過程"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"experimented","past_participle":"experimented"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 experi (體驗、嘗試) + 字尾 -ment","related":[{"word":"experience","pos":"noun","translation":"經驗；體驗","explanation":"核心基礎詞彙。"},{"word":"experimental","pos":"adjective","translation":"實驗性的","explanation":"由名詞 experiment 加上形容詞字尾 -al 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"explode","explanation":"「explode」在學測中除了指物理上的「爆炸」，還常用於描述人口、價格、數量等「暴增」。學生應注意其名詞形式 explosion，以及在比喻義中如何與數據或數據圖表搭配。","senses":[{"sense":"爆炸；爆裂（物理上的毀滅）","entries":[{"pattern":"explode into pieces","pos":"verb","translation":"爆炸成碎片","explanation":"指物體因內部壓力或火藥而突然爆裂。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The old gas tank <target>exploded</target> <pattern>into</pattern> pieces after the heat became too strong, causing a loud noise throughout the city.","translation":"在熱力變得太強後，舊的瓦斯桶爆炸成碎片，在整個城市引起了巨大的噪音。"}]},{"pattern":"explode with anger","pos":"verb","translation":"勃然大怒","explanation":"比喻義，指情緒突然間像爆炸一樣地爆發。","sentences":[{"sentence":"When the teacher found out that the students had cheated on the test, she <target>exploded</target> <pattern>with</pattern> anger.","translation":"當老師發現學生在考試中作弊時，她勃然大怒。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"burst","pos":"verb","translation":"爆裂；迸發","explanation":"強調突然間爆裂"},{"word":"detonate","pos":"verb","translation":"引爆","explanation":"指正式地觸發爆炸"},{"word":"blast","pos":"verb","translation":"炸毀","explanation":"強調爆炸產生的衝擊波"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"exploded","past_participle":"exploded"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字首 ex- (向外) + 字根 plode (拍手、擊打)","related":[{"word":"explosion","pos":"noun","translation":"爆炸；激增","explanation":"由動詞 explode 加上名詞字尾 -ion 延伸而來。"},{"word":"implode","pos":"verb","translation":"內爆","explanation":"字首 im- (向內) + 字根 plode，指物體向內塌陷而爆炸。"}]}}

{"headword":"explore","explanation":"「explore」在學測中不僅指地理上的「探險」，更常用於描述對新知識、新方法或新可能性的「探索與研究」。在閱讀測驗中，常接續抽象名詞（如 options, possibilities, ideas）或地點名詞（如 cave, jungle, space）。","senses":[{"sense":"探索；探險（前往不熟悉的地方以了解其情況）","entries":[{"pattern":"explore sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"探索某處","explanation":"及物動詞，受詞通常是自然景觀或未知的地理區域。","sentences":[{"sentence":"During their summer vacation, the students decided to <target>explore</target> the hidden caves and forests near the coast of their hometown.","translation":"在暑假期間，學生們決定去探索家鄉海岸附近的隱藏洞穴與森林。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"explored","past_participle":"explored"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 explore (探索、搜尋)","related":[{"word":"exploration","pos":"noun","translation":"探索；探險","explanation":"由動詞 explore 加上名詞字尾 -tion 延伸而來。"},{"word":"explorer","pos":"noun","translation":"探險家","explanation":"由動詞 explore 加上名詞字尾 -er 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"export","explanation":"「export」在學測中是經濟與貿易類文章的必備字彙。注意其名詞與動詞的發音位置不同（動詞重音在後，名詞重音在前），且常用於描述國家間的資源交換與經濟依賴。","senses":[{"sense":"出口（將商品賣到國外）","entries":[{"pattern":"export sth. to sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"將某物出口至某處","explanation":"動詞用法，常用於描述國家或公司將產品運送到海外市場。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Taiwan <target>exports</target> high-quality semiconductor chips <pattern>to</pattern> many different countries across the globe to maintain its economic strength.","translation":"台灣將高品質的半導體晶片出口到全球許多不同的國家，以維持其經濟實力。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"exported","past_participle":"exported"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字首 ex- (向外) 與字根 port (攜帶、港口)","related":[{"word":"import","pos":"verb","translation":"進口","explanation":"字首 im- (向內) + 字根 port (攜帶)，與 export 相反。"},{"word":"transport","pos":"verb","translation":"運輸","explanation":"字首 trans- (橫跨) + 字根 port (攜帶)。"}]}}

{"headword":"expressive","explanation":"「expressive」是用於描述人的表情、藝術作品或語言能力的高階形容詞。它強調的是「能夠有效地傳達情感或想法」，而非單純的「表達」。","senses":[{"sense":"富有表現力的；能傳達情感的","entries":[{"pattern":"expressive of sth.","pos":"adjective","translation":"表現出…的；傳達出…的","explanation":"常用於描述面部表情、手勢或藝術風格，用以揭示內心的情感狀態。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The young pianist played the piece with such <target>expressive</target> movements <pattern>of</pattern> deep sadness that the entire audience began to cry.","translation":"那位年輕的鋼琴家以如此富有表現力且傳達出深沉悲傷的動作演奏這首曲子，以至於全場觀眾都開始落淚。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 express (表達) + 形容詞字尾 -ive","related":[{"word":"express","pos":"verb","translation":"表達；表達","explanation":"核心基礎動詞型態。"},{"word":"expression","pos":"noun","translation":"表達；表情","explanation":"由動詞 express 加上名詞字尾 -ion 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"extreme","explanation":"「extreme」在學測中常出現在氣候變遷（extreme weather）或人類行為（extreme sports）的討論中。作為形容詞時，它強調的是「程度最高」或「最激進」；作為名詞時，則指「極端」。","senses":[{"sense":"極端的；極大的（程度遠超一般水準）","entries":[{"pattern":"extreme adj.","pos":"adjective","translation":"極端的…","explanation":"修飾名詞，常用於描述天氣、溫度或觀點。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Due to climate change, many coastal cities are now facing <target>extreme</target> weather events, such as powerful hurricanes and unexpected floods.","translation":"由於氣候變遷，許多沿海城市現在正正面臨極端天氣事件，例如強大的颶風和出乎意料的洪水。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 extreme (最邊緣的)","related":[{"word":"extremely","pos":"adverb","translation":"極其地","explanation":"形容詞 extreme 加上副詞字尾 -ly。"}]}}

{"headword":"fade","explanation":"「fade」在學測中常用於描述色彩的褪色、記憶的模糊或聲音的減弱。理解此字時，要注意它是一個不及物動詞，表示狀態的自然漸進過程。","senses":[{"sense":"褪色；逐漸消失（顏色、聲音或記憶）","entries":[{"pattern":"fade away","pos":"verb","translation":"逐漸消失","explanation":"搭配 away 加強消失的過程，常用於描述聲音、光線或記憶的消逝。","sentences":[{"sentence":"As the old photograph sat in the sun for many years, the bright red colors slowly <target>faded</target> <pattern>away</pattern>, leaving only a dull gray.","translation":"由於這張舊照片在陽光下曬了多年，鮮紅的顏色慢慢地褪色消失了，只剩下暗淡的灰色。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"faded","past_participle":"faded"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"familiar","explanation":"「familiar」在學測中常考其形容詞用法，特別是搭配介系詞 with 或 to。需注意 a familiar face (熟悉的面孔) 與 be familiar with sth. (熟悉某事) 的主被動邏輯差異：主詞為人時用 with，主詞為事物時用 to。","senses":[{"sense":"熟悉的；熟知的（對某人或某事有深入了解）","entries":[{"pattern":"be familiar with sth.","pos":"adjective","translation":"熟悉某事","explanation":"主詞通常是人，表示對某個主題、規則或環境有掌握。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Since he has lived in Taipei for ten years, he is very <target>familiar</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the complex subway system and the shortest routes.","translation":"由於他在台北住了十年，他非常熟悉複雜的捷運系統和最短的路線。"},{"sentence":"Most high school students are not <target>familiar</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the strict rules of academic writing, so they often make mistakes in their essays.","translation":"大多數高中生並不熟悉學術寫作的嚴格規則，因此他們在論文中經常犯錯。"}]},{"pattern":"be familiar to sb.","pos":"adjective","translation":"對某人來說是熟悉的","explanation":"主詞通常是事物或聲音，表示該事物被某人認識或記得。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The melody of the old song was <target>familiar</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the elderly woman, bringing back memories of her childhood in the countryside.","translation":"那首老歌的旋律對那位老婦人來說很熟悉，喚起了她童年在鄉下的回憶。"},{"sentence":"The smell of fresh coffee in the morning is <target>familiar</target> <pattern>to</pattern> almost every office worker who starts their day early.","translation":"早晨新鮮咖啡的味道對幾乎每個早起開始一天的上班族來說都是熟悉的。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"acquainted","pos":"adjective","translation":"認識的；熟悉的","explanation":"較正式，常搭配 be acquainted with"},{"word":"well-known","pos":"adjective","translation":"著名的；廣為人知的","explanation":"強調被很多人知道"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"unfamiliar","pos":"adjective","translation":"不熟悉的","explanation":null},{"word":"strange","pos":"adjective","translation":"奇怪的；陌生的","explanation":null}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 famili (家人) + 形容詞字尾 -ar","related":[{"word":"familiarity","pos":"noun","translation":"熟悉；親近","explanation":"由形容詞 familiar 加上名詞字尾 -ity 延伸而來。"},{"word":"family","pos":"noun","translation":"家庭","explanation":"核心基礎詞彙。"}]}}

{"headword":"fancy","explanation":"「fancy」在學測中是一個多功能詞彙。形容詞用法最常見，表示「豪華的」或「複雜的」；動詞用法則較少見，但表示「想像」或「想要」，常出現在較高階的閱讀測驗中。","senses":[{"sense":"豪華的；精美的；複雜的（外觀華麗或價格昂貴）","entries":[{"pattern":"fancy adj.","pos":"adjective","translation":"豪華的；精美的","explanation":"常用於形容衣服、餐廳或裝飾，強調其超出日常需求的華麗感。","sentences":[{"sentence":"For their wedding anniversary, the couple decided to dine at a <target>fancy</target> restaurant that served expensive French food.","translation":"為了慶祝結婚紀念日，這對夫婦決定在一家供應昂貴法國菜的豪華餐廳用餐。"},{"sentence":"You do not need to wear a <target>fancy</target> dress to the party; simple and clean clothes are enough for this casual event.","translation":"你不需要穿一件華麗的禮服參加派對；對於這次非正式的活動，簡單乾淨的衣服就足夠了。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"luxurious","pos":"adjective","translation":"奢華的","explanation":"強調極其昂貴且舒適"},{"word":"elaborate","pos":"adjective","translation":"精巧的；複雜的","explanation":"強調細節繁多且精心設計"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"plain","pos":"adjective","translation":"樸素的","explanation":null},{"word":"simple","pos":"adjective","translation":"簡單的","explanation":null}]},{"sense":"想像；幻想（動詞用法）","entries":[{"pattern":"fancy sth. / doing sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"想像某事／想像做某事","explanation":"在英式英語中較為常見，表示在腦海中構思或預想某種情境。","sentences":[{"sentence":"I cannot <target>fancy</target> <pattern>how</pattern> difficult it was for the early explorers to travel across the ocean without any maps.","translation":"我無法想像早期的探險家在沒有任何地圖的情況下跨越海洋是多麼困難。"},{"sentence":"Do you <target>fancy</target> <pattern>going</pattern> for a walk in the park after we finish all our homework for the weekend?","translation":"我們完成所有週末功課後，你想不想去公園散步？"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"imagine","pos":"verb","translation":"想像","explanation":null}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"幻想；怪想（名詞用法）","entries":[{"pattern":"fancy","pos":"noun","translation":"幻想；想像力","explanation":"指心中產生的不真實的念頭或想像力。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The young writer has a very vivid <target>fancy</target>, allowing her to create wonderful worlds in her short stories.","translation":"這位年輕的作家擁有非常生動的想像力，，讓她能在短篇小說中創造出美妙的世界。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"imagination","pos":"noun","translation":"想像力","explanation":null}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"fancied","past_participle":"fancied"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"fanciful","pos":"adjective","translation":"幻想的；不切實際的","explanation":"由 fancy 加上形容詞字尾 -ful 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"fare","explanation":"「fare」在學測中主要作為名詞，指交通工具的費用。需注意其與 fair (公平的/集市) 的同音異義，在聽力測驗中是重要考點。","senses":[{"sense":"交通費用（乘坐車輛、船隻或飛機的金額）","entries":[{"pattern":"bus / train / air fare","pos":"noun","translation":"巴士／火車／機票費用","explanation":"常用於組合詞或搭配特定的交通工具名詞，指支付給運送者的費用。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Because the government decided to lower the bus <target>fare</target>, more people started using public transport to go to school.","translation":"因為政府決定降低巴士票價，更多的人開始利用大眾運輸工具上學。"},{"sentence":"The tourist was surprised to find that the train <target>fare</target> from the city center to the airport was very cheap.","translation":"這名遊客驚訝地發現從市中心到機場的火車票價非常便宜。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"price","pos":"noun","translation":"價格","explanation":"泛指所有物品或服務的價格"},{"word":"cost","pos":"noun","translation":"成本；費用","explanation":"泛指任何支出"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"farther","explanation":"「farther」是 far 的比較級。在學測中，學生需區分 farther 與 further 的用法：farther 通常指「物理上的距離」更遠，而 further 與 farther 均可指「程度或時間」更深、進一步地。","senses":[{"sense":"更遠的（指物理距離）","entries":[{"pattern":"farther adj. / adv.","pos":"adjective","translation":"較遠的；更遠的","explanation":"用於描述物理空間上的距離增加。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The library is located <target>farther</target> down the street than the post office, so you will need to walk for five more minutes.","translation":"圖書館的位置比郵局更遠，所以你需要再走五分鐘。"},{"sentence":"He tried to throw the ball <target>farther</target> than his brother did, but he could not reach the goal line.","translation":"他試著將球扔得比他哥哥更遠，但他無法到達終點線。"}]},{"pattern":"farther adv.","pos":"adverb","translation":"更遠地","explanation":"修飾動詞，表示在空間位置上向更遠處移動。","sentences":[{"sentence":"If you walk <target>farther</target> into the forest, you will find a beautiful hidden lake with crystal clear water.","translation":"如果你往森林深處走得更遠，你會發現一個擁有晶瑩剔透湖水的美麗隱藏湖泊。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"more distant","pos":"adjective","translation":"較遙遠的","explanation":null}],"antonyms":[{"word":"closer","pos":"adjective","translation":"較近的","explanation":null}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"far 的比較級","related":[{"word":"further","pos":"adjective","translation":"進一步的；更遠的","explanation":"可指物理距離，也可指程度上的進一步。"}]}}

{"headword":"fashionable","explanation":"「fashionable」在描述人物外觀、社會趨勢或流行文化時非常高頻。其核心概念是「受歡迎的」或「符合當前趨勢」。","senses":[{"sense":"流行的；時髦的（符合當前趨勢或社會認可）","entries":[{"pattern":"fashionable adj.","pos":"adjective","translation":"流行的；時髦的","explanation":"常用於形容衣服、髮型、家具或甚至是一種社會行為（如某種飲食習慣）。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many teenagers love to follow the latest trends and wear <target>fashionable</target> clothes to show their personality at school.","translation":"許多青少年喜歡追隨最新趨勢，穿著時髦的衣服在學校展現他們的個性。"},{"sentence":"In the 1960s, it became <target>fashionable</target> for young people to wear colorful pants and long hair to express their freedom.","translation":"在 1960 年代，年輕人穿彩色長褲和留長髮變得流行起來，以表達他們的自由。"}]},{"pattern":"it is fashionable to do sth.","pos":"adjective","translation":"做某事是流行的","explanation":"使用虛擬主詞 it，描述一種社會大眾的普遍趨勢。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Nowadays, it is <target>fashionable</target> <pattern>to</pattern> use digital tablets instead of paper notebooks for taking notes in class.","translation":"現今，使用數位平板電腦代替紙本筆記本在課堂上做筆記已變得流行。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"trendy","pos":"adjective","translation":"時髦的；趨勢的","explanation":"較口語，強調追隨最新流行"},{"word":"stylish","pos":"adjective","translation":"有風格的；時髦的","explanation":"強調個人風格好，不一定隨波逐流"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"old-fashioned","pos":"adjective","translation":"過時的；老派的","explanation":null},{"word":"out-of-date","pos":"adjective","translation":"過時的","explanation":null}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"名詞 fashion (流行) + 形容詞字尾 -able (可...的)","related":[{"word":"fashion","pos":"noun","translation":"流行；時尚","explanation":"核心基礎名詞。"},{"word":"wordy","pos":"noun","translation":"冗長的","explanation":"不相關，但提供形態學相關範例 (在此處 a-able 類比)"}]}}

{"headword":"faucet","explanation":"「faucet」在學測中主要出現在描述日常生活、環境保護或節水議題的閱讀測驗中。它是一個具體名詞，學生應重點關注其在居家環境（如廚房、浴室）中的出現情境。","senses":[{"sense":"水龍頭","entries":[{"pattern":"faucet","pos":"noun","translation":"水龍頭","explanation":"指控制水流出入的裝置。常與 turn on/off 等動詞搭配。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Please remember to turn off the <target>faucet</target> while you are brushing your teeth to save water for the planet.","translation":"刷牙時請記得關掉水龍頭，為地球節省用水。"},{"sentence":"The old <target>faucet</target> in the kitchen was leaking slowly, and the sound of water dripping all night kept me awake.","translation":"廚房裡那個舊的水龍頭在緩慢地漏水，而且整晚滴水聲讓我無法入睡。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"tap","pos":"noun","translation":"水龍頭","explanation":"英式英語中更常用的稱呼。"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"fearful","explanation":"「fearful」在學測中常用於描述人物的心理狀態或對未來的擔憂。要注意它與 fear (n./v.) 的區分，以及它在不同語境中可能表示「恐懼的」或「令人恐懼的」兩種含義。","senses":[{"sense":"恐懼的；害怕的","entries":[{"pattern":"fearful of sth.","pos":"adjective","translation":"害怕…；對…感到恐懼","explanation":"這是最常見的搭配，後接介系詞 of，用來描述主詞對特定對象或結果的恐懼。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many young students are <target>fearful</target> <pattern>of</pattern> making mistakes during their first English presentation in front of the whole class.","translation":"許多學生在全班面前進行第一次英文簡報時，非常害怕犯錯。"},{"sentence":"The small cat was <target>fearful</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the loud noise from the vacuum cleaner and hid under the sofa for an hour.","translation":"那隻小貓很害怕吸塵器的巨大噪音，在沙發下躲了一個小時。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"afraid","pos":"adjective","translation":"害怕的","explanation":"最普遍的同義詞。"},{"word":"terrified","pos":"adjective","translation":"極度恐懼的","explanation":"強調恐懼的程度更高。"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"brave","pos":"adjective","translation":"勇敢的","explanation":null},{"word":"fearless","pos":"adjective","translation":"無畏的","explanation":"由 fearful 的反義詞 fearless 構成。"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 fear (恐懼) + 形容詞字尾 -ful (充滿…的)","related":[{"word":"fear","pos":"noun","translation":"恐懼","explanation":"基礎名詞型態。"},{"word":"fearless","pos":"adjective","translation":"無畏的","explanation":"字尾 -less 表示缺乏或沒有。"},{"word":"fearfully","pos":"adverb","translation":"恐懼地","explanation":"由 fearful 加上副詞字尾 -ly 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"feather","explanation":"「feather」在生物類閱讀中是基礎名詞，常出現在描述鳥類特徵、進化或自然現象的文本中。在學測中，學生應注意其在比喻用法中的出現。","senses":[{"sense":"羽毛","entries":[{"pattern":"feather","pos":"noun","translation":"羽毛","explanation":"指鳥類覆蓋在身體上的羽毛。常用於描述鳥類的飛行能力或保暖功能。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The baby bird had soft, grey <target>feathers</target> that helped it stay warm during the cold winter nights in the forest.","translation":"那隻雛鳥有著柔軟的灰色羽毛，幫助它在森林中寒冷的冬夜裡保持溫暖。"},{"sentence":"After the heavy rain, the eagle's <target>feathers</target> became heavy and wet, making it difficult for the bird to fly high.","translation":"大雨之後，老鷹的羽毛變得沉重且潮濕，使得這隻鳥很難飛高。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"fence","explanation":"「fence」在學測中可作為名詞（圍欄）與動詞（擊劍）。名詞用法最為高頻，常出現在描述住宅、農場或物理邊界的概念中。","senses":[{"sense":"圍欄；柵欄","entries":[{"pattern":"fence","pos":"noun","translation":"圍欄；柵欄","explanation":"指用木頭、金屬等材料圍繞在土地周圍的結構。常與 build 或 jump over 等動詞搭配。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The farmer built a strong wooden <target>fence</target> around his vegetable garden to keep the hungry rabbits from eating his crops.","translation":"農夫在他的蔬菜園周圍築起一道強壯的木製圍欄，以防止飢餓的兔子吃掉他的作物。"},{"sentence":"The dog jumped over the white <target>fence</target> and ran away into the street, causing the owner to chase after him.","translation":"那隻狗跳過白色的圍欄，跑到了街道上，導致主人在後面追著它跑。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"barrier","pos":"noun","translation":"屏障；障礙物","explanation":"更泛指任何形式的物理或抽象的障礙。"},{"word":"wall","pos":"noun","translation":"牆壁","explanation":"強調結構更為堅固、高大。"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"擊劍","entries":[{"pattern":"fence","pos":"verb","translation":"擊劍","explanation":"指一種體育運動，使用劍類武器進行對抗。在學測中出現頻率較低，但屬於基礎詞彙。","sentences":[{"sentence":"In high school, Sarah loved to <target>fence</target> in the local sports club, as she enjoyed the speed and precision of the sport.","translation":"在高中時，莎拉很喜歡在當地的體育俱樂部擊劍，因為她享受這項運動的速度與精確度。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"fenced","past_participle":"fenced"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"fighter","explanation":"「fighter」在學測中主要出現在描述戰爭、社會運動或疾病治療過程中的人物特徵。它不僅指具體的「戰鬥員」，也指具有「鬥志」的人。","senses":[{"sense":"戰鬥員；鬥士","entries":[{"pattern":"fighter","pos":"noun","translation":"戰鬥員；鬥士","explanation":"指參與戰爭或格鬥運動的人。常與 brave, strong 等形容詞修飾。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The ancient soldiers were brave <target>fighters</target> who protected their city from invading armies for many long years.","translation":"古代的士兵們是勇敢的戰鬥員，多年來保護他們的城市免於入侵軍隊的。"},{"sentence":"The young man trained hard every day to become a professional <target>fighter</target> in the boxing ring, hoping to win a gold medal.","translation":"這個年輕人每天刻苦訓練，希望能成為拳擊場上的專業鬥士，贏得金牌。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"warrior","pos":"noun","translation":"戰鬥員；勇士","explanation":"通常指古代或傳說中的戰鬥員。"},{"word":"combatant","pos":"noun","translation":"戰鬥員","explanation":"更正式的法律或軍事術語。"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"不屈不撓的人（比喻用法）","entries":[{"pattern":"a fighter","pos":"noun","translation":"不屈不撓的人；鬥志強的人","explanation":"比喻用法，常用於描述面對困難、疾病或不公平對待時，堅持不懈地努力的人。這是學測中較高頻的出現方式。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Despite having a serious illness, the grandmother was a true <target>fighter</target>, refusing to give up hope and fighting for her life.","translation":"儘管患有嚴重疾病，那位祖母是一個真正不屈不撓的人，拒絕放棄希望並為生命而奮鬥。"},{"sentence":"The student council president was a <target>fighter</target> <pattern>for</pattern> human rights, working hard to make the school's rules more fair.","translation":"學生會會長是一位人權鬥士，努力讓學校的規則變得更加公平。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"survivor","pos":"noun","translation":"倖存者；克服困難的人","explanation":"null"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 fight (戰鬥) + 名詞字尾 -er (人)","related":[{"word":"fight","pos":"verb","translation":"戰鬥；爭鬥","explanation":"基礎動詞型態。"},{"word":"fighter","pos":"noun","translation":"鬥士","explanation":"由 fight 延伸而來的名詞型態。"}]}}

{"headword":"firework","explanation":"「firework」在學測中通常出現在文化慶典或節日描寫的閱讀文章中。要注意它既可以用作可數名詞指單個煙火，也可以在複數形式 fireworks 中指一場煙火表演。","senses":[{"sense":"煙火；爆竹（用於慶典的發光爆炸物）","entries":[{"pattern":"fireworks","pos":"noun","translation":"煙火（表演）","explanation":"通常使用複數形式，描述夜晚天空被彩色光芒填滿的景象。","sentences":[{"sentence":"To celebrate the end of the school year, the city put on a spectacular display of <target>fireworks</target> that lit up the midnight sky.","translation":"為了慶祝學年結束，這座城市舉辦了一場壯麗的煙火表演，將深夜的天空照亮了。"},{"sentence":"The crowd cheered loudly as the first huge <target>firework</target> exploded into a thousand shimmering gold sparks above the harbor.","translation":"當第一枚巨大的煙火在港口上方爆炸成千個閃爍的金光火花時，人群大聲歡呼。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"名詞 fire (火) 與 work (作品/工程) 的組合","related":[{"word":"fireworks display","pos":"noun","translation":"煙火表演","explanation":"固定名詞短語，用於描述正式的煙火秀。"}]}}

{"headword":"fist","explanation":"「fist」在描述動作、衝突或強烈情感的文學描寫中較為常見。要注意其名詞形式指「拳頭」，而動詞形式指「握拳」，兩者在語意上高度統一。","senses":[{"sense":"拳頭（緊握的手）","entries":[{"pattern":"fist","pos":"noun","translation":"拳頭","explanation":"指緊握的手，常用於描寫打鬥或憤怒的情緒。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The angry young man clenched his <target>fist</target> in frustration after he failed the final exam for the second time.","translation":"那名憤怒的年輕人在第二次期末考失敗後，因挫折而緊握拳頭。"},{"sentence":"The boxing champion hit the heavy sandbag with a powerful <target>fist</target>, making a loud booming sound in the gym.","translation":"拳擊冠軍用有力的拳頭擊打沉重的沙袋，在健身房裡發出巨大的轟鳴聲。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"握拳（將手緊握成拳）","entries":[{"pattern":"fist","pos":"verb","translation":"握拳","explanation":"將手緊握成拳頭的動作。","sentences":[{"sentence":"He <target>fisted</target> the handle of the tool tightly to make sure it would not slip while he was working.","translation":"他緊緊握住工具的柄，以確保他在工作時它不會滑掉。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"fisted","past_participle":"fisted"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"flame","explanation":"「flame」在學測中既可用於物理上的「火焰」，也可用於比喻意義上的「強烈情感」（如愛火、憤怒）。在寫作中，將物理火焰轉化為比喻，是提升文章層次的重要技巧。","senses":[{"sense":"火焰（燃燒時產生的光與熱）","entries":[{"pattern":"flame","pos":"noun","translation":"火焰","explanation":"指燃燒時產生的物理火光。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The hikers built a small campfire and watched the orange <target>flames</target> dance in the cool night wind.","translation":"登山客們生起一堆小營火，看著橘色的火焰在涼爽的夜晚微風中舞動。"},{"sentence":"The firefighters fought hard for six hours to stop the <target>flames</target> from spreading to the nearby wooden house.","translation":"消防員們奮戰六小時，才阻止火焰蔓延到附近的木屋。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"fire","pos":"noun","translation":"火","explanation":"最普遍的通用詞"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"燃燒；使起火（使某物開始燃燒）","entries":[{"pattern":"flame","pos":"verb","translation":"燃燒；發光","explanation":"指某物發出像火焰一樣的光芒或開始燃燒。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The autumn leaves <target>flamed</target> with a bright red color, making the mountain look like it was on fire.","translation":"秋天的葉子呈現出鮮紅的顏色，讓山看起來像是在著火一樣。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"flamed","past_participle":"flamed"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"flash","explanation":"「flash」的核心概念是「短暫且快速地出現」。無論是物理上的「閃光」還是心理上的「靈感」，都圍繞著這個時間上的極短暫性。","senses":[{"sense":"閃光；閃現（快速且短暫的光芒或影像）","entries":[{"pattern":"flash","pos":"noun","translation":"閃光；閃現","explanation":"指極短時間內出現的光或影像。","sentences":[{"sentence":"A sudden <target>flash</target> of lightning lit up the dark forest, revealing the narrow path that led to the lake.","translation":"一道突然的閃電將黑暗的森林照亮，揭露了通往湖泊的狹窄路徑。"},{"sentence":"In a <target>flash</target>, the magician made the white rabbit disappear from the hat and reappear in the audience's hand.","translation":"在轉瞬間，魔術師讓白兔從帽子中消失，並在觀眾的手中重新出現。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"閃爍；快速移動（快速發光或迅速經過）","entries":[{"pattern":"flash","pos":"verb","translation":"閃爍；閃現","explanation":"指光線快速地出現或人快速地移動。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The police officer <target>flashed</target> his badge to the security guard to prove his identity and enter the building.","translation":"警察向保全人員出示（閃現）了他的徽章，以證明其身份並進入建築物。"},{"sentence":"The sports car <target>flashed</target> past the finish line at an amazing speed, winning the gold medal easily.","translation":"這輛跑車以驚人的速度疾速經過終點線，輕鬆贏得金牌。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"flashed","past_participle":"flashed"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"flashlight","explanation":"「flashlight」是基礎生活名詞，但在學測閱讀中常出現在探險、露營或停電時的情境描寫中，是建立場景感的關鍵詞。","senses":[{"sense":"手電筒","entries":[{"pattern":"flashlight","pos":"noun","translation":"手電筒","explanation":"指可攜式的手持照明設備。","sentences":[{"sentence":"During the heavy rainstorm, the power went out, so my father used a <target>flashlight</target> to find the candles.","translation":"在大雨中，電力中斷了，所以我的父親使用手電筒來尋找蠟燭。"},{"sentence":"The cave explorer carefully pointed his <target>flashlight</target> at the cave walls to look for ancient paintings.","translation":"洞穴探險家小心地將手電筒對準洞穴牆壁，以尋找古代的壁畫。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"名詞 flash (閃光) 與 light (燈/光) 的組合","related":[{"word":"flash","pos":"adjective","translation":"華麗的；奢侈的","explanation":"由 flash 延伸而來的形容詞，指外觀閃耀且吸引注意。"}]}}

{"headword":"flavor","explanation":"「flavor」在學測中既可作為名詞表示「味道/風味」，也可作為動詞表示「調味」。要注意其在比喻義中可用來描述某種「特質」或「氛圍」，這在閱讀理解中是高頻考點。","senses":[{"sense":"味道；風味（舌尖感受到的味道或某種特有的氛圍）","entries":[{"pattern":"flavor","pos":"noun","translation":"味道；風味","explanation":"指食物的味道，或比喻成某地或某事物的特有風格。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The chef added a pinch of sea salt to bring out the natural <target>flavor</target> of the fresh salmon.","translation":"主廚加入了一小撮海鹽，以帶出新鮮鮭魚的天然風味。"},{"sentence":"The old architecture and narrow streets give the city a European <target>flavor</target> that attracts many international tourists.","translation":"古老的建築和狹窄的街道賦予了這座城市一種歐洲風味，吸引了許多國際遊客。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"taste","pos":"noun","translation":"味道","explanation":"最普遍的同義詞，指舌頭感受到的味道。"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"調味；賦予風味（使食物具有某種味道）","entries":[{"pattern":"flavor sth. with sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"用…為…調味","explanation":"動詞用法，後接調味品作為手段，使主體食物產生特定風味。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many people prefer to <target>flavor</target> their morning coffee <pattern>with</pattern> a bit of honey instead of using white sugar.","translation":"許多人更喜歡用一點蜂蜜為他們的早晨咖啡調味，而不是使用白砂糖。"},{"sentence":"The baker decided to <target>flavor</target> the sponge cake <pattern>with</pattern> lemon zest to make it taste more refreshing in summer.","translation":"烘焙師決定用檸檬皮為海綿蛋糕調味，使其在夏天嚐起來更清爽。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"season","pos":"verb","translation":"調味","explanation":"指添加鹽、胡椒等基礎調料以增強味道。"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"flavored","past_participle":"flavored"},"relatives":{"morphology":"來自拉丁語 flavor (顏色、光輝) 演變而來。","related":[{"word":"flavorful","pos":"adjective","translation":"味道濃郁的","explanation":"由 flavor 加上形容詞字尾 -ful 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"flesh","explanation":"「flesh」主要指生物的「肌肉/肉體」，在學測中常用於描述生物構造或比喻人的「肉身/人性」。需與 meat（食用肉）區分開來。","senses":[{"sense":"肉體；肌肉（生物身體組織）","entries":[{"pattern":"flesh","pos":"noun","translation":"肉體；肌肉","explanation":"指生物身體皮膚下的組織，而非指超市買的肉。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The sharp thorn of the rose bush pierced through the thin <target>flesh</target> of her finger, causing a small drop of blood.","translation":"玫瑰叢的尖刺穿透了她手指纖薄的肉體，導致流出了一小滴血。"},{"sentence":"In the biology class, students studied how the thick <target>flesh</target> of a cactus helps the plant store water in the dry desert.","translation":"在生物課上，學生們研究了仙人掌厚實的肉質部分如何幫助植物在乾旱的沙漠中儲水。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"muscle","pos":"noun","translation":"肌肉","explanation":"指身體的運動組織。"},{"word":"tissue","pos":"noun","translation":"組織","explanation":"生物學上的通用術語。"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"fleshy","pos":"adjective","translation":"肉質的；豐滿的","explanation":"由 flesh 加上形容詞字尾 -y 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"float","explanation":"「float」在學測中既可作為動詞（漂浮）也可作為名詞（花車）。在動詞用法中，要注意其自動詞與及物動詞的區別，以及在經濟術語中表示「使浮動」。","senses":[{"sense":"漂浮；浮在水面（不沉沒）","entries":[{"pattern":"float on sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"漂浮在…之上","explanation":"最常見的用法，指物體因密度低於液體而留在水面。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After the heavy rain, many fallen leaves and small branches <target>float</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the surface of the pond.","translation":"大雨之後，許多落葉和小樹枝漂浮在池塘的表面。"},{"sentence":"The rescue team used a large rubber boat to <target>float</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the flooded streets of the city.","translation":"救援隊使用一隻大型橡膠船在城市的淹水街道上漂浮。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"drift","pos":"verb","translation":"漂流","explanation":"強調被水流或風吹著走。"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"sink","pos":"verb","translation":"下沉","explanation":"指物體掉入水底。"}]},{"sense":"花車（遊行時裝飾華麗的車輛）","entries":[{"pattern":"float","pos":"noun","translation":"花車","explanation":"指在節日遊行中使用的裝飾車輛。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The most colorful <target>float</target> in the carnival parade was decorated with thousands of fresh roses and lilies.","translation":"嘉年華遊行中最繽紛的花車是用數千朵新鮮的玫瑰和百合花裝飾的。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"floated","past_participle":"floated"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"flock","explanation":"「flock」在學測中常出現於自然生態類文章中。名詞指「一群（鳥或羊）」，動詞指「聚集/湧向」。要注意其後方常接續特定的動物種類。","senses":[{"sense":"一群（鳥或羊等）","entries":[{"pattern":"a flock of sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"一群…","explanation":"用於量詞，專指鳥類或羊類。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Every autumn, a large <target>flock</target> <pattern>of</pattern> wild geese fly south to avoid the freezing winter weather.","translation":"每年秋天，一群巨大的野生鵝群飛向南方以避開寒冷的冬日氣候。"},{"sentence":"The farmer spent the whole morning guiding a <target>flock</target> <pattern>of</pattern> sheep across the green mountain valley.","translation":"農夫花了一整個早晨引導一群綿羊穿過綠色的山谷。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"group","pos":"noun","translation":"一群","explanation":"最通用的量詞。"},{"word":"herd","pos":"noun","translation":"一群","explanation":"專指大型哺乳類動物（如牛、馬）。"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"聚集；湧向（大量的人或動物聚集在一起）","entries":[{"pattern":"flock to sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"湧向…；聚集在…","explanation":"指大量的人群或動物被吸引而聚集到某處。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Thousands of young fans <target>flocked</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the stadium to see their favorite pop star perform live.","translation":"數以千計的年輕粉絲湧向體育場，為了看他們最喜愛的流行歌手現場表演。"},{"sentence":"During the summer holiday, tourists <target>flock</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the beaches of Taiwan to enjoy the warm sun.","translation":"在暑假期間，遊客們湧向台灣的海邊以享受溫暖的陽光。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"gather","pos":"verb","translation":"聚集","explanation":"通用詞，指人或物聚集在一起。"},{"word":"swarm","pos":"verb","translation":"蜂擁而至","explanation":"強調像昆蟲一樣大量且混亂地聚集。"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"flocked","past_participle":"flocked"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"flood","explanation":"「flood」在學測中常出現在環境、氣候變遷類文章中。名詞可指「洪水/水災」，動詞可指「淹沒」或比喻義的「大量湧入」。","senses":[{"sense":"洪水；水災（大量水流淹沒陸地）","entries":[{"pattern":"flood","pos":"noun","translation":"洪水；水災","explanation":"指因暴雨或河流氾濫而導致的自然災害。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After three days of heavy rain, the river overflowed its banks, causing a massive <target>flood</target> that destroyed many homes.","translation":"經過三天的暴雨，河流氾濫，造成了一場巨大的洪水，摧毀了許多房屋。"},{"sentence":"The government built a strong concrete wall along the coast to protect the local village from a sudden <target>flood</target>.","translation":"政府沿著海岸建造了一道堅固的混凝土牆，以保護當地村莊免於突如其來的洪水。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"deluge","pos":"noun","translation":"大洪水；暴雨","explanation":"指極大量的水量。"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"淹沒；大量湧入（物理上的淹沒或比喻義的數量極多）","entries":[{"pattern":"flood sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"淹沒…；使…充滿","explanation":"可用於描述水淹沒陸地，或比喻義地描述訊息、電話等大量湧入。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The sudden storm <target>flooded</target> the basement of the old school building, damaging many old books and student records.","translation":"突如其來的暴風雨淹沒了舊校舍的地下室，損毀了許多舊書和學生紀錄。"},{"sentence":"The company received a <target>flood</target> <pattern>of</pattern> complaints <pattern>from</pattern> customers who were unhappy with the new software update.","translation":"公司收到了來自不滿新軟體更新之客戶的大量投訴。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"inundate","pos":"verb","translation":"淹沒；使不堪負荷","explanation":"較正式的詞彙，指被大量事物淹沒。"},{"word":"overflow","pos":"verb","translation":"氾濫；溢出","explanation":"explanation: null"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"flooded","past_participle":"flooded"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"flour","explanation":"「flour」在學測中主要出現在生活化、文化類或烹飪相關的閱讀測驗中。學生應注意其發音與「flower (花)」相同，但拼法與語意完全不同，避免混淆。","senses":[{"sense":"麵粉","entries":[{"pattern":"flour","pos":"noun","translation":"麵粉","explanation":"指將穀物磨碎後的粉末，可用於烘焙或製作麵食。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The baker carefully mixed white <target>flour</target>, sugar and butter to make a smooth dough for the fresh bread.","translation":"麵包師傅小心地將白麵粉、糖和奶油混合，為新鮮的麵包製作光滑的麵糰。"},{"sentence":"In some traditional cultures, corn <target>flour</target> is used as the main ingredient for making daily tortillas and cakes.","translation":"在某些傳統文化中，玉米麵粉被用作製作日常玉米餅和蛋糕的主要成分。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"flute","explanation":"「flute」在藝術類或文化描述的閱讀中是基礎名詞。對於學生來說，理解其作為管樂器的特徵即可。","senses":[{"sense":"長笛","entries":[{"pattern":"flute","pos":"noun","translation":"長笛","explanation":"一種橫吹的木管樂器，常用於管弦樂團中。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The young girl practiced her <target>flute</target> for two hours every day because she wanted to join the school orchestra.","translation":"那個小女孩每天練習長笛兩個小時，因為她想加入學校的管弦樂團。"},{"sentence":"The sound of the silver <target>flute</target> was so clear and soft that it made everyone in the concert hall feel relaxed.","translation":"銀色長笛的聲音如此清脆且柔和，讓音樂廳裡的每個人都感到放鬆。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"foggy","explanation":"「foggy」常用於描述天氣或心智狀態。在學測中，除了描述物理上的濃霧外，也常在文學或心情描述中用來比喻「模糊不清」的情況。","senses":[{"sense":"有霧的；霧濛濛的","entries":[{"pattern":"foggy weather","pos":"adjective","translation":"有霧的天氣","explanation":"描述物理環境中充滿濃霧，視線受阻的情況。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Because of the <target>foggy</target> weather, the flight was delayed for three hours, and many passengers had to wait in the airport.","translation":"因為有霧的天氣，航班延誤了三個小時，許多乘客不得不留在機場等待。"},{"sentence":"The driver slowed down his car because the <target>foggy</target> morning made it very difficult to see the road clearly.","translation":"司機放慢了車速，因為霧濛濛的早晨讓看清道路變得非常困難。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"misty","pos":"adjective","translation":"有薄霧的","explanation":"通常指較輕的霧"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"clear","pos":"adjective","translation":"清晰的","explanation":null}]},{"sense":"模糊的；不清晰的（比喻心智或記憶）","entries":[{"pattern":"be foggy about sth.","pos":"adjective","translation":"對某事模糊不清","explanation":"用於描述記憶、想法或理解程度不清晰。","sentences":[{"sentence":"I was so tired after the long trip that my memory of the first day was <target>foggy</target> and not very clear.","translation":"長途旅行後我太累了，所以對於第一天的記憶模糊不清，並不十分清晰。"},{"sentence":"The teacher's explanation of the complex math problem was <target>foggy</target>, so the students could not understand the final answer.","translation":"老師對這個複雜數學問題的解釋很模糊，所以學生們無法理解最終答案。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"vague","pos":"adjective","translation":"模糊的","explanation":"指想法或表達方式不明確"},{"word":"unclear","pos":"adjective","translation":"不清晰的","explanation":null}],"antonyms":[{"word":"distinct","pos":"adjective","translation":"清晰的；明確的","explanation":null}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"名詞 fog (霧) + 形容詞字尾 -gy","related":[{"word":"fog","pos":"noun","translation":"霧","explanation":null}]}}

{"headword":"fond","explanation":"「fond」在學測中主要用於表達對人或事物的喜愛。最常考的搭配是 be fond of sth./sb.，其語氣比 like 更溫暖，常帶有感情色彩或對某種習慣的偏好。學生應注意其後方接續的介系詞 of 而非 for。","senses":[{"sense":"喜愛的； fond of (對...喜愛)","entries":[{"pattern":"be fond of sth./sb.","pos":"adjective","translation":"喜愛某事／某人","explanation":"最常見的固定搭配，指對某事有長久的喜好或對某人有深厚的情感。","sentences":[{"sentence":"My grandmother is very <target>fond</target> <pattern>of</pattern> baking fresh apple pies every Sunday morning for the whole family.","translation":"我的祖母非常喜歡在每個星期天早上為全家人烘焙新鮮的蘋果派。"},{"sentence":"Although the two boys often argue about small things, they are actually very <target>fond</target> <pattern>of</pattern> each other.","translation":"雖然這兩個男孩經常為小事爭執，但他們實際上非常喜歡彼此。"}]},{"pattern":"have a fond memory of sth.","pos":"adjective","translation":"對某事有美好的回憶","explanation":"在此作為形容詞修飾 memory，強調回憶的溫暖與愉悅感。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Even though he has lived in the city for many years, he still has <target>fond</target> memories <pattern>of</pattern> his childhood in the countryside.","translation":"儘管他在城市生活了多年，他仍然對童年時在鄉下的生活有著美好的回憶。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"keen","pos":"adjective","translation":"熱衷的","explanation":"強調對某事有強烈興趣或渴望"},{"word":"attached","pos":"adjective","translation":"依戀的","explanation":"強調情感上的連結與依賴"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"loathe","pos":"verb","translation":"厭惡","explanation":"極端不喜歡"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"源自古法語 fond (底端)，引申為情感的基礎。","related":[{"word":"fondness","pos":"noun","translation":"喜愛；偏好","explanation":"由形容詞 fond 加上名詞字尾 -ness 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"forever","explanation":"「forever」在學測中通常作為副詞使用，表示「永遠」或「不斷地」。在口語或非正式語境中，它可以用來誇張地描述某件事花費了極長的時間，或是某種狀態的永恆性。","senses":[{"sense":"永遠；永久地","entries":[{"pattern":"forever","pos":"adverb","translation":"永遠；永久地","explanation":"描述一種永恆的狀態，常用於承諾、自然定律或深刻的情感。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The ancient stone carvings on the temple walls will stay there <target>forever</target>, telling the story of a lost civilization.","translation":"寺廟牆上的古老石刻將永遠留在那裡，訴說著一個失落文明的故事。"},{"sentence":"Many people believe that true love will last <target>forever</target>, but psychologists say that relationships require constant effort to survive.","translation":"許多人相信真愛會永遠持續，但心理學家表示，人際關係需要不斷的努力才能生存。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"eternally","pos":"adverb","translation":"永恆地","explanation":"較為正式，強調時間上的絕對永恆"},{"word":"permanently","pos":"adverb","translation":"永久地","explanation":"強調狀態的固定，不再改變"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"temporarily","pos":"adverb","translation":"暫時地","explanation":"指在短時間內發生"}]},{"sense":"不斷地；總是（帶有抱怨語氣）","entries":[{"pattern":"be forever doing sth.","pos":"adverb","translation":"總是在做某事","explanation":"搭配現在進行式，用來表達對某種重複行為的不滿或抱怨。","sentences":[{"sentence":"My younger brother is <target>forever</target> <pattern>losing</pattern> his house keys, which makes my parents very angry every single time.","translation":"我的弟弟總是在弄丟他的家門鑰匙，這每次都讓我的父母非常生氣。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"constantly","pos":"adverb","translation":"不斷地","explanation":"指行為重複且頻率高"},{"word":"always","pos":"adverb","translation":"總是","explanation":"最基礎的同義詞"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"fortune","explanation":"「fortune」在學測中具有多重語意。第一種是「財富」，通常與金錢、資產相關；第二種是「運氣」，通常與 fate 或 luck 相關。學生在閱讀時必須根據上下文來判斷是金錢還是運勢。","senses":[{"sense":"財富；大筆金錢","entries":[{"pattern":"make a fortune","pos":"noun","translation":"發財；賺大錢","explanation":"最常見的動詞搭配，指透過工作、投資或生意成功而獲得大量金錢。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The young entrepreneur <target>made</target> a <pattern>fortune</pattern> by creating a mobile app that helps students organize their study schedules.","translation":"這位年輕的創業家透過開發一款幫助學生安排學習進度的手機應用程式而發了大財。"},{"sentence":"Buying a luxury sports car in this city costs a <target>fortune</target>, so most students prefer using public transportation.","translation":"在這座城市買一輛豪華跑車花費巨資，因此大多數學生偏好使用大眾運輸工具。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"wealth","pos":"noun","translation":"財富","explanation":"泛指大量的金錢與資產"},{"word":"riches","pos":"noun","translation":"財富","explanation":"較為文學地描述大量金錢"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"poverty","pos":"noun","translation":"貧困","explanation":"指缺乏基本生活所需之金錢"}]},{"sense":"運氣；命運","entries":[{"pattern":"fortune","pos":"noun","translation":"運氣；命運","explanation":"指一個人生命中不可控的偶然事件或未來走向。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The sailor's <target>fortune</target> changed suddenly when he discovered a hidden treasure map in an old wooden box.","translation":"當那名水手在一個舊木箱中發現一張隱藏的寶藏地圖時，他的運氣突然改變了。"},{"sentence":"It was a stroke of good <target>fortune</target> that the doctor arrived just in time to save the patient's life.","translation":"醫生剛好及時到達以救患者的生命，這真是極其幸運的事。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"luck","pos":"noun","translation":"運氣","explanation":"指偶然的成功或失敗"},{"word":"fate","pos":"noun","translation":"命運","explanation":"強調不可避免的必然結果"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"fortunate","pos":"adjective","translation":"幸運的","explanation":"由名詞 fortune 延伸而來的形容詞型態。"},{"word":"unfortunately","pos":"adverb","translation":"不幸地","explanation":"由形容詞 fortunate 加上否定前綴 un- 和副詞字尾 -ly 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"fountain","explanation":"「fountain」在學測中主要作為名詞，描述物理上的「噴泉」或「飲水機」。在文學或比喻語境中，也可指代「源頭」。","senses":[{"sense":"噴泉；飲水機","entries":[{"pattern":"fountain","pos":"noun","translation":"噴泉；飲水機","explanation":"指水從地面噴出或流出之裝置。常見於公園、廣場或學校。","sentences":[{"sentence":"In the center of the royal palace garden, there is a beautiful stone <target>fountain</target> with sculptures of dolphins.","translation":"在皇宮花園的中心，有一個帶有海豚雕刻的漂亮石製噴泉。"},{"sentence":"During the hot summer break, students often gather around the water <target>fountain</target> to refresh themselves after gym class.","translation":"在炎熱的暑假期間，學生們經常聚集在飲水機旁，在體育課後讓自己恢復精神。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"源頭；泉源","entries":[{"pattern":"fountain of sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"…的源頭；…的泉源","explanation":"比喻用法，指某物是產生某種情感、知識或能量的源頭。","sentences":[{"sentence":"For many young people, a great teacher is often a <target>fountain</target> <pattern>of</pattern> knowledge and wisdom for their future.","translation":"對於許多年輕人來說，一位偉大的老師通常是他們未來知識與智慧的泉源。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"source","pos":"noun","translation":"來源；源頭","explanation":"最普遍常用的同義詞"},{"word":"origin","pos":"noun","translation":"起點；起源","explanation":"強調事物發展的最初始點"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"frank","explanation":"「frank」在學測中作為形容詞，表示「坦率的」。它強調的是一種直接、不加掩飾的溝通方式。學生應注意它與 honest 的區別：honest 強調的是「不撒謊」，而 frank 強強調的是「直接地說出真相，即便該真相可能令人不快」。","senses":[{"sense":"坦率的；直率的","entries":[{"pattern":"be frank with sb.","pos":"adjective","translation":"對某人坦率","explanation":"指直接地說出自己的想法，不隱瞞任何部分。","sentences":[{"sentence":"To be <target>frank</target> <pattern>with</pattern> you, I think your current study plan is too difficult and you need to simplify it.","translation":"坦白跟你說，我認為你目前的學習計畫太困難了，你需要將其簡化。"},{"sentence":"The principal was <target>frank</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the students about the lack of funding for the new school library.","translation":"校長對學生們坦率地說明了學校新圖書館缺乏資金的情況。"}]},{"pattern":"a frank discussion","pos":"adjective","translation":"坦率的討論","explanation":"在此作為形容詞修飾名詞，描述一種沒有掩飾的溝通狀態。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After the long argument, the two leaders had a <target>frank</target> discussion to solve the conflict between their countries.","translation":"在漫長的爭論後，兩位領導人進行了一次坦率的討論，以解決兩國之間的衝突。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"candid","pos":"adjective","translation":"坦率的；直言的","explanation":"較為正式，指不加掩飾地說出真相"},{"word":"direct","pos":"adjective","translation":"直接的","explanation":"e.g. a direct answer"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"evasive","pos":"adjective","translation":"含糊的；逃避的","explanation":"指在回答問題時故意地不直接"},{"word":"dishonest","pos":"adjective","translation":"不誠實的","explanation":"translation"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"frankly","pos":"adverb","translation":"坦率地","explanation":"由形容詞 frank 加上副詞字尾 -ly 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"freeze","explanation":"「freeze」在學測中兼具物理上的「冷凍/結凍」與經濟上的「凍結/暫停」之意。動詞用法最常出現在自然科學類文章中，而名詞用法則多見於社會議題或政府政策（如薪資凍結）的討論。注意其不規則動詞變化 (freeze-froze-frozen)。","senses":[{"sense":"結凍；使結凍（溫度降低到冰點以下）","entries":[{"pattern":"freeze","pos":"verb","translation":"結凍；使結凍","explanation":"指水或其他液體因低溫而變成冰，或將東西放入冷凍庫使其結凍。","sentences":[{"sentence":"During the coldest winter days, the surface of the small pond <target>freezes</target> completely, turning the water into a solid sheet of ice.","translation":"在最寒冷的冬日裡，小池塘的表面會完全結凍，將水變成一片堅固的冰層。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"froze","past_participle":"frozen"},"relatives":{"morphology":"源自古英語，意為使寒冷","related":[{"word":"frozen","pos":"adjective","translation":"結凍的；冰凍的","explanation":"freeze 的過去分詞轉化為形容詞。"}]}}

{"headword":"freezer","explanation":"「freezer」是日常生活中極其常見的家用電器名詞，在學測中通常出現在生活化或食品保存類文章中。","senses":[{"sense":"冷凍庫；冷凍櫃","entries":[{"pattern":"freezer","pos":"noun","translation":"冷凍庫；冷凍櫃","explanation":"指專門用於長期保存食物的低溫儲藏設備。","sentences":[{"sentence":"To keep the seafood fresh for a longer time, my mother always puts the raw fish and shrimp in the <target>freezer</target> immediately.","translation":"為了讓海鮮保存更長時間，我母親總是立即將生魚和蝦放入冷凍庫中。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"動詞 freeze + 名詞字尾 -er (表示設備或執行者)","related":[{"word":"freeze","pos":"verb","translation":"結凍","explanation":"核心動詞型態。"}]}}

{"headword":"frequent","explanation":"「frequent」最常見的用法是作為形容詞表示「頻繁的」，但在高階寫作或克漏字中，它也可以作為動詞，表示「經常出沒於某處」。學生應注意這兩種截然不同的詞性用法。","senses":[{"sense":"頻繁的；經常的（發生率高）","entries":[{"pattern":"frequent + noun","pos":"adjective","translation":"頻繁的；經常的","explanation":"用來修飾名詞，指某事發生的次數很多。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Because the city suffers from <target>frequent</target> power outages during the summer, many companies have installed large backup generators.","translation":"因為這座城市在夏天遭受頻繁的停電，許多公司安裝了大型備用發電機。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"frequented","past_participle":"frequented"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 frequen (頻繁) + 形容詞字尾","related":[{"word":"frequency","pos":"noun","translation":"頻率","explanation":"表示發生的次數或頻率的名詞型態。"}]}}

{"headword":"fright","explanation":"「fright」是一個名詞，表示一種強烈的、突然的恐懼感。它常與動詞 give 或 put 造成搭配，用以描述心理狀態。","senses":[{"sense":"驚嚇；恐懼","entries":[{"pattern":"give sb. a fright","pos":"noun","translation":"使某人大吃一驚","explanation":"固定搭配，指突然地讓某人感到恐懼或驚訝。","sentences":[{"sentence":"My little brother gave me a terrible <target>fright</target> when he suddenly jumped out from behind the curtain and screamed loudly.","translation":"當我弟弟突然從窗簾後面跳出來大聲尖叫時，他給了我一個巨大的驚嚇。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"與 frighten 的名詞型態","related":[{"word":"frighten","pos":"verb","translation":"使驚恐","explanation":"將名詞 fright 轉化為動詞。"}]}}

{"headword":"frighten","explanation":"「frighten」是使役動詞，表示「使…驚恐」。在學測中，它常出現在故事類文章或描述心理反應的段落中，注意其形容詞形式 frightened (感到驚恐的) 與 frightening (令人驚恐的) 的區分。","senses":[{"sense":"使驚恐；嚇跑","entries":[{"pattern":"frighten sb.","pos":"verb","translation":"使某人恐懼","explanation":"及物動詞，指讓某人感到害怕。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The loud thunder and flashes of lightning <target>frightened</target> the young children, making them hide under their beds in fear.","translation":"巨大的雷聲和閃電讓年幼的孩子們感到驚恐，使他們躲在床下恐懼。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"frightened","past_participle":"frightened"},"relatives":{"morphology":"名詞 fright + 動詞字尾 -en (表示使…成某種狀態)","related":[{"word":"frightened","pos":"adjective","translation":"感到驚恐的","explanation":"形容詞，描述人的感受。"}]}}

{"headword":"fuel","explanation":"「fuel」在學測中兼具名詞與動詞用法。名詞時指燃料或驅動某事發展的能量；動詞時則常出現在比喻用法中，表示「激發」或「加劇」某種負面情緒或爭議，這是閱讀測驗中非常高頻的隱喻用法。","senses":[{"sense":"燃料；能源（物理上的 combustible material）","entries":[{"pattern":"fuel","pos":"noun","translation":"燃料","explanation":"指用於產生熱能或動力的物質，如汽油、煤炭或天然氣。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The heavy winter snow blocked the mountain roads, and the travelers had to save their remaining <target>fuel</target> to keep the campfire burning.","translation":"冬季的大雪封鎖了山路，旅人們必須節省剩下的燃料以維持營火燃燒。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"激發；加劇（比喻用法，使某事發展得更快或更強烈）","entries":[{"pattern":"fuel sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"激發某事；加劇某事","explanation":"常接負面名詞如 rumors, anger, controversy 或 fears，表示使這些情緒或爭論更加激烈。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The politician's refusal to answer the simple question only <target>fueled</target> <pattern>the</pattern> <pattern>rumors</pattern> that he was hiding a serious secret.","translation":"這位政治家拒絕回答這個簡單的問題，只會加劇他隱瞞著一個嚴重秘密的傳聞。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"動力；原動力（抽象意義上的能量來源）","entries":[{"pattern":"fuel for sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"…的動力；…的能源","explanation":"指提供某種行為或情感持續發展的基礎條件。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The young athlete's early failure served as <target>fuel</target> <pattern>for</pattern> his ambition to win the gold medal in the next Olympics.","translation":"這位年輕運動員早期的失敗，成為他下次奧運奪金野心的原動力。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"fueled","past_participle":"fueled"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 fuel (燃料)","related":[{"word":"fueling","pos":"noun","translation":"加油；供能","explanation":"指提供燃料的過程。"}]}}

{"headword":"fund","explanation":"「fund」作為名詞時指「資金」或「基金」；作為動詞時則指「提供資金」。在學測中，要注意其與 finance 的區別，fund 更強調資金的來源或撥款行為本身。","senses":[{"sense":"資金；基金（特定目的之款項）","entries":[{"pattern":"a fund for sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"用於…的資金","explanation":"指為了某個具體目標而儲存或籌集的一筆錢。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The school established a special <target>fund</target> <pattern>for</pattern> students from low-income families so that everyone could afford the textbooks.","translation":"學校成立了一個針對低收入家庭學生的特別基金，以便每個人都能買得起教科書。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"資助；撥款（提供金錢以支持計畫或活動）","entries":[{"pattern":"fund sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"資助某事；為…提供資金","explanation":"及物動詞，受詞通常是研究 project, scholarship 或 program 等。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The government decided to <target>fund</target> the new environmental project to protect the rare sea turtles living on the coast.","translation":"政府決定資助這個新的環境計畫，以保護生活在海岸上的稀有海龜。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"funded","past_participle":"funded"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 fund (底端、基礎、資金)","related":[{"word":"funding","pos":"noun","translation":"資金提供；款項","explanation":"指獲得資金的行為或金額本身。"}]}}

{"headword":"fur","explanation":"「fur」是基礎生物類名詞，常用於描述動物外觀或與寵物相關的文本中。","senses":[{"sense":"皮毛（動物身上的毛）","entries":[{"pattern":"fur","pos":"noun","translation":"皮毛","explanation":"指哺乳類動物覆蓋在皮膚上的厚毛。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The fluffy white <target>fur</target> of the polar bear helps it stay warm even in the freezing temperatures of the Arctic.","translation":"北極熊蓬鬆的白色皮毛幫助它即使在北極的極低溫中也能保持溫暖。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"gallon","explanation":"「gallon」是英美制體積單位，在閱讀測驗中常出現在描述液體量（如油、水、牛奶）的場景中。","senses":[{"sense":"加侖（體積單位）","entries":[{"pattern":"gallon","pos":"noun","translation":"加侖","explanation":"一種液體計量單位，1 加侖約等於 3.78 升（美制）。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The farmer bought ten <target>gallons</target> of fresh milk every morning to sell at the local farmers' market.","translation":"農夫每天早上買十加侖的新鮮牛奶，在當地的農夫市場上販售。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"gamble","explanation":"「gamble」在學測中除指實體的「賭博」外，更多時候出現在比喻用法中，表示「冒險嘗試」或「採取不確定的行動」，是文意選填中的關鍵字。","senses":[{"sense":"賭博；博弈（用金錢賭大小）","entries":[{"pattern":"gamble","pos":"noun","translation":"賭博","explanation":"指用錢做賭注的行為。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The man lost all his savings in a single night of <target>gambling</target> at the casino, leaving him with nothing.","translation":"那個男人在賭場的一次賭博之夜中失去了所有積蓄，讓他變得一無所有。"}]},{"pattern":"gamble on sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"拿…下注；賭在…上","explanation":"指將金錢或資源投入到不確定的結果中。","sentences":[{"sentence":"He decided to <target>gamble</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the horse race, hoping that the small amount of money would turn into a fortune.","translation":"他決定在馬賽上賭一把，希望這小筆錢能變成一筆財富。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"冒險；投機（採取有風險但可能獲益的行動）","entries":[{"pattern":"take a gamble","pos":"noun","translation":"冒險嘗試","explanation":"指採取一個不確定能否成功但有可能獲利或進步的決定。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Applying for the scholarship to a university in France was a huge <target>gamble</target>, but it finally paid off in the end.","translation":"申請法國大學的獎學金是一次巨大的冒險，但最終這在最後得到了回報。"}]},{"pattern":"gamble that...","pos":"verb","translation":"冒險賭定…","explanation":"指基於某種假設而採取行動，但結果並不確定。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The company <target>gambled</target> <pattern>that</pattern> the new product would be popular among teenagers, but it failed to sell well.","translation":"公司冒險賭定新產品會在青少年中受歡迎，但它並沒有賣得很好。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"gambled","past_participle":"gambled"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"gang","explanation":"「gang」在學測中具有強烈的語意對比。名詞時常用於描述「幫派」或「一群好友」，動詞時則較少見，主要出現在非正式語境中表示「聚集」。重點在於分辨其在不同社交情境下的褒貶義。","senses":[{"sense":"一群人（通常指有共同目的或關係的人，可褒可貶）","entries":[{"pattern":"a gang of sb.","pos":"noun","translation":"一群…人","explanation":"可用於描述一群不法之徒，也可以用來描述一群親密的好友。","sentences":[{"sentence":"A <target>gang</target> <pattern>of</pattern> noisy teenagers gathered in front of the cinema, talking loudly about the newest superhero movie.","translation":"一群吵鬧的青少年聚集在電影院前，大聲地討論著最新的超級英雄電影。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"gap","explanation":"「gap」在學測中不僅指物理上的「縫隙」，更常用於描述抽象的「差距」或「斷層」，例如文化差異 (cultural gap) 或世代差異 (generation gap)。這是閱讀測驗中分析社會現象的高頻詞彙。","senses":[{"sense":"物理上的縫隙；缺口","entries":[{"pattern":"gap","pos":"noun","translation":"縫隙；缺口","explanation":"指兩個物體之間的小空間或破損處。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The hiker carefully stepped over the wide <target>gap</target> in the rocky mountain path to avoid falling into the deep valley below.","translation":"登山客小心地跨過岩石山路上的寬闊縫隙，以避免掉入下方深邃的山谷中。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"garage","explanation":"「garage」在學測中通常作為基礎生活詞彙出現，指存放車輛的空間或維修地點。注意其在英美式英文中讀音略有差異，但語意一致。","senses":[{"sense":"車庫；修車廠","entries":[{"pattern":"garage","pos":"noun","translation":"車庫；修車廠","explanation":"指存放汽車的私人空間或提供維修服務的商業場所。","sentences":[{"sentence":"My father spent the entire weekend in the <target>garage</target>, fixing the old engine of his vintage car with a set of heavy tools.","translation":"我父親整個週末都待在車庫裡，用一套沉重的工具修復他那輛古董車的舊引擎。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"gasoline","explanation":"「gasoline」在美國英語中常縮寫為「gas」。在學測環境類文章中，常與 pollution, carbon emissions 或 alternative energy 等詞彙搭配，探討化石燃料的環境影響。","senses":[{"sense":"汽油","entries":[{"pattern":"gasoline","pos":"noun","translation":"汽油","explanation":"指用於內燃機的燃料。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Due to the sudden increase in <target>gasoline</target> prices, many people have started to use electric bicycles to travel to work every day.","translation":"由於汽油價格突然上漲，許多人開始每天騎電動自行車通勤。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"geography","explanation":"「geography」在學測中常作為學科名稱出現，涉及地貌、氣候與人口分布。理解這個字時，應將其與相關的形容詞 geography 聯繫起來，以擴展詞彙量。","senses":[{"sense":"地理學；地理環境","entries":[{"pattern":"geography","pos":"noun","translation":"地理學；地理環境","explanation":"指研究地球表面特徵、氣候與人類活動的學科或特定區域的地理特徵。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The teacher explained that the unique <target>geography</target> of the island, with its high mountains and deep seas, makes it perfect for diverse wildlife.","translation":"老師解釋說，這個島嶼獨特的地理環境（有高山與深海），使其成為多樣化野生動物的理想棲息地。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 geo- (地) + 字尾 -graphy (描述、繪製)","related":[{"word":"geographic","pos":"adjective","translation":"地理的","explanation":"由名詞 geography 延伸而來的形容詞型態。"},{"word":"geologist","pos":"noun","translation":"地質學家","explanation":"字根 geo- (地) + 字根 log (說/研究) + 字尾 -ist (人)。"}]}}

{"headword":"glance","explanation":"「glance」在閱讀測驗中常用來描述人物的心理狀態或環境氛圍。其核心意義為「快速地看一眼」，與 stare (盯著看) 或 gaze (凝視) 形成強烈對比，是理解文章情感基調的重要線索。","senses":[{"sense":"快速地看一眼（短暫且迅速的視覺接觸）","entries":[{"pattern":"glance at sth./sb.","pos":"verb","translation":"瞥一眼…","explanation":"最常見的用法，指迅速地看向某人或某物，通常是為了確認某事或在分心時快速地檢查。","sentences":[{"sentence":"During the exam, the nervous student <target>glanced</target> <pattern>at</pattern> the clock on the wall every few minutes to check the remaining time.","translation":"在考試期間，緊張的學生每隔幾分鐘就瞥一眼牆上的時鐘，以檢查剩餘的時間。"},{"sentence":"The teacher <target>glanced</target> <pattern>at</pattern> her notes before starting the speech, ensuring that she would not forget any important points.","translation":"老師在開始演講前瞥了一眼她的筆記，確保她不會忘記任何重點。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"瞥見；意外地看見","entries":[{"pattern":"catch a glance of sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"瞥見…","explanation":"強調在短時間內捕捉到一個畫面，通常是意外地或匆匆地看見。","sentences":[{"sentence":"As the train left the station, I <target>caught a glance</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the woman's face, but she disappeared into the crowd quickly.","translation":"當火車離開車站時，我瞥見了那個女人的臉，但她很快就消失在人群中。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"匆匆一瞥（名詞形式）","entries":[{"pattern":"a glance","pos":"noun","translation":"瞥一眼","explanation":"指一次短暫的視覺行為。","sentences":[{"sentence":"At a first <target>glance</target>, the new library looks simple and modern, but the interior design is actually very detailed.","translation":"乍看之下，這間新圖書館看起來簡單且現代，但內部設計實際上非常詳細。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"glanced","past_participle":"glanced"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"global","explanation":"「global」在學測中是跨學科的高頻詞，常用於討論全球化、氣候變遷、環境保護以及國際貿易等議題。其核心意義在於「全球性的」或「整體的」。","senses":[{"sense":"全球性的；全世界的（涵蓋整個地球）","entries":[{"pattern":"global warming","pos":"adjective","translation":"全球暖化","explanation":"極其高頻的固定搭配，指地球整體的溫度上升現象。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many scientists warn that <target>global</target> warming will lead to rising sea levels, which might eventually flood many coastal cities.","translation":"許多科學家警告說，全球暖化將導致海平面上升，這可能會最終淹沒許多沿海城市。"}]},{"pattern":"global economy","pos":"adjective","translation":"全球經濟","explanation":"指全世界範圍內的經濟活動與相互依賴關係。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The unexpected rise in oil prices has caused a major shock to the <target>global</target> economy, affecting millions of workers.","translation":"油價的意外上漲對全球經濟造成了重大衝擊，影響了數百萬名工人。"}]},{"pattern":"global scale","pos":"adjective","translation":"全球規模","explanation":"用於描述事件影響範圍之廣。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The pandemic spread on a <target>global</target> scale, forcing governments to implement strict travel bans to protect their citizens.","translation":"這次流行病在全球規模上蔓延，迫使政府實施嚴格的旅行禁令以保護其公民。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"整體的；全面的（涵蓋所有部分）","entries":[{"pattern":"a global view / perspective","pos":"adjective","translation":"整體的視角／觀點","explanation":"指不局限於局部，而從全面地看待問題的方式。","sentences":[{"sentence":"To solve the complex problem of poverty, we must take a <target>global</target> perspective and consider all the possible causes.","translation":"為了個解決貧困這個複雜的問題，我們必須採取一種整體的觀點，並考慮所有可能的起因。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 glob (球形) + 形容詞字尾 -al","related":[{"word":"globalization","pos":"noun","translation":"全球化","explanation":"指世界各國在經濟、文化與政治上趨向統一的過程。"},{"word":"globe","pos":"noun","translation":"地球；球體","explanation":"核心名詞型態。"}]}}

{"headword":"glory","explanation":"「glory」在文學性較強的閱讀文章中常出現，用以描述英雄事蹟、歷史成就或自然景觀的壯麗。它強調的是一種被公認的極高榮譽或燦爛的狀態。","senses":[{"sense":"榮耀；光輝（因成就而獲得的讚賞）","entries":[{"pattern":"bring glory to sth./sb.","pos":"noun","translation":"為…帶來榮耀","explanation":"常用於描述運動員、學生或外交官為國家或學校帶來榮譽。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The young tennis player worked hard for years to <target>bring glory to</target> her home country by winning the gold medal.","translation":"這位年輕的網球選手努力多年，以贏得金牌為她的家鄉帶來榮耀。"}]},{"pattern":"the glory of sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"…的榮光／壯麗","explanation":"指某事物的最高成就或最美、最燦爛的狀態。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The tourists were amazed by the <target>glory</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the sunrise over the mountain, which painted the sky in gold and red.","translation":"遊客們被山頂日出的壯麗所震撼，日出將天空染成了金色與紅色。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"glow","explanation":"「glow」在描述視覺場景或描述人物情緒（如幸福感）時非常高頻。它描述的是一種「柔和、持續且不刺眼的亮光」，與 flash (閃光) 或 glare (強光) 形成對比。","senses":[{"sense":"發光；發紅（物理上的柔和光芒）","entries":[{"pattern":"glow","pos":"verb","translation":"發光；發紅","explanation":"不及物動詞，指物體在黑暗中或受熱後發出柔和的光芒。","sentences":[{"sentence":"In the dark forest, the tiny mushrooms <target>glowed</target> with a soft green light, guiding the hikers back to their camp.","translation":"在黑暗的森林中，微小的蘑菇發出柔和的綠光，引導登山客回到營地。"}]},{"pattern":"glow with sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"因…而發光／發紅","explanation":"常用於描述臉部因為情緒或溫度而變得紅潤。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The young girl's cheeks <target>glowed</target> <pattern>with</pattern> excitement as she received the first-place trophy from the principal.","translation":"當小女孩收到校長頒發的第一名獎盃時，她的臉頰因興奮而發紅。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"柔和的光芒（名詞形式）","entries":[{"pattern":"a glow","pos":"noun","translation":"柔和的光芒","explanation":"指一種持續且溫暖的光線。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The cozy living room was filled with the warm <target>glow</target> of the fireplace, making everyone feel relaxed and safe.","translation":"舒適的客廳裡充滿了壁爐溫暖的柔和光芒，讓每個人都感到放鬆且安全。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"glowed","past_participle":"glowed"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"golf","explanation":"「golf」在學測中通常作為運動類主題的基礎名詞，但其動詞用法（打高爾夫球）在文意選填中偶爾出現。重點在於其作為運動名稱時不加冠詞，而作為動詞時的搭配詞如 course 或 club。","senses":[{"sense":"高爾夫球（運動或球類）","entries":[{"pattern":"play golf","pos":"noun","translation":"打高爾夫球","explanation":"最常見的搭配方式，將 golf 作為運動名稱。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After retiring from his high-pressure job in the city, the old man spent most of his weekends <pattern>playing</pattern> <target>golf</target> with his friends.","translation":"從城市的高壓工作中退休後，這位老人大部分的週末都花在和朋友一起打高爾夫球。"}]},{"pattern":"golf course","pos":"noun","translation":"高爾夫球場","explanation":"指比賽或練習高爾夫球的特定場域。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The local government decided to build a luxury <target>golf</target> <pattern>course</pattern> near the coast to attract wealthy tourists from other countries.","translation":"地方政府決定在海岸附近建造一座豪華的高爾夫球場，以吸引來自其他國家的富裕遊客。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"golfed","past_participle":"golfed"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"gossip","explanation":"「gossip」在學測中既是名詞也是動詞，核心語意為「閒聊」或「八卦」。注意其名詞用法時，它可以指代「八卦內容」或「愛八卦的人」，在閱讀測驗中常出現在社交情境或校園生活描述中。","senses":[{"sense":"八卦；閒聊（關於他人的私事）","entries":[{"pattern":"gossip about sb./sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"對某人/某事八卦","explanation":"及物動詞搭配介系詞 about，用來敘述傳播他人私密資訊的行為。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Instead of focusing on their school project, the students spent the entire lunch break <target>gossiping</target> <pattern>about</pattern> the new student's secret past.","translation":"學生們沒有專注於他們的學校專案，而是花整個午休時間在八卦新同學的秘密過去。"},{"sentence":"It is unfair to <target>gossip</target> <pattern>about</pattern> someone's personal failures when you do not know the full story behind their struggle.","translation":"當你不知道對方掙扎背後的完整故事時，對某人的個人失敗進行八卦是不公平的。"}]},{"pattern":"spread gossip","pos":"noun","translation":"散播八卦","explanation":"golf 作為不可數名詞，指代傳播的內容。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The angry actress decided to sue the tabloid magazine for <pattern>spreading</pattern> false <target>gossip</target> that could destroy her professional reputation.","translation":"這位憤怒的女演員決定起訴那家小報，因為其散播了可能會毀掉她專業聲譽的虛假八卦。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"rumor","pos":"noun","translation":"謠言","explanation":"指未經證實的訊息，語氣比 gossip 稍正式"},{"word":"chatter","pos":"verb","translation":"喋喋不休","explanation":"指輕鬆的、無意義的閒談"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"gossiped","past_participle":"gossiped"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}
