{"headword":"handy","explanation":"「handy」在學測中主要有兩種含義：一是指物品「方便的、觸手可及的」，二是指人「手巧的、擅長修理的」。","senses":[{"sense":"方便的；觸手可及的（空間上的便利）","entries":[{"pattern":"be handy","pos":"adjective","translation":"方便的；在手邊的","explanation":"指物品位於容易獲取的位置。","sentences":[{"sentence":"When you travel to a foreign country, it is very <target>handy</target> to keep a physical map and a power bank in your bag.","translation":"當你旅行到外國時，將實體地圖和行動電源放在包包裡是非常方便的。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"convenient","pos":"adjective","translation":"方便的","explanation":"指整體流程或時間上的便利。"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"inconvenient","pos":"adjective","translation":"不方便的","explanation":null}]},{"sense":"手巧的；擅長操作的（能力上的便利）","entries":[{"pattern":"be handy with sth.","pos":"adjective","translation":"擅長使用某物；手巧","explanation":"指一個人擅長使用工具或進行手工製作。","sentences":[{"sentence":"My father is very <target>handy</target> <pattern>with</pattern> tools, so he can fix almost every broken appliance in our house by himself.","translation":"我的父親非常擅長使用工具，，因此他能獨自修理好家中幾乎所有損壞的電器。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"skillful","pos":"adjective","translation":"熟練的；技巧高超的","explanation":null}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"名詞 hand (手) + 形容詞字尾 -y","related":[{"word":"handbook","pos":"noun","translation":"手冊","explanation":"指方便攜帶且提供指導的書籍。"}]}}

{"headword":"hanger","explanation":"「hanger」在學測中主要指服飾管理中的「衣架」，但在特定閱讀情境中也可能指「懸掛物」。重點在於區分其在生活情境中的具體指涉。","senses":[{"sense":"衣架；懸掛物","entries":[{"pattern":"hanger","pos":"noun","translation":"衣架","explanation":"指用來將衣服懸掛起來以免起皺的工具。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After returning from the rainy trip, the girl carefully put her wet coat on a wooden <target>hanger</target> to let it dry.","translation":"從雨中旅程回來後，女孩小心地將她濕透的外套掛在木製衣架上晾乾。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"動詞 hang (懸掛) + 名詞字尾 -er (物)","related":[{"word":"hang","pos":"verb","translation":"懸掛","explanation":"基礎動詞。"}]}}

{"headword":"harbor","explanation":"「harbor」在學測中具有物理空間（港口）與心理狀態（懷抱情感）兩種完全不同的語意。區分「實體場所」與「抽象情感」是解題的關鍵。","senses":[{"sense":"港口；避風港（物理上的安全水域）","entries":[{"pattern":"harbor","pos":"noun","translation":"港口","explanation":"指船隻停泊、避風的深水區域。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The massive cargo ships slowly entered the quiet <target>harbor</target>, carrying thousands of containers filled with electronics and clothes.","translation":"巨大的貨輪緩慢地進入寧靜的港口，運載著數千個裝滿電子產品和衣服的貨櫃。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"port","pos":"noun","translation":"港口","explanation":"泛指商業貿易的港口"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"懷抱（負面情感）；隱匿（罪犯等）","entries":[{"pattern":"harbor a feeling / grudge / suspicion","pos":"verb","translation":"懷抱（某種情感）；心懷（怨恨、懷疑）","explanation":"常用於描述長期持有負面的情緒，如怨恨 (grudge) 或懷疑 (suspicion)。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Despite the public apology from his former boss, the young employee continued to <target>harbor</target> a deep <pattern>grudge</pattern> against him.","translation":"儘管前老闆公開道歉，這名年輕員工心中依然懷抱著對他的深切怨恨。"},{"sentence":"The detective suspected that the suspect might <target>harbor</target> <pattern>secret</pattern> plans to steal the remaining money from the bank.","translation":"偵探懷疑嫌疑人可能心懷秘密計劃，打算從銀行偷走剩餘的錢。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"cherish","pos":"verb","translation":"珍視；懷抱","explanation":"通常用於正面的情感"},{"word":"entertain","pos":"verb","translation":"考慮；心懷","explanation":"指在腦海中考慮某種想法或可能性"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"harbored","past_participle":"harbored"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 harbor (避風港/保護)","related":[{"word":"harboring","pos":"noun","translation":"隱匿；庇護","explanation":"動詞形式轉化為名詞。"}]}}

{"headword":"harm","explanation":"「harm」可用作名詞與動詞。在學測中，常出現於環境保護、健康、法律討論等主題中，用以描述負面影響或損害。","senses":[{"sense":"傷害；損害（物理上或抽象上的損毀）","entries":[{"pattern":"harm sb./sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"傷害某人／損害某事","explanation":"及物動詞，直接接受詞，指造成損害。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many scientists warn that the use of chemical pesticides can seriously <target>harm</target> the bees and other useful insects in the fields.","translation":"許多科學家警告說，使用化學農藥會嚴重損害田裡的蜜蜂和其他有益昆蟲。"}]},{"pattern":"do harm to sb./sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"對某人／某事造成傷害","explanation":"名詞用法，常與動詞 do 搭配，形成固定片語。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Although some people think that drinking coffee is bad, in small amounts it will <pattern>do</pattern> little <target>harm</target> <pattern>to</pattern> your health.","translation":"雖然有些人認為喝咖啡子是不好的，但少量飲用對你的健康幾乎沒有傷害。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"damage","pos":"verb","translation":"損害；破壞","explanation":"強調物理上的損毀或功能喪失"},{"word":"injure","pos":"verb","translation":"傷害；使受傷","explanation":"通常指身體上的受傷"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"benefit","pos":"verb","translation":"獲益；有益於","explanation":null}]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"harmed","past_participle":"harmed"},"relatives":{"morphology":"單一字根 harm (傷害)","related":[{"word":"harmless","pos":"adjective","translation":"無害的","explanation":"字根 harm + 字尾 -less (沒有)"},{"word":"harmful","pos":"adjective","translation":"有害的","explanation":"字根 harm + 字尾 -ful (充滿)"}]}}

{"headword":"harmful","explanation":"「harmful」是基礎形容詞，核心在於其對立面（harmless）。在學測中，常與環境、健康、醫療相關的描述出現。","senses":[{"sense":"有害的；不利的","entries":[{"pattern":"be harmful to sb./sth.","pos":"adjective","translation":"對某人／某事有害","explanation":"常用於描述化學物質、習慣或行為對生物或環境的負面影響。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The government released a report stating that smoking is extremely <target>harmful</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the lungs and the overall health of teenagers.","translation":"政府發布了一份報告指出，吸菸對青少年的肺部和整體健康極其有害。"},{"sentence":"Excessive noise from the nearby construction site has been <target>harmful</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the local birds' nesting habits.","translation":"來自附近建築工地的過度噪音對當地鳥類築巢的習性造成了不利影響。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"damaging","pos":"adjective","translation":"損害的；有害的","explanation":null},{"word":"detrimental","pos":"adjective","translation":"有害的；不利的","explanation":"較高階的同義詞，常出現在學測閱讀中"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"beneficial","pos":"adjective","translation":"有益的","explanation":null},{"word":"harmless","pos":"adjective","translation":"無害的","explanation":null}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 harm (傷害) + 形容詞字尾 -ful (充滿)","related":[{"word":"harm","pos":"noun","translation":"傷害","explanation":"基礎名詞形式。"},{"word":"harmfully","pos":"adverb","translation":"有害地","explanation":"由形容詞 harmful 加上副詞字尾 -ly 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"harvest","explanation":"「harvest」在學測中既是名詞也是動詞。其語義從具體的「農作物收穫」延伸到抽象的「收集數據/資訊」的科技語境中。","senses":[{"sense":"收穫；收成（農作物或資源）","entries":[{"pattern":"harvest","pos":"noun","translation":"收穫；收成","explanation":"指農作物的產量或收割期。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After months of hard work in the sun, the farmers were very happy because this year's <target>harvest</target> was larger than ever.","translation":"經過數月在陽光下的辛勤工作，農民們非常高興，因為今年的收成比以往任何時候都大。"}]},{"pattern":"harvest sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"收割；收穫某物","explanation":"及物動詞，指將成熟的成熟作物從土地上採摘或切割下來。","sentences":[{"sentence":"In many traditional villages, families gather together in October to <target>harvest</target> the golden rice fields before the winter.","translation":"在許多傳統村莊裡，家人們在十月聚集在一起，在冬天來臨之前收割金黃色的稻田。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"crop","pos":"noun","translation":"農作物","explanation":"指收割後的產量"},{"word":"gather","pos":"verb","translation":"採集；收集","explanation":"泛指收集物體"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"收集（數據、資訊或生物資源）","entries":[{"pattern":"harvest data / information","pos":"verb","translation":"收集數據／資訊","explanation":"科技語境中的延伸義，指利用程序自動地收集大量數據。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Some companies use special software to <target>harvest</target> personal <pattern>data</pattern> from social media platforms to show you targeted ads.","translation":"一些公司使用特別的軟體來從社交媒體平台收集個人數據，以便向你展示定向廣告。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"collect","pos":"verb","translation":"收集","explanation":null},{"word":"extract","pos":"verb","translation":"提取；抽出","explanation":"強調從中提取出有用的部分"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"harvested","past_participle":"harvested"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 harvest (收割)","related":[{"word":"harvester","pos":"noun","translation":"收割機；收割者","explanation":"由動詞 harvest 加上名詞字尾 -er (物/人) 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"hasty","explanation":"「hasty」在學測中常用於描述決定、結論或行動過於倉促，導致出錯。理解此字時，應將其與「快速 (fast/quick)」區分，hasty 帶有「不夠深思熟慮」的負面含義。","senses":[{"sense":"倉促的；草率的（缺乏思考或計畫）","entries":[{"pattern":"hasty decision / conclusion","pos":"adjective","translation":"倉促的決定／結論","explanation":"指在沒有足夠證據或思考時間的情況下迅速做出的判斷。這是大考最常見的搭配方式。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Do not make a <target>hasty</target> <pattern>decision</pattern> about your future college major before you have spoken to a professional counselor.","translation":"在你與專業諮詢師交談之前，不要對你未來的大學主修做出倉促的決定。"},{"sentence":"After seeing only one negative review, the manager made a <target>hasty</target> <pattern>conclusion</pattern> that the new product was a complete failure.","translation":"在僅看到一篇負面評論後，經理匆忙得出結論，認為新產品完全失敗了。"}]},{"pattern":"hasty action","pos":"adjective","translation":"草率的行動","explanation":"指因為衝動而快速採取行動，通常導致後悔。","sentences":[{"sentence":"In a moment of anger, he took <target>hasty</target> <pattern>action</pattern> by shouting at his teacher, which he deeply regretted the next morning.","translation":"在憤怒的一瞬間，他採取了草率的行動對老師大吼大叫，而他在隔天早晨對此深感後悔。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"rash","pos":"adjective","translation":"魯莽的","explanation":"比 hasty 更強調衝動且不顧後果"},{"word":"impulsive","pos":"adjective","translation":"衝動的","explanation":"指不經思考就直接採取行動"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"deliberate","pos":"adjective","translation":"深思熟慮的","explanation":null},{"word":"careful","pos":"adjective","translation":"小心謹慎的","explanation":null}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"形容詞 hasty 由名詞 haste (匆忙) 演變而來","related":[{"word":"haste","pos":"noun","translation":"匆忙；急促","explanation":"常用於片語 make haste (趕快)"}]}}

{"headword":"hatch","explanation":"「hatch」在學測中具有物理意義（孵化、艙口）與比喻意義（策劃）。名詞與動詞的用法區分非常重要，尤其是生物類閱讀中經常出現的「孵化」與驚悚/犯罪類故事中的「策劃」。","senses":[{"sense":"孵化（動物從蛋中破殼而出）","entries":[{"pattern":"hatch from eggs","pos":"verb","translation":"從蛋中孵化","explanation":"生物學基礎動詞，指幼體破殼而出的過程。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The biology students waited patiently for weeks until the baby turtles finally <target>hatched</target> <pattern>from</pattern> their <pattern>eggs</pattern> on the sandy beach.","translation":"生物課學生耐心地等待了數週，直到小海龜終於在沙灘上的蛋中孵化而出。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"策劃；密謀（秘密地計畫某事）","entries":[{"pattern":"hatch a plan / plot","pos":"verb","translation":"策劃計畫／密謀","explanation":"將「孵化」比喻為在心中秘密醞釀一個計畫，直到它準備好執行。常用於描述陰謀或惡作劇。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The three mischievous boys spent the whole afternoon in the library <target>hatching</target> a <pattern>plan</pattern> to play a prank on their strict teacher.","translation":"這三個調皮的男孩在圖書館花了一整個下午，策劃一個捉弄他們嚴格老師的計畫。"}]},{"pattern":"hatch a conspiracy","pos":"verb","translation":"密謀陰謀","explanation":"用於更正式或更嚴肅的犯罪情境。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The spies <target>hatched</target> a <pattern>conspiracy</pattern> to steal the secret government documents from the high-security vault.","translation":"間諜們密謀了一場陰謀，企圖從高安全性金庫中偷走政府的機密文件。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"plot","pos":"verb","translation":"策劃；密謀","explanation":"與 hatch 語意幾乎相同，強調秘密進行"},{"word":"scheme","pos":"verb","translation":"策劃；設計","explanation":"常帶有負面含義，指不誠實的計畫"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"艙口；蓋子（船、飛機或地下室的開口）","entries":[{"pattern":"hatch","pos":"noun","translation":"艙口；蓋子","explanation":"指在船隻、飛機或地板上設置的門或開口。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The captain ordered the crew to close the <target>hatch</target> tightly before the storm hit the ship, to prevent seawater from entering.","translation":"船長命令船員在風暴襲擊船隻前將艙口緊緊關上，以防止海水進入。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"hatched","past_participle":"hatched"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"hateful","explanation":"「hateful」是用於表達強烈厭惡或仇恨的形容詞。在閱讀測驗中，它常出現在描述人物衝突、社會議題（如仇恨言論）或極端負面情感的文本中。","senses":[{"sense":"可憎的；令人厭惡的（引起強烈仇恨或不滿）","entries":[{"pattern":"hateful remark / comment","pos":"adjective","translation":"可憎的言論／評論","explanation":"指充滿仇恨、攻擊性的語言，常用於探討社會歧視或網路霸凌議題。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The school board decided to punish the student who posted <target>hateful</target> <pattern>remarks</pattern> about his classmates on a public social media page.","translation":"學校董事會決定處罰一名在公開社交媒體頁面上發表關於同學的可憎言論的學生。"}]},{"pattern":"hateful behavior","pos":"adjective","translation":"可憎的行為","explanation":"描述一個人採取了讓他人感到極端不快或被憎恨的行動。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Her <target>hateful</target> <pattern>behavior</pattern> toward the new immigrants made her very unpopular among the local residents in the small town.","translation":"她對新移民那種可憎的行為使她在小鎮的當地居民中非常不受歡迎。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"loathsome","pos":"adjective","translation":"令人厭惡的","explanation":"極度厭惡，程度比 hateful 更深"},{"word":"detestable","pos":"adjective","translation":"可憎的","explanation":"指完全不值得被愛或尊重"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"lovely","pos":"adjective","translation":"可愛的；可喜的","explanation":null},{"word":"adorable","pos":"adjective","translation":"可愛的","explanation":null}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 hate (恨) + 形容詞字尾 -ful (充滿…的)","related":[{"word":"hate","pos":"verb","translation":"恨","explanation":"核心動詞型態。"},{"word":"hatred","pos":"noun","translation":"仇恨","explanation":"由動詞 hate 加上名詞字尾 -red 演變而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"hay","explanation":"「hay」在自然、農村或動物描述類閱讀中是基礎名詞。理解其與 grass (草) 的區別：hay 是指經過乾燥處理後的乾草，用於動物飼料。","senses":[{"sense":"乾草（經過乾燥處理後用於飼料的草）","entries":[{"pattern":"hay","pos":"noun","translation":"乾草","explanation":"常用於描述農場場景或動物（如馬、牛、兔子）的飲食。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The farmer spent the whole week cutting and drying the grass to make <target>hay</target> for his horses during the cold winter.","translation":"農夫花了一整週切割並將草晾乾，以便在寒冷的冬天為他的馬匹準備乾草。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"headline","explanation":"「headline」在媒體、新聞類閱讀測驗中是核心名詞。動詞用法較少見但有出現，意為「作為頭條地報導」。注意其在句中常與 a headline-grabbing (吸引目光的) 形容詞形式出現。","senses":[{"sense":"頭條新聞（報紙或網頁上的大標題）","entries":[{"pattern":"headline","pos":"noun","translation":"頭條新聞；標題","explanation":"指新聞報導中最醒目的位置，用以吸引讀者關注。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The shocking <target>headline</target> on the front page of the newspaper caught my eye immediately, making me read the entire story.","translation":"報紙第一頁上那則令人震驚的頭條新聞立即吸引了我的注意，使我讀完了整個故事。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"title","pos":"noun","translation":"標題","explanation":"泛指所有文章的標題"},{"word":"caption","pos":"noun","translation":"圖說；標題","explanation":"強調指照片或圖表下方的說明文字"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"作為頭條報導（將某事放在標題位置）","entries":[{"pattern":"headline sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"將…作為頭條報導","explanation":"指媒體將某個特定事件放在最醒目位置進行報導。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Local newspapers <target>headlined</target> <pattern>the</pattern> <pattern>victory</pattern> of the young athlete, celebrating his gold medal in the world championships.","translation":"當地報紙將這位年輕運動員的勝利作為頭條報導，慶祝他在世界錦標賽中獲得金牌。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"headlined","past_participle":"headlined"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 head (頭) + line (線/行)","related":[{"word":"headliner","pos":"noun","translation":"主唱；領銜主演者","explanation":"指在演出或音樂會中佔據最重要位置的人。"}]}}

{"headword":"headquarters","explanation":"「headquarters」在學測中通常作為組織的中心點，注意其形式上永遠帶有 s，但可以用於單數或複數動詞，且不具有單數形式的 headquarter。","senses":[{"sense":"總部；指揮中心（組織的核心管理地點）","entries":[{"pattern":"company/corporate headquarters","pos":"noun","translation":"公司總部","explanation":"指大型企業的主要管理辦公室所在地。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The global tech giant decided to move its corporate <target>headquarters</target> to Taiwan to better serve its customers in Asia.","translation":"這家全球科技巨頭決定將其公司總部遷至台灣，以便更好地服務其亞洲客戶。"}]},{"pattern":"at the headquarters of sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"在…的總部","explanation":"使用介系詞 at 來標記地點，常用於描述組織的行政運作。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The CEO is currently staying <pattern>at</pattern> the <target>headquarters</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the international bank to discuss the new investment plan.","translation":"執行長目前住在這家國際銀行的總部，以討論新的投資計畫。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"main office","pos":"noun","translation":"總辦公室","explanation":"較口語且通用的表達方式。"},{"word":"center","pos":"noun","translation":"中心","explanation":"泛指活動或管理的核心地帶。"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"head (頭/主) + quarters (住處/區域)","related":[{"word":"quarter","pos":"noun","translation":"四分之一；區域","explanation":"在此處指特定的居住或工作區域。"}]}}

{"headword":"heal","explanation":"「heal」主要用於描述身體傷口、心理創傷或關係的修復。在學測中，要注意它與 cure (治癒疾病) 的區別：heal 強調「癒合」或「恢復原狀」的過程。","senses":[{"sense":"癒合；康復（身體組織的恢復或心理創傷的平復）","entries":[{"pattern":"heal from sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"從…中康復","explanation":"常用於描述從重大受傷、疾病或心碎中慢慢恢復的過程。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After the terrible accident, the young boy spent several months in the hospital to <target>heal</target> <pattern>from</pattern> his broken leg.","translation":"在那場可怕的事故後，小男孩在醫院住了幾個月，以使他的斷腿康復。"}]},{"pattern":"heal a wound/heart","pos":"verb","translation":"癒合傷口／修復心靈","explanation":"及物動詞，直接接受詞，指身體上的切口或心靈上的悲傷。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The nurse applied a special cream to the cut on the patient's arm to help the skin <target>heal</target> more quickly.","translation":"護理師在患者手臂上的傷口塗抹了一種特殊的藥膏，以幫助皮膚更快癒合。"},{"sentence":"Time is often said to be the best medicine that can <target>heal</target> a broken <pattern>heart</pattern> after a painful breakup.","translation":"人們常說時間是最好的良藥，能在痛苦的分手後修復破碎的心。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"cure","pos":"verb","translation":"治癒","explanation":"強調完全消除疾病，使之恢復健康。"},{"word":"recover","pos":"verb","translation":"恢復","explanation":"強調從病痛或受傷中回到原先狀態。"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"damage","pos":"verb","translation":"損害","explanation":null},{"word":"injure","pos":"verb","translation":"傷害","explanation":null}]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"healed","past_participle":"healed"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"health","pos":"noun","translation":"健康","explanation":"相關的根源詞彙。"},{"word":"healthy","pos":"adjective","translation":"健康的","explanation":"由 health 加上形容詞字尾 -thy 衍生。"}]}}

{"headword":"heap","explanation":"「heap」在學測中常出現於描述物體雜亂堆積的場景，名詞用法較多，動詞用法則是指將東西「堆在一起」。","senses":[{"sense":"一堆（雜亂堆積的物體）","entries":[{"pattern":"a heap of sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"一堆…","explanation":"常用於描述大量但雜亂的物品，如衣服、垃圾或書本。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The messy student left a huge <target>heap</target> <pattern>of</pattern> dirty clothes on the floor of his bedroom for over a week.","translation":"那個邋遢的學生在臥室地板上留下了一大堆髒衣服，而且放了一週多。"},{"sentence":"After the storm, the city workers had to clear a massive <target>heap</target> <pattern>of</pattern> fallen tree branches from the main road.","translation":"風暴過後，城市工人必須將主幹道上巨大的落枝堆清理乾淨。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"pile","pos":"noun","translation":"一堆","explanation":"pile 通常指較為整齊的堆疊，而 heap 較雜亂。"},{"word":"stack","pos":"noun","translation":"一疊","explanation":"通常指平整的物體（如書本、盤子）的整齊疊放。"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"堆積；堆起（將物體放置在一個堆中）","entries":[{"pattern":"heap sth. up","pos":"verb","translation":"將…堆積起來","explanation":"搭配副詞 up 以強調堆積的高度或完整性。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The children decided to <target>heap</target> the fallen leaves <pattern>up</pattern> in the corner of the garden to make a small pile.","translation":"孩子們決定將落葉在花園角落堆積起來，好做成一個小堆。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"pile","pos":"verb","translation":"堆積","explanation":null},{"word":"accumulate","pos":"verb","translation":"累積","explanation":"指較為抽象的經驗或財富的累積。"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"heaped","past_participle":"heaped"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"heater","explanation":"「heater」在生活化場景的閱讀中是基礎名詞，指發熱設備。注意其詞根為 heat (熱)，加上名詞字尾 -er 表示「做此動作的機器」。","senses":[{"sense":"加熱器；暖氣設備","entries":[{"pattern":"electric heater / space heater","pos":"noun","translation":"電暖器／空間加熱器","explanation":"常見的加熱設備類別。","sentences":[{"sentence":"During the freezing winter months, many students rely on a small <target>heater</target> under their desks to keep their feet warm.","translation":"在寒冷的冬季月份中，許多學生依賴桌下的一個小加熱器來保持腳部溫暖。"}]},{"pattern":"turn on/off the heater","pos":"noun","translation":"開啟／關閉暖氣","explanation":"描述日常生活中操作設備的常見搭配。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Because the electricity bill was too high, the father told his daughter to <pattern>turn off</pattern> the <target>heater</target> before leaving the room.","translation":"因為電費太高，父親告訴女兒在離開房間前要關掉暖氣。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"heat (熱) + -er (機器/人)","related":[{"word":"heat","pos":"noun","translation":"熱；熱度","explanation":"核心名詞。"},{"word":"heat","pos":"verb","translation":"加熱","explanation":"核心動詞。"}]}}

{"headword":"heel","explanation":"「heel」在學測中主要作為名詞（腳後跟），但在某些情境中可作為動詞（如跟隨或恢復健康），動詞用法較少見但仍需掌握其核心意涵。","senses":[{"sense":"腳後跟（足部後方的硬組織）","entries":[{"pattern":"the heel of sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"…的腳後跟","explanation":"描述身體構造或鞋子後部。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The young girl wore high <target>heels</target> to the party, but her feet started to hurt after only two hours.","translation":"那個小女孩穿著高跟鞋參加派對，但僅僅兩個小時後她的腳就開始疼痛。"},{"sentence":"While walking on the hot sand, the boy felt a sharp pain in his <target>heel</target> as he stepped on a small stone.","translation":"在熱沙上行走時，男孩在踩到一顆小石頭時感到腳後跟有一陣劇痛。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"跟隨；聽話（通常指動物，如狗）","entries":[{"pattern":"heel (command)","pos":"verb","translation":"跟隨在側；聽話","explanation":"常用於訓練狗的口令，指讓動物跟在主人的腳後跟處。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The professional dog trainer taught the golden retriever to <target>heel</target> perfectly while walking through a crowded city street.","translation":"專業的狗訓練師教那隻黃金獵犬在走過擁擠的城市街道時完美地跟隨在側。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"follow","pos":"verb","translation":"跟隨","explanation":null}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"heeled","past_participle":"heeled"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"hell","explanation":"「hell」在學測中除了指宗教意義上的「地獄」，更常以比喻方式出現在口語或非正式描述中，用來形容極其痛苦、混亂或難熬的環境與處境，是閱讀測驗中捕捉情感色彩的關鍵字。","senses":[{"sense":"地獄（宗教或神話中死後靈魂受苦之處）","entries":[{"pattern":"hell","pos":"noun","translation":"地獄","explanation":"指死後惡人受懲罰的精神或物理空間。","sentences":[{"sentence":"In many ancient stories, the god of the underworld rules over <target>hell</target>, where souls are punished for their crimes on earth.","translation":"在許多古代故事中，冥界之神統治著地獄，靈魂在那裡因他們在人間的罪行而受懲罰。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[{"word":"heaven","pos":"noun","translation":"天堂","explanation":"靈魂死後進入的幸福之地"}]},{"sense":"極其痛苦、混亂的處境（比喻用法）","entries":[{"pattern":"a hell of a sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"極其…的（某事/某物）","explanation":"非正式用法，用來加強語氣，可表示極好或極壞，視上下文而定。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The summer heat was a <target>hell</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a ride for the cyclists, as they had to pedal through the burning sand.","translation":"夏季的酷暑對那些單車騎士來說是一場極其痛苦的旅程，因為他們必須在灼熱的沙地中踩踏。"}]},{"pattern":"make hell of sb. / make sb.'s life hell","pos":"noun","translation":"讓某人的生活變得像地獄一樣（讓某人極其痛苦）","explanation":"指透過欺凌或給予極大壓力，使他人處於極度不快之中。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The cruel supervisor decided to <pattern>make</pattern> the new intern's life <target>hell</target> by giving him impossible tasks and shouting at him every day.","translation":"那位殘忍的主管決定讓這名新實習生的生活變得像地獄一樣，每天給他不可能完成的任務並對他大吼大叫。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"nightmare","pos":"noun","translation":"噩夢","explanation":"比喻極其可怕或混亂的經歷"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"helmet","explanation":"「helmet」是基礎的生活與安全類名詞，常出現在描述運動、工業安全或交通規則的閱讀測驗中，重點在於其作為保護裝置的搭配用法。","senses":[{"sense":"安全帽；頭盔","entries":[{"pattern":"wear a helmet","pos":"noun","translation":"戴安全帽","explanation":"使用 wear 來表示狀態，指在頭上佩戴保護頭盔。","sentences":[{"sentence":"To prevent serious head injuries during a crash, every motorcycle rider is required by law to <pattern>wear</pattern> a <target>helmet</target>.","translation":"為了防止在碰撞中發生嚴重的頭部受傷，法律要求每位摩托車騎士都必須戴安全帽。"},{"sentence":"The construction workers <pattern>wear</pattern> yellow <target>helmets</target> to protect themselves from falling bricks and other heavy objects on the building site.","translation":"建築工人戴著黃色安全帽，以保護他們免於被建築工地上的掉落磚塊或其他沉重物體砸傷。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"hesitate","explanation":"「hesitate」在學測中常用於描述心理狀態，重點在於其後方接續的不定詞 (to V) 結構，以及在否定句中（如 Do not hesitate to...）用來表達禮貌的邀請或建議。","senses":[{"sense":"猶豫；遲疑","entries":[{"pattern":"hesitate to do sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"猶豫是否要做某事","explanation":"後接不定詞，表示對採取行動的不確定感或不安感。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Although the water looked cold, the brave swimmer did not <target>hesitate</target> <pattern>to</pattern> jump into the pool and save the drowning child.","translation":"雖然水看起來很冷，但那位勇敢的游泳者毫不猶豫地跳入泳池救起溺水的孩子。"},{"sentence":"Many shy students <target>hesitate</target> <pattern>to</pattern> raise their hands in class because they are afraid of making mistakes in front of others.","translation":"許多害羞的學生在課堂上猶豫是否要舉手，因為他們害怕在他人面前犯錯。"}]},{"pattern":"hesitate over sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"對某事猶豫不決","explanation":"使用介系詞 over，強調對特定選擇或細節猶豫不決。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The young artist <target>hesitated</target> <pattern>over</pattern> which color to use for the background of his painting, spending an hour just choosing the paint.","translation":"這位年輕藝術家對於要使用哪種顏色作為畫作背景而猶豫不決，花了一個小時僅僅在選擇顏料。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"pause","pos":"verb","translation":"暫停；遲疑","explanation":"指在行動或說話前短暫地停止"},{"word":"waver","pos":"verb","translation":"動搖；猶豫","explanation":"強調在兩個選項之間來回擺盪"}],"antonyms":[{"word":" ","pos":"verb","translation":"果斷","explanation":null}]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"hesitated","past_participle":"hesitated"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"hesitation","pos":"noun","translation":"猶豫；遲疑","explanation":"由動詞 hesitate 加上名詞字尾 -tion 延伸而來。"},{"word":"hesitant","pos":"adjective","translation":"猶豫的；遲疑的","explanation":"由動詞 hesitate 加上形容詞字尾 -ant 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"hint","explanation":"「hint」在學測中具有名詞與動詞雙重身份。作為名詞時，指「暗示」或「微小量」，作為動詞時，指「暗示」。學生應注意其搭配的介系詞（如 give a hint, drop a hint），是文意選填的重要考點。","senses":[{"sense":"暗示；提示（間接地表達想法或資訊）","entries":[{"pattern":"give / drop a hint","pos":"noun","translation":"給予暗示／丟出暗示","explanation":"指間接地讓對方察覺某事，而非直接地說出。","sentences":[{"sentence":"I wanted to buy my girlfriend a surprise gift, but my sister <pattern>dropped</pattern> a <target>hint</target> that I should buy some flowers.","translation":"我想給女朋友買一份驚喜禮物，但我姊姊丟出一個暗示，說我應該買一些花。"},{"sentence":"The teacher <pattern>gave</pattern> a small <target>hint</target> to the struggling student, helping him find the correct answer to the difficult math problem.","translation":"老師給了那位苦苦掙扎的學生一個小提示，幫助他找到那道困難數學題的正確答案。"}]},{"pattern":"hint at sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"暗示某事","explanation":"動詞用法，後接介系詞 at，指間接地表示某事可能發生或存在。","sentences":[{"sentence":"During the interview, the manager <target>hinted</target> <pattern>at</pattern> a possible promotion for the employee who could finish the project on time.","translation":"在面試期間，MANAGER 或是管理員暗示了對於能按時完成專案的員工可能會有升職機會。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"clue","pos":"noun","translation":"線索；提示","explanation":"指能幫助解題或發現真相的資訊"},{"word":"suggest","pos":"verb","translation":"建議；暗示","explanation":"指間接地表達某種想法"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"微量；一點點（通常指氣味、顏色或感覺）","entries":[{"pattern":"a hint of sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"一點點…","explanation":"指極小量的某種物質或感覺，常用於描述氣味、味道或顏色。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The fresh morning air had a <target>hint</target> <pattern>of</pattern> salt from the ocean, making the feel of the beach very refreshing.","translation":"清晨的清新空氣中帶著一點點海鹽的味道，讓海邊的感覺非常清新。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"trace","pos":"noun","translation":"微量；痕跡","explanation":"null"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"hinted","past_participle":"hinted"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"hire","explanation":"「hire」在學測中主要出現在就業、職場或租賃物品的物品租賃情境中。學生應區分其作為動詞（雇用雇用）與名詞（新雇員）的用法，並注意其在英美式英語中「租賃」的租賃義項的差異。","senses":[{"sense":"雇用；聘請（支付金錢以獲取勞動力）","entries":[{"pattern":"hire sb. (to do sth.)","pos":"verb","translation":"雇用某人（去做某事）","explanation":"指支付薪水以獲取某人的專業技能或服務。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The expanding company decided to <target>hire</target> three new programmers <pattern>to</pattern> help build their new mobile app for the global market.","translation":"這家擴張中的公司決定聘請三名新程式設計師，以幫助他們為全球市場建立新的行動應用程式。"},{"sentence":"Because she spoke four languages fluently, the hotel <target>hired</target> her as a front desk clerk to welcome tourists from all over the world.","translation":"因為她能流利地說四種語言，這家飯店聘請她擔任櫃檯接待員，以歡迎來自世界各地的人們。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"employ","pos":"verb","translation":"雇用；使用","explanation":"較為正式的用詞，指長期雇用"},{"word":"recruit","pos":"verb","translation":"招募","explanation":"強調從中挑選出合適的人才"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"fire","pos":"verb","translation":"開除；解雇","explanation":"null"},{"word":"dismiss","pos":"verb","translation":"解雇","explanation":" "}]},{"sense":"租用（支付金錢以暫時使用某物）","entries":[{"pattern":"hire sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"租用某物","explanation":"在英式英語中較為常見，等同於 rent。常用於短時間的租用。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Since we did not have our own equipment, we had to <target>hire</target> a small boat <pattern>to</pattern> explore the hidden caves along the coast.","translation":"因為我們沒有自己的設備，我們不得不租用一和小船來探索沿海的隱藏洞穴。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"rent","pos":"verb","translation":"租用","explanation":"null"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"新雇員（指被雇用的人）","entries":[{"pattern":"a new hire","pos":"noun","translation":"新雇員","explanation":"這裡 hire 作為名詞，指被聘請的人。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The manager spent the first hour of the meeting introducing the <target>hire</target> to the rest of the team, explaining her previous experience.","translation":"經理在會議的第一個小時花時間將這位新雇員介紹給團隊的其他成員，並解釋她的先前經驗。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"employee","pos":"noun","translation":"員工","explanation":"null"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"hired","past_participle":"hired"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"historian","explanation":"「historian」是指專業研究歷史的人。在學測閱讀中，常出現於討論文化遺產、古文明或社會演變的文本中。注意它與 history (歷史) 及 historic/historical (歷史的) 的區分。","senses":[{"sense":"歷史學家","entries":[{"pattern":"historian","pos":"noun","translation":"歷史學家","explanation":"指對歷史事件進行研究、記錄或分析的專業人士。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The famous <target>historian</target> spent ten years traveling through Asia to collect rare documents about ancient silk road trade.","translation":"那位著名的歷史學家花了十年時間遊歷亞洲，以收集關於古代絲路貿易的稀有文件。"},{"sentence":"Many <target>historians</target> argue that the industrial revolution completely changed the way people lived and worked in the nineteenth century.","translation":"許多歷史學家主張，工業革命完全改變了十九世紀人們生活與工作的方式。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 hist (歷史) + 字尾 -ian (人)","related":[{"word":"history","pos":"noun","translation":"歷史","explanation":"核心名詞，指過去發生的事情。"},{"word":"historic","pos":"adjective","translation":"具有歷史意義的","explanation":"強調事件的重要性。"},{"word":"historical","pos":"adjective","translation":"歷史上的；與歷史有關的","explanation":"泛指與歷史相關的事物。"}]}}

{"headword":"historic","explanation":"「historic」與「historical」極易混淆。Historic 強調的是「重要性」，指該事件或地點在歷史上具有里程碑意義；而 Historical 則僅僅是指「與歷史相關的」或「過去發生的」。","senses":[{"sense":"具有歷史意義的；重大的","entries":[{"pattern":"historic event / moment / agreement","pos":"adjective","translation":"具有歷史意義的事件／時刻／協議","explanation":"用來形容那些將被後世銘記、足以改變歷史走向的重大時刻。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The signing of the peace treaty was a <target>historic</target> <pattern>moment</pattern> that ended decades of war between the two nations.","translation":"和平條約的簽署是一個具有歷史意義的時刻，結束了兩個國家之間數十年的戰爭。"},{"sentence":"The city council decided to protect the <target>historic</target> <pattern>buildings</pattern> in the old town to keep the city's cultural identity.","translation":"市議會決定保護舊城區內具有歷史意義的建築物，以維持城市的文化認同。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"momentous","pos":"adjective","translation":"重大的；極其重要的","explanation":"強調對未來有深遠影響"},{"word":"significant","pos":"adjective","translation":"顯著的；重要的","explanation":"泛指重要程度高"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 hist (歷史) + 形容詞字尾 -ic","related":[{"word":"history","pos":"noun","translation":"歷史","explanation":"核心基礎名詞。"},{"word":"historical","pos":"adjective","translation":"歷史上的","explanation":"指與歷史相關，不一定具有重大意義。"}]}}

{"headword":"holder","explanation":"「holder」在學測中通常不指物理上的「持有者」，而是指持有特定權利、證書、文件或職位的「持有者」。注意其搭配的名詞。 ","senses":[{"sense":"持有者；持有人","entries":[{"pattern":"ticket / passport / account holder","pos":"noun","translation":"票券／護照／帳戶持有者","explanation":"指擁有某種法律文件、權利或資格的人。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Only a valid passport <target>holder</target> is allowed to enter the restricted area of the international airport.","translation":"只有持有有效護照的人才被允許進入國際機場的禁區。"},{"sentence":"The bank told the account <target>holder</target> <pattern>that</pattern> his balance was too low to cover the monthly service fee.","translation":"銀行告訴帳戶持有人，他的餘額太低，不足以支付每月的服務費。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"possessor","pos":"noun","translation":"擁有者","explanation":"較正式的用法，指擁有某物的人"},{"word":"owner","pos":"noun","translation":"所有者","explanation":"強調法律上的所有權"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"動詞 hold (持有) + 名詞字尾 -er (人)","related":[{"word":"hold","pos":"verb","translation":"持有；舉辦","explanation":"核心動詞。"}]}}

{"headword":"holy","explanation":"「holy」常用於描述宗教、信仰或神聖的事物。在學測中，常出現於文化研究或宗教建築的描述中。","senses":[{"sense":"神聖的","entries":[{"pattern":"holy place / site / book","pos":"adjective","translation":"神聖之地／聖地／聖經","explanation":"指與神或宗教信仰密切相關，被視為神聖不可侵犯的事物。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Jerusalem is considered a <target>holy</target> <pattern>city</pattern> by many different religions because of its deep historical roots.","translation":"由於其深厚的歷史根源，耶路撒冷被許多不同宗教視為一座神聖的城市。"},{"sentence":"Visitors are asked to remove their shoes before entering the <target>holy</target> <pattern>temple</pattern> to show respect for the tradition.","translation":"遊客在進入這座神聖的寺廟之前被要求脫鞋，以表示對傳統的尊重。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"sacred","pos":"adjective","translation":"神聖的","explanation":"幾乎完全同義，常用於描述宗教聖地"},{"word":"divine","pos":"adjective","translation":"神聖的；非凡的","explanation":"強調來自於神"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"profane","pos":"adjective","translation":"世俗的；褻瀆的","explanation":"指不神聖的事物"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"homesick","explanation":"「homesick」在學測中常用於描述青少年或留學生在面對新環境時的情感轉折，是寫作中表達「思鄉」或「適應壓力」時的關鍵形容詞。","senses":[{"sense":"思鄉的；想家的","entries":[{"pattern":"feel homesick","pos":"adjective","translation":"感到思鄉","explanation":"常用於連結動詞後，描述心理狀態。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After moving to a foreign city for university, many students start to <target>feel</target> <pattern>homesick</pattern> when they see photos of their family.","translation":"在搬到外國城市上大學後，許多學生在看到家人照片時會開始感到思鄉。"},{"sentence":"Although she loved her new job in London, the quiet evenings often made her <target>homesick</target> for the warm meals cooked by her mother.","translation":"儘管她喜歡在倫敦的新工作，但安靜的夜晚經常讓她想念母親煮的溫暖餐點。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"nostalgic","pos":"adjective","translation":"懷舊的；想念過去的","explanation":"範圍更廣，不僅限於家鄉，也包含對過去時光或地點的懷念"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"名詞 home (家) + 形容詞後綴 -sick (病態的/渴望的)","related":[{"word":"homesickness","pos":"noun","translation":"思鄉之情","explanation":"由形容詞 homesick 轉化而來的名詞形式。"}]}}

{"headword":"hometown","explanation":"「hometown」是描述個人背景、故鄉情懷的基礎名詞。在學測作文中，描述自己的出生地或討論鄉村與城市發展時經常使用。","senses":[{"sense":"故鄉；家鄉","entries":[{"pattern":"one's hometown","pos":"noun","translation":"某人的故鄉","explanation":"指一個人出生或成長的地方。","sentences":[{"sentence":"During the winter break, the college student decided to return to his <target>hometown</target> to visit his grandparents and celebrate the New Year.","translation":"在寒假期間，這名大學生決定回到他的故鄉去探望祖父母並慶祝新年。"},{"sentence":"The young artist often draws inspiration from the beautiful mountains and clear rivers of her <target>hometown</target> in the southern part of Taiwan.","translation":"這位年輕藝術家經常從她位於台灣南部的故鄉中那美麗的山脈與清澈河流中汲取靈感。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"birthplace","pos":"noun","translation":"出生地","explanation":"強調出生之時的地點"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"名詞 home (家) + 名詞 town (城鎮)","related":[]}}

{"headword":"honesty","explanation":"「honesty」是關於道德、人格特質的抽象名詞。在閱讀測驗中常與 trust (信任) 或 integrity (正直) 搭配，是探討誠實與欺騙主題時的核心字彙。","senses":[{"sense":"誠實；正直","entries":[{"pattern":"honesty","pos":"noun","translation":"誠實","explanation":"指不撒謊、不欺騙且坦率的特質。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The teacher praised the young boy for his <target>honesty</target> after he returned the expensive wallet he found on the school playground.","translation":"在男孩將在學校操場發現的昂貴錢包歸還後，老師稱讚了他的誠實。"},{"sentence":"In any healthy friendship, <target>honesty</target> is more important than agreeing with everything the other person says just to be polite.","translation":"在任何健康的友誼中，誠實比為了禮貌而同意對方所說的一切更重要。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"integrity","pos":"noun","translation":"正直；完整","explanation":"強調對道德原則的堅持"},{"word":"truthfulness","pos":"noun","translation":"真實性；誠實","explanation":"強調說出事實的行為"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"dishonesty","pos":"noun","translation":"不誠實","explanation":null},{"word":"deceit","pos":"noun","translation":"欺騙","explanation":"指蓄意誤導他人的行為"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"形容詞 honest + 名詞後綴 -y","related":[{"word":"honest","pos":"adjective","translation":"誠實的","explanation":"對應的形容詞形式。"}]}}

{"headword":"horrible","explanation":"「horrible」是一個強烈的負面形容詞。在學測中常用於描述極端不快、令人厭惡或品質極差的事物。注意其語氣比 bad 或 unpleasant 更強烈。","senses":[{"sense":"可怕的；極其糟糕的（令人厭惡或恐懼）","entries":[{"pattern":"horrible","pos":"adjective","translation":"可怕的；糟糕的","explanation":"修飾名詞，描述事物令人不適或令人厭惡。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The kitchen smelled <target>horrible</target> after the old fish had been left on the table for three whole days.","translation":"舊魚留在桌上整整三天後，廚房聞起來極其糟糕。"},{"sentence":"After the heavy storm, the city suffered <target>horrible</target> damage to its historical buildings and public parks.","translation":"在強風暴之後，這座城市其歷史建築和公共公園遭受了可怕的損毀。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"terrible","pos":"adjective","translation":"可怕的","explanation":"與 horrible 近義，程度極強。"},{"word":"dreadful","pos":"adjective","translation":"極糟的","explanation":"強調令人感到憂心或厭惡。"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"wonderful","pos":"adjective","translation":"絕佳的","explanation":null},{"word":"pleasant","pos":"adjective","translation":"令人愉快的","explanation":null}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 horror (恐懼) + 形容詞字尾 -ible","related":[{"word":"horrify","pos":"verb","translation":"使恐懼","explanation":"使人感到極度恐懼或驚駭。"},{"word":"horror","pos":"noun","translation":"恐懼；驚駭","explanation":"名詞形式，指一種強烈的恐懼感。"}]}}

{"headword":"hum","explanation":"「hum」在描述聲音或動作時非常重要，尤其是在描述環境氛圍或某人的情緒狀態（如快樂地哼歌）時。在學測閱讀中，它常被用來營造一種平靜或持續的背景聲音。","senses":[{"sense":"哼唱；發出嗡嗡聲（不開口地發聲或機械裝置的持續低頻聲音）","entries":[{"pattern":"hum a song / tune","pos":"verb","translation":"哼唱一首歌／曲調","explanation":"指不開口地發出聲音，通常表示心情愉快或在思考時下意識地做出的動作。","sentences":[{"sentence":"While cleaning the living room, my mother often <target>hums</target> a cheerful <pattern>tune</pattern> that makes the whole house feel peaceful.","translation":"在清理客廳時，我的母親經常哼著一個愉快的曲調，讓整個房子感覺很平靜。"}]},{"pattern":"hum with sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"充滿…（的聲音或活力）","explanation":"比喻用法，指某個地方充滿了嗡嗡聲或繁忙地運作中，常與 activity 或 excitement 搭配。","sentences":[{"sentence":"During the morning rush hour, the city center <target>hums</target> <pattern>with</pattern> activity as thousands of office workers hurry to their jobs.","translation":"在早晨的高峰時段，市中心充滿了繁忙的氣息，因為數千名上班族正匆忙地前往工作地點。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"buzz","pos":"verb","translation":"發出嗡嗡聲","explanation":"通常指昆蟲或電器設備發出的尖銳嗡嗡聲。"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"hummed","past_participle":"hummed"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"humid","explanation":"「humid」是描述氣候、天氣的基礎核心形容詞。在學測關於環境、全球暖化或地理類閱讀測驗中，極為高頻。學生應將其與 moisture 或 humidity 建立關聯。","senses":[{"sense":"潮濕的（空氣中水氣較多）","entries":[{"pattern":"humid weather / climate","pos":"adjective","translation":"潮濕的天氣／氣候","explanation":"用來修飾天氣或氣候，指空氣中含有大量水蒸氣，讓人感到不適。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Taiwan's summer is extremely <target>humid</target>, which makes people feel sticky and tired even if they are just sitting still.","translation":"台灣的夏天極其潮濕，這使得人們即使只是靜靜地坐著，也會感到黏膩且疲憊。"},{"sentence":"Tropical rainforests have a very <target>humid</target> <pattern>climate</pattern>, allowing a huge variety of exotic plants and animals to grow and survive.","translation":"熱帶雨林擁有非常潮濕的氣候，使得各種異國植物和動物能夠生長與生存。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"moist","pos":"adjective","translation":"潮濕的；微濕的","explanation":"通常指適度的潮濕，且往往具有正向意義（如 moist cake）。"},{"word":"damp","pos":"adjective","translation":"陰濕的","explanation":"通常指不舒服的潮濕（如 damp clothes）。"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"dry","pos":"adjective","translation":"乾燥的","explanation":null},{"word":"arid","pos":"adjective","translation":"乾旱的","explanation":"常用於描述沙漠或極其乾燥的地區。"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"形容詞 humid 加上名詞字尾 -ity","related":[{"word":"humidity","pos":"noun","translation":"濕度；潮濕","explanation":"指空氣中的水蒸氣含量。"}]}}

{"headword":"indoor","explanation":"「indoor」是形容詞，必須接在名詞之前作為修飾語。學生常將其與副詞 indoors 混淆，區分其詞性別是解題關鍵。","senses":[{"sense":"室內的","entries":[{"pattern":"indoor sth.","pos":"adjective","translation":"室內…","explanation":"直接修飾名詞，指在室內進行的活動或設施。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Because of the heavy rain, the school decided to move the sports day to an <target>indoor</target> stadium.","translation":"因為大雨，學校決定將運動會移至室內體育場。"},{"sentence":"Many elderly people enjoy <target>indoor</target> hobbies like reading or painting when the weather outside is too cold.","translation":"許多老年人在室外天氣太冷時，喜歡閱讀或繪畫等室內愛好。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[{"word":"outdoor","pos":"adjective","translation":"室外的","explanation":"對立的形容詞"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"名詞 in + door (門)","related":[{"word":"indoors","pos":"adverb","translation":"在室內","explanation":"對應的副詞型態，不可接名詞。"}]}}

{"headword":"indoors","explanation":"「indoors」是副詞，用來修飾動詞，指在室內這個空間內。它不需要接名詞，且常出現在描述居家生活或天氣影響活動變更的句子中。","senses":[{"sense":"在室內","entries":[{"pattern":"stay / go indoors","pos":"adverb","translation":"留在室內／進入室內","explanation":"常用於描述因為天氣、污染或疫情而被迫留在室內。","sentences":[{"sentence":"When the thunderstorm started, all the students were told to go <target>indoors</target> immediately for their safety.","translation":"當雷雨開始時，所有學生都被告知立即進入室內以策安全。"},{"sentence":"During the hot summer months, many people prefer to stay <target>indoors</target> with the air conditioning on.","translation":"在炎熱的夏季月份中，許多人偏好留在室內並開啟冷氣。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[{"word":"outdoors","pos":"adverb","translation":"在室外","explanation":"對立的副詞"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"形容詞 indoor 加上副詞字尾 -s","related":[{"word":"indoor","pos":"adjective","translation":"室內的","explanation":"對應的形容詞型態。"}]}}

{"headword":"industrial","explanation":"「industrial」在學測中極高頻，常出現在描述工業化進程、經濟轉型或環境污染問題的閱讀文章中。需注意其與 industry (名詞) 及 industrialize (動詞) 的詞性轉換。","senses":[{"sense":"工業的；產業的","entries":[{"pattern":"industrial area / zone","pos":"adjective","translation":"工業區","explanation":"指專門用於工廠運作的地理區域。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many people move from the countryside to the <target>industrial</target> <pattern>zone</pattern> to find better-paying jobs in factories.","translation":"許多人從鄉下搬到工業區，以便在工廠中尋找待遇更好的工作。"}]},{"pattern":"industrial waste / pollution","pos":"adjective","translation":"工業廢物／工業污染","explanation":"常用於環境保護類文章，描述工廠排放的廢氣或廢水。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The local government has passed new laws to reduce <target>industrial</target> <pattern>waste</pattern> that flows into the river.","translation":"當地政府通過了新法律，以減少流入河流的工業廢物。"}]},{"pattern":"industrial revolution","pos":"adjective","translation":"工業革命","explanation":"歷史專有名詞，指 18 世紀起由機器取代人力之大變革。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The <target>industrial</target> <pattern>revolution</pattern> completely changed how people lived and worked, leading to the growth of big cities.","translation":"工業革命完全改變了人們生活與工作的方式，導致了大城市的成長。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[{"word":"agricultural","pos":"adjective","translation":"農業的","explanation":"在經濟描述中常與工業相對立"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"名詞 industry (工業) + 形容詞字尾 -ial","related":[{"word":"industrialize","pos":"verb","translation":"使工業化","explanation":"由形容詞 industrial 延伸而來。"},{"word":"industrialization","pos":"noun","translation":"工業化","explanation":"y- 轉型為 -ial, then -ization (名詞化)。"}]}}

{"headword":"inferior","explanation":"「inferior」在學測中常被用來比較品質、能力或地位。最關鍵的考點在於其搭配的介系詞 for 或 to，特別是 inferior to sth. {"headword":"inform","explanation":"「inform」的核心在於「告知」。在學測中，要注意其常見的句型結構：inform sb. of sth. 或 inform sb. that...。這類動詞在克漏字中常考其後方的介系詞搭配，是解題關鍵。","senses":[{"sense":"告知；通知（正式地將資訊傳達給他人）","entries":[{"pattern":"inform sb. of sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"告知某人某事","explanation":"inform 後接人名或代名詞，再接介系詞 of 來引導出被通知的具體內容。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The school principal decided to <target>inform</target> the students <pattern>of</pattern> the new rules regarding the use of mobile phones in class.","translation":"校長決定通知學生關於在課堂上使用手機的新規定。"}]},{"pattern":"inform sb. that...","pos":"verb","translation":"告知某人…（後接子句）","explanation":"inform 後接人，再接 that 子句，用來詳細地敘述被通知的內容。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The flight attendant kindly <target>informed</target> the passengers <pattern>that</pattern> the plane would be delayed by two hours due to heavy rain.","translation":"空服員親切地通知乘客，飛機將因為大雨而延誤兩小時。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"informed","past_participle":"informed"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 inform (形塑、給予形式) + 動詞字尾","related":[{"word":"information","pos":"noun","translation":"資訊；資料","explanation":"由動詞 inform 加上名詞字尾 -tion 延伸而來。"},{"word":"informative","pos":"adjective","translation":"提供豐富資訊的；有益的","explanation":"由動詞 inform 加上形容詞字尾 -ative 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"injury","explanation":"「injury」通常指身體上的傷害，與 damage (損壞) 或 wound (傷口) 區分。在學測中，常出現在健康、運動或事故類文章中，且常搭配特定的動詞如 suffer an injury 或 cause an injury。","senses":[{"sense":"傷害；受傷（身體上的損害）","entries":[{"pattern":"suffer an injury","pos":"noun","translation":"受傷","explanation":"常用於描述在運動或事故中遭受身體傷害的狀況。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The young soccer player had to leave the game early because he <target>suffered</target> a serious knee <pattern>injury</pattern> during the first half.","translation":"這名年輕的足球員不得不早早離開比賽，因為他在上半場遭受了嚴重的膝蓋傷害。"}]},{"pattern":"cause an injury","pos":"verb","translation":"造成傷害","explanation":"指外部力量或原因導致身體受傷。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The sharp edges of the broken glass could <target>cause</target> a severe <pattern>injury</pattern> to anyone who touches them without gloves.","translation":"碎玻璃的鋒利邊緣可能會對任何沒有戴手套觸摸它們的人造成嚴重傷害。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 injur (傷害) + 名詞字尾 -y","related":[{"word":"injure","pos":"verb","translation":"傷害；使受傷","explanation":"由名詞 injury 延伸而來，指對身體造成損害。"}]}}

{"headword":"innocent","explanation":"「innocent」在學測中主要分為「清白」與「純真」兩種語意。前者多出現在法律或衝突情境中，後者則出現在描述人物性格或心態的文本中。注意其名詞形式 innocence 為高頻考點。","senses":[{"sense":"清白的；無辜的（指未犯罪或未犯錯）","entries":[{"pattern":"be innocent of sth.","pos":"adjective","translation":"對…是清白的／無辜的","explanation":"常用於法律情境，表示主詞對某項指控（如犯罪）沒有責任。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After the police found the real thief, the young man was finally proven to be <target>innocent</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the crime.","translation":"在警察找到真正的小偷後，這個年輕人終於被證明對這起犯罪是清白的。"},{"sentence":"The lawyer argued that his client was completely <target>innocent</target> <pattern>of</pattern> any wrongdoing, as he was in another city during the robbery.","translation":"律師主張他的當事人完全沒有做錯任何事，因為在搶劫發生時他在另一個城市。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"blameless","pos":"adjective","translation":"無辜的；無可指責的","explanation":"強調沒有任何過錯。"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"guilty","pos":"adjective","translation":"有罪的；內疚的","explanation":"法律上的對立面，指確定犯了罪。"}]},{"sense":"純真的；天真的（指缺乏經驗或單純）單","entries":[{"pattern":"an innocent child / smile","pos":"adjective","translation":"一個純真的孩子／純真的微笑","explanation":"描述人物的性格、表情或心態，強調其單純、未被世俗污染。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The grandmother looked at the baby's <target>innocent</target> smile and felt a sudden wave of warmth and love in her heart.","translation":"祖母看著寶寶純真的微笑，心中突然湧起一股溫暖與愛意。"},{"sentence":"He was so <target>innocent</target> that he believed every single word the stranger told him about the hidden treasure in the forest.","translation":"他如此天真，以至於相信了陌生人告訴他的關於森林中隱藏寶藏的每一個字。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"naive","pos":"adjective","translation":"天真的；單純的","explanation":"帶有輕微的負面含義，指缺乏社會經驗而容易被欺騙。"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"sophisticated","pos":"adjective","translation":"老練的；複雜的","explanation":"指人物性格或心態成熟且經驗豐富。"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 in- (不) + noc (傷害) + 形容詞字尾 -ent","related":[{"word":"innocence","pos":"noun","translation":"清白；純真","explanation":"由形容詞 innocent 轉化為名詞。"}]}}

{"headword":"inspect","explanation":"「inspect」強調的是「仔細檢查」以發現問題或確保符合標準。在學測中，常出現在工業檢查、政府監管或學校管理情境中，與 check 或 examine 相似，但更強調正式的官方檢查。","senses":[{"sense":"檢查；視察（仔細觀察以發現瑕疵或確認正確性）","entries":[{"pattern":"inspect sth. (carefully)","pos":"verb","translation":"（仔細地）檢查某物","explanation":"及物動詞，直接接名詞受詞，常用於描述檢查設備、文件或現場。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Before the plane takes off, the engineers must <target>inspect</target> the engines <pattern>carefully</pattern> to make sure there are no mechanical problems.","translation":"在飛機起飛前，工程師必須仔細檢查引擎，以確保沒有機械故障。"},{"sentence":"The health officer arrived at the restaurant to <target>inspect</target> the kitchen and check if the food was stored at the correct temperature.","translation":"衛生官員到達餐廳以視察廚房，並檢查食物是否儲存在正確的溫度下。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"examine","pos":"verb","translation":"檢查；審查","explanation":"泛指所有的仔細觀察。"},{"word":"scrutinize","pos":"verb","translation":"詳細檢查；審視","explanation":"更強調極其仔細地檢查。"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"inspected","past_participle":"inspected"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字首 in- (進入/在內) + 字根 spec (看)","related":[{"word":"inspection","pos":"noun","translation":"檢查；視察","explanation":"由動詞 inspect 加上名詞字尾 -tion 延伸而來。"},{"word":"inspector","pos":"noun","translation":"檢查員；視察員","explanation":"由動詞 inspect 加上執行者字尾 -or 延伸而來。"},{"word":"perspective","pos":"noun","translation":"觀點；視角","explanation":"字根 spec (看) 的延伸詞。"}]}}

{"headword":"inspector","explanation":"「inspector」是「inspect」的執行者名詞。在閱讀中，常與 specific 職稱（如 health inspector, building inspector）搭配，用以指代特定的專業檢查員。","senses":[{"sense":"檢查員；視察員（負責正式檢查的人）","entries":[{"pattern":"a health / building / school inspector","pos":"noun","translation":"衛生／建築／學校檢查員","explanation":"常用於描述專業職稱，指負責確保某項標準被遵守的人。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The <target>inspector</target> found several safety problems in the old building, so he ordered the owner to fix them immediately.","translation":"檢查員在舊建築中發現了幾個安全問題，因此他命令屋主立即修理。"},{"sentence":"If the <target>inspector</target> does not find any violations of the law, the new factory will be allowed to operate officially.","translation":"如果檢查員沒有發現任何違法行為，這家新工廠將被允許正式營運。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"examiner","pos":"noun","translation":"考官；檢查員","explanation":"常用於考試或正式審查。"},{"word":"supervisor","pos":"noun","translation":"監督者；主管","explanation":"強調監督管理權限。"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"inspect (檢查) + 字尾 -or (執行者)","related":[{"word":"inspect","pos":"verb","translation":"檢查；視察","explanation":"基礎動詞形式。"},{"word":"inspection","pos":"noun","translation":"檢查；視察","explanation":"名詞形式。"}]}}

{"headword":"intelligent","explanation":"「intelligent」在學測中常用於描述人的智力、動物的行為或科技（如 AI）。注意其名詞形式 intelligence 為高頻考點，且與 smart 不同，intelligent 更強調邏輯思考能力與學習能力。","senses":[{"sense":"聰明的；有才智的（指學習、理解與邏輯能力強）","entries":[{"pattern":"an intelligent person / student","pos":"adjective","translation":"一個聰明的人／學生","explanation":"描述人的智力水平，強調其學習能力快且分析能力強。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The <target>intelligent</target> student was able to solve the complex math problem in just a few minutes, surprising all his classmates.","translation":"這位聰明的學生能在短短幾分鐘內內解決這個複雜的數學問題，讓所有同學都感到驚訝。"},{"sentence":"Dolphins are known as some of the most <target>intelligent</target> creatures in the ocean, as they can communicate with each other.","translation":"海豚被認為是海洋中最聰明的生物之一，因為它們能夠彼此溝通。"}]},{"pattern":"artificial intelligence (AI)","pos":"adjective","translation":"人工智慧","explanation":"極高頻的科技類主題，指用電腦程序模擬人類的智力。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many experts worry that <target>intelligent</target> software programs, such as artificial intelligence, will replace many human jobs in the future.","translation":"許多專家擔心，像是人工智慧這樣聰明的軟體程序，未來將會取代許多人類的工作。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"smart","pos":"adjective","translation":"聰明的","explanation":"較為口語，泛指一切聰明。"},{"word":"bright","pos":"adjective","translation":"聰明的；靈活的","explanation":"常用於描述年輕人或小孩的學習能力強。"},{"word":"clever","pos":"adjective","translation":"聰明的；機靈的","explanation":"ten強調機靈、快思考，有時帶有負面含義（如狡猾）。"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"stupid","pos":"adjective","translation":"愚笨的","explanation":null},{"word":"foolish","pos":"adjective","translation":"愚蠢的","explanation":"強調行為或決定錯誤。"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 intel- (在之間) + 字根 leg (收集/選擇) + 形容詞字尾 -igent","related":[{"word":"intelligence","pos":"noun","translation":"智力；情報","explanation":"由形容詞 intelligent 加上名詞字尾 -ence 延伸而來。"},{"word":"intellectual","pos":"adjective","translation":"智力的；理性的","explanation":"強調與知識、學術相關的智力活動。"}]}}

{"headword":"interrupt","explanation":"「interrupt」在學測中常出現在對話描述、會議討論或生活衝突的情境中。其核心概念是「切斷」某種持續的狀態或行動。要注意它既可以指物理上的中斷（如電力、網路），也可以指社交上的打斷（如說話中途被插嘴）。","senses":[{"sense":"打斷；插嘴（在他人說話或行動時突然介入）","entries":[{"pattern":"interrupt sb.","pos":"verb","translation":"打斷某人","explanation":"及物動詞，受詞為被打斷的人，強調社交互動中的不禮貌或突發狀況。","sentences":[{"sentence":"I am sorry to <target>interrupt</target> you, but there is an important phone call waiting for you in the office.","translation":"很抱歉打斷您，但辦公室有一通重要的電話在等您。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"interrupted","past_participle":"interrupted"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字首 inter- (在…之間) + 字根 rupt (斷裂)","related":[{"word":"interrupt","pos":"verb","translation":"打斷","explanation":"核心動詞。"}]}}

{"headword":"invent","explanation":"「invent」的核心在於「創造出原本不存在的東西」。在學測中，它常與科技、歷史進步或文學創作相關。要注意它與 create 或 discover 的區別：invent 是創造新東西，而 discover 是發現已存在但未被知曉的東西。","senses":[{"sense":"發明；創造（產生全新的產品、技術或方法）","entries":[{"pattern":"invent sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"發明某事","explanation":"及物動詞，受詞通常是機械裝置、新科技或新方法。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Thomas Edison is famous for his ability to <target>invent</target> new devices that made life easier for people everywhere.","translation":"湯瑪斯·愛迪生以其發明新裝置的能力而聞名，這些裝置讓各地人們的生活變得更輕鬆。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"invented","past_participle":"invented"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字首 in- (進入/在內) + 字根 vent (來)","related":[{"word":"invention","pos":"noun","translation":"發明；發明物","explanation":"由動詞 invent 加上名詞字尾 -tion 延伸而來。"},{"word":"inventor","pos":"noun","translation":"發明家","explanation":"由動詞 invent 加上人稱字尾 -or 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"inventor","explanation":"「inventor」是指將想法轉化為實體產品的創造者。在閱讀測驗中，常出現在介紹偉人、科技史或創新專案的段落中。","senses":[{"sense":"發明家","entries":[{"pattern":"inventor","pos":"noun","translation":"發明家","explanation":"指創造出新產品或新技術的人。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The young <target>inventor</target> spent months in his small garage, trying to build a robot that could clean the floor.","translation":"這位年輕的發明家在他的小車庫裡花了幾個月時間，試圖建造一個能清理地板的機器人。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 invent (發明) + 字尾 -or (人)","related":[{"word":"invent","pos":"verb","translation":"發明","explanation":"核心動詞。"}]}}

{"headword":"investigate","explanation":"「investigate」在學測中是高頻動詞，常出現在科學實驗、犯罪調查或社會現象研究的文本中。其核心意涵是透過系統性的觀察與蒐集證據來尋找真相。","senses":[{"sense":"調查；研究（系統性地檢查以發現真相）","entries":[{"pattern":"investigate sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"調查某事","explanation":"及物動詞，受詞通常是犯罪案件、科學問題或不尋常的現象。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The police are currently <target>investigating</target> the cause of the car accident to see if the driver was tired.","translation":"警方目前正在調查車禍的原因，以確認駕駛是否疲勞。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"investigated","past_participle":"investigated"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 vestig (足跡/痕跡) + 字尾 -ate (使…成)","related":[{"word":"investigation","pos":"noun","translation":"調查","explanation":"由動詞 investigate 加上名詞字尾 -ion 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"invitation","explanation":"「invitation」是基礎名詞，常用於社交情境。在學測中，常出現在書信、對話或生活化情境的題目中。注意其常見的搭配詞，如 accept 或 decline an invitation。","senses":[{"sense":"邀請；邀請函","entries":[{"pattern":"accept an invitation","pos":"noun","translation":"接受邀請","explanation":"固定搭配，指同意參加某項活動。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After receiving a beautiful gold card, Sarah decided to <pattern>accept</pattern> the <target>invitation</target> to her best friend's wedding party.","translation":"在收到一張精美的金卡後，莎拉決定接受她最好朋友的婚禮派對邀請。"}]},{"pattern":"decline an invitation","pos":"noun","translation":"拒絕邀請","explanation":"固定搭配，指禮貌地拒絕參加活動。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Although he really wanted to visit the museum, he had to <pattern>decline</pattern> the <target>invitation</target> because of his exams.","translation":"儘管他很想參觀博物館，但他因為考試而不得不拒絕這次邀請。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 invit (邀請) + 字尾 -ation (名詞)","related":[{"word":"invite","pos":"verb","translation":"邀請","explanation":"核心動詞型態。"}]}}

{"headword":"ivory","explanation":"「ivory」在學測中常見於環境保護與野生動物貿易的閱讀測驗中。它既可以用作名詞指代象牙，也可以用作形容詞指代象牙色的（乳白色）。","senses":[{"sense":"象牙（由象牙製成的材質）","entries":[{"pattern":"ivory","pos":"noun","translation":"象牙","explanation":"指象牙這種材質，常與非法貿易或動物保護議題相關。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many countries have banned the trade of <target>ivory</target> to protect elephants from being hunted for their tusks.","translation":"許多國家已經禁止象牙貿易，以保護大象免於為了獲取其象牙而被獵殺。"},{"sentence":"The museum displayed a beautiful collection of antique <target>ivory</target> carvings from the nineteenth century.","translation":"博物館展示了一系列來自十九世紀的精美象牙雕刻品。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"象牙色的（乳白色）","entries":[{"pattern":"ivory","pos":"adjective","translation":"象牙色的；乳白色的","explanation":"用來描述顏色，是一種溫潤的白色。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The bride chose an <target>ivory</target> wedding dress instead of a bright white one to better match her skin tone.","translation":"新娘選擇了一件象牙色的婚紗，而非純白色，以更好地搭配她的膚色。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"off-white","pos":"adjective","translation":"乳白色的","explanation":"指非純白色的白色"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"jail","explanation":"「jail」在社會議題、法律與犯罪類閱讀中是高頻字彙。注意其名詞與動詞用法，以及與 prison 的 微小區別（jail 通常指短期或等待審判的拘留所）。","senses":[{"sense":"監獄；拘留所","entries":[{"pattern":"go to jail","pos":"noun","translation":"入獄","explanation":"最常見的固定搭配，表示進入監獄服刑或被拘留。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The judge decided that the thief would <target>go</target> <pattern>to</pattern> <target>jail</target> for two years for stealing expensive jewelry.","translation":"法官決定該名小偷將因偷竊昂貴珠寶而入獄兩年。"}]},{"pattern":"in jail","pos":"noun","translation":"在監獄中","explanation":"表示狀態，指人處於被拘禁狀態。","sentences":[{"sentence":"While he was <pattern>in</pattern> <target>jail</target>, he spent most of his time reading books and learning how to paint.","translation":"當他在監獄中時，他大部分的時間都花在閱讀書籍和學習繪畫。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"prison","pos":"noun","translation":"監獄","explanation":"通常指長期服刑的監獄"},{"word":"cell","pos":"noun","translation":"囚室","explanation":"監獄中最小的單元"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"監禁；投入監獄","entries":[{"pattern":"jail sb.","pos":"verb","translation":"將某人投入監獄","explanation":"及物動詞，直接接人作為受詞。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The government decided to <target>jail</target> the political prisoners who had spoken out against the unfair laws.","translation":"政府決定將那些公開反對不公平法律的政治犯投入監獄。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"imprison","pos":"verb","translation":"監禁","explanation":"較正式的用詞"},{"word":"incarcerate","pos":"verb","translation":"監禁","explanation":"法律專業術語"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"release","pos":"verb","translation":"釋放","explanation":null},{"word":"free","pos":"verb","translation":"釋放；使自由","explanation":null}]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"jailed","past_participle":"jailed"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"jar","explanation":"「jar」在學測中主要作為名詞指代一種容器，但在某些特定情境中也可作為動詞指代「震驚」或「不協調」。","senses":[{"sense":"罐子（通常指寬口玻璃罐）","entries":[{"pattern":"a jar of sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"一罐…","explanation":"常用於描述食物保存或手工製品。","sentences":[{"sentence":"My grandmother always keeps a <target>jar</target> <pattern>of</pattern> homemade strawberry jam on the kitchen table every morning.","translation":"我的祖母每天早晨都會在廚房桌上放一罐自製的草莓果醬。"},{"sentence":"The children put their saved coins into a large glass <target>jar</target> to save money for a new toy.","translation":"孩子們將他們存的硬幣放入一個大的玻璃罐中，以儲蓄買新玩具的錢。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"container","pos":"noun","translation":"容器","explanation":"泛指所有類型的容器"},{"word":"pot","pos":"noun","translation":"罐子；鍋子","explanation":"通常指陶瓷或金屬材質"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"震驚；使不協調","entries":[{"pattern":"jar sb.","pos":"verb","translation":"使某人震驚；使不舒服","explanation":"指突然的衝擊或聲音讓人感到不適或驚訝。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The loud, sudden noise of the alarm clock <target>jarred</target> me awake from a deep and peaceful sleep.","translation":"鬧鐘突然且巨大的噪音將我從深沉且平靜的睡眠中震醒。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"shock","pos":"verb","translation":"震驚","explanation":null},{"word":"word","pos":"verb","translation":"震動","explanation":null}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"jarred","past_participle":"jarred"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"jaw","explanation":"「jaw」在生物類或醫學類閱讀測驗中是基礎名詞，指代下顎骨或嘴部構造。","senses":[{"sense":"下顎；下巴","entries":[{"pattern":"jaw","pos":"noun","translation":"下顎；下巴","explanation":"指面部下方的骨骼構造。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The hungry crocodile opened its powerful <target>jaw</target> wide to catch the small fish swimming in the river.","translation":"飢餓的鱷魚張開它強而有力的下顎，以捕捉在河中游泳的小魚。"},{"sentence":"He was so surprised by the news that his <target>jaw</target> dropped, and he could not speak for a few minutes.","translation":"他對這個消息如此驚訝，以至於下巴掉了（驚訝得合不攏嘴），好幾分鐘都說不出話來。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"jazz","explanation":"「jazz」在文化、藝術類閱讀中是基礎名詞，指一種特定的音樂風格。","senses":[{"sense":"爵士樂","entries":[{"pattern":"jazz","pos":"noun","translation":"爵士樂","explanation":"常用於描述音樂類型或文化歷史。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The city is famous for its old <target>jazz</target> clubs, where musicians play smooth melodies every single night.","translation":"這座城市以其古老的爵士樂俱樂部而聞名，音樂家們在那裡每晚演奏平滑的旋律。"},{"sentence":"My father loves listening to <target>jazz</target> music because it feels more relaxed and creative than classical music.","translation":"我的父親喜歡聽爵士樂，因為比起古典音樂，它感覺更放鬆且更具創意。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"jealous","explanation":"「jealous」在學測中常用於描述人際關係中的情感衝突。需注意其兩種核心語意：一種是常見的「嫉妒」，另一種是較為高階的「視為至寶而小心保護」的用法，後者常出現在文學性質的閱讀測驗中。","senses":[{"sense":"嫉妒的；眼紅的（因他人擁有而感到不快）","entries":[{"pattern":"jealous of sb./sth.","pos":"adjective","translation":"嫉妒某人／某事","explanation":"最常見的固定搭配，接介系詞 of，表示對他人的成就、外貌或財富感到不滿。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The young pianist was <target>jealous</target> <pattern>of</pattern> his classmate's natural talent and spent hours practicing every single day to catch up.","translation":"這位年輕的鋼琴家嫉妒同學的天賦，每天花好幾個小時練習以求趕上。"},{"sentence":"Many people feel <target>jealous</target> <pattern>of</pattern> those who can travel the world and experience different cultures without worrying about money.","translation":"許多人嫉妒那些能夠環遊世界、體驗不同文化且不必擔心金錢的人。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"envious","pos":"adjective","translation":"嫉妒的","explanation":"與 jealous 近義，但 envious 更傾向於渴望擁有對方擁有的東西"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"content","pos":"adjective","translation":"滿意的","explanation":null}]},{"sense":"小心保護的；視為至寶的（不願與他人分享）","entries":[{"pattern":"jealous of sth.","pos":"adjective","translation":"對…小心保護的","explanation":"]}指對自己的權力、名聲或隱私極其在意，不允許他人染指或干涉。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The experienced professor was <target>jealous</target> <pattern>of</pattern> his private research notes and refused to let any students see them.","translation":"那位經驗豐富的教授對他的私人研究筆記小心保護，拒絕讓任何學生看到。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"jealousy","pos":"noun","translation":"嫉妒；妒心","explanation":"由形容詞 jealous 轉化而來的名詞型態。"}]}}

{"headword":"jeep","explanation":"「jeep」指一種強而有力的越野車，在學測的自然、探險或旅遊類閱讀中常作為具體的交通工具出現。","senses":[{"sense":"吉普車；越野車","entries":[{"pattern":"jeep","pos":"noun","translation":"吉普車","explanation":"指一種適合在崎嶇路面行駛的車輛。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The safari guides drove their heavy <target>jeep</target> through the tall grass of the savanna to find the hidden lions.","translation":"野生動物園的導遊開著他們沉重的吉普車穿過稀樹草原的高草叢，以尋找隱藏的獅子。"},{"sentence":"Because the mountain road was narrow and muddy, the travelers had to rent a sturdy <target>jeep</target> to reach the village.","translation":"因為山路狹窄且泥濘，旅行者們不得不租一輛堅固的吉普車才能到達那個村莊。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"ladder","explanation":"「ladder」在學測中除了指實體的「梯子」外，常出現在比喻用法中，用來描述社會地位、職位晉升或成功的階梯。理解其「階梯式上升」的概念是解讀高階文章的關鍵。","senses":[{"sense":"梯子（用於攀爬的工具）","entries":[{"pattern":"ladder","pos":"noun","translation":"梯子","explanation":"指由兩根長桿和橫桿組成的攀爬工具。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The painter climbed up the wooden <target>ladder</target> to reach the high ceiling and finish painting the white walls of the room.","translation":"油漆工爬上木梯，以觸及高天花板並完成房間白牆的粉刷。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"階梯；等級（比喻成功的過程或社會地位）","entries":[{"pattern":"the social / career ladder","pos":"noun","translation":"社會階梯／職涯階梯","explanation":"比喻一個人透過努力工作或權力獲取，逐步提升社會地位或職位。常用於描述職業發展或階級流動。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many young graduates work hard and compete with each other to climb the <target>ladder</target> <pattern>of</pattern> success in large corporations.","translation":"許多年輕畢業生努力工作並互相競爭，以在大型企業中攀登成功的階梯。"},{"sentence":"She started as a low-level clerk and spent ten years climbing the corporate <target>ladder</target> before she finally became the CEO.","translation":"她最初是一名低階職員，在成為執行長之前，花了十年時間攀登公司職涯階梯。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"hierarchy","pos":"noun","translation":"階級制度","explanation":"強調結構化的等級制度"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"laughter","explanation":"「laughter」是名詞，由動詞 laugh 延伸而來。在閱讀測驗中，常用於描述人物的情緒狀態、社交氛圍或心理健康的重要性。","senses":[{"sense":"笑聲；大笑","entries":[{"pattern":"laughter","pos":"noun","translation":"笑聲","explanation":"指大笑時發出的聲音或行為。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The room was filled with loud <target>laughter</target> as the comedian told a funny story about his clumsy life in the city.","translation":"當喜劇演員講述他城市生活中笨拙的趣事時，房間裡充滿了響亮的笑聲。"},{"sentence":"Medical experts believe that <target>laughter</target> can reduce stress and help people recover from illness more quickly than usual.","translation":"醫學專家認為笑聲（大笑）可以減輕壓力，並幫助人們比平時更快地從疾病中康復。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"動詞 laugh 加上名詞字尾 -ter","related":[{"word":"laugh","pos":"verb","translation":"笑","explanation":"核心動詞"},{"word":"laughable","pos":"adjective","translation":"可笑的；荒謬的","explanation":"指事情到了可笑的地步"}]}}
