{"headword":"learning","explanation":"「learning」在學測中主要作為名詞，指「學習過程」或「學識」。要注意其在句中作為名詞時，與動詞 learn 的動作過程區分開來，常出現在教育類、心理學類閱讀中。","senses":[{"sense":"學習；學習過程","entries":[{"pattern":"learning process","pos":"noun","translation":"學習過程","explanation":"指從未知到知曉的認知過程，是教育類文章的高頻搭配。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Every student has a different <target>learning</target> <pattern>process</pattern>, so teachers should use different methods to help every child.","translation":"每個學生都有不同的學習過程，因此老師應該使用不同的方法來幫助每個孩子。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"study","pos":"noun","translation":"研究；學習","explanation":"指系統性的學習或學業"},{"word":"acquisition","pos":"noun","translation":"習得；獲取","explanation":"常用於語言習得 (language acquisition) 的語境"},{"word":"education","pos":"noun","translation":"教育","explanation":"泛指整個教育系統或過程"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"學識；知識","entries":[{"pattern":"a man/woman of learning","pos":"noun","translation":"博學之士","explanation":"較為正式的用法，指一個人擁有深厚的學問或知識。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The professor is a man of great <target>learning</target>, and his books on ancient history are read by students worldwide.","translation":"這位教授是一位博學之士，他的書籍關於古代歷史的部分被全世界的學生閱讀。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"knowledge","pos":"noun","translation":"知識","explanation":"對事實、資訊的掌握"},{"word":"scholarship","pos":"noun","translation":"學問；學術研究","explanation":"指深厚的學術知識"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"動詞 learn 加上名詞字尾 -ing","related":[{"word":"learn","pos":"verb","translation":"學習","explanation":"核心基礎動詞型態。"}]}}

{"headword":"leather","explanation":"「leather」在學測中是一個基礎名詞，主要出現在描述材質、時尚或動物保護類文章中。其用法單純，重點在於辨識其作為材質名詞的特徵。","senses":[{"sense":"皮革","entries":[{"pattern":"leather","pos":"noun","translation":"皮革","explanation":"指經過處理的動物皮，常用於製作衣服、鞋子或包包。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Because he loved the smell of old books and <target>leather</target> jackets, he often visited the small vintage shop downtown.","translation":"因為他熱愛舊書和皮夾克的味道，他經常造訪市中心那間小小的古著店。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"leisure","explanation":"「leisure」在學測中常與時間、活動搭配，描述現代人的生活壓力與平衡。注意其形容詞型態 leisurely (或 leisure) 在修飾活動時的用法。","senses":[{"sense":"閒暇；餘暇","entries":[{"pattern":"leisure time","pos":"noun","translation":"閒暇時間","explanation":"最常見的搭配，指工作或學習之外的自由時間。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Since the school term ended, many students spend their <target>leisure</target> <pattern>time</pattern> traveling to different cities to explore new cultures.","translation":"自從學期結束，許多學生利用他們的閒暇時間前往不同城市旅行，以探索新文化。"}]},{"pattern":"at leisure","pos":"noun","translation":"在閒暇時；從容地","explanation":"固定片語，表示在沒有壓力、不匆忙的情況下做某事。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Please read the long report and send me your comments <target>at</target> <pattern>leisure</pattern>, as there is no urgent deadline.","translation":"請在您方便（從容）時閱讀這份長報告並將您的評論發給我，因為沒有緊急的截止日期。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"spare time","pos":"noun","translation":"閒暇時間","explanation":"泛指所有空閒時間"},{"word":"free time","pos":"noun","translation":"閒暇時間","explanation":"最普遍的口語用法"},{"word":"relaxation","pos":"noun","translation":"放鬆；休息","explanation":"強調從壓力中解脫出的狀態"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"work","pos":"noun","translation":"工作","explanation":null},{"word":"labor","pos":"noun","translation":"工作；勞動","explanation":"強調體力勞動"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"leisurely","pos":"adjective","translation":"從容的；悠閒的","explanation":"由名詞 leisure 加上形容詞字尾 -ly 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"lemonade","explanation":"「lemonade」在閱讀測驗中常作為日常生活中清涼飲料的代表，屬於基礎生活詞彙。學習時需注意它與 lemon (檸檬) 的區分，它是指經過調製的「檸檬水/檸檬汽水」。","senses":[{"sense":"檸檬水；檸檬汽水","entries":[{"pattern":"lemonade","pos":"noun","translation":"檸檬水；檸檬汽水","explanation":"指由檸檬汁、糖和水調製而成的飲料。","sentences":[{"sentence":"On a hot summer afternoon, nothing feels more refreshing than a glass of ice-cold <target>lemonade</target> served in a tall glass.","translation":"在炎熱的夏天下午，沒有什麼比一杯盛在長杯裡的冰涼檸檬水更令人清爽的了。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"名詞 lemon (檸檬) + 字尾 -ade (飲料)","related":[{"word":"lemon","pos":"noun","translation":"檸檬","explanation":"基礎水果名稱。"}]}}

{"headword":"leopard","explanation":"「leopard」是自然科學與生物類文章中常見的貓科動物名詞。學生應將其與 cheetah (獵豹) 或 tiger (老虎) 等相似動物區分，注意其外觀特徵（斑點）。","senses":[{"sense":"豹；金豹","entries":[{"pattern":"leopard","pos":"noun","translation":"豹","explanation":"指一種大型貓科動物，特徵是身體有斑點。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The wildlife photographer waited for hours in the dense jungle to capture a perfect photo of a spotted <target>leopard</target> hunting for food.","translation":"野生動物攝影師在茂密的叢林中等待了數小時，以捕捉一張斑點豹獵食的完美照片。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"lettuce","explanation":"「lettuce」是基礎生活詞彙，常用於描述飲食、健康或農業主題。在句子中通常作為不可數名詞使用，描述沙拉或蔬菜類。","senses":[{"sense":"萵苣；生菜","entries":[{"pattern":"lettuce","pos":"noun","translation":"萵苣；生菜","explanation":"一種常用於沙拉的葉菜類蔬菜。","sentences":[{"sentence":"To make a healthy lunch, the student added some fresh, crisp <target>lettuce</target> and sliced tomatoes to her homemade sandwich.","translation":"為了準備一份健康的午餐，這名學生在她的手工三明治中加入了新鮮且脆口的萵苣和切片番茄。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"liberty","explanation":"「liberty」在社會科學、歷史或政治類文章中是極高頻的核心詞彙。它與 freedom (自由) 近義，但 liberty 往往更強調「從限制中獲釋放」或「法律賦予的權利」之自由。","senses":[{"sense":"自由；權利","entries":[{"pattern":"liberty","pos":"noun","translation":"自由","explanation":"指不受限制地行動或思考的狀態，或被法律保障的權利。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many soldiers fought bravely for many years to ensure that future generations could live in <target>liberty</target> and peace.","translation":"許多士兵英勇地戰鬥多年，以確保後代能夠在自由與和平之中生活。"}]},{"pattern":"take the liberty of doing sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"擅自做某事","explanation":"這是一個高階固定搭配，指在未經對方同意的情況下，禮貌地先行採取行動。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Since you were not in the office, I <target>took</target> the <pattern>liberty</pattern> <pattern>of</pattern> sending the email to your manager instead.","translation":"因為您不在辦公室，我擅自將電子郵件改寄給了您的經理。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"freedom","pos":"noun","translation":"自由","explanation":"最通用的自由之意"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"slavery","pos":"noun","translation":"奴隸制度","explanation":null},{"word":"captivity","pos":"noun","translation":"囚禁","explanation":"指被限制在特定空間內"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 liber (自由)","related":[{"word":"liberal","pos":"adjective","translation":"自由的；開明的","explanation":"指思想開放且不拘泥於傳統。"},{"word":"liberalize","pos":"verb","translation":"使自由化","explanation":"常用於經濟政策的描述。"},{"word":"liberation","pos":"noun","translation":"解放","explanation":"指從壓迫中獲釋放的過程。"}]}}

{"headword":"lick","explanation":"「lick」在描述動物行為或日常肢體動作時常用。它既可作為動詞（舔）也可作為名詞（舔一下），但在學測中主要以動詞形式出現。","senses":[{"sense":"舔；舔舐","entries":[{"pattern":"lick sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"舔某物","explanation":"用舌頭觸碰或在表面上移動。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The small puppy <target>licked</target> its owner's face with excitement when he finally came home from work.","translation":"當主人終於下班回家時，那隻小狗興奮地舔著主人的臉。"}]},{"pattern":"lick","pos":"noun","translation":"舔一下","explanation":"指一次舔的動作。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The child gave the colorful ice cream cone a big <target>lick</target> before it started to melt in the sun.","translation":"孩子在彩色冰淇淋甜筒被陽光曬化之前，用力舔了一大口。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"licked","past_participle":"licked"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"lifetime","explanation":"「lifetime」在學測中常作為名詞修飾名詞（如 lifetime achievement），或用於表達「一生」的時長。需注意它與 life 的區別：life 指生命或生活，而 lifetime 指從出生到死亡的這段完整時間跨度。","senses":[{"sense":"一生；終身（從出生到死亡的完整時間跨度）","entries":[{"pattern":"a lifetime of sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"一輩子的…","explanation":"用來描述一個人一生中累積的經驗、努力或情感。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After a <pattern>lifetime of</pattern> hard work and saving, the elderly couple finally retired to a quiet house by the sea.","translation":"經過一輩子的努力工作與儲蓄，這對老夫婦終於退休到海邊的一棟寧靜房子裡。"},{"sentence":"The famous painter spent a <pattern>lifetime of</pattern> passion and study to master the art of traditional oil painting.","translation":"這位著名的畫家花了一輩子的熱情與研究，才精通了傳統油畫藝術。"}]},{"pattern":"lifetime achievement","pos":"noun","translation":"終身成就","explanation":"固定搭配，常用於頒獎典禮或描述偉人傳記，指一個人一生中達到的最高成就。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The director received a <target>lifetime</target> <pattern>achievement</pattern> award for his amazing contributions to the world of cinema.","translation":"這位導演因為對電影世界的驚人貢獻而獲得了終身成就獎。"}]},{"pattern":"for a lifetime","pos":"noun","translation":"終身；一輩子","explanation":"作時間副詞用法，強調某種狀態或感覺將持續整個生命週期。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The experience of visiting the Great Wall of China provided the young student with memories that will last <pattern>for</pattern> a <target>lifetime</target>.","translation":"參訪中國長城的經驗為這位年輕學生提供了將持續一輩子的記憶。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"lifespan","pos":"noun","translation":"壽命；生命週期","explanation":"更偏向生物學上的生存時長"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"名詞 life (生命) + 字尾 -time (時間)","related":[{"word":"lifelong","pos":"adjective","translation":"終身的；一輩子的","explanation":"指持續整個生命週期的，例如 lifelong friend (終身之友)"}]}}

{"headword":"lighthouse","explanation":"「lighthouse」是一個複合名詞，常用於文學描寫或環境類文章中，象徵著「指引」、「希望」或「安全」。在閱讀測驗中，注意其功能描述（發出光芒指引船隻）。","senses":[{"sense":"燈塔","entries":[{"pattern":"lighthouse","pos":"noun","translation":"燈塔","explanation":"指沿海或危險海域建立的發光建築物。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The old <target>lighthouse</target> on the rocky cliff sent out a strong beam of light to guide ships safely to the harbor.","translation":"岩石峭壁上的那座舊燈塔發出強光，指引船隻安全地進入港口。"},{"sentence":"During the violent storm, the sailors looked for the <target>lighthouse</target> to make sure they were not heading toward the dangerous rocks.","translation":"在猛烈的風暴中，水手們尋找著燈塔，以確保他們沒有正朝著危險的岩石前進。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"名詞 light (光) + 名詞 house (房子)","related":[]}}

{"headword":"lightning","explanation":"「lightning」在學測中主要出現在自然災害或科學類文章中。需注意它與 light (光) 及 lighten (使變輕/亮) 的拼寫區別，且通常作為不可數名詞使用。","senses":[{"sense":"閃電","entries":[{"pattern":"lightning","pos":"noun","translation":"閃電","explanation":"指雷雨期間天空出現的電光。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The sudden flash of <target>lightning</target> lit up the dark sky for a second before the loud sound of thunder followed.","translation":"突然的一道閃電在雷聲響起前，將漆黑的天空照亮了一秒鐘。"},{"sentence":"Farmers are often warned to stay inside their homes during a storm because <target>lightning</target> can strike tall trees or metal poles.","translation":"農民在風暴期間經常被警告要留在家中，因為閃電可能會擊中高大的樹木或金屬桿。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"源自動詞 lighten (使亮)，加上名詞字尾 -ing","related":[{"word":"lighten","pos":"verb","translation":"使變輕；使變亮","explanation":"指降低重量或改善心情"}]}}

{"headword":"lily","explanation":"「lily」是基礎植物類名詞，在文學描寫或自然環境類文章中較為常見，常用於象徵純潔（purity）。","senses":[{"sense":"百合花","entries":[{"pattern":"lily","pos":"noun","translation":"百合花","explanation":"一種具有強烈香味且花瓣大型的植物。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The gardener planted several white <target>lilies</target> along the garden path to make the entrance look more elegant and fresh.","translation":"園丁沿著花園小徑種了幾株白色百合花，使入口看起來更優雅且清新。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"limb","explanation":"「limb」在學測中具有雙重語意：一是生物學上的「肢體」（手臂或腿），二是植物學上的「大樹枝」。在閱讀測驗中，學生應根據上下文決定其具體指代對象。","senses":[{"sense":"肢體（手臂或腿）","entries":[{"pattern":"limb","pos":"noun","translation":"肢體","explanation":"指人或動物的身體部位，如手臂或腿。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After the terrible car accident, the young man had to undergo a long recovery to regain movement in his left <target>limb</target>.","translation":"在那場可怕的車禍後，這位年輕人必須經歷長期的恢復，才能恢復左肢的活動能力。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"extremity","pos":"noun","translation":"肢體末端","explanation":"較正式的醫學用詞"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"大樹枝","entries":[{"pattern":"limb","pos":"noun","translation":"大樹枝","explanation":"指從主幹分出的較粗的樹枝。","sentences":[{"sentence":"During the heavy snowstorm, a thick <target>limb</target> of the old maple tree broke off and fell onto the garage roof.","translation":"在強烈的雪災中，老楓樹的一根粗樹枝斷裂並掉落在車庫屋頂上。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"branch","pos":"noun","translation":"樹枝","explanation":"泛指所有大小的樹枝"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"litter","explanation":"「litter」在學測中具有名詞與動詞兩種截然不同的核心用法。名詞時可指「隨處丟棄的垃圾」或「一胎所生的小動物」，動詞時則指「亂丟垃圾」或「使雜亂」。考生需根據上下文判斷是環境議題（垃圾）還是自然生物（動物）情境。","senses":[{"sense":"垃圾；廢棄物（隨意丟棄在公共場所的物品）","entries":[{"pattern":"litter","pos":"noun","translation":"垃圾；廢棄物","explanation":"指隨意丟棄在街道、公園或海灘上的垃圾，與 trash 或 garbage 不同，強調的是「丟棄」這個動作後的狀態。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After the big music festival, the park was filled with <target>litter</target> like plastic bottles and food wrappers, which upset many environmentalists.","translation":"在大型音樂祭結束後，公園裡到處都是塑膠瓶和食物包裝紙等垃圾，這讓許多環保人士感到不快。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"trash","pos":"noun","translation":"垃圾","explanation":"泛指所有廢棄物"},{"word":"debris","pos":"noun","translation":"碎片；殘骸","explanation":"指破碎的物品或建築殘骸"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"一胎所生的小動物","entries":[{"pattern":"a litter of...","pos":"noun","translation":"一胎所生的…","explanation":"用於描述貓、狗、豬等動物一次生產的後代數量。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The rescue center was happy to announce that the stray cat had a <target>litter</target> <pattern>of</pattern> five healthy kittens last week.","translation":"救援中心很高興地宣布，那隻流浪貓上週生了一胎五隻健康的小貓。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"亂丟垃圾；使雜亂","entries":[{"pattern":"litter (sth.)","pos":"verb","translation":"亂丟垃圾；使雜亂","explanation":"可作為及物或不及物動詞。及物時指將某物隨處丟棄，或使某個空間被垃圾填滿。","sentences":[{"sentence":"It is illegal to <target>litter</target> in the national park, and anyone who does so will be forced to pay a heavy fine.","translation":"在國家公園內亂丟垃圾是違法的，任何這樣做的人都將被強迫支付高額罰金。"},{"sentence":"The storm was so strong that it <target>littered</target> the entire beach <pattern>with</pattern> broken branches and fallen leaves.","translation":"暴風雨如此強烈，以至於將整個海灘填滿了斷掉的樹枝和落葉。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"scatter","pos":"verb","translation":"散布；撒","explanation":"強調將東西散落在各處"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"littered","past_participle":"littered"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"lively","explanation":"「lively」是一個常見的形容詞，用來描述人、氣氛或場所的動態感。在閱讀測驗中，常出現在描述城市街道、聚會或性格開朗的人員時使用。注意它雖然以 -ly 結尾，但它是形容詞而非副詞。","senses":[{"sense":"活潑的；充滿活力的","entries":[{"pattern":"lively","pos":"adjective","translation":"活潑的；充滿活力的","explanation":"描述人性格開朗、好動，或描述場所、討論、音樂充滿能量與活力。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The small town becomes very <target>lively</target> during the summer, as many tourists visit the local markets to buy handmade crafts.","translation":"這個小鎮在夏天變得非常熱鬧，因為許多遊客造訪當地市場購買手工藝品。"},{"sentence":"The teacher appreciated the <target>lively</target> discussion in class, as students shared different ideas and debated the topic with great energy.","translation":"老師很讚賞課堂上活潑的討論，因為學生們分享了不同的想法並以極大的能量對該主題進行辯論。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"energetic","pos":"adjective","translation":"精力充沛的","explanation":"強調體力或精神上的活力"},{"word":"vibrant","pos":"adjective","translation":"充滿活力的；鮮豔的","explanation":"常用於描述城市、文化或色彩"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"dull","pos":"adjective","translation":"乏味的；沉悶的","explanation":null},{"word":"lifeless","pos":"adjective","translation":"毫無生氣的","explanation":null}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"loaf","explanation":"「loaf」在學測中主要作為名詞（指麵包）或動詞（指偷懶）。名詞用法極其簡單，但動詞用法在克漏字或閱讀中可能成為陷阱，因為其含義與名詞完全不同。","senses":[{"sense":"麵包（一條、一塊）","entries":[{"pattern":"a loaf of...","pos":"noun","translation":"一條/塊…（麵包）","explanation":"loaf 是麵包的量詞，通常指未切片的整條麵包。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The baker spent the whole morning preparing a fresh <target>loaf</target> <pattern>of</pattern> white bread for the local village market.","translation":"麵包師花了一整個早晨準備一條新鮮的白麵包，準備提供給當地村莊的市場。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"偷懶；遊蕩","entries":[{"pattern":"loaf around","pos":"verb","translation":"遊蕩；偷懶","explanation":"常用於描述人在沒有目的或沒有工作地閒逛或虛度光陰。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Instead of studying for the final exam, the boy decided to <target>loaf</target> <pattern>around</pattern> the living room all afternoon.","translation":"這個男孩決定整個下午在客廳裡偷懶遊蕩，而不是準備期末考。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"idle","pos":"verb","translation":"閒著；懶散","explanation":"強調不工作或不活動"},{"word":"loiter","pos":"verb","translation":"閒逛；逗留","explanation":"常用於法律或保安警告，指在某處無目的逗留"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"work","pos":"verb","translation":"工作","explanation":null}]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"loafed","past_participle":"loafed"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"lobby","explanation":"「lobby」在學測中具有兩種完全不同的語意：一是空間上的「大廳」，二是政治上的「遊說」。考生在閱讀中應能快速分辨這兩個含義，特別是在社會科學或政治類文章中。","senses":[{"sense":"大廳；門廳","entries":[{"pattern":"lobby","pos":"noun","translation":"大廳；門廳","explanation":"指飯店、劇院、辦公大樓等公共建築的入口處大廳。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The hotel guest waited in the <target>lobby</target> for an hour, reading a magazine while waiting for his taxi to arrive.","translation":"飯店客人在大廳等了一個小時，在等待計程車到達時閱讀一本雜誌。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"hall","pos":"noun","translation":"走廊；大廳","explanation":"泛指進入建築物後的走廊或空間"},{"word":"entrance","pos":"noun","translation":"入口","explanation":null}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"遊說；影響（試圖影響政府決定）","entries":[{"pattern":"lobby for sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"為…而遊說","explanation":"指透過與政客或官員溝通，試圖影響政策或法律的制定。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Environmental groups began to <target>lobby</target> <pattern>for</pattern> stricter laws to protect the endangered animals in the tropical rainforest.","translation":"環保組織開始為制定更嚴格的法律以保護熱帶雨林中的瀕危動物而遊說。"}]},{"pattern":"lobby the government","pos":"verb","translation":"遊說政府","explanation":"及物動詞，直接接對象，指對政客或官員施壓以達成目的。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Big tech companies often <target>lobby</target> the government to ensure that their new products are not affected by high taxes.","translation":"大型科技公司經常遊說政府，以確保他們的新產品不會受到高稅金的影響。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"persuade","pos":"verb","translation":"說服","explanation":"泛指說服他人接受某種想法"},{"word":"influence","pos":"verb","translation":"影響","explanation":"指對他人決定造成影響"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"lobbied","past_participle":"lobbied"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"lock","explanation":"「lock」在學測中既可作為具體的「鎖」，也可作為動詞表示「鎖上」或「鎖定」。在較高階的閱讀中，lock-in 亦可用於描述某種固定不變的狀態。","senses":[{"sense":"鎖（用於關閉門窗或保護財產的裝置）","entries":[{"pattern":"lock","pos":"noun","translation":"鎖","explanation":"指用鑰匙或密碼開啟的物理裝置。","sentences":[{"sentence":"I forgot to put a <target>lock</target> on my bicycle, and someone stole it while I was buying a drink.","translation":"我忘了在我的自行車上上鎖，結果我在買飲料時它被偷走了。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"鎖上；鎖定（使無法開啟或固定在某位置）","entries":[{"pattern":"lock sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"將某物鎖上","explanation":"及物動詞，指使用鎖將門或箱子關閉。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Please remember to <target>lock</target> the front door <pattern>before</pattern> you leave the house for school in the morning.","translation":"請記得在早晨出門上學前將前門鎖上。"}]},{"pattern":"be locked in / out","pos":"verb","translation":"被鎖在裡面／被鎖在外面","explanation":"被動形式，描述因門被鎖而無法進出的窘境。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The poor student was <target>locked</target> <pattern>out</pattern> of his dormitory because he accidentally left his key inside the room.","translation":"那個可憐的學生被鎖在宿舍外面，因為他不小心把鑰匙留在房間裡了。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"fasten","pos":"verb","translation":"繫緊；固定","explanation":"較廣義的固定動作"},{"word":"secure","pos":"verb","translation":"使安全；固定","explanation":"強調確保安全而鎖定"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"unlock","pos":"verb","translation":"解鎖；開啟","explanation":"將鎖打開"}]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"locked","past_participle":"locked"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"locker","pos":"noun","translation":"儲物櫃","explanation":"由 lock 加上 -er (物) 構成，常見於學校場景。"},{"word":"locksmith","pos":"noun","translation":"鎖匠","explanation":"lock (鎖) + smith (工匠)。"}]}}

{"headword":"log","explanation":"「log」在學測中具有兩極化的意義：一是自然類文章中的「原木」，二是科技與行政類文章中的「紀錄/登入」。後者在數位時代的閱讀測驗中極為高頻。","senses":[{"sense":"原木；圓木（砍伐後未加工的樹幹）","entries":[{"pattern":"log","pos":"noun","translation":"原木","explanation":"指砍掉後去掉分枝的樹幹。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The heavy <target>log</target> rolled down the hill and crashed into the river, floating slowly toward the ocean.","translation":"沉重的原木從山上滾下並撞入河中，緩慢地向大海漂流。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"紀錄；日誌（對事件的詳細按時間順序之記錄）","entries":[{"pattern":"keep a log (of sth.)","pos":"noun","translation":"記錄…的日誌","explanation":"指定期記錄活動或數據的行為。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The scientist decided to keep a detailed <target>log</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the plant's growth to see how it reacted to different light.","translation":"科學家決定詳細記錄這株植物生長的日誌，以觀察它對不同光線的反應。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"record","pos":"noun","translation":"紀錄","explanation":"最普遍的替代詞"},{"word":"journal","pos":"noun","translation":"日誌；期刊","explanation":"較正式的個人或專業紀錄"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"登入；記錄（將資訊輸入電腦系統）","entries":[{"pattern":"log in / on (to sth.)","pos":"verb","translation":"登入（系統）","explanation":"指輸入帳號密碼進入數位平台。","sentences":[{"sentence":"You must <target>log</target> <pattern>in</pattern> to the school website using your student ID to check your final exam grades.","translation":"你必須使用學生證號碼登入學校網站來查詢你的期末考成績。"}]},{"pattern":"log out / off","pos":"verb","translation":"登出","explanation":"結束系統使用狀態。","sentences":[{"sentence":"For your own security, always <target>log</target> <pattern>out</pattern> of your email account when using a public computer in the library.","translation":"為了你的安全，在圖書館使用公共電腦時，請務必登出你的電子郵件帳號。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"logged","past_participle":"logged"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"logger","pos":"noun","translation":"伐木工","explanation":"指砍伐原木的人。"},{"word":"logging","pos":"noun","translation":"伐木業；登錄","explanation":"可指砍樹或在電腦中紀錄。"}]}}

{"headword":"lollipop","explanation":"「lollipop」屬於基礎生活詞彙，在學測中較少作為考點，但常出現在情境對話或輕鬆的閱讀文章中。","senses":[{"sense":"棒棒糖","entries":[{"pattern":"lollipop","pos":"noun","translation":"棒棒糖","explanation":"指固定在小棍子上的硬糖。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The little girl was very happy when her father bought her a bright red <target>lollipop</target> from the candy store.","translation":"當父親在糖果店給她買了一根鮮紅色的棒棒糖時，那個小女孩非常開心。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"loose","explanation":"「loose」在學測中常與 lose (失去) 混淆。需明確區分 loose 是形容詞 (鬆的)，而 lose 是動詞 (失去/輸掉)。此外，它可用於描述衣服寬鬆或控制不嚴的情況。","senses":[{"sense":"鬆的；寬鬆的（未緊固或尺寸過大的）","entries":[{"pattern":"loose clothing","pos":"adjective","translation":"寬鬆的衣服","explanation":"指衣服尺寸比身體大，穿起來不緊繃。","sentences":[{"sentence":"During the hot summer, many people prefer to wear <target>loose</target> clothing to keep themselves cool and comfortable.","translation":"在炎熱的夏天，許多人偏好穿寬鬆的衣服以保持涼爽與舒適。"}]},{"pattern":"come loose","pos":"adjective","translation":"鬆脫","explanation":"指原本固定好的東西變得不緊了。","sentences":[{"sentence":"While he was running fast in the race, the lace of his left shoe <pattern>came</pattern> <target>loose</target>, almost causing him to fall.","translation":"在他賽跑快速奔跑時，他左腳的鞋帶鬆脫了，幾乎導致他跌倒。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"baggy","pos":"adjective","translation":"寬大的","explanation":"特別指衣服過大而下垂"},{"word":"slack","pos":"adjective","translation":"鬆弛的","explanation":"指繩索或肌肉不緊繃"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"tight","pos":"adjective","translation":"緊的","explanation":"尺寸過小或固定很牢"}]},{"sense":"不被拘束的；逃脫的（指動物或囚犯脫離控制）","entries":[{"pattern":"get loose","pos":"adjective","translation":"逃脫；掙脫","explanation":"指從束縛或籠子中脫離。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The zoo staff were very worried when a small monkey <pattern>got</pattern> <target>loose</target> and started climbing the visitors' umbrellas.","translation":"當一隻小猴子逃脫並開始爬訪客的雨傘時，動物園的工作人員非常擔心。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"free","pos":"adjective","translation":"自由的；不受限制的","explanation":"指沒有被關住"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"confined","pos":"adjective","translation":"受限的；被禁閉的","explanation":"指被關在狹小空間內"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"loosen","pos":"verb","translation":"放鬆；使鬆開","explanation":"由形容詞 loose 加上動詞字尾 -en 構成。"}]}}

{"headword":"lord","explanation":"「lord」在學測中主要出現在文學作品、歷史背景閱讀或關於貴族制度的文本中。現代用法中，它可以用來指稱擁有權力的統治者，或是宗教語境中的「主」。","senses":[{"sense":"領主；貴族（擁有土地、權力或地位的統治者）","entries":[{"pattern":"lord","pos":"noun","translation":"領主；貴族","explanation":"指在封建制度下擁有土地並對農民擁有管轄權的人。","sentences":[{"sentence":"In the old story, the poor farmers had to give a part of their crops to the local <target>lord</target> every year.","translation":"在那個古老的故事中，貧苦的農民每年必須將部分作物上繳給當地的領主。"},{"sentence":"The young man spent years studying law and politics to eventually earn a title and become a powerful <target>lord</target> in the royal court.","translation":"這個年輕人花了多年時間學習法律和政治，最終獲得了頭銜並成為宮廷中一位權勢顯赫的貴族。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"noble","pos":"noun","translation":"貴族","explanation":"泛指具有高貴血統或社會地位的人"},{"word":"aristocrat","pos":"noun","translation":"貴族","explanation":"強調社會階級中的頂層"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"peasant","pos":"noun","translation":"農民；平民","explanation":"封建制度下的底層階級"},{"word":"commoner","pos":"noun","translation":"平民","explanation":"沒有貴族頭銜的人"}]},{"sense":"主；上帝（宗教語境中的最高權威）","entries":[{"pattern":"the Lord","pos":"noun","translation":"主；上帝","explanation":"在宗教文本中，Lord 通常大寫，指代上帝或耶穌基督。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many people find peace and strength by praying to the <target>Lord</target> during the most difficult moments of their lives.","translation":"許多人在生命中最艱難的時刻透過向主禱告來尋找平安與力量。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"lordship","pos":"noun","translation":"領主地位；權威","explanation":"由 lord 加上狀態名詞字尾 -ship 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"loser","explanation":"「loser」在日常口語及社會心理類文本中常見。它不僅指競賽中的「失敗者」，在現代俚語中也常用來形容一個人缺乏社交能力或生活不成功的人。","senses":[{"sense":"失敗者（競賽、遊戲或爭議中的輸家）","entries":[{"pattern":"loser","pos":"noun","translation":"失敗者","explanation":"指在某場具體競賽中輸掉的人。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Although he was the <target>loser</target> of the tennis match, he shook hands with the winner and praised his opponent's skill.","translation":"雖然他是這場網球賽的失敗者，但他與贏家握手並稱讚對手的技巧。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"the defeated","pos":"noun","translation":"被擊敗者","explanation":"較正式的說法，指被擊敗的一方"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"winner","pos":"noun","translation":"贏家","explanation":null}]},{"sense":"沒出息的人（社交或生活上的失敗者）","entries":[{"pattern":"a loser","pos":"noun","translation":"沒出息的人；廢物","explanation":"用來羞辱或批評一個人沒有目標、沒有成就或不受歡迎。","sentences":[{"sentence":"In the movie, the main character was treated as a <target>loser</target> by his classmates because he had no friends and loved strange hobbies.","translation":"在電影中，主角因為沒有朋友且喜愛奇怪的嗜好，而被同學們視為一個沒出息的人。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"failure","pos":"noun","translation":"失敗的人","explanation":"指在人生目標上未能成功的人"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"success","pos":"noun","translation":"成功人士","explanation":null}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"動詞 lose 加上名詞字尾 -er (執行者)","related":[{"word":"lose","pos":"verb","translation":"失去；輸掉","explanation":"核心基礎動詞。"},{"word":"loss","pos":"noun","translation":"損失；失去","explanation":"指失去某物或某人的狀態。"}]}}

{"headword":"lover","explanation":"「lover」在文學或情感類文本中出現。學生應注意其含義從單純的「愛好者」到「親密關係」的區別。","senses":[{"sense":"愛好者（對某事物有強烈熱愛的人）","entries":[{"pattern":"a lover of sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"…的愛好者","explanation":"指對藝術、音樂、自然等事物有深厚興趣的人。這是學測中較為常見且安全的用法。","sentences":[{"sentence":"As a lifelong <target>lover</target> <pattern>of</pattern> classical music, the old professor spent every weekend visiting different opera houses.","translation":"作為一名終身的古典音樂愛好者，這位老教授每個週末都會造訪不同的歌劇院。"},{"sentence":"She is a true <target>lover</target> <pattern>of</pattern> nature, and she often spends her free time hiking in the mountains to see the wild flowers.","translation":"她是個真正的自然愛好者，經常在空閒時間去山中健行以欣賞野花。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"enthusiast","pos":"noun","translation":"熱衷者；愛好者","explanation":"強調對某事物的強烈熱情"},{"word":"fan","pos":"noun","translation":"粉絲；愛好者","explanation":"較口語的說法"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"情人；愛人（具有親密關係的人）","entries":[{"pattern":"lovers","pos":"noun","translation":"情人；愛人","explanation":"指在浪漫關係中的兩個人。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The story describes two young <target>lovers</target> who were separated by a great war but eventually found each other again after ten years.","translation":"故事描述了兩個年輕的情人，他們被一場巨大的戰爭分開，但最終在十年後再次找到了彼此。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"動詞 love 加上名詞字尾 -er (執行者)","related":[{"word":"love","pos":"verb","translation":"愛；喜愛","explanation":"核心基礎動詞。"},{"word":"lovely","pos":"adjective","translation":"可愛的；美好的","explanation":"由 love 延伸而來的形容詞。"}]}}

{"headword":"luggage","explanation":"「luggage」是學測中極其重要的語法考點：它是一個不可數名詞。學生經常在寫作中錯誤地將其加 s 或使用 a luggage，必須強調其不可數特性。","senses":[{"sense":"行李（旅行時攜帶的箱子與物品）","entries":[{"pattern":"luggage","pos":"noun","translation":"行李","explanation":"不可數名詞。若要表達「一件行李」，必須使用 a piece of luggage。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After the long flight from New York, the tired travelers waited for their <target>luggage</target> to come out on the conveyor belt.","translation":"從紐約飛來的長途航班後，疲憊的旅客們在輸送帶上等待他們的行李出來。"},{"sentence":"Because the <target>luggage</target> was too heavy for the young girl to carry, her father helped her move the large suitcase to the hotel room.","translation":"因為行李對這個小女孩來說太重而無法攜帶，她的父親幫她將大行李箱搬到飯店房間。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"baggage","pos":"noun","translation":"行李","explanation":"同樣為不可數名詞，與 luggage 通用"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"bag","pos":"noun","translation":"袋子；行李箱","explanation":"可數名詞，指單個的行李袋。"}]}}

{"headword":"lung","explanation":"「lung」在生物類或健康類閱讀測驗中是基礎名詞。通常與呼吸系統及空氣污染等主題相關。","senses":[{"sense":"肺","entries":[{"pattern":"lung","pos":"noun","translation":"肺","explanation":"指人類或動物的呼吸器官。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Doctors warn that smoking cigarettes for many years can severely damage the <target>lungs</target> and make it difficult for people to breathe.","translation":"醫生警告說，吸菸多年會嚴重損害肺部，並使人們呼吸困難。"},{"sentence":"The deep breath of fresh air in the mountains filled her <target>lungs</target> with oxygen, making her feel refreshed and energetic again.","translation":"山中新鮮的空氣深深地填滿了她的肺，讓她感到再次恢復活力且充滿能量。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"magician","explanation":"「magician」在學測中主要指代執行魔術表演者的表演者，也可以在文學作品中指代擁有超自然力量的人。","senses":[{"sense":"魔術師；表演者","entries":[{"pattern":"magician","pos":"noun","translation":"魔術師","explanation":"指在舞台上透過技巧技巧地表演魔術的人。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The <target>magician</target> amazed the audience by making a white rabbit suddenly appear out of his black top hat.","translation":"那名魔術師透過讓一隻白兔突然從他的黑色高頂禮帽中出現，讓觀眾感到驚訝。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"illusionist","pos":"noun","translation":"幻術師","explanation":"強調使用幻覺技巧的表演者"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"名詞 magic 加上表示人的字尾 -ian","related":[{"word":"magic","pos":"adjective","translation":"魔術的；神奇的","explanation":"可用作形容詞修飾名詞。"},{"word":"magical","pos":"adjective","translation":"神奇的；迷人的","explanation":"由 magic 延伸而來的形容詞。"}]}}

{"headword":"magnet","explanation":"「magnet」在學測中既可指物理學上的「磁鐵」，也可比喻地指代「吸引人的事物或地點」，後者在閱讀測驗中常出現在描述觀光業或文化中心時。","senses":[{"sense":"磁鐵（物理實體）","entries":[{"pattern":"magnet","pos":"noun","translation":"磁鐵","explanation":"指具有磁性的物體，常用於科學類文章中。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The science teacher used a strong <target>magnet</target> to show the students how iron filings move around a magnetic field.","translation":"科學老師使用一個強力的磁鐵向學生展示鐵屑是如何在磁場中移動的。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"吸引力強的事物或地點（比喻用法）","entries":[{"pattern":"a magnet for sth./sb.","pos":"noun","translation":"吸引…的中心；…的磁鐵","explanation":"比喻某地或某物具有極強的吸引力，使許多人或事物被吸引而來。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The new shopping mall, with its luxury stores and great food, has become a <target>magnet</target> <pattern>for</pattern> teenagers in the city.","translation":"這座新的購物中心憑藉著豪華商店和美食，已成為城市中青少年的吸引中心。"},{"sentence":"Because of its beautiful beaches and warm weather, the island is a huge <target>magnet</target> <pattern>for</pattern> international tourists every summer.","translation":"因為美麗的海灘和溫暖的天氣，這個島嶼在每年夏天都是國際遊客的強大吸引中心。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"attraction","pos":"noun","translation":"吸引物","explanation":"泛指吸引人的東西"},{"word":"draw","pos":"noun","translation":"吸引力","explanation":"指能吸引人們前來的事物"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"magnetic","pos":"adjective","translation":"有磁性的；有吸引力的","explanation":"由 magnet 延伸而來的形容詞。"},{"word":"magnetize","pos":"verb","translation":"磁化","explanation":"由 magnet 加上動詞字尾 -ize 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"maid","explanation":"「maid」在學測中通常指代在飯店或私人住宅中負責清潔工作的人員，在閱讀測驗中常出現在家庭或歷史背景的敘事文中。","senses":[{"sense":"女僕；清潔員","entries":[{"pattern":"maid","pos":"noun","translation":"女僕；清潔員","explanation":"指在私人住宅或飯店中工作的女性清潔員。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The hotel <target>maid</target> comes to clean the room and change the towels every morning while the guests are at breakfast.","translation":"飯店的女僕在客人吃早餐時，每天早上都會來清理房間並更換毛巾。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"housekeeper","pos":"noun","translation":"管家；房屋管理員","explanation":"指負責管理房屋清潔與維護的人"},{"word":"cleaner","pos":"noun","translation":"清潔員","explanation":"t-pos: noun, translation: 清潔員"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"majority","explanation":"「majority」在學測中是極其高頻的量化描述詞。它通常用於描述數據、投票結果或人群的組成。學生應特別注意其後方接續的名詞（如 majority of the students）以及其動詞一致性（主詞為 majority of + 複數名詞時，動詞通常用複數）。","senses":[{"sense":"大多數；大部分","entries":[{"pattern":"the majority of sth./sb.","pos":"noun","translation":"大多數的…","explanation":"最常見的搭配，用來描述一個群體中大部分的人或事物。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The <target>majority</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the students in our class decided to go to the museum instead of staying in the classroom.","translation":"我們班上的大多數學生決定去博物館而不是留在教室裡。"},{"sentence":"In the recent survey, the <target>majority</target> <pattern>of</pattern> local residents strongly agreed that the city should build more public parks.","translation":"在最近的調查中，大多數的當地居民強烈同意城市應該建造更多公共公園。"}]},{"pattern":"in the majority","pos":"noun","translation":"佔大多數","explanation":"指某個想法或意見在群體中中佔據主導地位。","sentences":[{"sentence":"People who believe that digital learning is more effective than traditional classrooms are now <pattern>in</pattern> the <target>majority</target>.","translation":"認為數位學習比傳統教室更有效的人現在佔了大多數。"}]},{"pattern":"a vast majority","pos":"noun","translation":"絕大多數","explanation":"用 vast 加上來強化語氣，指幾乎所有人。","sentences":[{"sentence":"A <target>vast</target> <target>majority</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the farmers in this village have already switched to organic farming to protect the environment.","translation":"這個村莊中絕大多數的農民已經轉向有機耕作以保護環境。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"bulk","pos":"noun","translation":"大部分","explanation":"指物體或群體的絕大部分"},{"word":"most","pos":"noun","translation":"大多數","explanation":"常用於形容詞或代名詞功能"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"minority","pos":"noun","translation":"少數","explanation":"直接對立的量化詞"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"形容詞 major (主要的) 加上名詞字尾 -ity","related":[{"word":"major","pos":"adjective","translation":"主要的；重大的","explanation":"核心基礎形容詞。"},{"word":"minor","pos":"noun","translation":"次要的；未成年人","explanation":"major 的反義詞。"}]}}

{"headword":"mall","explanation":"「mall」在現代英文中主要指大型購物中心。在學測閱讀中，常出現於討論消費主義、城市規劃或青少年社交生活的文章中。注意區分它與單純的 shop 或 store 的規模差異。","senses":[{"sense":"大型購物中心；商場","entries":[{"pattern":"shopping mall","pos":"noun","translation":"購物商場","explanation":"最常見的固定搭配，指將許多商店、餐廳和娛樂設施集中在一個大型室內空間的建築。","sentences":[{"sentence":"During the weekend, many teenagers gather at the local <pattern>shopping</pattern> <target>mall</target> to watch movies and hang out with their friends.","translation":"週末期間，許多青少年聚集在當地的購物商場看電影並與朋友聚會。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"mall","pos":"noun","translation":"散步道","explanation":"早期定義指有樹木遮蔽的步行街道。"}]}}

{"headword":"mankind","explanation":"「mankind」與「humankind」在學測中常被用來泛指「全人類」。在探討環境問題、科技倫理或歷史演進的論說文中極為高頻。現代英文趨向於使用中性的 humankind 以避免性別偏向。","senses":[{"sense":"人類；全人類","entries":[{"pattern":"mankind / humankind","pos":"noun","translation":"人類","explanation":"作為不可數名詞，泛指地球上所有的人類。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The discovery of fire was a huge step for <target>mankind</target>, as it allowed early humans to cook food and stay warm during winter.","translation":"火的發現對全人類來說是一個巨大的進步，因為它讓早期人類能夠烹飪食物並在冬季保持溫暖。"},{"sentence":"Climate change poses a serious threat to <target>humankind</target>, forcing us to find new ways to protect our planet from getting hotter.","translation":"氣候變遷對全人類構成了嚴重的威脅，迫使我們尋找新方法來防止我們的地球變得更熱。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 human (人) + 名詞字尾 -kind (種類)","related":[{"word":"humanity","pos":"noun","translation":"人類；人性","explanation":"強調人類這個物種的整體或其具備的同情心。"},{"word":"humane","pos":"adjective","translation":"仁慈的；人道的","explanation":"指對人或動物展現出同情與善良。"}]}}

{"headword":"marble","explanation":"「marble」在學測中主要有兩種語境：一是作為物質名詞指「大理石」，常用於藝術、建築或雕刻描述；二是作為可數名詞指「彈珠」。在閱讀測驗中，重點在於根據上下文判斷其具體指涉。","senses":[{"sense":"大理石","entries":[{"pattern":"marble","pos":"noun","translation":"大理石","explanation":"不可數名詞，常用於描述昂貴的建築物或藝術品的外觀。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The ancient Greek temple was built with white <target>marble</target>, making the building look elegant and bright under the sun.","translation":"那座古希臘神廟是用白色大理石建造的，使得建築在陽光下看起來優雅且明亮。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"march","explanation":"「march」在學測中兼具名詞與動詞用法。動詞用法強調「有規律的行進」或「穩定前進」；名詞用法則常出現在社會運動（如抗議遊行）或時間概念（三月）中。需注意其發音與語意區分。","senses":[{"sense":"行軍；遊行（有規律的行走方式）","entries":[{"pattern":"march","pos":"verb","translation":"行軍；遊行","explanation":"指像士兵一樣步伐統一地行走，或為了表達訴求而集體行走。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Thousands of people <target>marched</target> through the city streets to protest against the new law and demand their basic rights.","translation":"數千人走上城市街道遊行，以抗議新法律並要求其基本權利。"},{"sentence":"The soldiers <target>marched</target> in perfect rhythm to the sound of the drums, showing their discipline and strength.","translation":"士兵們隨著鼓聲以完美的節奏行軍，展現出他們的紀律與力量。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"marched","past_participle":"marched"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"march","pos":"noun","translation":"三月","explanation":"月份名稱，首字母須大寫。"}]}}

{"headword":"marker","explanation":"「marker」在學測中主要有兩種含義：一是具體的「標記物/記號筆」，二是抽象的「指標/標誌」。在描述實驗過程、學習習慣或社會趨勢時經常出現。","senses":[{"sense":"記號筆；標記","entries":[{"pattern":"marker","pos":"noun","translation":"記號筆；標記","explanation":"指用來在白板或紙上做標記的工具，或是在地圖上標記位置的記號。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The teacher used a red <target>marker</target> to circle the most important words on the white board for the students to remember.","translation":"老師用一支紅色的記號筆在白板上重要字詞上圈起來，好讓學生們記得。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"動詞 mark (標記) + 名詞字尾 -er (物)","related":[{"word":"mark","pos":"verb","translation":"標記；打分","explanation":"基礎動詞形式。"},{"word":"landmark","pos":"noun","translation":"地標；里程碑","explanation":"指一個容易辨識的地理位置或重要的歷史轉折點。"}]}}

{"headword":"marvelous","explanation":"「marvelous」用於表達強烈的讚嘆，語氣比 simple 的 good 或 great 更強。在學測作文中，可用於描述令人驚嘆的風景、卓越的表現或完美的計畫，增加詞彙的豐富度。","senses":[{"sense":"極好的；令人驚嘆的（強調品質極高或令人驚訝）","entries":[{"pattern":"marvelous sth.","pos":"adjective","translation":"極好的…；絕佳的…","explanation":"直接修飾名詞，用以強調該事物在視覺、聽覺或整體感受上令人讚嘆。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The young artist spent three months painting the scenery, and the final result was a <target>marvelous</target> masterpiece of light and color.","translation":"這位年輕藝術家花了三個月繪製風景，最終的結果是一幅光影與色彩絕佳的傑作。"},{"sentence":"After weeks of hard training, the school choir gave a <target>marvelous</target> performance that earned a standing ovation from the entire audience.","translation":"經過數週的刻苦訓練，學校合唱團帶來了一場極好的演出，贏得了全場觀眾的起立鼓掌。"}]},{"pattern":"It is marvelous that...","pos":"adjective","translation":"令人驚嘆的是…","explanation":"作為主詞補語，後接 that 子句，用來表達對某種事實或情況的強烈讚賞。","sentences":[{"sentence":"It is <target>marvelous</target> <pattern>that</pattern> the local community worked together to turn the abandoned wasteland into a beautiful public park.","translation":"令人驚嘆的是，當地社區共同努力將廢棄的荒地變成了一個美麗的公共公園。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"wonderful","pos":"adjective","translation":"精彩的；絕佳的","explanation":"最普遍的同義詞，強調帶給人愉悅感"},{"word":"extraordinary","pos":"adjective","translation":"非凡的；卓越的","explanation":"強調超出尋常，具有特殊之處"},{"word":"splendid","pos":"adjective","translation":"極好的；壯麗的","explanation":"常用於描述建築、風景或正式的盛況"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"terrible","pos":"adjective","translation":"糟糕的","explanation":null},{"word":"ordinary","pos":"adjective","translation":"平凡的","explanation":null}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"名詞 marvel (奇蹟) + 形容詞字尾 -ous","related":[{"word":"marvel","pos":"noun","translation":"奇蹟；令人驚嘆的人或事","explanation":"核心名詞形式。"},{"word":"marvel","pos":"verb","translation":"驚嘆；讚嘆","explanation":"指對某事感到驚訝且讚賞。"}]}}

{"headword":"mathematical","explanation":"「mathematical」主要出現在學術類文章中，用來描述邏輯嚴謹、基於計算或屬於數學範疇的事物。注意它與 math (口語) 的區別，在正式寫作中應使用此完整形式。","senses":[{"sense":"數學的；基於數學計算的","entries":[{"pattern":"mathematical sth.","pos":"adjective","translation":"數學上的…","explanation":"修飾名詞，指與數學原理、公式或計算相關的事物。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The professor used a complex <target>mathematical</target> formula to calculate the exact speed at which the rocket would enter the atmosphere.","translation":"教授使用了一個複雜的數學公式來計算火箭進入大氣層的確切速度。"},{"sentence":"Students often struggle with <target>mathematical</target> logic because it requires a high level of abstract thinking and extreme precision.","translation":"學生經常在數學邏輯上感到困難，因為它需要高度的抽象思考能力和極高的精確度。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"numerical","pos":"adjective","translation":"數字的","explanation":"強調與數字本身的操作相關"},{"word":"calculable","pos":"adjective","translation":"可計算的","explanation":"指可以用數學方式算出結果的"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"名詞 mathematics (數學) + 形容詞字尾 -al","related":[{"word":"mathematician","pos":"noun","translation":"數學家","explanation":"指專業從事數學研究的人。"},{"word":"mathematics","pos":"noun","translation":"數學","explanation":"學科名稱，通常視為單數。"}]}}

{"headword":"mayor","explanation":"「mayor」是描述城市治理、地方政治或社區活動時的核心名詞。在閱讀測驗中，常與 city hall (市政廳) 或 election (選舉) 等詞彙共同出現。","senses":[{"sense":"市長（城市的最高行政長官）","entries":[{"pattern":"the mayor of sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"…的市長","explanation":"用來明確指出該市長所管轄的城市或地區。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The <target>mayor</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the small coastal town announced a new plan to protect the beaches from rising sea levels.","translation":"這座沿海小鎮的市長宣布了一項保護海灘免受海平面上升影響的新計畫。"},{"sentence":"During the town hall meeting, the <target>mayor</target> listened carefully to the complaints of citizens regarding the poor road conditions.","translation":"在市政會議期間，市長仔細聆聽了市民關於道路狀況糟糕的抱怨。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"governor","pos":"noun","translation":"州長","explanation":"管理範圍比市長更大的行政長官"},{"word":"leader","pos":"noun","translation":"領導者","explanation":"泛指任何組織或地區的帶領者"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"meadow","explanation":"「meadow」常出現在文學描寫或自然生態類文章中。它指的是一片長滿草的開闊地，與 field (農田/原野) 不同，meadow 通常帶有更自然、更具美感的意象。","senses":[{"sense":"草地；牧場（通常指自然生長的草地）","entries":[{"pattern":"meadow","pos":"noun","translation":"草地","explanation":"指一片開闊的、長滿野草或花卉的自然區域。","sentences":[{"sentence":"In the middle of the sunny afternoon, the children ran happily through the flower-filled <target>meadow</target> to chase colorful butterflies.","translation":"在陽光燦爛的午後，孩子們快樂地在開滿花的草地上奔跑，追逐著五彩繽紛的蝴蝶。"},{"sentence":"The cows spent the entire summer grazing peacefully in the green <target>meadow</target> behind the old farmhouse.","translation":"牛群整個夏天都安詳地在舊農舍後方的綠色草地上吃草。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"pasture","pos":"noun","translation":"牧場；牧草地","explanation":"特指供牲畜吃草的土地"},{"word":"field","pos":"noun","translation":"原野；田地","explanation":"較廣義的開闊土地，包含農田"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"meaningful","explanation":"「meaningful」在學測作文中是極高頻的加分字，可用於取代 simple 的 important。它不僅表示「重要」，更強調「有意義的」、「能觸動心弦的」或「具有深遠影響的」。","senses":[{"sense":"有意義的；深具意義的（指能產生正面影響或具有重要價值）","entries":[{"pattern":"meaningful sth.","pos":"adjective","translation":"有意義的…","explanation":"修飾名詞，強調該經驗、對話或行動對當事者有深層的心理影響。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Volunteering at the local animal shelter provided the students with a <target>meaningful</target> experience that taught them about compassion.","translation":"在當地動物收容所擔任志工為學生們提供了一次有意義的經驗，教會了他們何謂同情心。"},{"sentence":"Instead of just chatting about the weather, the two old friends had a <target>meaningful</target> conversation about their future goals.","translation":"這兩個老朋友不再只是聊聊天氣，而是就他們未來的目標進行了一次深具意義的對話。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"significant","pos":"adjective","translation":"顯著的；重要的","explanation":"強調影響力大或程度明顯"},{"word":"worthwhile","pos":"adjective","translation":"值得的","explanation":"強調投入時間或精力後獲得的回報是有價值的"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"meaningless","pos":"adjective","translation":"無意義的","explanation":null},{"word":"trivial","pos":"adjective","translation":"微不足道的","explanation":"強調事情太小而沒有重要性"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"名詞 meaning (意義) + 形容詞字尾 -ful (充滿…的)","related":[{"word":"meaning","pos":"noun","translation":"意義；意思","explanation":"核心名詞形式。"},{"word":"meaninglessly","pos":"adverb","translation":"無意義地","explanation":"由反義詞 meaningless 加上副詞字尾 -ly 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"meanwhile","explanation":"「meanwhile」在學測中主要作為副詞，用於連接兩個同時發生的事件，或是對比兩個不同場景的進展。要注意它通常位於句首並用逗號隔開，或位於兩個句子之間，起到承接時間線的作用。","senses":[{"sense":"在此同時；與此同時（兩個動作同時進行）","entries":[{"pattern":"Meanwhile, ...","pos":"adverb","translation":"與此同時…","explanation":"放在句首，用來引導出另一個在同一時間點發生的獨立事件。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The students were studying hard for their final exams in the library; <target>meanwhile</target>, their parents were waiting for them outside.","translation":"學生們在圖書館努力準備期末考；與此同時，他們的父母在外面等待著他們。"},{"sentence":"The government is trying to reduce carbon emissions; <target>meanwhile</target>, many factories are still using old, polluting machines.","translation":"政府正試圖減少碳排放；與此同時，許多工廠仍在使用舊的污染機器。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"simultaneously","pos":"adverb","translation":"同時地","explanation":"強調兩個動作在同一秒或極短時間內同步發生"},{"word":"in the meantime","pos":"adverb","translation":"在此期間","explanation":"強調在等待某事發生之前的這段時間"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"名詞 mean (中間) + while (時間)","related":[{"word":"mean","pos":"adjective","translation":"刻薄的；平均的","explanation":"在此指中間值或平均數"}]}}

{"headword":"medal","explanation":"「medal」是描述運動賽事或榮譽成就的基礎名詞，常與 win, award, gold/silver/bronze 等詞彙搭配。","senses":[{"sense":"獎牌；勳章","entries":[{"pattern":"win a medal","pos":"noun","translation":"贏得獎牌","explanation":"指在體育競賽或軍事貢獻中獲得的實體獎勵。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After training for four long years, the young swimmer finally <pattern>won</pattern> a gold <target>medal</target> at the Olympic Games.","translation":"經過四年的長期訓練，這位年輕的游泳選手終於在奧運會上贏得了一枚金牌。"},{"sentence":"The brave soldier was awarded a <target>medal</target> for his courage during the dangerous rescue mission in the mountains.","translation":"那位勇敢的士兵因為在山區危險的救援任務中表現英勇而獲頒勳章。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"award","pos":"noun","translation":"獎項","explanation":"泛指各種形式的獎勵"},{"word":"trophy","pos":"noun","translation":"獎盃","explanation":"通常指較大的杯狀獎勵"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"omit","explanation":"「omit」在學測中常出現在學術寫作與指示說明中，意為「省略」或「遺漏」。要注意它與 forget 的區別：omit 更傾向於刻意地不包含某項內容，或是因為疏忽而導致遺漏。","senses":[{"sense":"省略；遺漏（刻意不包含或因疏忽而漏掉）","entries":[{"pattern":"omit sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"省略某事；遺漏某事","explanation":"及物動詞直接接受詞，受詞通常是文字、細節、姓名或步驟。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Because the essay was too long, the student decided to <target>omit</target> some less important details to meet the word limit.","translation":"因為文章太長，學生決定省略一些較不重要的細節以符合字數限制。"},{"sentence":"If you <target>omit</target> the last step of the experiment, the final chemical result will be completely different.","translation":"如果你遺漏了實驗的最後一個步驟，最終的化學結果將會完全不同。"}]},{"pattern":"omit to do sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"忘了／忽略做某事","explanation":"後接不定詞 (to V)，強調因為疏忽而沒有執行某個動作。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The careless secretary <target>omitted</target> <pattern>to</pattern> <pattern>sign</pattern> the official document, which caused a long delay in the application process.","translation":"粗心的秘書忘了在官方文件中簽名，這導致申請過程延遲了很久。"},{"sentence":"He <target>omitted</target> <pattern>to</pattern> <pattern>mention</pattern> that he had already failed the test twice, making his parents believe he was doing well.","translation":"他忽略提到他已經考過兩次試了，讓他的父母相信他表現良好。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"leave out","pos":"verb","translation":"省略；遺漏","explanation":"較口語化的表達方式。"},{"word":"exclude","pos":"verb","translation":"排除；不包括","explanation":"強調刻意地將某物從中剔除。"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"include","pos":"verb","translation":"包含","explanation":null}]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"omitted","past_participle":"omitted"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 omit (讓出、丟棄)","related":[{"word":"omission","pos":"noun","translation":"遺漏；省略","explanation":"由動詞 omit 加上名詞字尾 -sion 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"painter","explanation":"「painter」在學測中通常出現在藝術類文章中，指代「畫家」或「油漆工」。學生應注意其在特定語境中如何區分這兩種截然不同的職業。","senses":[{"sense":"畫家；藝術家（創造藝術作品的人）","entries":[{"pattern":"painter","pos":"noun","translation":"畫家","explanation":"指從事藝術創作，使用油畫、水彩等媒介的人。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The famous <target>painter</target> spent three years traveling across Europe to capture the beauty of the mountains and the sea.","translation":"這位著名的畫家花了三年時間在歐洲旅行，以捕捉山脈與海洋之美。"},{"sentence":"In the art gallery, students observed how the <target>painter</target> used bright colors to express the sadness of the city.","translation":"在藝術畫廊中，學生觀察這位畫家如何使用鮮豔的顏色來表達城市的悲傷。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"artist","pos":"noun","translation":"藝術家","explanation":"較廣義的稱呼"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"油漆工（從事裝潢工程的人）","entries":[{"pattern":"painter","pos":"noun","translation":"油漆工","explanation":"指負責將油漆塗在牆壁、房屋或家具上的工人。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The school hired a professional <target>painter</target> to refresh the old walls of the library with a bright, clean white color.","translation":"學校聘請了一位專業的油漆工，將圖書館舊牆壁刷成鮮豔、乾淨的白色。"},{"sentence":"Be careful not to touch the walls because the <target>painter</target> has just finished painting the living room.","translation":"小心不要觸碰牆壁，因為油漆工剛剛才完成客廳的油漆工程。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"decorator","pos":"noun","translation":"裝潢工","explanation":"指負責室內設計與油漆的人"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"動詞 paint (繪畫/刷漆) + 名詞字尾 -er (人)","related":[{"word":"painting","pos":"noun","translation":"繪畫；油畫","explanation":"由動詞 paint 加上 -ing 構成的名詞。"}]}}

{"headword":"pal","explanation":"「pal」是一個非正式的口語詞彙。在學測的對話篇（Cloze or Dialogue）中，常作為 friend 的同義詞出現，用以營造自然、親近的社交情境。","senses":[{"sense":"好朋友；夥伴（非正式用語）","entries":[{"pattern":"pal","pos":"noun","translation":"好朋友；夥伴","explanation":"指關係親近的朋友，通常用於口語，語氣比 friend 更為親暱。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After spending the whole summer together in the same camp, the two boys became the best of <target>pals</target> and wrote letters every week.","translation":"在同一個營隊共度整個夏天後，這兩個男孩成了最好的夥伴，且每週互寄信件。"},{"sentence":"My old school <target>pal</target> from primary school suddenly called me yesterday, and we spent two hours talking about our childhood memories.","translation":"我國小時期的老朋友昨天突然打電話給我，我們花了兩個小時聊起童年回憶。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"buddy","pos":"noun","translation":"好朋友；死黨","explanation":"同樣是非正式的口語詞彙"},{"word":"companion","pos":"noun","translation":"同伴；夥伴","explanation":"較為正式的用詞"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"enemy","pos":"noun","translation":"敵人","explanation":null},{"word":"stranger","pos":"noun","translation":"陌生人","explanation":null}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"palace","explanation":"「palace」在閱讀測驗中常出現在歷史、文化或童話故事的語境中。它不僅指君主居住的豪華建築，有時也用來比喻極其華麗、寬敞的居住空間。","senses":[{"sense":"宮殿；皇宮（君主或高級官員居住的豪華建築）","entries":[{"pattern":"palace","pos":"noun","translation":"宮殿；皇宮","explanation":"指規模宏大且裝飾奢華的建築物。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The royal family lives in a massive <target>palace</target> with hundreds of rooms and beautiful gardens that stretch for miles.","translation":"皇室家族居住在一座巨大的宮殿中，裡面有數百個房間以及延伸數英里之遠的美麗花園。"},{"sentence":"Visitors from all over the world come to see the ancient <target>palace</target> to learn about the royal history of the country.","translation":"來自世界各地的遊客前來參觀這座古老的宮殿，以了解該國的皇室歷史。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"castle","pos":"noun","translation":"城堡","explanation":"雖然同樣宏大，但 castle 更強調防禦功能（如城牆、護城河）。"},{"word":"mansion","pos":"noun","translation":"豪宅","explanation":"指私人擁有的極其豪華的住宅。"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"palm","explanation":"「palm」在學測中具有兩種截然不同的核心意義。一種是人體部位（手掌），另一種是植物（棕櫚樹）。學生在閱讀時應根據上下文快速判斷是哪一種，以免造成誤解。","senses":[{"sense":"手掌（手心部分）","entries":[{"pattern":"palm","pos":"noun","translation":"手掌；手心","explanation":"指從手腕到手指根部的內側區域。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The nervous student felt his <target>palms</target> getting sweaty as he stood in front of the class to give his speech.","translation":"那名緊張的學生在站在全班面前演講時，感覺到他的手心在出汗。"},{"sentence":"The magician carefully hid a small gold coin in the <target>palm</target> of his hand to trick the audience.","translation":"魔術師小心地將一枚小金幣藏在手掌中，以欺騙觀眾。"}]},{"pattern":"read someone's palm","pos":"verb","translation":"看手相","explanation":"一種特定的慣用語，指透過觀察手掌線條來預測未來。","sentences":[{"sentence":"During the school trip to the local market, the girl asked the old woman to <target>read</target> her <pattern>palm</pattern> for fun.","translation":"在學校去當地市場的旅行中，那個女孩為了好玩而請那位老婦人幫她看手相。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"棕櫚樹（熱帶地區常見的一種樹）","entries":[{"pattern":"palm tree","pos":"noun","translation":"棕櫚樹","explanation":"常用於描寫熱帶海邊或度假地風景。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The beach was filled with golden sand, clear blue water, and tall <target>palm</target> trees that swayed gently in the wind.","translation":"海灘上佈滿了金色的沙子、清澈的藍色海水，以及在風中輕輕搖曳的高大棕櫚樹。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"pancake","explanation":"「pancake」是基礎生活類詞彙，在閱讀測驗中常出現在描述日常飲食或文化交流的短文中。","senses":[{"sense":"鬆餅；薄煎餅","entries":[{"pattern":"pancake","pos":"noun","translation":"鬆餅","explanation":"指一種由面粉、蛋和牛奶製成的圓形扁平煎餅。","sentences":[{"sentence":"For a special Sunday breakfast, my mother made a stack of fluffy <target>pancakes</target> topped with maple syrup and fresh berries.","translation":"為了慶祝特別的週日早餐，我母親做了一疊鬆軟的鬆餅，上面淋著楓糖漿和新鮮莓果。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"panic","explanation":"「panic」在學測中既可作為名詞也可作為動詞。其核心意涵是「極度恐慌導致失去理智」，常用於描述災難、緊急情況或考場上的反應。","senses":[{"sense":"恐慌；驚慌 (名詞)","entries":[{"pattern":"panic","pos":"noun","translation":"恐慌；驚慌","explanation":"指一種強烈的恐懼感，通常導致人們失去控制或做出不理智的行為。","sentences":[{"sentence":"When the smoke alarm suddenly went off in the library, a sense of <target>panic</target> spread quickly through the crowd.","translation":"當圖書館的煙霧報警器突然響起時，一種恐慌感迅速在人群中蔓延。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"terror","pos":"noun","translation":"恐怖；驚恐","explanation":"強調極度的恐懼。"},{"word":"fear","pos":"noun","translation":"恐懼","explanation":"一般性的恐懼感。"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"calm","pos":"noun","translation":"冷靜","explanation":null}]},{"sense":"驚慌；陷入恐慌 (動詞)","entries":[{"pattern":"panic","pos":"verb","translation":"驚慌；陷入恐慌","explanation":"不及物動詞，指在緊急情況下失去冷靜。","sentences":[{"sentence":"If you get lost in the forest, the most important thing is to stay calm and <pattern>not</pattern> <target>panic</target>, or you will get more lost.","translation":"如果你在森林中迷路，最重要的事情是保持冷靜且不要驚慌，否則你會迷路得更嚴重。"},{"sentence":"The student <target>panicked</target> when he realized he had forgotten his identity card for the big exam, and he began to breathe quickly.","translation":"那名學生在意識到自己忘了帶大考的身分證時陷入了驚慌，並開始快速地呼吸。"}]},{"pattern":"panic into doing sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"因恐慌而（做某事）","explanation":"描述因極度緊張而做出衝動且不理智的行為。","sentences":[{"sentence":"During the sudden power outage, some people <target>panicked</target> <pattern>into</pattern> running out of the building without checking the stairs.","translation":"在突然的停電中，一些人因為驚慌而衝出建築物，卻沒有檢查樓梯。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"fret","pos":"verb","translation":"焦慮；煩惱","explanation":"程度較輕的擔憂。"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"compose oneself","pos":"verb","translation":"使自己冷靜","explanation":null}]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"panicked","past_participle":"panicked"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"parade","explanation":"「parade」在描述文化活動、節日慶典或軍事閱兵時非常高頻。它不僅指物理上的「遊行」，也可以比喻為「展示」或「炫耀」某種特質。","senses":[{"sense":"遊行；閱兵 (名詞)","entries":[{"pattern":"parade","pos":"noun","translation":"遊行；閱兵","explanation":"指一群人為了慶祝某事而沿著街道走行的活動。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Thousands of people gathered along the main street to watch the colorful <target>parade</target> celebrating the city's birthday.","translation":"數千人聚集在主街上，觀看慶祝城市生日的色彩繽紛的遊行。"},{"sentence":"The annual flower <target>parade</target> in the city center features giant floats and musicians playing loud, happy music.","translation":"市中心的年度花卉遊行以巨大的花車和演奏著歡快音樂的音樂家為特徵。"}]},{"pattern":"on parade","pos":"noun","translation":"在遊行中；在展示中","explanation":"指某人或某物被公開地展示給大眾看。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The new military weapons were put <pattern>on</pattern> <target>parade</target> to show the strength of the national army.","translation":"新型軍事武器被公開展示，以顯示國軍的實力。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"procession","pos":"noun","translation":"行列；遊行","explanation":"通常指較為莊重、緩慢的行進隊伍。"},{"word":"march","pos":"noun","translation":"遊行；行軍","explanation":"強調有節奏的行走或軍事性質。"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"遊行；展示 (動詞)","entries":[{"pattern":"parade sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"展示；炫耀某事","explanation":"指故意地讓他人看到自己的優點或財富，帶有輕微的負面色彩。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The rich businessman liked to <target>parade</target> his expensive jewelry and fast cars in front of his jealous neighbors.","translation":"這位富有的商人喜歡在嫉妒他的鄰居面前炫耀他的昂貴珠寶和快車。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"show off","pos":"verb","translation":"炫耀","explanation":null},{"word":"display","pos":"verb","translation":"展示","explanation":"中性詞，指單純地展示。"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"paraded","past_participle":"paraded"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"paradise","explanation":"「paradise」在學測中常出現在文學描寫、旅遊介紹或對理想社會的構想中。它不僅指地理上的「天堂」，更常用來形容一個環境極其完美、令人愉悅的狀態。理解這個字時，要注意它常與形容詞（如 tropical, earthly）搭配，用來營造特定的氛圍。","senses":[{"sense":"天堂；極樂世界（一個完美、沒有痛苦且極其美麗的地方）","entries":[{"pattern":"a paradise for sb.","pos":"noun","translation":"對某人而言的天堂","explanation":"指某個地方或環境對特定人群具有極大的吸引力，使他們感到極其快樂。","sentences":[{"sentence":"With its quiet libraries and endless shelves of old books, the university campus became a <target>paradise</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the shy student who loved reading.","translation":"由於擁有安靜的圖書館和無盡的舊書架，大學校園變成了那位熱愛閱讀的害羞學生的天堂。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"paradisiacal","pos":"adjective","translation":"天堂般的","explanation":"由名詞 paradise 延伸而來的形容詞，用來形容極其完美的環境。"}]}}

{"headword":"parcel","explanation":"「parcel」在學測中具有名詞與動詞兩種用法。名詞部分最常見於日常生活的「包裹」；動詞部分則較少見，但出現在法律或土地管理語境中，意為「將…分塊/分包」。學生應優先掌握名詞用法，但需注意其在閱讀中可能出現的動詞形式。","senses":[{"sense":"包裹；小包裹（透過郵遞或快遞傳送的物品）","entries":[{"pattern":"send a parcel","pos":"noun","translation":"寄包裹","explanation":"最常見的日常搭配，指將物品裝在盒中寄出。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After waiting for a week, the excited girl finally received a large <target>parcel</target> containing a hand-made sweater from her grandmother in Canada.","translation":"等待了一週後，興奮的女孩終於收到了一個從加拿大祖母寄來的、裝有手工毛衣的大包裹。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"parceled","past_participle":"parceled"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"parcel","pos":"verb","translation":"分塊；分包","explanation":"將大塊土地或物資分成小塊分發。"}]}}

{"headword":"parrot","explanation":"「parrot」最常作為名詞指代一種動物，但在學測的高階用法中，它是個重要的動詞，意為「機械式地重複（他人的話）」。在閱讀測驗中，這個動詞用法常被用來批評某人缺乏獨立思考能力，是極具考點的語意轉向。","senses":[{"sense":"鸚鵡","entries":[{"pattern":"parrot","pos":"noun","translation":"鸚鵡","explanation":"指一種羽毛鮮豔的鳥類。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The colorful <target>parrot</target> perched on the wooden branch and began to mimic the sounds of the people talking nearby.","translation":"那隻色彩鮮豔的鸚鵡棲息在木質樹枝上，並開始模仿附近人們交談的聲音。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"parroted","past_participle":"parroted"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"parrot","pos":"verb","translation":"機械式地重複（他人的話）","explanation":"比喻像鸚鵡一樣不加思考地重複別人的話。"}]}}

{"headword":"passage","explanation":"「passage」在學測中是多義字，必須根據上下文區分。它最常出現在閱讀測驗的指令中（指「文章片段」），但在描述建築或地理時指「通道/走廊」，在描述時間或生命階段時則指「流逝」。這三個義項在考題中出現頻率極高。","senses":[{"sense":"文章片段；段落（書本或文章中的一小部分）","entries":[{"pattern":"read a passage","pos":"noun","translation":"閱讀一段文字","explanation":"最基礎的閱讀指令用語，指讀完一小段特定的文字內容。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Before answering the multiple-choice questions, students are required to read the <target>passage</target> carefully to find the main idea of the text.","translation":"在回答選擇題之前，學生被要求仔細閱讀這段文字，以找出文章的主旨。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"passenger","explanation":"「passenger」在學測中是一個基礎名詞，主要出現在交通運輸、旅遊或意外事故的描述中。理解這個字時，應注意它與 driver（駕駛者）或 pilot（飛行員）的對比，強調其「被動」的運輸地位。","senses":[{"sense":"乘客；旅客（在交通工具中由他人運送的人）","entries":[{"pattern":"passenger","pos":"noun","translation":"乘客","explanation":"指在飛機、火車、巴士或船上被運送的人。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Due to the heavy snowstorm, hundreds of <target>passengers</target> were forced to wait in the airport terminal for several hours.","translation":"由於強烈的暴風雪， hundreds of passengers were forced to wait in the airport terminal for several hours. "}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 pass (通過) + 字尾 -enger (人)","related":[{"word":"passage","pos":"noun","translation":"通道；流逝","explanation":"與 passenger 共享 pass- 字根，指通過的過程或路徑。"}]}}

{"headword":"passion","explanation":"「passion」在學測中不僅指強烈的「熱情」，也常用於描述對藝術、運動或學業的深厚興趣。在寫作中，可用於取代 simple like 或 love，提升文章的層次感。","senses":[{"sense":"熱情；激情（強烈的興趣或情感）","entries":[{"pattern":"have a passion for sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"對某事有熱情","explanation":"最常見的搭配，用於描述個人對特定領域、愛好或志業的強烈追求。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Since she was a young child, Maria has had a deep <target>passion</target> <pattern>for</pattern> classical music and spends every weekend practicing the piano.","translation":"自從幼年起，瑪麗亞就對古典音樂有著深厚的熱情，每個週末都花時間練習鋼琴。"},{"sentence":"The young entrepreneur started his own company because of his lifelong <target>passion</target> <pattern>for</pattern> solving complex technical problems.","translation":"這位年輕的創業家因為他終身對解決複雜技術問題的熱情而創立了自己的公司。"}]},{"pattern":"with passion","pos":"noun","translation":"充滿熱情地","explanation":"作為副詞片語，用來修飾動作，強調執行該動作時投入的情感強度。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The teacher spoke <pattern>with</pattern> <target>passion</target> about the importance of protecting the environment, inspiring many students to join the recycling project.","translation":"老師充滿熱情地談論保護環境的重要性，激勵了許多學生加入回收計畫。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"enthusiasm","pos":"noun","translation":"熱忱；熱心","explanation":"強調積極且樂觀的態度"},{"word":"zeal","pos":"noun","translation":"熱誠；熱情","explanation":"強調強烈的精神動力與勤奮"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"indifference","pos":"noun","translation":"冷漠；漠不關心","explanation":null},{"word":"apathy","pos":"noun","translation":"冷淡；缺乏興趣","explanation":"指對原本應該關心的事物完全沒有感覺"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"源自拉丁語 passio (受難、忍受)，後演變為強烈的情感。","related":[{"word":"passionate","pos":"adjective","translation":"熱情的；激情的","explanation":"形容詞形式，常用於描述人或其表現。"}]}}

{"headword":"passport","explanation":"「passport」在生活化情境的閱讀測驗中極為常見。除了指物理上的「護照」，在比喻意義上也可指進入某個領域的「通行證」或「門票」。","senses":[{"sense":"護照（出入境證明文件）","entries":[{"pattern":"passport","pos":"noun","translation":"護照","explanation":"指用於國際旅行的官方身分證明文件。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Before you board the international flight, please make sure that your <target>passport</target> is still valid for at least six months.","translation":"在登機國際航班前，請確保您的護照有效期至少還有六個月。"},{"sentence":"The traveler was very worried when he realized he had lost his <target>passport</target> while visiting the museum in Paris.","translation":"那名旅客在發現自己在巴黎參觀博物館時弄丟了護照後感到非常擔心。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"通行證；門票（比喻進入某處或獲得某種機會的手段）","entries":[{"pattern":"a passport to sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"進入…的通行證／門票","explanation":"比喻指某種能力、資格或學位能讓人獲得更好的機會。","sentences":[{"sentence":"For many students, getting a degree from a top university is seen as a <target>passport</target> <pattern>to</pattern> a successful professional career.","translation":"對於許多學生來說，獲得頂尖大學的學位被視為進入成功職業生涯的通行證。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"ticket","pos":"noun","translation":"門票；手段","explanation":"比喻指獲得某種機會的唯一方式"},{"word":"access","pos":"noun","translation":"進入權；通道","explanation":"指進入某個空間或系統的權利"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"pass (通過) + port (港口)","related":[{"word":"export","pos":"noun","translation":"出口","explanation":"ex- (向外) + port (港口)"},{"word":"import","pos":"noun","translation":"進口","explanation":"im- (向內) + port (港口)"}]}}

{"headword":"pat","explanation":"「pat」作為動詞時，最常出現在描述動作的短文或小說情境中，指輕輕拍打。作為名詞時，則常出現在特定片語中，如 a pat on the back。","senses":[{"sense":"輕拍（用手掌輕輕拍打）","entries":[{"pattern":"pat sb. on the back/shoulder","pos":"verb","translation":"拍拍某人的背/肩膀","explanation":"指用手掌輕輕拍打，通常表示鼓勵、讚美或安慰。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The coach gave the young player a friendly <target>pat</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the shoulder to encourage him after the losing game.","translation":"教練在比賽輸掉後，友善地拍了拍那個年輕球員的肩膀以鼓勵他。"},{"sentence":"The mother gently <target>patted</target> her baby <pattern>on</pattern> the back to help the child fall asleep more quickly.","translation":"母親輕輕拍著寶寶的背，好讓孩子能更快入睡。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"tap","pos":"verb","translation":"輕敲；輕拍","explanation":"強調快速且輕微的敲擊"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"讚美（比喻意義上的拍肩）","entries":[{"pattern":"a pat on the back","pos":"noun","translation":"稱讚；鼓勵","explanation":"慣用語，指給予某人肯定或稱讚，不需要真的拍背。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After completing the difficult project on time, the entire team deserves a <target>pat</target> <pattern>on the back</pattern> for their hard work.","translation":"在準時完成這項艱鉅的計畫後，整個團隊因為他們的努力而值得獲得稱讚。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"praise","pos":"noun","translation":"稱讚","explanation":null},{"word":"compliment","pos":"noun","translation":"讚美","explanation":null}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"patted","past_participle":"patted"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"patience","explanation":"「patience」是學測中描述性格特質或學習過程的關鍵名詞。常搭配 lose 或 have 與 a lot of 共同出現，用來描述面對困難或緩慢進展時的心理狀態。","senses":[{"sense":"耐心（忍耐力）","entries":[{"pattern":"have patience with sb./sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"對某人/某事有耐心","explanation":"指在面對困難、遲緩或煩人的事情時，能夠保持冷靜與忍耐。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Teaching young children requires a great deal of <target>patience</target> <pattern>with</pattern> their constant questions and curious behavior.","translation":"教小孩子需要對他們不斷地提問和好奇的行為有極大的耐心。"},{"sentence":"The experienced guide had plenty of <target>patience</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the slow hikers who struggled to keep up with the group.","translation":"這位經驗豐富的導遊對那些跟不上團體步伐的緩慢登山客非常有耐心。"}]},{"pattern":"lose one's patience","pos":"noun","translation":"失去耐心","explanation":"指不再能夠忍受某種情況，通常隨後會表現出憤怒或不耐煩。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The customer finally <target>lost</target> his <target>patience</target> when the waiter ignored him for ten minutes while he waited for his food.","translation":"當服務生在顧客等待食物時無視他十分鐘後，該顧客終於失去了耐心。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"tolerance","pos":"noun","translation":"寬容；忍耐","explanation":"強調對不同意見或不快之事的忍受力"},{"word":"forbearance","pos":"noun","translation":"忍耐；克制","explanation":"較正式，指有意識地克制情緒"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"impatience","pos":"noun","translation":"不耐煩","explanation":null}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"源自拉丁語 patientia (忍耐)，與 patient (病人) 同根，意為「被動地忍受」。","related":[{"word":"patient","pos":"adjective","translation":"有耐心的","explanation":"形容詞形式。"},{"word":"word","pos":"noun","translation":"病人","explanation":"名詞形式，指接受治療的人（被動忍受病痛的人）。"}]}}

{"headword":"pause","explanation":"「pause」在學測中既可作動詞也可作名詞。其核心概念是「暫停」，常用於描述對話中的間隔或在執行某項任務時的短暫休息。","senses":[{"sense":"暫停；間歇（短暫地停止動作或言語）","entries":[{"pattern":"pause","pos":"verb","translation":"暫停","explanation":"指在繼續動作前短暫地停止。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The speaker <target>paused</target> for a few seconds to drink some water before continuing his long speech about global warming.","translation":"演講者在繼續他關於全球暖化的長篇演講前，先暫停了幾秒鐘喝水。"},{"sentence":"As she walked through the forest, she <target>paused</target> to look at the beautiful flowers blooming along the path.","translation":"當她走在森林中時，她暫停了一下，觀察沿路盛開的美麗花朵。"}]},{"pattern":"a pause in sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"…中的暫停／間歇","explanation":"指在某個過程中的短暫休息或中斷。","sentences":[{"sentence":"There was a long <target>pause</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the conversation when the teacher asked a very difficult question that no one could answer.","translation":"當老師問了一個沒人能回答的困難問題時，對話中出現了很長的暫停。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"break","pos":"noun","translation":"休息；中斷","explanation":"最通用，指短暫的停止"},{"word":"halt","pos":"verb","translation":"停止；停頓","explanation":"強調突然或強制性的停止"},{"word":"word","pos":"verb","translation":"暫停","explanation":" "}],"antonyms":[{"word":"word","pos":"verb","translation":"word","explanation":" "}]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"paused","past_participle":"paused"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"perform","explanation":"「perform」是一個多義詞，在學測中最高頻的兩個面向是「演出」與「執行（任務/實驗/手術）」。學生必須根據前後文辨識其具體含義。","senses":[{"sense":"演出；表演","entries":[{"pattern":"perform","pos":"verb","translation":"表演；演出","explanation":"指在觀眾面前展示才藝或演出劇本。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The talented young pianist will <target>perform</target> a famous piece of music in front of the whole school during the graduation ceremony.","translation":"那位才華橫溢的年輕鋼琴家將在畢業典禮期間，在全校面前表演一段著名的音樂作品。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"act","pos":"verb","translation":"表演","explanation":"指在戲劇中扮演角色"},{"word":"present","pos":"verb","translation":"呈現；演出","explanation":"較為正式的演出表達方式"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"執行；進行（任務、手術、實驗）","entries":[{"pattern":"perform sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"執行某事；進行某事","explanation":"指完成一項特定的工作或專業程序，如手術、測試或日常職責。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The experienced surgeons had to <target>perform</target> a complex heart <pattern>surgery</pattern> to save the patient's life.","translation":"經驗豐富的外科醫生不得不進行一場複雜的心臟手術，以挽救患者的生命。"},{"sentence":"Students in the chemistry class were asked to <target>perform</target> an <pattern>experiment</pattern> to see how heat affects the reaction.","translation":"化學課的學生被要求進行一次實驗，以觀察熱量如何影響反應。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"carry out","pos":"verb","translation":"執行；履行","explanation":"極為常見的同義詞，常用於實驗或計畫"},{"word":"execute","pos":"verb","translation":"執行；實施","explanation":"更為正式且強調完成過程的詞彙"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"performed","past_participle":"performed"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 perform (執行、完成)","related":[{"word":"performance","pos":"noun","translation":"表演；表現","explanation":"由動詞 perform 加上名詞字尾 -ance 延伸而來。"}]}}
