{"headword":"pity","explanation":"「pity」在學測中常作為名詞使用，表示「遺憾」或「憐憫」。特別注意其在 a pity that... 句型中的用法，這是閱讀理解中的關鍵考點。","senses":[{"sense":"憐憫；同情（對他人不幸的感覺）","entries":[{"pattern":"feel pity for sb.","pos":"verb","translation":"憐憫某人","explanation":"指對他人處境不幸而感到同情。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many people <target>pitied</target> the homeless man who sat alone in the cold rain, hoping for a little bit of food.","translation":"許多人憐憫那個坐在寒冷雨中、希望得到一點食物的孤單流浪漢。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"sympathy","pos":"noun","translation":"同情；共鳴","explanation":"泛指對他人不幸的感覺"},{"word":"compassion","pos":"noun","translation":"憐憫；同情心","explanation":"強調對他人痛苦的深刻同情"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"遺憾（對某事感到可惜）","entries":[{"pattern":"It is a pity that...","pos":"noun","translation":"很遺憾…","explanation":"固定句型，後接 that 子句，用來表達對某事感到可惜。","sentences":[{"sentence":"It is a <target>pity</target> <pattern>that</pattern> the museum is closed today, so we cannot see the famous painting we wanted.","translation":"很遺憾博物館今天關門了，，所以我們不能看到我們想看的那幅名畫。"},{"sentence":"It was a <target>pity</target> <pattern>that</pattern> the talented musician failed the audition because he was too nervous to play.","translation":"很遺憾那位才華橫溢的音樂家因為太過緊張而未能通過試演。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"shame","pos":"noun","translation":"遺憾；可惜","explanation":"在 a shame that... 句型中與 a pity that... 完全相同"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"pitied","past_participle":"pitied"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"plastic","explanation":"「plastic」在學測中主要出現在環境保護類文章中，指代「塑料/塑膠」。此外，它也可以作為形容詞，指代「可塑的」或「由塑膠製成的」。","senses":[{"sense":"塑膠；塑料（一種人造材料）","entries":[{"pattern":"plastic","pos":"noun","translation":"塑膠","explanation":"指代一種人造的合成聚合物材料。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Because <target>plastic</target> takes hundreds of years to break down, it causes serious pollution to our oceans and sea animals.","translation":"因為塑膠需要數百年才能分解，它對我們的海洋和海洋動物造成了嚴重的污染。"},{"sentence":"The government decided to ban single-use <target>plastics</target> like straws and bags to protect the environment from more waste.","translation":"政府決定禁用一次性塑膠製品，如吸管和袋子，以保護環境免於更多廢棄物。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"塑膠製的（由塑膠材料構成）","entries":[{"pattern":"plastic sth.","pos":"adjective","translation":"塑膠製的…","explanation":"用來修飾名詞，指代物品的材料。","sentences":[{"sentence":"To reduce waste, the teacher asked the students to bring their own <target>plastic</target> bottles instead of buying new ones.","translation":"為了減少廢棄物，教師要求學生們攜帶自己的塑膠瓶，而不是購買新的。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"plasticity","pos":"noun","translation":"可塑性","explanation":"由 plastic 加上名詞字尾 -ity 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"playful","explanation":"「playful」常用於描述人或動物的性格特質，強調一種輕鬆、愉快且不嚴肅的態度。在學測中，常出現在人物特質描寫或動物行為觀察的文章中。","senses":[{"sense":"愛玩弄的；俏皮的；開玩笑的","entries":[{"pattern":"playful","pos":"adjective","translation":"愛玩的；俏皮的","explanation":"直接修飾名詞，描述對象的性格、神情或行為模式。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The <target>playful</target> puppy kept jumping around the living room and trying to steal the tennis ball from its owner's hand.","translation":"這隻俏皮的小狗在客廳裡不停地跳來跳去，並試圖從主人的手中偷走網球。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 play (玩) + 形容詞字尾 -ful (充滿...的)","related":[{"word":"playfully","pos":"adverb","translation":"俏皮地；開玩笑地","explanation":"由形容詞 playful 加上副詞字尾 -ly 延伸而來。"},{"word":"playfulness","pos":"noun","translation":"俏皮；愛玩","explanation":"由形容詞 playful 加上名詞字尾 -ness 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"plenty","explanation":"「plenty」在學測中具有多種詞性，最常用作代名詞或名詞，表示「充足的量」。要注意它在句子中常與介系詞 of 搭配，形成量詞片語，且後方接續的不可數名詞或複數可數名詞均視為複數概念。","senses":[{"sense":"充足；豐富（作為名詞或代名詞）","entries":[{"pattern":"plenty of sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"充足的…；大量的…","explanation":"作為量詞片語，後接不可數名詞或複數可數名詞，語意等同於 a lot of 或 more than enough。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After the heavy rain last night, there was <target>plenty</target> <pattern>of</pattern> fresh water in the small pond, which attracted many thirsty birds.","translation":"昨晚大雨之後，小池塘裡有充足的淡水，吸引了許多口渴的鳥類。"}]},{"pattern":"plenty","pos":"pronoun","translation":"充足的量","explanation":"單獨使用，指代前面提到過的事物，在句中常作主詞或受詞。","sentences":[{"sentence":"You don't need to buy more snacks for the class party because we already have <target>plenty</target> in the kitchen.","translation":"你不需要為班級派對購買更多零食，因為我們廚房裡已經有充足的量了。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"源自古法語 plente (豐富)","related":[]}}

{"headword":"plug","explanation":"「plug」在學測中分為實體「插頭/塞子」與動作「插上電源/堵住」兩種主要方向。此外，在現代口語或商業語境中，它有「宣傳」的引申義，但學測重點在於其物理功能。","senses":[{"sense":"插頭；塞子（物理實體）","entries":[{"pattern":"plug","pos":"noun","translation":"插頭；塞子","explanation":"指將電子產品連接到電源的設備，或用來堵住孔洞的物品。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Before you leave the house, please make sure that you have pulled the <target>plug</target> out of the wall socket.","translation":"在你離開家之前，請確保你已經將插頭從牆上的插座中拔出。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"plugged","past_participle":"plugged"},"relatives":{"morphology":"單字 root，指堵塞或填充物","related":[{"word":"plug-in","pos":"noun","translation":"外掛程式","explanation":"由 plug (插) 與 in (進入) 組成，指在軟體中增加的功能模組。"}]}}

{"headword":"pole","explanation":"「pole」在學測中主要出現在兩種截然不同的語境：一是地理/物理上的「極地/極點」；二是物理實體上的「長桿/柱子」。學生需根據上下文決定翻譯。","senses":[{"sense":"長桿；柱子（細長的實體物）","entries":[{"pattern":"pole","pos":"noun","translation":"長桿；柱子","explanation":"指由木頭或金屬製成的細長支撐物。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The workers spent the whole afternoon setting up a tall metal <target>pole</target> to support the heavy canvas tent.","translation":"工人花了一整個下午時間安裝一根高大的金屬桿子，用以支撐沉重的帆布帳篷。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"單字 root，指長形的物體","related":[{"word":"polar","pos":"adjective","translation":"極地的；兩極分化的","explanation":"由 noun pole 延伸而來的形容詞，常用於描述極地氣候或截然相反的觀點。"}]}}

{"headword":"political","explanation":"「political」是探討社會、政府、國際關係與公民權利的關鍵形容詞。在閱讀測驗中，常與 government, system, power, party 等名詞搭配，構成核心術語。","senses":[{"sense":"政治的；與政府或權力相關的","entries":[{"pattern":"political system / party / power","pos":"adjective","translation":"政治制度／政黨／政治權力","explanation":"修飾名詞，指與國家管理、法律制定或權力爭奪相關的事宜。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After the revolution, the country decided to change its <target>political</target> <pattern>system</pattern> to ensure that every citizen had a fair vote.","translation":"革命之後，這個國家決定改變其政治制度，以確保每位公民都擁有公平的投票權。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 polyt (城市/國家) + 形容詞字尾 -ical","related":[{"word":"politics","pos":"noun","translation":"政治","explanation":"對應的基礎名詞形式。"}]}}

{"headword":"politician","explanation":"「politician」在學測中常出現在社會議題或公民教育類文章中。需注意它與「politics」的不同，它指的是具體的「從政者」，且在某些語境下可能帶有輕微的負面含義，暗示其為了選票而妥協或不誠實。","senses":[{"sense":"政治家；從政者","entries":[{"pattern":"politician","pos":"noun","translation":"政治家；從政者","explanation":"指參與政府管理或競選公職的人。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The experienced <target>politician</target> gave a long speech to convince the voters that his new tax plan would help the poor.","translation":"那位經驗豐富的政治家發表了一場長篇演說，以說服選民他的新稅收計畫將能幫助窮人。"},{"sentence":"Many young people believe that a modern <target>politician</target> should listen to the needs of citizens rather than just following party rules.","translation":"許多年輕人認為，現代的從政者應該傾聽公民的需求，而非僅僅遵循政黨規則。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"statesman","pos":"noun","translation":"政治家","explanation":"通常帶有正面含義，指具有遠見且受人尊敬的領導者"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 polit (城市、國家) + 字尾 -ician (專業人士)","related":[{"word":"politics","pos":"noun","translation":"政治","explanation":"指管理國家或組織的活動與權力分配。"},{"word":"political","pos":"adjective","translation":"政治的","explanation":"用來修飾名詞，描述與政治相關的事物。"}]}}

{"headword":"politics","explanation":"「politics」在形式上看似複數（以 s 結尾），但在表達「政治這門學問」或「政治活動」時，通常被視為單數名詞。在學測寫作中，它是討論社會變革、權力鬥爭或公民權利時的關鍵字彙。","senses":[{"sense":"政治；政務","entries":[{"pattern":"politics","pos":"noun","translation":"政治","explanation":"指管理國家或組織的權力分配與運作方式。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many students decide to study <target>politics</target> in college because they want to understand how laws are made and how governments work.","translation":"許多學生決定在大學學習政治，因為他們想要了解法律是如何制定以及政府是如何運作的。"},{"sentence":"In some families, parents prefer not to discuss <target>politics</target> during dinner to avoid arguments between family members with different views.","translation":"在某些家庭中，父母偏好在晚餐時不討論政治，以避免持有不同觀點的家庭成員之間產生爭執。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"government","pos":"noun","translation":"政府；治理","explanation":"強調管理國家的機構或行為"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 polit (城市、國家) + 字尾 -ics (學問/活動)","related":[{"word":"politician","pos":"noun","translation":"政治家","explanation":"參與政治活動的人。"},{"word":"political","pos":"adjective","translation":"政治的","explanation":"描述與政治相關的屬性。"}]}}

{"headword":"poll","explanation":"「poll」在學測閱讀中常與選舉（election）或民意調查（survey）相關。作為名詞時，指「民調」或「投票所」；作為動詞時，指「進行民意調查」。","senses":[{"sense":"民意調查；投票","entries":[{"pattern":"poll","pos":"noun","translation":"民意調查；投票","explanation":"指透過詢問一群人來獲取大眾意見的統計結果。","sentences":[{"sentence":"According to a recent <target>poll</target>, a majority of high school students prefer digital textbooks over traditional paper books.","translation":"根據最近的一項民意調查，大多數高中生比起傳統紙本書籍更喜歡數位教科書。"},{"sentence":"The candidate checked the latest <target>polls</target> to see if his promises about lowering taxes had attracted more voters.","translation":"該候選人查看了最新的民調，以確認他關於降低稅收的承諾是否吸引了更多選民。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"survey","pos":"noun","translation":"調查；問卷","explanation":"較廣泛的數據收集方式，不限於民意"},{"word":"opinion poll","pos":"noun","translation":"民意調查","explanation":"專指針對大眾意見的調查"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"polled","past_participle":"polled"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"polling station","pos":"noun","translation":"投票所","explanation":"進行投票的具體地點。"}]}}

{"headword":"pollute","explanation":"「pollute」是環境保護類文章的基礎動詞。其核心意義在於「使…污染」。在寫作中，應注意其受詞通常是自然資源（如 air, water, soil, river）。","senses":[{"sense":"污染","entries":[{"pattern":"pollute sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"污染某事","explanation":"及物動詞，直接接受詞，描述使環境變得不潔或危險。","sentences":[{"sentence":"If factories continue to <target>pollute</target> <pattern>the</pattern> river with dangerous chemicals, the local fish will soon disappear.","translation":"如果工廠繼續用危險化學物質污染這條河，當地的魚類很快就會消失。"},{"sentence":"Many people are worried that too many cars on the road will <target>pollute</target> <pattern>the</pattern> air we breathe every day.","translation":"許多人擔心道路上過多的汽車會污染我們每天呼吸的空氣。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"contaminate","pos":"verb","translation":"弄髒；污染","explanation":"強調使某物變得不純或具有毒性，常用於食物或水"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"purify","pos":"verb","translation":"淨化","explanation":"去除雜質使之變得乾淨"}]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"polluted","past_participle":"polluted"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 poll (髒污) + 動詞字尾","related":[{"word":"pollution","pos":"noun","translation":"污染","explanation":"由動詞 pollute 轉化而來的名詞。"},{"word":"pollutant","pos":"noun","translation":"污染物","explanation":"指造成污染的具體物質。"}]}}

{"headword":"pollution","explanation":"「pollution」在學測中是環境議題的最高頻名詞。需注意它是一個不可數名詞，且常用於與 air, water, noise, light 等修飾語連用，形成特定的污染類型。","senses":[{"sense":"污染（狀態或過程）","entries":[{"pattern":"pollution","pos":"noun","translation":"污染","explanation":"指環境被污染的狀態或造成污染的行為。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The government has introduced new laws to reduce air <target>pollution</target> in the city by limiting the number of cars allowed on the road.","translation":"政府推出了新法律，透過限制道路上的汽車數量來減少城市中的空氣污染。"},{"sentence":"Too much plastic <target>pollution</target> in the ocean is killing millions of sea animals, such as turtles and whales, every single year.","translation":"海洋中過多的塑料污染每年都在殺死數百萬隻海洋動物，例如海龜和鯨魚。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"contamination","pos":"noun","translation":"污染；受汙染","explanation":"較正式，強調物質的混合導致的不純"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"動詞 pollute + 名詞字尾 -ion","related":[{"word":"pollute","pos":"verb","translation":"污染","explanation":"核心動詞形式。"},{"word":"pollutant","pos":"noun","translation":"污染物","explanation":"指具體造成污染的物質。"}]}}

{"headword":"pottery","explanation":"「pottery」在學測中常出現在藝術、考古或文化類文章中。要注意它既可以用來指「陶器」這類物品，也可以指製作陶器的「陶藝」或「陶藝工作室」。","senses":[{"sense":"陶器；陶藝（由黏土燒製而成的器皿或其工藝）","entries":[{"pattern":"pottery","pos":"noun","translation":"陶器；陶藝","explanation":"泛指所有用黏土燒製的器皿，或指這門藝術形式。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The museum displays a collection of ancient Greek <target>pottery</target>, showing how people stored olive oil and wine thousands of years ago.","translation":"博物館展出了一系列古希臘陶器，展示了數千年前人們如何儲存橄欖油和葡萄酒。"},{"sentence":"During the summer break, Sarah took a <target>pottery</target> class to learn how to shape wet clay into beautiful vases on a spinning wheel.","translation":"暑假期間，莎拉參加了一個陶藝班，學習如何用旋轉輪將濕黏土塑造成美麗的花瓶。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"ceramics","pos":"noun","translation":"陶瓷","explanation":"較為正式或科學的稱呼，包含陶器與瓷器。"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 pot (容器) 加上名詞字尾 -ery","related":[{"word":"pot","pos":"noun","translation":"鍋；盆","explanation":"基礎容器名詞。"}]}}

{"headword":"pour","explanation":"「pour」在描述天氣或日常動作時非常高頻。除了字面上的「傾倒液體」，在學測中常出現的比喻用法是描述大雨滂沱，以及在口語中表示「湧入」。","senses":[{"sense":"傾倒；注入（液體從容器中流出）","entries":[{"pattern":"pour sth. into sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"將某物倒入某處","explanation":"最基礎的物理動作，常用於烹飪或日常生活中。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Please carefully <target>pour</target> the hot milk <pattern>into</pattern> the coffee cup so that you do not spill it on the table.","translation":"請小心地將熱牛奶倒入咖啡杯中，以免灑在桌子上。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"empty","pos":"verb","translation":"倒空","explanation":"強調將容器內的所有東西全部倒出。"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"湧出；傾瀉（大量液體或人群迅速移動）","entries":[{"pattern":"pour out of sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"從…湧出","explanation":"描述大量的人或液體快速地從某個空間流出。","sentences":[{"sentence":"As soon as the school bell rang, hundreds of excited students <target>poured</target> <pattern>out of</pattern> the main building to go home.","translation":"只要學校鐘聲一響，數百名興奮的學生就從主建築中湧出回家。"}]},{"pattern":"pour with rain","pos":"verb","translation":"下大雨","explanation":"固定搭配，用來描述雨勢極大，等同於 rain heavily。","sentences":[{"sentence":"We wanted to go for a picnic in the park, but it started to <target>pour</target> <pattern>with rain</pattern> suddenly, so we stayed home.","translation":"我們想去公園野餐，但突然開始下起大雨，所以我們留在家裡。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"flood","pos":"verb","translation":"淹沒；湧入","explanation":"強調量極大且不可收拾。"},{"word":"stream","pos":"verb","translation":"流動；湧出","explanation":"強調像溪流一樣連續地移動。"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"poured","past_participle":"poured"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"poverty","explanation":"「poverty」是探討社會問題、經濟不平等及全球議題時的核心名詞。在閱讀測驗中，常與 poverty line (貧窮線) 或 cycle of poverty (貧窮循環) 等固定搭配連用。","senses":[{"sense":"貧窮；貧困（缺乏基本生活需求）","entries":[{"pattern":"live in poverty","pos":"noun","translation":"生活在貧窮中","explanation":"描述一個人或一群人缺乏金錢與資源的生存狀態。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many families in the remote mountain village still <target>live</target> <pattern>in poverty</pattern>, without access to clean water or proper electricity.","translation":"偏遠山村的許多家庭仍然生活在貧窮之中，無法獲得乾淨的水或適當的電力。"},{"sentence":"The government is trying to provide more education and job training to help people escape the <target>poverty</target> they have suffered for years.","translation":"政府正試圖提供更多教育和職業訓練，以幫助人們擺脫他們多年來遭受的貧困。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"indigence","pos":"noun","translation":"極貧","explanation":"較正式且程度更深的貧窮。"},{"word":"destitution","pos":"noun","translation":"赤貧","explanation":"強調完全沒有資源，甚至無法生存。"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"wealth","pos":"noun","translation":"財富","explanation":null},{"word":"affluence","pos":"noun","translation":"富裕","explanation":"強調資源豐富且生活優渥。"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"形容詞 poor 加上名詞字尾 -ty","related":[{"word":"poor","pos":"adjective","translation":"貧窮的；糟糕的","explanation":"核心形容詞型態。"}]}}

{"headword":"powder","explanation":"「powder」在學測中主要出現在科學實驗、美容產品或日常物品描述中。要注意它既可以作為名詞（粉末）也可以作為動詞（塗粉）。","senses":[{"sense":"粉末（極細小的顆粒物質）","entries":[{"pattern":"powder","pos":"noun","translation":"粉末","explanation":"指任何細小顆粒形式的物質，如面粉、藥粉或化妝品。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The chemist carefully weighed the white <target>powder</target> in the lab and mixed it with water to create a chemical reaction.","translation":"化學家在實驗室中小心地稱量白色粉末，並將其與水混合以產生化學反應。"},{"sentence":"Many athletes use a special <target>powder</target> on their hands to keep them dry and get a better grip on the equipment.","translation":"許多運動員在手上使用特殊的粉末，以保持乾燥並在操作設備時獲得更好的抓握力。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"dust","pos":"noun","translation":"灰塵；粉塵","explanation":"通常指不需要的、細小的顆粒物。"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"塗粉；將…磨成粉（使之成為粉末狀）","entries":[{"pattern":"powder sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"將某物磨成粉","explanation":"指將固體物質物理地轉化為粉末狀。","sentences":[{"sentence":"To make the cake, you should first <target>powder</target> the almonds into a fine dust before mixing them with the sugar.","translation":"為了製作蛋糕，由於你應該先將杏仁磨成細粉，然後再將它們與糖混合。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"grind","pos":"verb","translation":"研磨","explanation":"使用壓力或摩擦力將東西磨碎。"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"powdered","past_participle":"powdered"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"precious","explanation":"「precious」在學測中常用於描述極具價值的物品（如金鑽）或極其珍貴的時間、生命與情感。注意其在特定語境下也可帶有諷刺意味，指某人過分地保護某物。","senses":[{"sense":"珍貴的；寶貴的（價值極高或情感深厚）","entries":[{"pattern":"precious metal / stone","pos":"adjective","translation":"貴金屬／寶石","explanation":"描述具有高經濟價值的物質，常用於歷史、地理或藝術類文章中。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The ancient temple was decorated with <target>precious</target> <pattern>metals</pattern> and colorful stones that had been brought from far-away lands.","translation":"這座古廟裝飾著從遙遠土地運來的貴金屬和彩色寶石。"}]},{"pattern":"precious time / memory","pos":"adjective","translation":"寶貴的時間／回憶","explanation":"描述抽象的價值，強調時間的有限性或回憶的不可替代性。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Since the final exam is only two weeks away, students should not waste their <target>precious</target> <pattern>time</pattern> on mindless scrolling through social media.","translation":"由於期末考只剩兩週，學生不應該將寶貴的時間浪費在漫無目的地刷社群媒體上。"},{"sentence":"Looking at old family photographs always brings back <target>precious</target> <pattern>memories</pattern> of the summers we spent together in the countryside.","translation":"看著舊的家庭照片總是能喚起我們一起在鄉下度過的夏天那些寶貴的回憶。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"valuable","pos":"adjective","translation":"有價值的","explanation":"最通用的詞彙，可用於經濟或抽象價值"},{"word":"priceless","pos":"adjective","translation":"無價的","explanation":"強調價值高到無法用金錢衡量"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"worthless","pos":"adjective","translation":"毫無價值的","explanation":null}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 prec (價值、價格) + 字尾 -ious (形容詞)","related":[{"word":"price","pos":"noun","translation":"價格","explanation":"基礎核心詞彙。"}]}}

{"headword":"preparation","explanation":"「preparation」在學測中常見於描述準備過程（如考試準備、心理準備）或在化學/藥學語境下指代「製劑」。重點在於掌握其常見的搭配名詞與介系詞（如 make preparations for）。","senses":[{"sense":"準備；籌備（為了達成某目標而進行的先前行動）","entries":[{"pattern":"make preparations for sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"為某事做準備","explanation":"常見的動詞搭配，強調準備的過程與行動。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The city government began to <pattern>make</pattern> <target>preparations</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the upcoming international festival to ensure that all visitors would feel welcome.","translation":"市政府開始為即將到來的國際節慶做準備，以確保所有訪客都能感受到歡迎。"}]},{"pattern":"in preparation for sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"為了準備某事","explanation":"介系詞片語，通常作為狀語，交代行動的目的。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The athlete spent six months training hard <pattern>in</pattern> <target>preparation</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the Olympic Games, focusing on both strength and endurance.","translation":"這名運動員花六個月辛苦訓練以準備奧運會，重點在於力量與耐力的提升。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"arrangement","pos":"noun","translation":"準備；安排","explanation":"更傾向於組織與時間上的安排"},{"word":"readiness","pos":"noun","translation":"準備就緒的狀態","explanation":"強調結果而非過程"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"製劑；準備物（化學或藥物組成物）","entries":[{"pattern":"a chemical / medicinal preparation","pos":"noun","translation":"化學／藥物製劑","explanation":"出現在科學類閱讀文章中，指經過處理而製成的物質。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The scientist carefully mixed the two liquids to create a special chemical <target>preparation</target> that could detect the presence of rare gases.","translation":"科學家小心地將兩種液體混合，以製造一種能偵測稀有氣體的特殊化學製劑。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"動詞 prepare + 名詞字尾 -ation","related":[{"word":"prepare","pos":"verb","translation":"準備","explanation":"核心基礎動詞。"},{"word":"preparatory","pos":"adjective","translation":"準備的；預備的","explanation":"常用於描述 preparatory school (預備學校)。"}]}}

{"headword":"presence","explanation":"「presence」在學測中主要區分「在場/出席」與「風範/氣場」兩種語意。前者在社交或法律語境中高頻，後者則出現在人物描寫中。","senses":[{"sense":"出席；在場（物理上的存在）","entries":[{"pattern":"in the presence of sb./sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"在…面前；在…在場的情況下","explanation":"固定片語，常用於描述在他人監督或陪伴下進行某事。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The witness felt very nervous and could barely speak <pattern>in</pattern> the <target>presence</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the judge and the lawyers.","translation":"證人感到非常緊張，在法官和律師面前幾乎無法說話。"}]},{"pattern":"a strong presence","pos":"noun","translation":"強大的存在感（或市場佔有率）","explanation":"可用於描述人或公司在特定領域的影響力。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The tech company has established a strong <target>presence</target> in the Asian market by opening several large offices in Taipei and Tokyo.","translation":"這家科技公司透過在台北和東京開設數個大型辦公室，在亞洲市場建立起了強大的存在感。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"attendance","pos":"noun","translation":"出席","explanation":"強調參與某活動的行為"},{"word":"existence","pos":"noun","translation":"存在","explanation":"泛指事物存在的狀態"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"absence","pos":"noun","translation":"缺席；不存在","explanation":null}]},{"sense":"風範；氣場（給人留下的深刻印象）","entries":[{"pattern":"a commanding presence","pos":"noun","translation":"威嚴的氣場","explanation":"描述一個人具有領導力或讓人敬畏的特質。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Even before she started speaking, the experienced professor had a commanding <target>presence</target> that made every student in the room listen carefully.","translation":"甚至在她開始說話之前，這位經驗豐富的教授就擁有一種威嚴的氣場，讓教室裡的每個學生都專注聆聽。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"形容詞 present + 名詞字尾 -ence","related":[{"word":"present","pos":"adjective","translation":"在場的；目前的","explanation":"核心基礎形容詞。"},{"word":"presentation","pos":"noun","translation":"簡報；呈現","explanation":"由 present (呈現) 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"pretend","explanation":"「pretend」在學測中主要用於描述孩童的想像遊戲或成年人的偽裝行為。注意其後方接續的結構（如 pretend to be / pretend that），是文法考點。","senses":[{"sense":"假裝；偽裝（故意使人相信非真實之事）","entries":[{"pattern":"pretend to be sth./sb.","pos":"verb","translation":"假裝成…","explanation":"後接不定詞，描述偽裝的身份或狀態。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The little boy loved to <target>pretend</target> <pattern>to</pattern> <pattern>be</pattern> a brave astronaut exploring a distant planet in his backyard.","translation":"這個小男孩喜歡假裝成一名勇敢的太空人，在自家後院探索遙遠的行星。"}]},{"pattern":"pretend (that) ...","pos":"verb","translation":"假裝…（後接子句）","explanation":"後接名詞子句，描述假裝的具體內容。","sentences":[{"sentence":"When the teacher entered the classroom, the students quickly <target>pretended</target> <pattern>that</pattern> they were studying hard, even though they had been chatting.","translation":"當老師走進教室時，學生們趕快假裝自己在努力學習，儘管他們之前一直在聊天。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"fake","pos":"verb","translation":"偽造；假裝","explanation":"口語且強烈，常用於描述偽造證件或情感"},{"word":"simulate","pos":"verb","translation":"模擬","explanation":"常用於科技或科學實驗語境"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"be honest","pos":"adjective","translation":"誠實的","explanation":"指不掩蓋事實"}]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"pretended","past_participle":"pretended"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字首 pre- (預先) + 字根 tend (伸展、傾向)","related":[{"word":"tendency","pos":"noun","translation":"傾向","explanation":"由 tend (傾向) 延伸而來。"},{"word":"extend","pos":"verb","translation":"延伸；擴展","explanation":"字首 ex- (向外) + 字根 tend (伸展)。"}]}}

{"headword":"prevent","explanation":"「prevent」是學測極高頻的動詞，最核心的考點在於其固定搭配：prevent sb. from doing sth.。學生必須對此結構完整記憶，以免在填空題中遺漏介系詞 from 或將其誤用為不定詞。","senses":[{"sense":"防止；阻止（使某事不發生或使某人不能做某事）","entries":[{"pattern":"prevent sb. from doing sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"阻止某人做某事","explanation":"這是學測最熱門的文法結構。注意 from 是介系詞，後面必須接動名詞 (V-ing) 或名詞。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The heavy rain and strong wind <target>prevented</target> the tourists <pattern>from</pattern> <pattern>visiting</pattern> the mountain temple this morning.","translation":"大雨和強風阻止了遊客們今天早上參訪山上的寺廟。"},{"sentence":"To protect the environment, the government has passed a new law to <target>prevent</target> companies <pattern>from</pattern> <pattern>dumping</pattern> waste into the river.","translation":"為了保護環境，政府通過了一項新法律，以防止公司將廢棄物排放到河流中。"}]},{"pattern":"prevent sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"防止某事發生","explanation":"及物動詞直接接受詞，受詞通常是天災、事故或疾病。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Regular exercise and a balanced diet can help <target>prevent</target> many serious heart diseases in the long run.","translation":"長期的規律運動和均衡飲食有助於防止許多嚴重的心臟疾病。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"stop","pos":"verb","translation":"停止；阻止","explanation":"最基礎的通用詞彙"},{"word":"hinder","pos":"verb","translation":"妨礙；阻礙","explanation":"強調使事情進展緩慢或困難"},{"word":"word","pos":"verb","translation":"阻礙","explanation":"雖然是同義詞，但在學測中 hinder 更常用"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"allow","pos":"verb","translation":"允許","explanation":null},{"word":"permit","pos":"verb","translation":"允許","explanation":"較正式，常用於法律或規定"}]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"prevented","past_participle":"prevented"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字首 pre- (預先) + 字根 vent (來)","related":[{"word":"event","pos":"noun","translation":"事件","explanation":"由字根 vent (來) 延伸而來。"},{"word":"invent","pos":"verb","translation":"發明","explanation":"字首 in- (進入) + 字根 vent (來)。"}]}}

{"headword":"promote","explanation":"「promote」在學測中具有多重語意，最常見的是「晉升」與「推廣」。在描述公司管理或行銷活動時使用 promote，能讓學生在寫作中將其與 push 或 sell 區分開來，提升文章的層次感。","senses":[{"sense":"推廣；促進（使某事發展或變得更好）","entries":[{"pattern":"promote sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"促進；推廣某事","explanation":"及物動詞，受詞通常是健康、和平、發展或新產品。常用於描述政策或行銷。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The school decided to <target>promote</target> a healthy lifestyle by providing free fresh fruit to all students during lunch.","translation":"學校決定透過在午餐時間為所有學生提供免費新鮮水果來促進健康生活方式。"},{"sentence":"To <target>promote</target> international peace, the two countries agreed to increase cultural exchange programs for university students.","translation":"為了促進國際和平，這兩個國家同意增加大學生的文化交流計畫。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"encourage","pos":"verb","translation":"鼓勵；促進","explanation":"強調使某事更有可能發生"},{"word":"advance","pos":"verb","translation":"推進；促進","explanation":"強調進步"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"hinder","pos":"verb","translation":"阻礙","explanation":"指使事情進展緩慢"},{"word":"block","pos":"verb","translation":"阻擋","explanation":"指完全停止進展"}]},{"sense":"晉升；升職（提升職位或等級）","entries":[{"pattern":"promote sb. to sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"將某人晉升為…","explanation":"常用於描述職涯發展。注意 preposition to 表示方向與目標。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After three years of hard work and great results, the manager <target>promoted</target> him <pattern>to</pattern> head of the sales department.","translation":"經過三年的努力工作並取得極佳結果，經理將他晉升為銷售部門的主管。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"elevate","pos":"verb","translation":"提升；提高","explanation":"較為正式的用詞"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"demote","pos":"verb","translation":"降職","explanation":"與 promote 完全相反的詞彙"}]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"promoted","past_participle":"promoted"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字首 pro- (向前) + 字根 mot (移動)","related":[{"word":"promotion","pos":"noun","translation":"晉升；促銷","explanation":"由動詞 promote 加上名詞字尾 -tion 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"pronounce","explanation":"「pronounce」在學測中主要出現於「發音」與「正式宣告」兩種語境。前者在口說或語言學習話題中常見，後者則在法律或醫療診斷話題中出現，需注意其正式程度。","senses":[{"sense":"發音（說出單字或句子的方式）","entries":[{"pattern":"pronounce sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"發音","explanation":"及物動詞，指說出一個單字、字母或語言的方式。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Since the word is very long and complex, the teacher asked the student to <target>pronounce</target> it slowly and clearly.","translation":"因為這個單字非常長且複雜，老師要求學生緩慢且清晰地發音。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"正式宣告（法律、醫療或正式場合的判定）","entries":[{"pattern":"pronounce sb. adj.","pos":"verb","translation":"宣布某人為…","explanation":"正式判定某人處於某種狀態（如：死亡、合格、無辜）。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After checking the patient's heart for several minutes, the doctor <target>pronounced</target> him <pattern>dead</pattern> at six o'clock.","translation":"在檢查了病人的心臟幾分鐘後，醫生在六點鐘宣布他死亡。"},{"sentence":"The judge <target>pronounced</target> the man <pattern>guilty</pattern> of the crime after reading the final evidence in the court.","translation":"法官在法庭上閱讀完最終證據後，宣布該男子犯有罪行。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"declare","pos":"verb","translation":"宣布；聲明","explanation":"最接近的通用同義詞"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"pronounced","past_participle":"pronounced"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字首 pro- (向前/向外) + 字根 nounce (說/宣告)","related":[{"word":"pronunciation","pos":"noun","translation":"發音","explanation":"注意發音與動詞 pronounce 的拼寫不同，中間的 o 消失了。"}]}}

{"headword":"proof","explanation":"「proof」在學測中作為名詞時指「證據」，作為形容詞時指「防止…的（如 waterproof）」。學生應重點關注其作為名詞時的搭配，以及其作為形容詞後綴時的構成方式。","senses":[{"sense":"證據；證明（名詞）","entries":[{"pattern":"proof of sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"…的證據","explanation":"指用來證明某事真實或正確的實體證據或邏輯證明。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The police found a small piece of cloth at the scene, which served as clear <target>proof</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the thief's identity.","translation":"警察在現場發現了一小塊布料，這成了證明小偷身分之明確證據。"},{"sentence":"The scientist spent three years doing experiments to find solid <target>proof</target> <pattern>of</pattern> climate change in the Arctic.","translation":"科學家花了三年時間做實驗，以尋找北極氣候變遷的堅實證據。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"evidence","pos":"noun","translation":"證據","explanation":"最常用的同義詞，通常為不可數名詞"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"防止…的；耐…的（形容詞後綴）","entries":[{"pattern":"adj. + proof","pos":"adjective","translation":"防止…的；耐…的","explanation":"當 proof 作為後綴時，表示該物體能抵抗某種外部力量（如水、火、子彈）。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Because the mountains are often rainy, the hikers decided to wear water<target>proof</target> jackets to keep their clothes dry.","translation":"因為山區經常下雨，因此登山客決定穿上防水夾克，以保持衣服乾燥。"},{"sentence":"The company created a bullet<target>proof</target> glass for the president, ensuring he remains safe during his public speech.","translation":"公司為總統製作了一款防彈玻璃，確保他在公開演講期間保持安全。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 proof (證明/防禦)","related":[{"word":"prove","pos":"verb","translation":"證明","explanation":"對應的動詞型態。"}]}}

{"headword":"react","explanation":"「react」在學測中是極高頻的動詞，涵蓋了心理、化學、物理上的「反應」。學生必須區分其後方接續的介系詞 to，表示對某事做出反應，以及其在科學類文章中指代化學反應。","senses":[{"sense":"做出反應；回應（對某種刺激或情況做出行動）","entries":[{"pattern":"react to sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"對某事做出反應","explanation":"最常用的搭配。to 是介系詞，後方接名詞或動名詞。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The teacher was surprised by how the students <target>reacted</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the new school rule about using smartphones in class.","translation":"老師對學生們如何反應於這項關於在課堂上使用智慧型手機的新校規感到驚訝。"},{"sentence":"Many people <target>react</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the cold weather by wearing thicker clothes and staying inside their warm houses.","translation":"許多人透過穿著更厚實的衣服並留在溫暖的家中，來對寒冷的天氣做出反應。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"respond","pos":"verb","translation":"回應；反應","explanation":"更正式的詞彙，強調對刺激的回答或回應"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"（化學上）產生反應","entries":[{"pattern":"react with sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"與某物產生（化學）反應","explanation":"用於化學類文章，指兩者結合或改變性質。","sentences":[{"sentence":"In the chemistry lab, the teacher showed us how baking soda <target>reacts</target> <pattern>with</pattern> vinegar to create bubbles.","translation":"在化學實驗室裡，老師向我們展示了小蘇打如何與醋產生反應而產生氣泡。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"reacted","past_participle":"reacted"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 react (反饋、反應) + 字尾 -ion / -ive","related":[{"word":"reaction","pos":"noun","translation":"反應","explanation":"由動詞 react 加上名詞字尾 -ion 延伸而來。"},{"word":"reactive","pos":"adjective","translation":"反應迅速的；化學活性強的","explanation":"由動詞 react 加上形容詞字尾 -ive 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"reaction","explanation":"「reaction」作為名詞，是「react」的衍生詞。在學測中，它不僅指生理上的反應，更常用於描述對某個計畫、新聞或決定之「反饋」或「社會反應」。","senses":[{"sense":"反應；回應（對刺激或消息的行為、情感反應）","entries":[{"pattern":"reaction to sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"對某事的反應","explanation":"常搭配介系詞 to，用以指明反應的對象。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The students' <target>reaction</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the surprise party was wonderful, as they all jumped for joy and cheered.","translation":"學生們對驚喜派對的反應太棒了，他們全部跳起來歡呼。"},{"sentence":"The government's <target>reaction</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the oil spill was too slow, which made many citizens angry.","translation":"政府對漏油事故的反應太慢，導致許多市民感到憤怒。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"response","pos":"noun","translation":"回應；答覆","explanation":"泛指對某事做出回應的行為"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"（化學）反應","entries":[{"pattern":"chemical reaction","pos":"noun","translation":"化學反應","explanation":"指兩者或多個物質結合並產生新物質的過程。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The science teacher explained that a <target>reaction</target> <pattern>between</pattern> two different chemicals creates heat and light.","translation":"科學老師解釋說，兩種不同的化學物質之間的反應會產生熱量和光線。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 react (反應) + 名詞字尾 -ion","related":[{"word":"react","pos":"verb","translation":"做出反應","explanation":"核心基礎動詞型態。"}]}}

{"headword":"reasonable","explanation":"「reasonable」在學測中具有兩種極高頻的語意：一是指價格「合理、適中」，二是指行為或要求「合情合理、理智」。在閱讀中需根據上下文判斷是涉及金錢交易還是邏輯推論。","senses":[{"sense":"合理地；理智的（指思考方式、要求或價格符合常理）","entries":[{"pattern":"a reasonable price","pos":"adjective","translation":"合理的價格","explanation":"指價格不高且符合市場價值，常用於購物或旅遊情境的對話。","sentences":[{"sentence":"While the hotel was located in the city center, its room rates were surprisingly <target>reasonable</target>, making it a great choice for students.","translation":"雖然這家飯店位於市中心，但其房價出乎意料地合理，使其成為學生的絕佳選擇。"},{"sentence":"The street market is famous for selling high-quality handmade clothes at a <target>reasonable</target> <pattern>price</pattern>, attracting many young tourists.","translation":"這個街頭市場以價格合理地銷售高品質手工服裝而聞名，吸引了許多年輕遊客。"}]},{"pattern":"be reasonable","pos":"adjective","translation":"合情合理；理智","explanation":"描述人的行為或提出的要求不極端，可以被接受。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Although the two teammates had a huge argument, they eventually became <target>reasonable</target> and agreed to share the work equally.","translation":"儘管這兩位隊友發生了激烈的爭執，但他們最終變得理智，並同意平分工作量。"},{"sentence":"The teacher's request for the students to submit their reports by Friday was <target>reasonable</target>, as they had two full weeks to prepare.","translation":"老師要求學生在週五前提交報告的要求是合情合理的，因為他們有整整兩週的時間準備。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"fair","pos":"adjective","translation":"公平的；合理的","explanation":"最通用且對應的同義詞"},{"word":"logical","pos":"adjective","translation":"邏輯通順的","explanation":"強調思考過程符合邏輯"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"unreasonable","pos":"adjective","translation":"不合理的；無理的","explanation":null},{"word":"excessive","pos":"adjective","translation":"過多的；過高的","explanation":"常用於描述價格過高"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 reason (理由) + 形容詞字尾 -able (可...的)","related":[{"word":"reason","pos":"noun","translation":"理由；原因","explanation":"核心基礎名詞"},{"word":"reasonably","pos":"adverb","translation":"合理地；相當地","explanation":"副詞形式，常用於修飾形容詞"}]}}

{"headword":"receipt","explanation":"「receipt」在學測中主要作為名詞使用，最常見的是指購物後的「收據」。另外在較正式的文書中，可能指「收到某物」的動作或狀態。","senses":[{"sense":"收據；發票（證明已付款的憑證）","entries":[{"pattern":"keep the receipt","pos":"noun","translation":"保留收據","explanation":"常見於購物情境，強調為了之後可能的退貨或保固而保留憑證。","sentences":[{"sentence":"If you want to return the broken lamp to the store, you must <pattern>keep</pattern> the <target>receipt</target> to prove that you bought it there.","translation":"如果你想將損壞的燈具退回商店，你必須保留收據以證明你在那裡購買。"},{"sentence":"The cashier handed me a long <target>receipt</target> after I paid for the groceries, but I accidentally dropped it in the parking lot.","translation":"在我支付雜貨費用後，收銀員遞給我一張長長的收據，但我意外地把它掉在停車場了。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"voucher","pos":"noun","translation":"憑證；代金券","explanation":"較寬泛的證明文件"},{"word":"bill","pos":"noun","translation":"帳單","explanation":"指付款前需要支付的金額"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"收到（某物）的行為或狀態","entries":[{"pattern":"upon receipt of sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"一收到…就…","explanation":"正式用法，常用於商務信件或官方通知，表示時間點。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The company will send the official invitation to your home <pattern>upon</pattern> <target>receipt</target> <pattern>of</pattern> your application form.","translation":"公司在收到您的申請表後，將會把正式邀請函寄到您的家中。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"來自動詞 receive (收到) 的名詞形式","related":[{"word":"receive","pos":"verb","translation":"收到；接獲","explanation":"核心動詞"},{"word":"receiver","pos":"noun","translation":"接收者；接收器","explanation":"由 receive 加上 -er 延伸而來"}]}}

{"headword":"recorder","explanation":"「recorder」在學測中具有多重意義，最常見的是指音樂課上的「直笛」或電子設備的「錄音機」。在閱讀中需注意其在特定情境（如音樂或科技）中的詞義。","senses":[{"sense":"直笛（一種木管樂器）","entries":[{"pattern":"recorder","pos":"noun","translation":"直笛","explanation":"出現在音樂課或學校生活描述中。","sentences":[{"sentence":"In the first grade of music class, most children are taught how to play the <target>recorder</target> because it is easy to learn.","translation":"在音樂課的一年級，大多數孩子都被教如何吹直笛，因為它很容易學習。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"錄音機；紀錄器（記錄聲音、數據的設備）","entries":[{"pattern":"voice recorder","pos":"noun","translation":"錄音機","explanation":"指記錄聲音的電子設備。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The journalist used a small digital <target>recorder</target> to capture every word of the interview with the famous scientist.","translation":"記者使用一台小型數位錄音機來捕捉與這位著名科學家訪談的的每一個字。"},{"sentence":"The aircraft's black box is actually a flight <target>recorder</target> that stores important data to help experts find the cause of the crash.","translation":"飛機的黑盒子實際上是一個飛行紀錄器，儲存重要數據以幫助專家找到墜機原因。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"來自動詞 record (紀錄) 的名詞形式 (物)","related":[{"word":"record","pos":"noun","translation":"紀錄；紀錄片","explanation":"核心基礎名詞"},{"word":"record","pos":"verb","translation":"紀錄；錄音","explanation":"核心基礎動詞"}]}}

{"headword":"rectangle","explanation":"「rectangle」是基礎幾何學名詞，在學測的圖表分析或數學描述類文章中偶爾出現。重點在於區分其與 square（正方形）的定義差異，即長寬不等。","senses":[{"sense":"長方形","entries":[{"pattern":"rectangle","pos":"noun","translation":"長方形","explanation":"指四個角均為直角且對邊相等的平面圖形。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The teacher asked the students to draw a perfect <target>rectangle</target> on their paper using a ruler to ensure the lines were straight.","translation":"老師要求學生用尺在紙上畫一個完美的長方形，以確保線條是直的。"},{"sentence":"The large projection screen in the school auditorium is a giant <target>rectangle</target> that allows everyone to see the presentation clearly.","translation":"學校禮堂的大型投影螢幕是一個巨大的長方形，讓每個人都能清晰地看到簡報。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 rect (直) + 字尾 -angle (角)","related":[{"word":"rectangular","pos":"adjective","translation":"長方形的","explanation":"由名詞 rectangle 加上形容詞字尾 -ar 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"reduce","explanation":"「reduce」是學測高頻動詞，常用於描述數量、程度、價格或壓力等「減少」的狀態。在寫作中，可用於替代 simple 減少，提升文章的專業感。","senses":[{"sense":"減少；降低（數量、程度、價格或壓力）","entries":[{"pattern":"reduce sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"減少某事","explanation":"及物動詞，直接接受詞，如減少污染、減少成本或降低壓力。","sentences":[{"sentence":"To protect the environment, the local government decided to <target>reduce</target> the amount of plastic waste produced by the city's restaurants.","translation":"為了保護環境，當地政府決定減少城市餐廳所產生的塑料垃圾量。"},{"sentence":"Many students try to <target>reduce</target> their daily stress by practicing meditation or taking short walks in the park after school.","translation":"許多學生試圖透過練習冥想或在放學後在公園散步來減輕他們的日常壓力。"}]},{"pattern":"reduce sth. to sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"將某事減少到…","explanation":"用來精確描述減少後的最終狀態或量級。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The heavy rain and strong winds <target>reduced</target> the forest <pattern>to</pattern> a pile of broken trees and mud, leaving the animals homeless.","translation":"暴雨和強風將森林減少（簡化）成一堆斷樹和泥土，使動物們失去了家園。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"decrease","pos":"verb","translation":"減少","explanation":"最通用的減少"},{"word":"diminish","pos":"verb","translation":"減少；削弱","explanation":"強調數量或影響力逐漸變小"},{"word":"curtail","pos":"verb","translation":"縮減；限制","explanation":"常用於縮減預算或權力"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"increase","pos":"verb","translation":"增加","explanation":null},{"word":"expand","pos":"verb","translation":"擴張","explanation":null}]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"reduced","past_participle":"reduced"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字首 re- (向後/再次) + 字根 duc (引導/拉)","related":[{"word":"reduction","pos":"noun","translation":"減少；降低","explanation":"由動詞 reduce 加上名詞字尾 -tion 延伸而來。"},{"word":"reducible","pos":"adjective","translation":"可減少的","explanation":"由動詞 reduce 加上形容詞字尾 -ible 延伸而來。"}]}}
